name: CardputerDict 中英离线词典
description:
## CardputerDict 中英离线词典

适用于普通 M5Stack Cardputer（ESP32-S3、8 MB Flash），支持英汉 / 汉英双向查词、离线整词全拼和逐字输入，无需联网。

### 功能
- 英汉：770,611 个英文词头；汉英：198,650 个简繁体词头。
- 85,610 种整词拼音组合，支持 pingguo → 苹果、nihao → 你好；v 代表 ü。
- 中文和 IPA 音标显示，释义翻页；单行紧凑候选、数字选词。
- SD 索引自动缓存：首次生成后，实测软件重启约 1.32 秒进入界面（随 SD 卡而异）。

### 首次使用：必须准备 SD 词库
固件内仅带 29 词演示；完整词库不包含在 .bin 内。请下载项目源码 ZIP，将其中 sdcard/ 里面的 dictionaries/ 和 licenses/ 两个目录复制到 FAT32 microSD 卡根目录，关机后插卡再开机。首次会建立索引缓存，之后快速启动。

- [项目与完整说明](https://github.com/RadioDisney/CardputerDict)
- [SD 词库目录](https://github.com/RadioDisney/CardputerDict/tree/master/sdcard)
- 在 GitHub 点击 Code → Download ZIP，即可取得词库；也可使用项目 tools/upload_sd.py 通过 USB 安装。

### 按键
- Tab：英汉 / 汉英切换，同时清空输入。
- Enter：打开词条；拼音未选入时先选首项。
- 空格、1–9：选择当前页拼音候选；[ / ]：候选前后翻页。
- 释义页 Space 下一页；Fn+; 或 Fn+, 上一页；Fn+. 或 Fn+/ 下一页。
- Fn+; / Fn+.：列表上下选择，超出可见区域自动滚动。
- Backspace：删除字符；释义页返回。反引号键：返回 / 取消输入。
- Fn+Backspace：清空；Fn+H / G0：帮助；Fn+D：切换词库。
- Fn+R：重新加载 SD 缓存；Fn+Shift+R：强制完整校验并重建缓存。

### 烧录与兼容
这是从 0x0 烧录的完整合并固件，包含 bootloader、分区表、初始化数据和应用。已在普通 Cardputer 实机验证；Cardputer ADV 未验证，请勿选为该设备固件。烧录会替换现有应用；microSD 上的其他文件不会随烧录删除。

### 数据来源与许可
应用及原创演示代码：MIT。英汉数据来自 ECDICT（MIT）；汉英及词组拼音数据改编自 MDBG / CC-CEDICT，按 CC BY-SA 4.0 分发；逐字拼音来自 mozillazg/pinyin-data（MIT）。字体及依赖分别遵循各自许可。来源、修改说明和完整许可保留于项目 third_party/ 与 sdcard/licenses/。

当前不含语音、整句联想、自动词形还原；生僻字仍受字体覆盖限制。支持未压缩、UTF-8 纯文本 StarDict。
author: RadioDisney
description_en:
## CardputerDict Chinese-English offline dictionary

Applicable to ordinary M5Stack Cardputer (ESP32-S3, 8 MB Flash), supports English-Chinese/Chinese-English two-way word search, offline whole word spelling and word-by-word input, no need to be connected to the Internet.

### Function
- English-Chinese: 770,611 English prefixes; Chinese-English: 198,650 simplified and traditional Chinese prefixes.
- 85,610 pinyin combinations of whole words, supporting pingguo → apple, nihao → hello; v stands for ü.
- Chinese and IPA phonetic symbols are displayed, and the meanings are flipped; single-line compact candidates and digital word selection.
- SD index automatic caching: After the first generation, the measured software restarts and enters the interface in about 1.32 seconds (varies with the SD card).

### First time use: SD dictionary must be prepared
Only a 29-word demo is included with the firmware; the full vocabulary is not included in the .bin. Please download the project source code ZIP, copy the dictionaries/ and licenses/ directories in sdcard/ to the root directory of the FAT32 microSD card, shut down the computer, insert the card and then turn it on again. The index cache will be created for the first time and will start quickly thereafter.

- [Project and full description](https://github.com/RadioDisney/CardputerDict)
- [SD dictionary directory](https://github.com/RadioDisney/CardputerDict/tree/master/sdcard)
- Click Code → Download ZIP on GitHub to get the dictionary; you can also use the project tools/upload_sd.py to install it via USB.

### Button
- Tab: Switch between English-Chinese/Chinese-English and clear the input at the same time.
- Enter: Open the entry; if the pinyin is not selected, select the first item first.
- Space, 1–9: Select the Pinyin candidate of the current page; [ / ]: Turn pages before and after the candidates.
- Definition page Space next page; Fn+; or Fn+, previous page; Fn+. or Fn+/ next page.
- Fn+; / Fn+.: Select up and down the list, and automatically scroll beyond the visible area.
- Backspace: Delete characters; return to the interpretation page. Backtick key: return/cancel input.
- Fn+Backspace: Clear; Fn+H / G0: Help; Fn+D: Switch thesaurus.
- Fn+R: Reload the SD cache; Fn+Shift+R: Force a full check and rebuild the cache.

### Burning and Compatibility
This is a complete merged firmware burned from 0x0, including bootloader, partition table, initialization data and applications. It has been verified on ordinary Cardputer actual machines; Cardputer ADV has not been verified, please do not select this device firmware. Burning will replace existing applications; other files on the microSD will not be deleted with burning.

### Data sources and permissions
Application and original demo code: MIT. English-Chinese data comes from ECDICT (MIT); Chinese-English and phrase pinyin data are adapted from MDBG/CC-CEDICT, distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0; word-by-word pinyin comes from mozillazg/pinyin-data (MIT). Fonts and dependencies are subject to their respective licenses. Source, modification notes and full license remain in the project third_party/ and sdcard/licenses/.

Currently it does not include pronunciation, whole sentence association, and automatic lemmatization; rare characters are still limited by font coverage. Supports uncompressed, UTF-8 plain text StarDict.

CardputerOS 2.4 is a split-mode all-in-one firmware for the M5Stack Cardputer that turns it into both a multimedia handheld and a wireless field toolkit.
It has two boot modes:

name: Cardputer监控固件-v2.0
description:
================================================================
  CAM VIEW  ——  M5 Cardputer 摄像头观看器  固件 v2.0
================================================================
  适用硬件：M5Stack Cardputer ADV（ESP32-S3 / 8MB Flash / 240x135 屏）
  配套软件：电脑端「摄像头局域网直播」包（另一个压缩包）
================================================================


【一、这是什么】

把 Cardputer 变成一个随身监视器：
开机连上 WiFi → 用键盘敲电脑的 IP → 屏幕直接显示电脑摄像头的画面。

它看的是电脑端 8090 端口的 MJPEG 流：

       或 GitHub espressif/esptool 的 releases 里也有）
  2. 打开工具 → ChipType 选 ESP32-S3 → WorkMode 选 Develop → OK
  3. 按下面填：

description_en:
================================================================
CAM VIEW - M5 Cardputer Camera Viewer Firmware v2.0
================================================================
Applicable hardware: M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3 / 8MB Flash / 240x135 screen)
Supporting software: PC "Camera LAN Live Broadcast" package (another compressed package)
================================================================


[1. What is this]

Turn Cardputer into a portable monitor:
Turn on the computer and connect to WiFi → type the IP address of the computer with the keyboard → the screen will directly display the image of the computer camera.

It looks at the MJPEG stream on port 8090 on the computer:
480x270 JPEG, 10 fps, ~7 KB per frame, ~0.3 sec latency

The mobile phone/tablet side is not affected. You can still scan the QR code to view the web page on port 8889. Both channels work at the same time.


[2. Load the firmware (only once)]

The compiled entire firmware has been included in the package: firmware\camview-v2.0-8MB.bin
Choose one of the following three methods. Method A is recommended.

─────────────────────────────────────────────
Method A: Burning with graphic tools (easiest)
─────────────────────────────────────────────
1. Download Espressif’s official tool ESP32 Flash Download Tool
(Search "flash_download_tool", official website dl.espressif.com
Or it’s also available in the releases of GitHub espressif/esptool)
2. Open the tool → ChipType and select ESP32-S3 → WorkMode and select Develop → OK
3. Fill in the following:
File: firmware\camview-v2.0-8MB.bin
Address: 0x0 (note it is 0x0, not 0x1000)
Check the box for that row
       SPI SPEED：80MHz
       SPI MODE ：DIO
       FLASH SIZE：8MB
4. Select the COM port (it will appear after the device is connected to USB-C, driver-free for Windows 10/11)
5. Click START and wait for the progress bar to finish (about 40 seconds). When FINISH appears, it is successful.
6. Unplug the USB and power on again

─────────────────────────────────────────────
Method B: Command line (if esptool is installed)
─────────────────────────────────────────────
  esptool.exe --chip esp32s3 -p COM3 -b 460800 write_flash 0x0 camview-v2.0-8MB.bin

Replace COM3 with your actual serial port number. You can see it in Device Manager → Ports on Windows.

─────────────────────────────────────────────
Method C: Source code compilation (if you want to change it yourself)
─────────────────────────────────────────────
The source code is in the source\camview\ directory. Use Arduino IDE to open camview.ino.

Dependent libraries (versions must be consistent, otherwise they may not be compiled):
    M5Cardputer    1.1.1
    M5Unified      0.2.29
    M5GFX          0.2.36
    JPEGDEC        1.8.5
    esp32 core     3.3.12
qrcodegen comes with the source code (qrcodegen.c / qrcodegen.h, no need to install it separately)

arduino-cli installation dependencies:
    arduino-cli lib install "M5Cardputer@1.1.1"
    arduino-cli lib install "JPEGDEC@1.8.5"
    arduino-cli core install esp32:esp32@3.3.12

Development board settings (must be consistent, otherwise there is not enough memory):
Development board ESP32S3 Dev Module
    Flash Size  8MB (64Mb)
Partition plan Huge APP (3MB No OTA/1MB SPIFFS)
USB CDC On Boot Default (firmware does not rely on serial port output)

After compilation and uploading, it takes up about 37% of Flash.


[3. First time use: equipped with WiFi (only once)]

1. After booting, the screen displays "Setup Mode", indicating that the network has not been configured yet.
2. Use your mobile phone to connect to a WiFi called Cardputer-Cam (no password, there is also a QR code on the screen)
3. Open http://192.168.4.1 in the mobile browser
4. Fill in your home WiFi name and password → Save, the device will automatically restart
5. Automatically connect to the Internet after restarting and enter the address input interface.


[4. Daily use]

When "Enter PC address" appears on the screen:

1. Use the keyboard to enter the computer’s IP, for example 192.168.1.100
· No need to enter the port, the firmware will automatically fill in 8090
· What you lost last time will be automatically remembered and will be brought out next time you start the game.
2. Press Enter → Display Connecting → The screen will appear after about 2 seconds
The green number in the upper right corner is the real-time frame rate (stable 10 fps)
3. Press Esc to exit the screen and return to the input interface

Keystroke quick check (input interface)
Enter to start watching
Del backspace
Esc Clear and re-enter
Ctrl+Del Restore factory settings (clear WiFi and addresses, reset everything)

Keystroke quick check (viewing interface)
Esc to exit viewing
C Switch color mode (used when the picture has a color cast, the settings will be remembered)

The screen will automatically turn off if you don't touch the keyboard for 90 seconds, and light up if you press any key. Do not turn off the screen when watching the picture.


[5. Disconnection and self-healing]

· Turn off push streaming on the computer: reconnect #n is displayed in the upper right corner and keeps retrying.
· Re-push the stream on the computer: the screen will be automatically restored within about 3 seconds without restarting the device.
· 10 consecutive failures: Automatically reconnect to WiFi
· 40 consecutive failures: the whole machine automatically restarts (you can save yourself even if it is stuck)


【6. Frequently Asked Questions】

Q The color of the screen is wrong (blurred screen, color cast, purple color)
A Press the C key to switch the color mode. Press it once to view it and it will be remembered automatically.
Normally, the machine is correct when it leaves the factory and is generally not used.
Q keeps Connecting or shows no stream
A ① The push stream on the computer is not enabled: double-click "Start push stream.vbs"
② The IP is entered incorrectly: refer to the address in the pop-up window on the computer.
③ The computer and Cardputer are not in the same WiFi

Q There is a picture but it is frozen, and the frame rate is always 0
A Click any key on the keyboard to wake it up (the screen may be off).
If that still doesn't work, press Esc to exit and Enter to re-enter.

Q Changed WiFi password/replaced router
A Press Ctrl+Del on the input interface to restore factory settings and re-use the third part of the distribution network.

Q There are black edges on the screen/the proportion is wrong
A Normal. A 480x270 stream is scaled down to 240x135 with minimal difference.

Q How long can I watch?
A Just leave it on all the time, the power consumption is very low. Does not sleep when powered by USB (except screen).


[7. Technical Parameters]

Main control ESP32-S3 (M5Stack Cardputer ADV)
Screen 240x135 ST7789
Firmware framework Arduino + M5Cardputer 1.1.1 + JPEGDEC 1.8.5
Video source PC ffmpeg extracts frames from the live stream → 480x270 JPEG
Decoding Hardware-level JPEG decoding → write directly to screen, RGB565
Frame rate: stable 10 frames/second (speed limit on computer)
Delay approximately 0.3 seconds
Bandwidth approximately 70 KB/s
Storage WiFi and address are stored in NVS and will not be lost when power is off.

File description

Firmware\camview-v2.0-8MB.bin The entire firmware, burned to 0x0
Source code\camview\camview.ino main program
Source code\camview\qrcodegen.c/.h QR code library (for network configuration page)
README.md Project Description and License
Instructions for use.txt / .html this file

https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
Keep the original copyright statement in the source code

    https://github.com/bitbank2/JPEGDEC

The source code of this firmware can be freely used, modified, and redistributed. Please retain the above third-party copyright notice.

description:
Serial terminal software for Cardputer.
GROVE connector is as following.
 G1(Yellow) = Tx
 G2(White) = Rx
"setup.sys" file on the sd-card will be loaded as configuration.
Definition is as following.
; speed (default 9600bps)
baudrate = 115200
; delay for character sending (ms)
chardelay = 30
; delay for line sending (ms)

name: Charge Station
description:
**中文**

把 Cardputer 变成一台会告诉你「到底在不在充」的充电座。
插上电、熄屏、放一夜 —— 它只做两件事：把能省的电全省给电池，把真相画在屏幕上。

一眼看懂：橙黄 = 正在充 · 绿 = 已充满 · 红 = 接着但没电流 · 灰 = 没在充
40 分钟电压曲线 · 按任意键 3 秒读数 · 整夜记录可插回电脑回读
中英双语开机自选 · 灭屏守候 · 还有多久充满

本版新增：净充电电流估算、9 键清空整夜记录。

⚠️ 开关必须拨到 ON。OFF 是断开电池，物理上就充不进去 —— 这是「充不进电」最常见的原因 ⚠️

github.com/andjiang0083/cardputer-charge-station

---

**English**

Turn your Cardputer into a charging dock that tells you the truth.
Plug it in, let the screen go dark, leave it overnight — it does two things only: give every spare milliamp to the battery, and draw the truth on screen.

Amber = charging · Green = full · Red = plugged but no current · Grey = not charging
40-minute voltage sparkline · one key press for a 3 s readout · night-long log you can read back over USB
Bilingual UI, picked on first boot · dark-screen standby · time-to-full estimate

Now with an estimated net charge current and a one-key log clear.

⚠️ The power switch must be ON. OFF disconnects the battery — nothing can charge, no matter how good the charger ⚠️

**Chinese**

Turn Cardputer into a charging stand that will tell you whether it is charging or not.
Plug it in, turn off the screen, and leave it overnight - it only does two things: save all the energy it can save on the battery, and draw the truth on the screen.

Easy to understand at a glance: Orange = charging · Green = fully charged · Red = continuing but no current · Gray = not charging

name: ChatOFFGRID
description:
Title: Tactical Node LAN (Off-Grid Web Chat)
Platform: M5Stack Cardputer
Requirement: MicroSD Card formatted in FAT32.

Description:
The Tactical Node LAN turns your M5Cardputer into a highly functional decentralized communication router (PirateBox). Ideal for hiking, events, camping, or any off-grid situation without internet access, it allows multiple users to connect via smartphone or PC to exchange messages and files within a local network bubble.

Key Features:

    Web PWA Interface: A fluid "Dark Mode" style chat, fully responsive for any mobile or desktop browser without the need to install any apps.

    File Sharing: Send photos, audio recordings, and documents. Uploaded images automatically generate inline previews inside the chat bubbles.

    Hybrid System (AP / STA): Create an isolated network outdoors (Access Point Mode) or stealthily run the chat inside an existing local router (Station Mode).

    Native Configuration: Set the Network Name (SSID) and Password directly using the Cardputer's keyboard. Settings and chat history are persistently saved to the SD card.

    Memory Management: One-click "Wipe" option from the main menu to delete all messages and files from the SD card to free up space instantly.

⚠️ Technical Notice Regarding Wi-Fi Passwords (WPA2):
Due to the global WPA2 security protocol, if you choose to set a password for your tactical network, it must contain 8 or more characters. If you configure a password with fewer than 8 characters, the Cardputer's system—as a fail-safe against crashing—will default to creating an Open Network (no password).

🇧🇷 Versão em Português

Título: Tactical Node LAN (Off-Grid Web Chat)
Plataforma: M5Stack Cardputer
Requisito: Cartão MicroSD formatado em FAT32.

Descrição:
O Tactical Node LAN transforma o seu M5Cardputer em um roteador de comunicação descentralizada (PirateBox) de alta utilidade. Ideal para trilhas, eventos, acampamentos ou situações sem acesso à internet, ele permite que múltiplos usuários se conectem via smartphone ou PC para trocar mensagens e arquivos em uma bolha de rede local.

Principais Recursos:

    Interface Web PWA: Um chat fluído no estilo "Dark Mode", responsivo para qualquer navegador mobile ou desktop, sem precisar instalar nenhum aplicativo.

    Compartilhamento de Arquivos: Envie fotos, áudios e documentos. As imagens enviadas geram miniaturas automáticas diretamente no balão do chat.

    Sistema Híbrido (AP / STA): Crie uma rede isolada na rua (Modo Access Point) ou camufle o chat dentro de um roteador já existente (Modo Station).

    Configuração Nativa: Defina o Nome da Rede (SSID) e a Senha diretamente pelo teclado do Cardputer. As configurações e o histórico do chat são salvos permanentemente no cartão SD.

    Gestão de Memória: Opção nativa de "Wipe" com um clique para apagar todas as mensagens e arquivos do SD e liberar espaço.

⚠️ Aviso Técnico sobre Senhas Wi-Fi (WPA2):
Devido ao protocolo de segurança mundial WPA2, se você optar por colocar uma senha na sua rede tática, ela deverá ter obrigatoriamente 8 caracteres ou mais. Se você configurar uma senha com menos de 8 caracteres, o sistema do Cardputer, por medida de segurança contra travamentos, criará uma Rede Aberta (sem senha).

name: ChessClock Pro (Relógio de Xadrez)
description:
Transforme seu M5Cardputer em um Relógio de Xadrez digital de nível de torneio! O ChessClock Pro foi desenhado para ficar exatamente no centro da mesa, dividindo a tela perfeitamente entre os dois jogadores. Ele suporta o formato de tempo mais usado no mundo do xadrez moderno: o sistema de Incremento Fischer (onde segundos extras são adicionados ao relógio a cada jogada realizada).

Assim como os relógios profissionais da marca DGT, o aplicativo usa a identidade visual a favor do jogo: o lado da tela do jogador que está com a vez (e o tempo correndo) ganha um fundo brilhante em destaque, permitindo que ambos saibam de quem é a vez usando apenas a visão periférica. Além disso, o app permite a conexão de grandes botões de arcade na parte superior do aparelho para quem busca a verdadeira sensação de bater no relógio durante partidas rápidas de Blitz ou Bullet.

Como Funciona a Dinâmica
O sistema possui duas fases perfeitamente isoladas para evitar acidentes durante a partida.

    Ajuste da Partida: Antes de jogar, a tela exibe o menu de configuração. Você define o "Tempo Base" (em minutos) que cada jogador terá no relógio, e o "Incremento" (em segundos) que será somado a cada movimento.

    A Partida: Com o relógio armado, o Jogador das Brancas (esquerda) faz o primeiro movimento no tabuleiro e aperta o seu botão. O tempo dele congela, o bônus de incremento é somado e o cronômetro do Jogador das Pretas (direita) começa a cair na mesma fração de segundo.

    Queda de Seta (Time Out): Se o relógio de qualquer um dos jogadores chegar a zero (00:00), a tela inteira é bloqueada. Um alerta vermelho gigante de "FIM DE JOGO" aparece declarando o vencedor por tempo, acompanhado de um alarme sonoro intermitente.

    Pausa e Revanche: Durante disputas de regras, a partida pode ser pausada. Ao final, com apenas um botão, uma revanche instantânea é iniciada puxando os exatos tempos configurados anteriormente.

Mapeamento de Controles e Pinos Físicos

Configuração Inicial e Menus:

    Teclas ; e . : Aumenta ou diminui o Tempo Base (Minutos).

    Teclas / e , : Aumenta ou diminui o Incremento (Segundos).

    Tecla ENTER: Confirma os tempos e arma o relógio na mesa.

    Tecla 0: Retorna ao menu principal.

    Tecla R: Inicia uma Revanche imediata após o fim do jogo.

    Tecla P (ou ENTER): Pausa o relógio no meio da partida.

Controles do Jogador 1 - Brancas (Lado Esquerdo):

    Teclado: Tecla CTRL.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico de fliperama/arcade entre o pino G5 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

Controles do Jogador 2 - Pretas (Lado Direito):

    Teclado: Tecla ESPAÇO.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico de fliperama/arcade entre o pino G3 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

name: ChrisDaDriver
description:
ChrisDaDriver is an ultra-fast, multi-threaded wardriving firmware built specifically for the M5Cardputer. It captures WiFi networks (802.11 b/g/n) and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices in parallel, enriches the data with GPS coordinates, and exports logs in the official WiGLE CSV format (v1.5) for seamless upload to wigle.net or wdgwars.pl and even wardrift.net.


Features

  • WiGLE v1.5 Compliant: Pre-formatted CSV log files ready for direct WiGLE submission.
  • Parallel Dual-Core Architecture:
    • WiFi promiscuous sniffer and channel hopping on Core 0.
    • BLE scanning, GPS parsing, UI rendering, and SD writing on Core 1.
  • High-Throughput Processing: Capable of capturing and processing ~22 scan entries per second.
  • Dynamic SD Benchmarking:
    • Measures write latency on boot to dynamically scale buffer queue limits (maxSdQueueSize).
  • Thread-Safe Memory Management:
    • FreeRTOS mutexes (dataMutex) protect shared GPS and scan buffers against race conditions.
  • Flicker-Free Optimized UI:
    • Direct rendering without heavy canvas overhead to save RAM.
    • Smooth color-transitioning battery indicator (Green > Yellow > Red).
  • Interactive File Management:
    • Built-in menu to select, upload, or securely delete individual log files directly on the device.
  • Direct API upload to WDGWars:
    • Upload your csv files directly from the Cardputer to the API.


Controls

Key / ButtonAction
Btn 0 (Short Press)Toggle Display Backlighting ON / OFF (Dim / Bright)
Btn 0 (Long Press)Open Main Menu
Enter (Keyboard)Start scanning / Execute selected menu action / Save setting
Del (Keyboard)Stop scanning / Return or exit menu
D (Keyboard)Toggle Developer Diagnostic Overlay


Hardware Requirements

  • M5Stack Cardputer
  • MicroSD Card (FAT32 formatted)
  • GPS Module (connected via Grove or I/O header)

Radio mode

Touch Zone	Button	Normal Mode	Settings Mode
[SET]	BtnA (short)	Open sound settings	—
[STA]	BtnB	Cycle station (1.5s debounce)	Select next parameter

bottom capacitive STOP button stops an active recording

top-center BOT / YOU chip toggles between the latest bot reply and the latest user transcript

settings menu currently includes:
Setup
Personality preset cycling
Model cycling

on-screen NEW clears the current bot chat
long replies now auto-scroll and repeat
tapping the reply panel can still manually bump the scroll position if needed
in radio mode, tap the BOT button in the header to return

Optional LCD	16x2 I2C character LCD (0x27 / 0x3F typical)

VCC	5V
GND	GND
SDA	GPIO33

line 1 shows mode / recording / connectivity status
line 2 scrolls the current bot reply, user transcript, or radio title using the same auto-scroll speed setting as the bot screen

pio run --target upload

pio device monitor --baud 115200

default boot mode (Bot or Radio)

continue polishing the touchscreen bot UI

description:
# CoreInkMate

A beautifully designed e-ink daily companion for M5Stack CoreInk — calendar, utilities, games, and web-configurable stock/weather/RSS, all in one deep-sleep-optimized package.

---

## 中文介绍

一款为 M5Stack CoreInk 墨水屏精心设计的桌面日历时钟。极简 UI、超低功耗、功能丰富，是桌面上的优雅伴侣。

### 主屏 · 月历

- **日历** — 月视图网格，今日高亮，中/英文星期
- **月相** — 按日期绘制动态月亮图标
- **年月标题** — ISO 格式大号无衬线字体
- **周次 & 年内天数** — 右上角显示第几周 / 第几天
- **电量** — 电池图标 + 百分比

### 应用菜单（5 大类）

| 分类 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| **网络** | RSS 阅读、天气 |
| **扫描** | WiFi 扫描图、BLE 蓝牙扫描、I2C 总线扫描 |
| **时间** | 世界时钟、秒表（最多 50 圈）、NTP 校时 |
| **游戏** | 井字棋、猜数字、24 点 |
| **股票** | Finnhub 实时行情，涨跌幅显示 |

### 特性亮点

- **⚡ 超低功耗** — 深度睡眠，每天只醒一次刷新日历，或按键唤醒
- **🌐 配网页配置** — 手机连 AP 热点，浏览器打开 192.168.4.1 一站式配置 WiFi、RSS 订阅、天气城市、世界时钟、股票代码
- **🌍 双语支持** — 完整中/英文切换
- **📡 WiFi 按需连接** — 联网后立即断开，省电
- **📰 RSS 阅读** — 内置轻量 XML 解析器，无需外部依赖
- **🌤 天气** — 免费 Open-Meteo API，显示温度、天气描述、湿度、风速
- **📈 股票** — Finnhub 实时行情，涨跌幅百分比，最多 5 支股票
- **🎮 游戏** — 井字棋（人机对战）、猜数字、24 点数学谜题

---

## English

A beautifully designed e-ink daily companion for the M5Stack CoreInk. Minimalist UI, ultra-low power, packed with features — the elegant desk accessory you didn't know you needed.

### Main Screen · Calendar

- **Calendar** — Monthly grid with today highlighted, Chinese/English weekday support
- **Moon Phase** — Dynamic moon phase icon calculated by date
- **Date Header** — ISO-format large sans-serif title
- **Week & Day of Year** — Top-right corner (e.g. `28W / 194`)
- **Battery** — Icon + percentage indicator

### Apps (5 Categories)

| Category | Apps |
|---|---|
| **Network** | RSS Reader, Weather |
| **Scan** | WiFi Scanner, BLE Scanner, I2C Scanner |
| **Time** | World Clock, Stopwatch (up to 50 laps), NTP Sync |
| **Games** | Tic-Tac-Toe (vs CPU), Guess Number, 24-Point Puzzle |
| **Stocks** | Finnhub real-time quotes with change percentage |

### Highlights

- **⚡ Ultra-Low Power** — Deep sleep; wakes only once at midnight or on button press
- **🌐 Web Config Portal** — Connect phone to AP hotspot, open `192.168.4.1` in browser to configure everything: WiFi, RSS feeds, weather city, world clock, stock tickers
- **🌍 Bilingual** — Full Chinese/English toggle
- **📡 On-demand WiFi** — Connect only when needed, disconnect immediately after
- **📰 RSS Reader** — Built-in lightweight XML parser, no external dependencies
- **🌤 Weather** — Free Open-Meteo API; shows temperature, condition, humidity, wind speed
- **📈 Stocks** — Finnhub API; real-time price + change %, up to 5 tickers
- **🎮 Games** — Tic-tac-toe (smart CPU opponent), Guess Number, 24-Point math puzzle

CoreS3の内蔵カメラで顔検出するAIｽﾀｯｸﾁｬﾝです。
（robo8080さんのAIｽﾀｯｸﾁｬﾝをベースとしています。）

・顔検出すると「御用でしょうか？」と音声認識を起動します。
・LCD左上隅にカメラ画像が表示されます。画像部分をタッチすると表示ON/OFFできます。
・画面中央左側をタッチするとサイレントモードになります。サイレントモード中に顔を検出すると、顔を追いかけるようにサーボ制御します。
・その他の機能はrobo8080さんのAIｽﾀｯｸﾁｬﾝと同じです。

【動作条件】
タカオさんのPWMサーボ版シェルで動作確認済みです。
サーボはPort.Cに接続してください。

AIｽﾀｯｸﾁｬﾝをベースにしているため、SDカードに次の情報を保存しておく必要があります。
・WIFIのSSIDとパスワード
・ChatGPTのAPIキー
・Google Cloud STTのAPIキー

description:
COSMIC-CORE — M5Stack Core 1 Art Portal
A full-featured WiFi captive portal for the M5Stack Core 1 (Basic). Power it on, connect your phone to the WiFi hotspot, and you're dropped into an interactive art gallery, cosmic trivia game, visitor guestbook, and SD file gallery — all running on a tiny ESP32 with three physical buttons.
VERY IMPORTANT---IF USING SD CARD -SET THE PASSWORD FOR THE FOLDERS IMMEDIATELY IN PORTAL - IF YOU DO NOT WANT STRANGERS VIEWING AND DOWNLOADING YOUR FILES!!!!!

Usage
Power on the M5Stack
On your phone or PC, connect to WiFi:
COSMIC-CORE FILE GALLERY 🎨
A browser page opens automatically (captive portal). If not, navigate to:
192.168.4.1
Explore the portal — art, trivia, guestbook, and gallery are all linked from the home page
Button Reference
Button	Context	Action
BtnB (middle)	Visitor connected, idle screen	Open preset message menu
BtnA (left)	Message menu open	Scroll up through presets
BtnB (middle)	Message menu open	Send selected preset
BtnC (right)	Message menu open	Cancel / close menu
Features
🎨 Art Portal
70+ generative art animations served as interactive web pages — Matrix Rain, Starfield, Plasma, Mandala, Fractal, Voronoi, Lorenz attractor, Mandelbrot, Game of Life, Snake, Tetris, Breakout, and many more
Pure HTML5 Canvas — no app install, works in any phone browser
Captive portal — connecting to the WiFi AP automatically opens the portal
🌌 Cosmic Trivia
100 cosmic & metaphysical questions — quantum physics, black holes, consciousness, cosmology, science quotes
Fully stateless — multiple visitors can play simultaneously
Score rating from Cosmic Infant to Cosmic Oracle
📜 Visitor Guestbook
Visitors leave a name and message (up to 100 characters)
Entries saved permanently to SD card (/guestbook.txt)
Last 10 entries shown in the portal
Display flashes NEW ENTRY! + name + message for 10 seconds when someone signs
🗂️ SD File Gallery
Browse and download files from the SD card over the portal
Optional password protection (/sdpass.txt on SD)
Single-visitor lock — the first connected device gets exclusive gallery access
Bulk ZIP download
🌠 Screensavers (when no visitors connected)
Matrix Rain — green falling characters
Starfield — 3D warp star tunnel
Plasma Waves — sinusoidal color field
Single Image — display a custom JPEG from SD (/ssaver.jpg)
SD Image Shuffle — cycle through all JPEGs on the SD card on a timer (1 / 5 / 15 / 30 min)
Mode and interval saved to NVS flash — survives reboots
💬 Operator Preset Messages
When a visitor is connected, press BtnB to open the message menu
5 preset messages displayed in the portal (/api/msg)
BtnA scrolls up, BtnB sends, BtnC cancels

name: Cryptspeak (csCardputer)
description:
Cryptspeak is a standalone LXMF / Reticulum Firmware for the Cardputer-Adv featuring security hardening. It includes mandatory at-rest encryption, that means any sensitive asset the device writes to storage is encrypted. It is able to communicate over  LoRa radio and WiFi/TCP. 

Notable Feature:
Color themes: 9 presets plus custom hex/RGB.
LXMF stamps: proof-of-work stamps computed in the background.
GPS time sync: UTC from GPS with automatic timezone detection and manual override.
Radio diagnostics: live RSSI/SNR/throughput graphs, packet counters, Reticulum path stats.

NOTE: It requires the SX1262 LoRa cap (850–950 MHz) for the Cardputer Adv to function properly.

name: CyberKey
description:
# 🔐 CyberKey — Standalone Hardware 2FA & Password Vault for M5Stack Cardputer

A sleek, air-gapped, open-source hardware TOTP authenticator with USB/BLE auto-typing, Google Password Manager MicroSD vault, OTA updates, and zero master-password delays.

--- ## 🌟 Overview **CyberKey** turns your [M5Stack Cardputer](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/core/cardputer) into a dedicated, standalone **Hardware Two-Factor Authenticator (2FA) & Password Autotyper**. No waiting for your phone to unlock, no cloud subscriptions, and no reliance on mobile apps. CyberKey computes standard RFC 6238 TOTP codes locally on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller using hardware-accelerated SHA1 crypto. Whether you're authenticating into GitHub, Google, AWS, or your home server, simply pick your account on the Cardputer screen and let CyberKey do the work. --- ## ✨ Features - ⚡ **Instant Boot & Unlock-Free Access**: Boots directly to your active 2FA codes. No mandatory PINs, biometric scans, or tedious boot delays. - 🏷️ **Dual-Field Account Identification**: - **Line 1 (Large Cyan)**: Primary Service / Site name (e.g. `GitHub`, `Google`, `Proton`, `AWS`). - **Line 2 (Muted Gray)**: Account username or email (e.g. `user@example.com`, `admin`). - ⌨️ **Dual USB HID & Bluetooth BLE Auto-Type ("YubiKey" Mode)**: - Plug your Cardputer into any PC, Mac, Linux machine, or iPad using USB-C, **or** pair it wirelessly over Bluetooth Low Energy (**`CyberKey BLE`**). - Press **`Enter`**: automatically types the active 6-digit TOTP code into your focused cursor and presses return! - Press **`U`**: automatically types your **Username** for the selected account. - Press **`P`**: automatically types your **Password** from the MicroSD password vault. - 🚀 **Dual LAN/WAN Over-The-Air (OTA) Updates**: - Update your firmware wirelessly with a single keypress (O) or via the web portal. - Dual smart routing checks local LAN (`http://192.168.5.55:8099`) when on your home network, falling back seamlessly to secure WAN (`https://cyberkey.sndjy.us`) when traveling. - Low-footprint chunked flash streaming with real-time on-screen progress indicator. - 🔑 **Google Password Manager MicroSD Import & Streaming Vault**: - Drag-and-drop or upload your exported `passwords.csv` in the CyberKey web interface (or drop it onto the root of the MicroSD card). - Automatically parses service names, URLs, usernames, and passwords directly into `/passwords.json` on the MicroSD card. - High-performance, memory-efficient streaming loader ensures zero heap crashes or boot loops even with large password collections. - Smart fuzzy matching automatically links your passwords to your 2FA accounts by service name or username. - 🔍 **First-Letter Quick Search**: - Jump directly to any service across dozens of stored keys by pressing the first letter (`G` for Google/GitHub, `P` for Proton, `A` for AWS). - 🌐 **Web Management & Captive Portal**: - Add, edit, or delete 2FA secrets from any phone or computer browser. - **Smart QR Screenshot Decoder**: Drag-and-drop or upload a 2FA QR code screenshot in the browser; CyberKey decodes the secret, parses the issuer and username, and populates the fields automatically. - **Captive Portal Fallback**: If no saved Wi-Fi is reachable, CyberKey spins up a `CyberKey-Setup` hotspot at `http://192.168.4.1`. - 💾 **MicroSD Vault Backup & Restore**: - Hit **`B`** on the keyboard to save a backup to your MicroSD card (`/cyberkey_backup.json`). - Hit **`R`** to restore all accounts and Wi-Fi credentials onto any new device. - 📶 **Multi-Wi-Fi Profile Manager**: - Stores up to 5 Wi-Fi profiles. - Automatically scans and connects to the strongest available network on boot to synchronize NTP time. - 🔋 **Battery Eco-Mode & Auto-Dim**: - Screen auto-dims from 80% to 15% brightness after 45 seconds of idle inactivity (restores instantly on any keypress). - Press **`W`** to toggle Wi-Fi into sleep mode on-demand to maximize battery life. - 🔔 **Audio Countdown Ticks**: - Optional subtle audio chirp during the final 3 seconds of a TOTP cycle to alert you when a code is about to expire (toggle with `M`). - 🚨 **Emergency Panic Wipe**: - Double-tap `Del` to instantly wipe all keys and Wi-Fi secrets from onboard flash memory. --- ## ⌨️ Cardputer Controls | Key | Function | |:---:|---| | Enter | **Auto-Type TOTP**: Types active 6-digit TOTP code and presses Enter (BLE / USB) | | U | **Auto-Type Username**: Types the account username/email into focused cursor | | P | **Auto-Type Password**: Types the linked password stored on MicroSD | | Space / D / . / / | Next Account | | A / , / ; | Previous Account | | A – Z | **Quick Jump**: Jump directly to first account starting with that letter | | O | **OTA Update**: Check for updates and flash new firmware over Wi-Fi | | W | **Wi-Fi Toggle**: Switch Wi-Fi radio ON / SLEEP (Eco-Mode) | | M | Toggle Expiration Audio Chirp (ON / OFF) | | B | Quick Backup to MicroSD Card (`/cyberkey_backup.json`) | | R | Quick Restore from MicroSD Card | | Del | Emergency Panic Wipe (press twice to wipe flash & SD passwords) | --- ## 🚀 Quick Start / Flashing ### Option A: Over-The-Air (OTA) Update (If already running CyberKey) 1. Ensure your Cardputer is connected to Wi-Fi. 2. Press uppercase O on the Cardputer keyboard (or visit the web portal and click **Check for Updates**). 3. The device will automatically stream the latest firmware and reboot. ### Option B: M5Launcher (MicroSD Card) 1. Download `CyberKey-complete.bin`. 2. Copy it to your Cardputer's MicroSD card. 3. Boot into **M5Launcher**, select `CyberKey-complete.bin`, and flash at offset `0x00000`. ### Option C: Web Flasher / esptool (USB-C) 1. Hold the `G0` (Boot) button on your Cardputer and connect the USB-C cable to your computer. 2. Run: ```bash esptool.py --chip esp32s3 write_flash 0x0000 CyberKey-complete.bin ``` --- ## 🛠️ Building from Source This project is built using [PlatformIO](https://platformio.org/). 1. Clone this repository: ```bash git clone https://github.com/your-username/cardputer-cyberkey.git cd cardputer-cyberkey ``` 2. Build firmware: ```bash pio run ``` 3. Merge complete 8MB flash binary: ```bash esptool.py --chip esp32s3 merge_bin -o CyberKey-complete.bin --flash_mode keep --flash_size 8MB 0x0000 .pio/build/m5stack-cardputer/bootloader.bin 0x8000 .pio/build/m5stack-cardputer/partitions.bin 0x10000 .pio/build/m5stack-cardputer/firmware.bin ``` 4. Flash directly via USB: ```bash pio run -t upload ``` --- ## 🔒 Security Architecture - **Air-Gapped Operation**: After initial NTP time sync, Wi-Fi can be completely shut down (`W` key). The device functions 100% offline. - **On-Chip Hardware Crypto**: TOTP codes are calculated on-the-fly using ESP32-S3's hardware-accelerated `mbedtls` cryptographic engine. - **MicroSD Data Portability**: Backups and passwords remain securely on the removable MicroSD card without risking exposure from internal flash dumps. --- ## 📄 License Distributed under the **MIT License**. See `LICENSE` for more information.

name: Daoa Mini — Yi Jing for Cardputer ADV
description:
A Yi Jing casting device, not another tool.

Six lines, cast one by one the traditional three-coin way. Then the figure,
the figure it is tending toward, and a text to sit with — portrait,
Judgment, Image, and the meaning of each of the six lines. English and
French, entirely offline.

> **Built and tested on the Cardputer ADV only.** The place reading relies
> on the ADV's Wi-Fi and the device list here does not distinguish models —
> hence the `-ADV` suffix on the version.

## Reading the place

Before each casting the device listens to the room. A passive Wi-Fi scan —
never connected, radio off the moment it ends, no SSID or BSSID kept,
nothing stored or transmitted — becomes a living particle field on screen,
one dot per network, and it gently weights the draw.

| Reading | Derived from | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| **density** | network count + mean signal energy | leans yin or yang, **± 5 % at most** |
| **agitation** | channel spread + signal variance | makes changing lines likelier, **+ 4 % at most** |

Bounded, documented, on by default, and switchable off in the settings.

Press `w` at any moment for the raw numbers — networks, channels, dBm, both
readings, both weights, and the resulting probabilities of the four line
values. If something influences a draw, you should be able to audit exactly
how much.

```
P(yang)     = 0.5  + B     B = (density - 0.5) x 0.1   in [-0.05, +0.05]
P(changing) = 0.25 + G     G = agitation x 0.04        in [0, 0.04]
```

At B = G = 0 this is exactly the traditional 1/8, 3/8, 3/8, 1/8. Randomness
comes from `esp_random()`, the ESP32 hardware TRNG — no network, no account,
no AI, no cloud.

## Keys

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `space` | begin, cast a line, continue |
| `←` `→` | first figure / complementary figure |
| `↓` | full text, then pages, then trigram structure |
| `↑` | back through the pages |
| `l` | English / French |
| `h` | built-in help |
| `s` | settings — place reading, sounds, volume |
| `w` | technical view of the field |
| `esc` | back |

Soft PCM interface sounds, all switchable, with three volume levels.

## Source and method

MIT licensed, with the full casting specification and a desktop SDL
simulator that runs the exact same rendering code:
<https://github.com/chatelp/daoa-mini-cardputeradv>

Daoa Mini is a companion object for **Daoa**, my Yi Jing app for iPhone and
Android: <https://daoa.app>

I designed and directed this project; Claude Code wrote most of the
implementation. The scope, the product decisions, the visual direction and
all validation on real hardware are mine. The casting logic and the
probability maths are covered by tests anyone can run.

name: Dash-Chan
description:
## Dash-Chan — your tiny wardriving companion

**Official M5Stack StackChan K151 only. Public beta.** Eight original companions, Avatar Studio, offline personality, passive Wi-Fi/BLE awareness and GPS-tagged WiGLE CSV logging to microSD.

**These instructions describe 0.8.1-beta. Check the selected firmware version: earlier releases remain available, and new submissions may be awaiting M5Stack review.** Version 0.8.0 requires `upload.json`; 0.7.x and earlier do not support Wardrift. The web installer provides the current release.

### Installation — read before burning

**The M5Burner BIN is a factory-reset image at 0x0. It overwrites NVS, including saved preferences and factory servo calibration.** Back up your own robot and restore its NVS before enabling head motion. Speech and motion default OFF on a fresh installation. The SD card is not formatted.

For updates that preserve calibration, use the **[web flasher and Avatar Studio](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/)**. Follow the [backup and recovery instructions](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/M5BURNER.html) before using the merged image.

### Meet your copilot

- Eight original buddies, layered outfits, custom colors and eyes; all cosmetics available immediately.
- Full Face or Recon + Buddy view, contextual phrases, quiet petting, level/XP, an SD lifetime notebook, and food earned through saved wardrives.
- Receiver/port/baud settings for original Unit GPS, GPS SMA/AT6668 and DIY ATGM336H. [GPS wiring and settings](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/GPS.html).
- Steady, Gentle, Lively or Motors off head modes, mute controls, and distinct camera/drone clue reactions.
- Manual uploads, Upload all and optional uploads after Stop + Save to WiGLE, WDGWars and Wardrift, using the SD-card configuration below.

## SD card setup: step by step

1. **Check the firmware version.** Use **0.8.1-beta or newer** for the filename `config.json`. Version 0.8.0 uses the same schema-2 contents but requires the old name `upload.json`. Earlier versions do not support Wardrift. If installing from M5Burner, check the selected version; a submitted update may still be awaiting review. Follow the [installation guide](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/FLASHING.html) or [M5Burner calibration/backup guide](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/M5BURNER.html) when updating.
2. **Gather your credentials.** Use your home **2.4 GHz Wi-Fi SSID and password**. For WiGLE, obtain the **API name and API token** from [your account](https://wigle.net/account), not your login password. For WDGWars, obtain the **64-character hexadecimal API key** from [your profile](https://wdgwars.pl/profile). For Wardrift, create a **device API key** in [your Wardrift account](https://wardrift.net). Only obtain credentials for services you plan to enable. Keep them out of chat, screenshots and public repositories.
3. **Stop and save any drive, wait for uploads to finish, then power off Dash-Chan.** Remove the microSD card and insert it into your computer. Do not format it. Existing logs and pet progress should stay on the card.
4. **Open the SD card's root folder and create `dashchan` if it does not already exist.** Inside it, create `config.json`. The complete device path must be `/dashchan/config.json`, not `/config.json` or `/dashchan/dashchan/config.json`.
5. **Copy the template below into a plain-text editor**, or download [config.example.json](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/config.example.json) and rename it to `config.json`. Enter your Wi-Fi credentials. Change a destination from `false` to `true` and fill its credential fields to enable it. **Enable at least one destination**; the blank template is deliberately unconfigured. You may enable all three. Unused credential strings can stay empty.
6. **Save as UTF-8 JSON.** On Windows, choose **Save as type: All files** and the exact filename `config.json`. Enable **View → Show → File name extensions** in File Explorer to ensure it is not `config.json.txt`. Keep the double quotes, commas, braces and unquoted `true`/`false`; JSON does not allow comments or trailing commas. If a password contains a double quote or backslash, escape it as `\"` or `\\`, or use the optional web setup form to generate the file safely.
7. **Safely eject the card, reinsert it, and power on Dash-Chan.** Open **Menu → Upload drives → Refresh**. The enabled destinations should appear. A missing/invalid-configuration message means you should check the filename, folder, JSON syntax and enabled service credentials.
8. **Test one saved drive while within range of your home Wi-Fi.** In **Menu → Upload drives**, select a drive with the arrows, tap **Send selected**, review the destination list, then tap again to confirm. Wait for the result and check that service's account. No networks are uploaded merely by saving the configuration or pressing Refresh.
9. **Send the backlog when ready.** Tap **Upload all (N)**, review the destination list, then **Confirm all (N)**. Confirmed destinations are skipped on later attempts; original CSV files remain on SD. See the full upload guide linked below if an outcome is uncertain.
10. **Choose automatic behavior explicitly.** Set `automatic` to `true`, save the file and Refresh to attempt each new nonempty drive after **Stop + Save**. Keep it `false` for manual uploads only. Automatic mode tries at that moment: it does **not** wait for your arrival home, upload an old backlog at boot, or retry failed sends. If home Wi-Fi was unavailable when you stopped, use **Send selected** or **Upload all** when you get home.

```json
{
  "schema": 2,
  "ssid": "YOUR_2.4_GHZ_WIFI_NAME",
  "password": "YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD",
  "wigle": false,
  "wigleName": "",
  "wigleToken": "",
  "wdg": false,
  "wdgKey": "",
  "wardrift": false,
  "wardriftToken": "",
  "automatic": false,
  "donate": false
}
```

| Setting | Enter or choose |
| --- | --- |
| `ssid`, `password` | Your 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi name and password. An empty password is allowed for an open network. Enterprise login and captive portals are unsupported. |
| `wigle`, `wigleName`, `wigleToken` | Set `wigle` to `true` and enter the WiGLE API name and token. |
| `wdg`, `wdgKey` | Set `wdg` to `true` and enter the 64-character hexadecimal WDGWars API key. |
| `wardrift`, `wardriftToken` | Set `wardrift` to `true` and enter the Wardrift device API key. |
| `automatic` | `false` for manual control; `true` for a single attempt after each Stop + Save. |
| `donate` | Optional WiGLE commercial-use donation, off by default. This does not enable uploads by itself. |
| `schema` | Leave at `2`. Keep every field in the template, even for disabled destinations. |


### Old configs, recovery and privacy

Existing `/dashchan/upload.json` files still work in 0.8.1+. You may rename one to `config.json`. If both exist, `config.json` takes precedence; an invalid new file does not silently use the old one. The website's form is optional and produces this same SD-card file.

Keep configuration files private: they contain readable Wi-Fi passwords and API keys. To disable uploads and remove credentials, stop activity and power off; remove `config.json`, `config-new.json`, `config-backup.json`, `upload.json`, `upload-new.json` and `upload-backup.json` from `/dashchan/` if present. Reinsert/restart and Refresh. Keep `/wardrives/` and upload receipts intact. Removing only the main file can restore a recovery copy.

Uploads pause scanning and resume it afterward. Accepted receipts prevent blind duplicate submissions; uncertain outcomes require checking the service account first. **[Full upload guide, troubleshooting and receipts](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/UPLOADS.html)** · **[GitHub setup guide](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/Dash-Chan/blob/main/docs/UPLOADS.md)**.

### On the robot

![Recon and buddy](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/assets/ui-recon.png)

![GPS settings](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/assets/ui-gps-setup.png)

![Upload destinations — synthetic setup](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/assets/ui-upload-all.png)

### Validation and limits

The 0.8.1 configuration change passes host tests for new/legacy names, precedence, backup recovery and write failures. The preceding 0.8.0 build was checked on K151: GPS SMA on black B had a valid fix with both radios active, and a short stationary drive saved 115 validated CSV rows. That does not prove moving-car coverage or endurance. Factory-reset installation through M5Burner and live uploads with real service accounts remain unverified beta checks. Transport acceptance does not guarantee service-side processing or credit.

Native radio coverage is passive 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and BLE. Detection signatures/OUI matches are clues, not proof of device identity, recording or intent. No 5 GHz, Bluetooth Classic, jamming, deauthentication or payload recording.

The merged image is assembled from clean release parts; no device backup, user credentials or recorded observations are included. [Download bundle with source, checksums and notices](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/firmware/Dash-Chan.zip) · [Corresponding source archive](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/source.zip) · [Quickstart](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/QUICKSTART.html) · [Credits and licenses](https://valleytech-dash-chan.pages.dev/guide/docs/SOURCES.html).

GPL-3.0-or-later with retained dependency notices. Thanks to Dragon Detector, SquachWatch/skizzophrenic, Colonel Panic, Midwest Gadgets/Piglet, JustCallMeKoko, M5Stack, Espressif, NimBLE, TinyGPSPlus, OpenDroneID and the credited researchers. Original Dash-Chan companions; BWM/VTS marks belong to their owners. No upstream endorsement is implied.

name: Dragon Detector - M5Stack StopWatch C152
description:
# Dragon Detector for M5Stack StopWatch C152

Built specifically for the **M5Stack StopWatch C152**: a round Wi-Fi/Bluetooth detector, themed watch, stopwatch and locksport timer.

## StopWatch features

- Radar, signal tracking, watch lists and local detection history.
- Logo watch faces, custom themes and animated locksport timers.
- Touchscreen, yellow/blue buttons, vibration and the RX8130CE real-time clock.
- Capture sessions, notebook exports, radio tools and BLE Lab.
- Background scanning pauses while using the clock or timers.

## Installation and clock setup

**M5Stack StopWatch C152 only.** Use the complete ESP32-S3 factory BIN at **0x0** for its **16 MB flash**. A factory installation replaces saved settings and files. For a compatible existing installation, choose StopWatch C152 and **Update matching Dragon Detector** in the [web flasher](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/#install).

Connect a USB data cable. Hold the power/reset button for about two seconds until the green LED lights, then release to enter download mode. Leave the buttons untouched during flashing and verification. After flashing, briefly press the button to restart. If it stays blank, close the serial connection, unplug USB, double-press power to turn it off, wait five seconds, then press power once. Reconnect USB after the logo appears.

Close M5Burner's serial connection and connect **Detector tools** in the web flasher to set and verify the time, date and timezone. M5Burner does not set the clock. On the StopWatch, **Settings > Time** provides separate Time, Date and Sync tabs. [Clock setup guide](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/guides/CLOCK-SETUP.html).

## On the StopWatch

![Dragon Detector running on M5Stack StopWatch C152](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/assets/stopwatch-clock-01320.png)

Detection identifies radio signatures, not intent or ownership. Radar position represents signal strength, not direction. Use active radio tools only with devices and networks you are authorized to test.

[Source and releases](https://git.churchofmalware.org/Valleytech/Dragon-Detector) · [Attributions](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/guides/CREDITS.html)

description:
# Dragon Detector for M5Stack Dial

A compact Wi-Fi and Bluetooth awareness display, tested on M5Stack Dial v1.1.

- Live radar with 32 contact slots, priority labels, device details and signal-strength hunting.
- Turn the ring to browse, press to select, hold to go back. Touchscreen menus and dot actions are also available.
- 40 built-in radar and clock themes, stopwatch and locksport timing. Clock and timer pause scanning.
- Separate Time and Date settings, brightness and buzzer controls. USB clock setup verifies the hardware RTC.

This image is exclusively for M5Stack Dial, with 8 MB flash and no PSRAM. The original K130 has not been physically tested. The compact profile does not include active radio labs, FindMy beeping, badge uploads, saved captures, SD, GPS or RFID operations. Radar positions are visual organization, not measured direction or distance.

## Installation

Flash this complete factory BIN at **0x0**. A fresh installation replaces existing settings. If necessary, hold the rear G0/BOOT button while reconnecting, then release it. After flashing, reconnect normally without holding any buttons. No SD pack is needed.

Set the date, time and timezone using the USB Studio on the project website, or use Menu > Settings > Time and Date on the Dial. RTC retention requires its power supply.

[Web flasher and USB tools](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/#install) · [Dial controls and clock setup](https://valleytech-dragon-detector.pages.dev/guides/M5STACK-DIAL.html)

name: Drumputer  Antonio J. Lara
description:
Drumputer User Manual   https://youtu.be/KHAryvxbX6w
Drumputer is a drum machine and sequencer program for the M5Cardputer device. It allows you to create, edit, and play drum patterns with up to 4 instruments and 16 , 32 steps.
   Main Interface
- The grid shows 4 rows (instruments) and 16 or 32 columns (steps).
- Numbers on the left (1-4) represent instruments.
- Numbers on top represent steps (1-16 or 1-32).
- Filled squares indicate active steps for each instrument.
- The red cursor shows the current editing position.
- The green bar shows the current playing step.

Basic Controls
- Use ',' and '/' keys to move the cursor left and right.
- Press ENTER to toggle a step on/off.
- Use keys 1-4 to select an instrument.
- Press '0' to start/stop playback.
- Use the up or down keys to increase/decrease BPM.
- Press 'E' to toggle between 16 and 32-step mode.

## Special Playback Modes
- Press '5' for two-step roll mode (alternates between first two steps).
- Press '6' for reverse playback mode.

## File Management
- Press '9' to enter/exit the WAV file selection menu.
- In the WAV menu, use ',' and '/' to navigate, ENTER to select a file.
- Press '7' to enter/exit the sequence management menu.
- In the sequence menu:
  - Use 'S' to toggle between Save and Load modes.
  - Use 'D' to enter Delete mode.
  - Use ',' and '/' to navigate, ENTER to perform the selected action.

## Synchronization
- The device outputs a 2 PPQ (Pulses Per Quarter Note) sync signal on pin G2 y Gnd 
- This allows synchronization with other music equipment.
- The sync pulse is sent twice per beat, aligned with the sequencer's timing.
Tips
- In the WAV selection menu, you can preview sounds as you navigate.
- Saved sequences include BPM, step count, pattern, and sample assignments.
- The 32-step mode allows for more complex patterns.
- Use the roll and reverse modes for interesting rhythmic variations.
The wav files go in the root of the sd memory 
with any name but if you rename it this way 1.wav, 2.wav, 3.wav, 4.wav
 they will sound by default on each track without selecting anything

# Disclaimer

While the Drumputer has been successfully tested with equipment such as the Korg Pocket Operator and TD-3 without issues, the creator and developer of this software do not assume any responsibility for potential damages that may occur to your equipment when using this device.

The use of the Drumputer, including its synchronization features, is at the user's own risk. Users are advised to exercise caution and ensure compatibility with their specific equipment before connecting or using the Drumputer with other devices.

By using the Drumputer, you acknowledge that you understand and accept these terms, and agree to use the device responsibly and at your own discretion.
Drumputer was developed with the help of AI over the last month. While it has been successfully tested, it is still in development.
Known issue: Simultaneous playback of WAVs on a track may slow down the beat. Marketing and selling is not permitted

description:
DUCO Miner for M5 Cardputer (ESP32)

This is a lightweight, optimized Duino-Coin (DUCO) miner designed specifically for the M5 Cardputer (ESP32-S3).

Features
Stable ~41–42 kH/s on M5 Cardputer
Fully compatible with Duino-Coin pools
Miner correctly appears in “My miners” on the DUCO website
On-device configuration (Wi-Fi + DUCO username) using the built-in keyboard

Smooth UI (no screen flicker) with:
Live hashrate
Accepted/total shares
Difficulty & ping
Battery level
Small hashrate graph
Pause / resume mining with a key or button
Configuration stored in NVS (persists after reboot)

Quick Start
Flash the firmware to your M5 Cardputer
Power on the device
On first boot, enter:
Wi-Fi SSID
Wi-Fi password
DUCO username (wallet)

The miner will automatically:
Connect to Wi-Fi
Pick the best DUCO pool
Start mining

Controls
P or BtnA – pause / resume mining
C – open settings menu
Hold BtnA during boot – force configuration mode

Disclaimer
This project is for educational and experimental purposes.
Duino-Coin mining on microcontrollers is not meant for profit.

name: ENV Monitor ADV ENG&PL
description:
3.0 update:
Altitude (m a.s.l.) setting: you enter your local height above sea level so the device can convert the BME280 station pressure (ABS) to sea-level pressure (QNH) using the barometric formula. This makes pressure comparable to weather reports and other locations.

Temperature offset (± °C): a user calibration value added to the BME280 temperature reading.

Settings menu + SD config: both values are saved to env_cfg.txt (altitude_m, temp_offset_c) and loaded on boot.

Web UI config: the browser page shows the temp offset and lets you edit/save altitude + temp offset (/api/cfg, /api/setcfg).

SD log graph on-device: added a screen to plot data from env_log.csv.

UI fixes: better menu highlight for themes and “wake screen without activating the selected item.”

ENV Monitor ADV for M5Cardputer is a versatile environment monitoring application for the M5Cardputer platform. It reads data from the BME280 (temperature, humidity, pressure) and VEML7700 (lux) sensors, displaying live readings and saving them to a CSV log on an SD card. The application features a live view with no flicker, Wi-Fi connectivity (both STA and AP modes), and a web interface for viewing live data and downloading logs. It also includes a graphing feature to display logged data on the device screen.

Key Features:
Live display of Lux, Temp, Humidity, and Pressure
Logs data to CSV file on SD card
Graphs data from the log on the screen
Web interface for live monitoring and CSV download
Wi-Fi: connects to your network (STA) or creates a hotspot (AP)
Screen saver to prevent burn-in
Customizable theme colors

name: ESP32 Cleaner - CCleaner for your SD card
description:
CCleaner for your SD card, running on the Cardputer. It finds the hidden files that macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and NAS boxes leave on a card, groups them by pack, and deletes only what you tick.

- Scan the whole card, then review the results by pack or item by item.
- Quick clean scans and deletes in one step. Dry run reports real numbers and deletes nothing.
- The macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and NAS packs are on by default. They match files such as .DS_Store, ._ files, Thumbs.db, $RECYCLE.BIN, LOST.DIR and @eaDir.
- Dev caches, logs and temp files, empty folders and empty files are off by default. When a clean includes a risky pack, the confirm screen names it and asks you to press Enter twice.
- Add your own glob rules on the device or in /sdcleaner.rules on the card.
- The scan writes results to a file on the card and keeps one offset and one bit per item in RAM, so it handles tens of thousands of matches.

One image runs on the Cardputer and the Cardputer ADV.

name: ESP32 Marauder for M5Stick C Plus (Screen works)
description:
The latest updated version of ESP32Maurauder with SD Card support and some much needed changes to the on-screen menu. More features work, but there are still a few things that aren't fully operational. I was able to get PCAPs stored to the SD Card for offline cracking, so that's a start.

You have to build your own SD Card adapter to plug into the M5Stick C Plus. To wire this up, you can get any generic Arduino/esp32 SPI MicroSD slot with 6 pins. 

StickCPlus Header - SPI SD Card Reader
             3v3   -   3v3
              GND   -   GND
               G0   -   CLK
          G36/G25   -   MISO
              G26   -   MOSI
                       
CS on the reader should be jumpered to GND

Known issues:
Recommend using external power. When the battery voltage drops, even a little, some brands of SD Cards stop working properly and could get corrupted.
No touch screen, so you can only use the "next" key (side button) and "select" key (M5 button on the front) to navigate

name: ESP32 Marauder – Custom UI + External Display
description:
A modified version of ESP32 Marauder featuring a redesigned user interface, external ILI9341 SPI display support, and additional improvements.

### Features

- Redesigned user interface
- External ILI9341 display support
- Dual-screen functionality
- **GPS U032 via Grove** – automatic baud rate detection, hot-plug reconnection without restarting, and automatic clearing of stale GPS location data.
- **180° screen rotation** – adjustable in settings, with the selected orientation saved after power-off. Rotation also applies to the startup screen and animations.
- Original Marauder features preserved

### External Display (ILI9341)

Connect the external display to your M5Stack Cardputer ADV using the following wiring:

| **ILI9341** | **Cardputer ADV** |
| :---------- | :---------------- |
| GND         | GND               |
| VCC         | 5V OUT            |
| SCK / SCL   | G40               |
| MOSI / SDA  | G14               |
| RST / RES   | G3                |
| DC          | G6                |
| CS          | G5                |
| LED / BLK   | 5V OUT            |

**Note:** Check your display module's voltage requirements before connecting it.

⚙️ Captive portal setup — configure WiFi, font color, font size, auto-refresh interval, and auto-scroll speed from any phone or browser on first boot
💾 Settings persist to NVS flash — survives reboots

Button	Short Press	Long Press (hold ~0.6s)
A (left)	Scroll up	Cycle content: WIKI → JOKE → QUOT → ALL
B (middle)	Fetch new content	Toggle auto-refresh on / off
C (right)	Scroll down	Show QR code (WIKI mode only)
In QR mode, press any button to return to the article.

Hold BtnA during the 3-second boot window to re-enter the setup portal and change WiFi or settings.

Setup (First Boot)
Power on the M5Stack — it will broadcast a WiFi AP called WikiCYD_Setup
Connect your phone or PC to that network
A PORTAL SHOULD OPEN AUTOMATICALLY! IF IT DOES NOT THEN YOU WILL WANT TO TURN OFF YOUR MOBILE DATA AND FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTION FOR YOUR BROWSER. 
Open a browser and go to 192.168.4.1 (only needed if the portal does not open)
Enter your WiFi credentials and choose your preferences:
Font color theme (Blue, Orange, Green, Cyan, White, Multicolor)
Font size (Small / Medium / Large)
Auto-refresh interval (15s → 1hr)
Auto-scroll speed (Off, 30s, 1m, 90s, 2m)
Tap Save & Connect — the device will connect and start fetching content

Note: Photo is of the SMALL multicolor text.

name: Enso (円相) — Ambient Sound Simulator
description:
# Ensō (円相) — Ambient Sound Simulator

A firmware that turns the Cardputer ADV into an **ambient sound generator** for relaxation, meditation, focus and sleep. Every sound is **synthesized in real time** — no recorded samples are used.

## Key features

- **15 sound layers in 7 groups**, mixed freely
  - Water (Rain / Stream / Waves) · Weather (Wind / Thunder) · Life (Leaves / Birds / Crickets) · Fire · Meditative (Bowl / Chime) · Mechanical (Clock / Fan) · Noise (White / Pink)
- **13 preset scenes** (Forest, Ocean, Rainy Day, Thunderstorm, Campfire, Zen Garden, Study Room and more)
- **Drift**: a scene that slowly changes by itself, one layer at a time, with long crossfades
- **Random scene** with one key, and your own scenes saved to the SD card
- **Breathing guide** (Coherent 5.5 / Box 4-4-4-4 / Relax 4-7-8)
- **Session timer** with a singing-bowl bell, and a **sleep timer**
- **Space** (reverb), **LED** effects, and **shake** actions using the built-in IMU

## What you need

- M5Stack Cardputer ADV
- A microSD card (for settings and your own scenes)
- Earphones or an external speaker are recommended (the built-in speaker barely reproduces low sounds)

## Manual (English / Japanese)

https://github.com/oldtokage-collab/Enso

Made by @Tokagetchi / Code by Claude (Anthropic) / License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

# CoreInk Humidor & Environmental Monitor - v1.0.0 Release Package

---
【固件名称】
CoreInk Humidor & Environmental Monitor (雪茄箱 / 室内环境监测仪)

【必须外接硬件 / 传感器说明】
⚠️ 运行本固件必须连接以下传感器，否则无法完成环境感知：
• 主控设备：M5Stack CoreInk (ESP32-PICO-D4，1.54 寸 E-Ink 电子墨水屏)
• 必须传感器：M5Stack Unit ENV-Pro (内置 Bosch BME688 传感器，SKU: U170)
• 连接方式：通过 Grove HY2.0-4P 线缆直接插入 CoreInk 机身顶部的 Port A (I2C 端口：SDA=G32, SCL=G33)

【主要特性】
1. 墨水屏全正相白底黑字显示，护眼纸质质感，强光清晰，双批次屏幕 (D67/M09) 动态驱动防冻结。
2. 室内与雪茄养护全维监测：高精度温湿度(0.1分辨率/65%黄金参考线)、气压、换算海拔高度、Bosch BSEC 空气质量(IAQ/Static IAQ/bVOC/eCO2)及气敏电阻原生阻值。
3. 双曲线历史趋势折线图：支持 10m / 1h / 6h / 24h / 2d / 7d 滚轮自由缩放与历史平移回溯。
4. 四档智能功耗架构：Realtime (高频监测 ~10h)、Balanced (日常浅睡 ~6天)、Eco ULP (10分钟周期深睡 ~2个月)、On-Demand (按需唤醒测量 ~4个月+)。
5. 开机可选 Wi-Fi NTP 校时至硬件 RTC，对时完毕彻底断开 Wi-Fi 射频，纯离线零辐射超长续航。

【按键操作】
• G5 (EXT 按键)：短按在【主仪表盘】与【空气质量实验室】之间切换；长按(>=800ms)呼出【功耗模式选单】。
• 顶部三向拨轮：G37(上推放大/向后回溯)、G39(下拉缩小/向前平移)、G38(中键短按切换缩放/平移模式)。
• 电源键 (G27)：单击重启；双击彻底关机断电。


---
[Firmware Name]
CoreInk Humidor & Environmental Monitor (Cigar Humidor & Air Quality Monitor)

[Required Sensor & Hardware Notice]
⚠️ This firmware REQUIRES external sensor hardware to function properly:
• Main Device: M5Stack CoreInk (ESP32-PICO-D4 with 1.54" E-Ink Display)
• Required Sensor: M5Stack Unit ENV-Pro (equipped with Bosch BME688, SKU: U170)
• Connection: Plug into CoreInk Port A (Grove HY2.0-4P connector on the top, I2C: SDA=GPIO32, SCL=GPIO33)

[Key Features]
1. Crisp True Positive E-Ink Display: Paper-like readability in direct sunlight. Universal auto-probe driver supports both D67 and M09 hardware batches without freezing or flashing.
2. Comprehensive Environmental Sensing: High-precision Temp & Humidity (0.1 resolution with 65% RH humidor benchmark), Atmospheric Pressure, Altitude, and Bosch BSEC Air Quality Engine (IAQ, Static IAQ, bVOC, eCO2, raw gas resistance).
3. Dynamic Dual-Curve History Charts: Smooth zoom (5m to 7d) and bidirectional time-travel panning using the dial switch.
4. 4 Intelligent Power Modes: Realtime (~10h), Balanced (~6 days with dynamic light-sleep), Eco ULP (~2 months with 10-min deep-sleep cycle), and On-Demand (~4+ months).
5. Fast Wi-Fi NTP Time Sync: Syncs RTC (BM8563) on boot and shuts off Wi-Fi immediately for ultra-low power offline operation.

[Controls]
• G5 (EXT Button): Short press to toggle Main Dashboard / Air Quality Lab; Long press (>=800ms) to open Power Mode Menu.
• Top Dial Wheel: G37 (Up / Zoom-in / Pan-back), G39 (Down / Zoom-out / Pan-forward), G38 (Mid-click to toggle Zoom/Pan mode).
• Power Button (G27): Click to reboot; Double-click to power off completely.

MOSI → PIN 9 (GPIO 14)
CS → PIN 13 (GPIO 5)

GND               →    GND (Ground) 
G32 (SDA)         →    SDA (I2C Data)
G33 (SCL)         →    SCL (I2C Clock)
G26               →    RST (Reset - CRITICAL!)
G25               →    Left + Right Audio Input
⚠️ IMPORTANT: The RST (reset) connection to G26 is CRITICAL - without it, the Si4713 won't be detected on I2C!

Button A: Select/activate modes

Perfect for MP3 players, phones, etc.
Same frequency controls as RDS mode
Real-time transmission
🌐 Mode 3: Custom Messages (Portal)

Web interface opens automatically in browser
Upload up to 5 custom messages (50 characters each)
Messages saved permanently to device memory
📝 Mode 4: Custom Broadcast
Transmits only YOUR uploaded messages
Same interface as RDS mode but with custom content
Auto-cycling through your messages

10–50 ft reliable
100–200 ft faint / receiver-dependent
Moderate wire (≈12–18″):
100–300 ft reliable
RDS may drop before audio
Quarter-wave (~30″):

# DeskClock for Cardputer ADV

基于 `UIFlow2 / MicroPython` 的 Cardputer ADV 桌面信息面板程序。

## 项目简介

这个程序运行在 `Cardputer ADV` 上，用于在主界面集中显示时间、日期、天气、日出日落、经纬度、梅登黑德网格以及当前通联呼号等信息。

当前版本以“稳定可用”为优先，适合作为日常值守和后续继续升级的基础版本。

## 主要功能

- 本地时间显示，按东八区校时
- UTC 时间显示
- 日期与星期显示
- 按经纬度拉取真实天气数据
- 显示实时温度
- 联网后拉取真实日出、日落时间
- 显示当前使用的经纬度
- 根据经纬度计算 6 位梅登黑德网格
- 通过 WS 显示当前正在通联的呼号
- 支持 WiFi 自动连接、扫描、保存
- 支持设置固定城市、固定经纬度、GPS 开关、WS 服务器 IP
- 支持亮度切换、熄屏、查看电量
- 支持手动刷新天气与 WS

## 主界面显示内容

- 本地时间
- UTC 时间
- 日期
- 星期
- 状态栏
- 温度
- 当前通联呼号
- Maidenhead 6 位网格
- 纬度 / 经度
- Sunrise / Sunset

## 按键说明

主界面下：

- `L`：切换亮度，共 4 档
  - `100%`
  - `75%`
  - `50%`
  - `25%`
- `ESC`：熄屏，再按一次亮屏
- `S`：进入设置页面
- `B`：显示当前电量
- `R`：刷新天气、温度、日出、日落
- `W`：重连 WS，刷新呼号数据

设置界面下：

- `;`：上移选择
- `.`：下移选择
- `Enter`：进入或编辑当前项
- `ESC`：返回主界面

## 设置页面

当前设置项包括：

- `City`
- `Lat`
- `Lon`
- `GPS`
- `IP`
- `WiFi Setup`
- `Back`

说明：

- `GPS = OFF` 时，天气按填写的固定经纬度拉取
- `GPS = ON` 时，优先使用 GPS 获取的经纬度
- `IP` 用于连接呼号 WS 服务

## WiFi 逻辑

开机后程序会先尝试连接已保存的 WiFi。

如果已保存 WiFi 不可用，则可进入 `WiFi Setup`：

1. 扫描周边 WiFi
2. 选择网络
3. 输入密码
4. 连接并保存

## 天气与位置逻辑

天气、温度、日出、日落均按“当前实际使用的经纬度”拉取：

- GPS 关闭：使用设置中填写的 `Lat / Lon`
- GPS 开启：优先使用 GPS 坐标

梅登黑德网格也按当前使用的经纬度实时计算。

## 呼号显示逻辑

主界面的 `Call:` 区域用于显示当前正在通联的呼号。

- WS 连接成功时，状态可显示为 `WS OK`
- 未连接时显示 `WS Off`
- 重连过程中可显示 `WS Try`

当前版本中，呼号字体颜色已设为红色。

## 状态栏常见含义

- `Boot`：启动中
- `Clock OK`：校时成功
- `Clock Loc`：使用本地时间
- `Wx OK`：天气刷新成功
- `Wx Off`：天气刷新失败
- `WS OK`：WS 已连接
- `WS Off`：WS 未连接
- `WS Try`：WS 重连中
- `Offline`：网络未连接
- `BATxx%`：当前电量
- `BL 100% / 75% / 50% / 25%`：亮度档位

## 目录与主要文件

主程序：

- [cardputer_adv_dashboard_uiflow2.py](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/cardputer_adv_dashboard_uiflow2.py)

当前推荐的用户文件系统镜像：

- [deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin)

当前推荐的完整总固件：

- [deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin)

刷写说明：

- [刷写说明_CardputerADV_DeskClock.txt](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/刷写说明_CardputerADV_DeskClock.txt)

当前最佳版本备份：

- [backup_20260709_best_so_far](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/backup_20260709_best_so_far)

## 刷写方式

### 方式一：刷完整总固件

适合一次性完整刷入。

- 写入地址：`0x0`
- 文件：`deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin`

示例：

```bash
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 --port COMx --baud 1500000 write_flash 0x0 deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin
```

### 方式二：只刷用户文件系统

适合设备已经有匹配版本 UIFlow2 固件，只更新程序。

- 写入地址：`0x641000`
- 文件：`deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin`

示例：

```bash
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 --port COMx --baud 1500000 write_flash 0x641000 deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin
```

说明：

- `COMx` 请替换为实际串口号
- 当前分区按本地 UIFlow2 源码确认：
  - `vfs offset = 0x641000`
  - `vfs size = 0x1BE000`

## 版本说明

当前版本重点：

- 主界面闪烁已明显减轻
- 时间区域刷新更稳定
- 日期与星期显示已恢复
- 天气刷新与 WS 刷新已拆分
- 呼号显示逻辑已按“当前正在通联的呼号”处理

## 使用建议

推荐首次使用流程：

1. 先刷完整总固件
2. 配置 WiFi
3. 配置固定经纬度或开启 GPS
4. 配置 WS 服务器 IP
5. 返回主界面观察时间、天气、日出日落和呼号状态

后续如果只是更新程序，优先只刷 `fs-user` 镜像即可。

# DeskClock for Cardputer ADV

Cardputer ADV desktop information panel program based on `UIFlow2/MicroPython`.

## Project Introduction

This program runs on `Cardputer ADV` and is used to display information such as time, date, weather, sunrise and sunset, longitude and latitude, Maidenhead grid and current call sign on the main interface.

The current version prioritizes "stable and usable" and is suitable as a basic version for daily maintenance and subsequent upgrades.

## Main functions

- Local time display, according to East Eighth District school time
- UTC time display
- Date and day display
- Pull real weather data by latitude and longitude
- Display real-time temperature
- Pull the real sunrise and sunset times after connecting to the Internet
- Display the currently used latitude and longitude
- Calculate 6-digit Maidenhead grid based on latitude and longitude
- Display the call sign currently being contacted via WS
- Support WiFi automatic connection, scanning, and saving
- Support setting fixed city, fixed latitude and longitude, GPS switch, WS server IP
-Support brightness switching, screen off, and battery check
-Support manual refresh of weather and WS

## Main interface display content

- local time
- UTC time
- date
- Week
- status bar
- temperature
-Current call sign
- Maidenhead 6-bit grid
- Latitude / Longitude
- Sunrise / Sunset

## Key description

Under the main interface:

- `L`: switch brightness, 4 levels in total
  - `100%`
  - `75%`
  - `50%`
  - `25%`
- `ESC`: turn off the screen, press it again to turn on the screen
- `S`: Enter the settings page
- `B`: Display the current battery level
- `R`: Refresh weather, temperature, sunrise, sunset
- `W`: Reconnect to WS and refresh call sign data

Under the settings interface:

- `;`: Move selection up
- `.`: Move selection down
- `Enter`: enter or edit the current item
- `ESC`: Return to the main interface

## Setting page

Current settings include:

- `City`
- `Lat`
- `Lon`
- `GPS`
- `IP`
- `WiFi Setup`
- `Back`

illustrate:

- When `GPS = OFF`, the weather is pulled based on the filled in fixed longitude and latitude
- When `GPS = ON`, priority is given to using the longitude and latitude obtained by GPS
- `IP` is used to connect to the callsign WS service

## WiFi logic

After booting, the program will first try to connect to the saved WiFi.
If the saved WiFi is not available, you can enter `WiFi Setup`:

1. Scan surrounding WiFi
2. Select network
3. Enter password
4. Connect and save

## Weather and location logic

Weather, temperature, sunrise, and sunset are all pulled according to the "currently used longitude and latitude":

- GPS off: Use `Lat / Lon` filled in settings
- GPS on: Prioritize using GPS coordinates

The Maidenhead grid is also calculated in real time at the currently used latitude and longitude.

## Call sign display logic

The `Call:` area of ​​the main interface is used to display the call sign currently being contacted.

- When the WS connection is successful, the status can be displayed as `WS OK`
- Display `WS Off` when not connected
- `WS Try` can be displayed during reconnection process

In the current version, the call sign font color has been set to red.

## Common meanings of status bar

- `Boot`: starting
- `Clock OK`: Time adjustment successful
- `Clock Loc`: use local time
- `Wx OK`: Weather refreshed successfully
- `Wx Off`: Weather refresh failed
- `WS OK`: WS is connected
- `WS Off`: WS is not connected
- `WS Try`: WS heavy
- `Offline`: The network is not connected
- `BATxx%`: current battery capacity
- `BL 100% / 75% / 50% / 25%`: brightness level

## Directory and main files

Main program:

- [cardputer_adv_dashboard_uiflow2.py](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/cardputer_adv_dashboard_uiflow2.py)

Currently recommended user file system images:

- [deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin)

Current recommended complete firmware:

- [deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin)

Flashing instructions:
- [Flash Instructions_CardputerADV_DeskClock.txt](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/Flash Instructions_CardputerADV_DeskClock.txt)

Current best version backup:

- [backup_20260709_best_so_far](C:/Users/Hans/Documents/Codex/2026-07-03/an/outputs/backup_20260709_best_so_far)

## Flash writing method

### Method 1: Flash the complete firmware

Suitable for one-time complete brushing.

- Write address: `0x0`
- File: `deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin`

Example:

```bash
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 --port COMx --baud 1500000 write_flash 0x0 deskclock_cardputeradv_full_8mb.bin
```

### Method 2: Only flash the user file system

For devices that already have a matching version of UIFlow2 firmware, only update the program.

- Write address: `0x641000`
- File: `deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin`

Example:

```bash
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 --port COMx --baud 1500000 write_flash 0x641000 deskclock_cardputeradv_fs-user_clean.bin
```

illustrate:

- `COMx` please replace with the actual serial port number
- The current partition is confirmed according to the local UIFlow2 source code:
  - `vfs offset = 0x641000`
  - `vfs size = 0x1BE000`

## Release Notes

Highlights of the current version:

- Main interface flickering has been significantly reduced
- Time area refresh is more stable
- Date and day display has been restored
- Weather refresh and WS refresh have been split
- The call sign display logic has been processed according to the "call sign currently being contacted"

## Usage suggestions

Recommended first-time use process:

1. First flash the complete firmware
2. Configure WiFi
3. Configure fixed latitude and longitude or turn on GPS
4. Configure WS server IP
5. Return to the main interface to observe the time, weather, sunrise and sunset and call sign status

If you only update the program in the future, just flash the `fs-user` image first.

### 中文

FORM Gaussian Avatar 是 M5Stack CoreS3 上的可定制高斯点云角色演示。最多保存 16 个角色，可通过 USB 从 FORM Avatar Studio 传入最多 5,000 点的角色。触摸屏支持切换表情、转身和缩放；长按可打开设置并切换角色。动作和表情默认循环播放。

name: Fatalcraft Cardputer Edition
description:
# Fatalcraft Cardputer Edition

A voxel sandbox for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV. Generate a world, dig, build, explore mountains and rivers, and find the way into the Glimmerdeep dimension.

## Features
- Large, varied worlds: mountains, rivers, waterfalls, biomes and 10 tree types
- Glimmerdeep dimension with three zones: glimmer forest, amethyst chasm and ash basin
- World map on **M** with four zoom levels, saved to the SD card
- Creative mode, or survival mode (health, hunger, crafting, tools), chosen when creating a world
- Chat and commands such as `/tp`, `/give`, `/fill`, `/dim`, `/gamemode` and `/panorama`
- Built for the 240×135 screen, with lower resolution modes for more speed

## Controls
- **W A S D**: move
- **; . , /**: look around
- **L**: break block (hold for several)
- **'** or **Enter**: place block
- **M**: world map
- **`** (Esc): pause menu
- **Fn+2**: screenshot

## Requirements
- M5Stack Cardputer ADV
- microSD card recommended. Without one, the internal flash is used.

## Credits
- Developer and assets: Fatallon
- Skin edited by @napsaw (Fiverr)
- Based on Fatalcraft main engine 22

Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
