name: FeiyuOS for Cardputer Adv
description:
肥鱼 OS：跑在 Cardputer Adv 上的 AI 小操作系统，无需宿主机——不用连电脑、不用树莓派，连上 Wi-Fi 后录音、识别、执行都由设备自己完成。

按住 Enter 说一句话，大肥鱼（DeepSeek）调度设备能力：位置天气路线、联网搜索、红外遥控、屏幕显示、SSH 连主机；还能把几件事组合成小程序，定时或开机自动运行。

设置可以用手机：设置页选「手机设置（扫码）」，手机扫码连上设备热点，自动弹出设置页，Wi-Fi 和各种 Key 都在手机上填，不用在小键盘上敲。

常用按键
· 按住 Enter：说话，松开发送
· Y / N / A：执行 / 取消 / 本任务后续都执行
· ; 和 .：在时间线上下移动；/ 打开详情；, 回到最新
· `（Esc）：取消当前任务
· Btn0：切换 Agent / SSH
· Fn+W：设置（Wi-Fi、Key、SSH 主机、手机扫码设置）
· Fn+H：帮助
· Fn+Del：清空对话记忆

须知：只支持 Cardputer Adv。固件不含任何 Key，首次开机自动进入设置页，填写 Wi-Fi（仅 2.4 GHz）、语音识别 Key（通义千问）和 DeepSeek Key。右下角吉祥物：把 GitHub Release 里的 mascot.bin 放到 TF 卡 /vat/assets/。

源码、完整说明和更新记录：https://github.com/hedykan/FeiyuOS
author: hedykan-0
description_en:
Feiyu OS: A small AI operating system that runs on Cardputer Adv. It does not require a host—no need to connect to a computer or Raspberry Pi. After connecting to Wi-Fi, recording, recognition, and execution are all completed by the device itself.

Press and hold Enter to say a word, and DeepSeek will schedule equipment capabilities: location weather route, network search, infrared remote control, screen display, SSH connection to the host; it can also combine several things into a small program to run automatically at a scheduled time or on startup.

You can use your mobile phone to set up: Select "Mobile phone settings (scan QR code)" on the settings page, scan the QR code on your phone to connect to the device hotspot, and the settings page will automatically pop up. Wi-Fi and various keys can be filled in on the phone, without typing on the small keyboard.

Commonly used keys
· Press and hold Enter: speak, release to send
· Y / N / A: Execute / Cancel / This task will be executed subsequently
· ; and .: move up and down the timeline; / open details;, return to the latest
· `(Esc): Cancel the current task
· Btn0: Switch Agent/SSH
· Fn+W: Settings (Wi-Fi, Key, SSH host, mobile phone scan code settings)
· Fn+H: Help
· Fn+Del: Clear conversation memory

Note: Only Cardputer Adv is supported. The firmware does not contain any Key. When you turn it on for the first time, you will automatically enter the settings page and fill in the Wi-Fi (only 2.4 GHz), speech recognition Key (Tongyi Qianwen) and DeepSeek Key. Mascot in the lower right corner: Put mascot.bin in GitHub Release to TF card /vat/assets/.

Source code, complete description and update record: https://github.com/hedykan/FeiyuOS

name: Firefly Clock
description:
**萤火虫时钟 · 腐草为萤，时光为钟**

> *In the deep of night, when the grass whispers and the stars blink softly,*
> *a tiny firefly alights on your palm — carrying not just its glow,*
> *but the quiet passage of time itself.*
>
> *每当夜幕低垂，草叶低语，星子轻眨，*
> *一只小小的萤火虫落在你掌心——它衔来的不只是光，*
> *还有时光静静流淌的声音。*

---

**Firefly Clock** transforms your M5StickS3 into a living diorama — a miniature grassland that breathes, sways, and glows. Watch 1400 grass blades dance in the wind, fireflies drift through the dark, stars twinkle at their own rhythm, and a soft clock marks the hours. Tilt the device to look around. Press a button to change the mood. All on a 240×135 screen that fits in your pocket.

**萤火虫时钟** 把你的 M5StickS3 变成一座掌心的微缩草原——它会呼吸、会摇曳、会发光。1400 根草叶随风起舞，萤火虫在夜色中飘游，星星各自闪烁，左上角的时钟安静地走着。转动设备换个视角，按一下按钮换种心情。一切都在 240×135 的小屏幕上，刚好装进口袋。

---

## ✨ How It Glows · 它如何发光

| Mode · 模式 | What you'll see · 你会看见 |
|---|---|
| **Fire** 🔥 | Fireflies rise from the grass like earth breathing starlight / 萤火虫从草丛升起，仿佛大地在呼吸星光 |
| **Walk** 🚶 | You walk through the field; the grass parts as you move, the world turns with your wrist / 你穿行在原野中，草叶随你分开，天地随你手腕转动 |
| **Free** 🎐 | The camera drifts like a daydream, gentle and unhurried / 镜头像一场白日梦般漂浮，温柔而从容 |

---

## 🌙 What it carries · 它带走什么

- **1400+ grass blades** — tall green stalks and short brown ground cover, bending in the wind, rooted in a undulating terrain / 1400 多根草叶——高的青绿，低的褐黄，随风俯仰，扎根在起伏的地表上
- **Wind that sweeps** — variable direction and speed, like a real summer night / 风是扫过去的——方向在变，速度在变，像真正的夏夜
- **60 twinkling stars** — each with its own rhythm, some shy, some bold / 60 颗星星，各自闪烁，有的害羞，有的热烈
- **Fireflies that pulse** — drifting gently, glowing in soft rhythm, like tiny lanterns on a summer field / 萤火虫缓缓飘游，柔和地明灭，像夏夜里的小灯笼
- **A clock that knows the time** — WiFi syncs on boot, connects to the world, then quietly lets go / 时钟知道现在几点——开机时连上 WiFi 获取时间，然后静静断开，不打扰

---

## 🕯️ How to begin · 如何开始

| Step · 步骤 | What happens · 发生了什么 |
|---|---|
| 1. Power on | The splash appears. WiFi connects silently in the background / 开机画面点亮，WiFi 在后台静默连接 |
| 2. Wait 6 seconds | The screen shows: *Connecting WiFi...* → *Syncing time...* → *Time synced* or *Press A to setup* / 屏幕会告诉你 WiFi 连上了没、时间同步了没 |
| 3. Press **A** (if time missing) | AP mode: scan the QR with your phone, enter WiFi, save — done / 扫二维码，输 WiFi，保存，重启后自动对时 |
| 4. Enter the grassland | Three modes, one button, infinite calm / 三种模式，一个按钮，无尽的安宁 |

---

**萤火虫时钟** 把你的 M5StickS3 变成一座掌心的微缩草原——它会呼吸、会摇曳、会发光。1400 根草叶随风起舞，萤火虫在夜色中飘游，星星各自闪烁，左上角的时钟安静地走着。转动设备换个视角，按一下按钮换种心情。一切都在 240×135 的小屏幕上，刚好装进口袋。

---

## ✨ How It Glows · 它如何发光

| Mode · 模式 | What you'll see · 你会看见 |
|---|---|
| **Fire** 🔥 | Fireflies rise from the grass like earth breathing starlight / 萤火虫从草丛升起，仿佛大地在呼吸星光 |
| **Walk** 🚶 | You walk through the field; the grass parts as you move, the world turns with your wrist / 你穿行在原野中，草叶随你分开，天地随你手腕转动 |
| **Free** 🎐 | The camera drifts like a daydream, gentle and unhurried / 镜头像一场白日梦般漂浮，温柔而从容 |

---

## 🌙 What it carries · 它带走什么

- **1400+ grass blades** — tall green stalks and short brown ground cover, bending in the wind, rooted in a undulating terrain / 1400 多根草叶——高的青绿，低的褐黄，随风俯仰，扎根在起伏的地表上
- **Wind that sweeps** — variable direction and speed, like a real summer night / 风是扫过去的——方向在变，速度在变，像真正的夏夜
- **60 twinkling stars** — each with its own rhythm, some shy, some bold / 60 颗星星，各自闪烁，有的害羞，有的热烈
- **Fireflies that pulse** — drifting gently, glowing in soft rhythm, like tiny lanterns on a summer field / 萤火虫缓缓飘游，柔和地明灭，像夏夜里的小灯笼
- **A clock that knows the time** — WiFi syncs on boot, connects to the world, then quietly lets go / 时钟知道现在几点——开机时连上 WiFi 获取时间，然后静静断开，不打扰

name: Fox Hunt for M5StickS3
description:
Fox Hunt for M5StickS3

Active hide-and-seek game for two M5StickS3 devices. One player hides as the Fox, and the other searches as the Hunter.

The game uses radio (ESP-NOW) to track distance like a "hot-or-cold" radar and an infrared beam (IR) on top of the device for direct line-of-sight tag shots.

Hardware

    2x M5StickS3 devices.
    No extra components required: all game mechanics use the built-in screen, buttons, speaker, radio antenna, and top-facing IR transmitter/receiver.

Important: The infrared sensor is located on the top edge of the M5StickS3. Do not cover the top of the case with fingers, stickers, or clothes, or shots will not register.
Game Rules
Role Selection

When turned on, the screen prompts for role selection:

    Side Button: Choose Fox.
    Blue Front Button: Choose Hunter.
    Both Buttons (pressed together): Return to role selection menu.

Hunter

    Starts with 5 shots.
    The screen shows a signal bar in the center. When the bar is low (green), the Fox is far away. When the bar fills up with yellow and red segments, the Fox is nearby.
    Press the Blue Front Button to fire.
    Save your ammo: Shooting from far away is useless. The IR beam will miss, the Fox will not react, and you will lose the game once all 5 shots are spent. Wait until the signal bar turns red to strike!
    You must aim the top of the device directly at the Fox.
    If you shoot while close to the Fox and miss with the IR beam, the Fox dodges, and you receive a 30-second penalty lockdown during which you cannot shoot.
    If you use all 5 shots without tagging the Fox, you lose.

Fox

    Hide and do not get tagged.
    The Fox automatically barks at random intervals (every 40 to 75 seconds) and can manually bark using the Side Button.
        If the IR beam hits your device, you are caught and the Hunter wins.
        If the IR beam does not hit, you successfully dodge: a 30-second countdown screen appears, giving you time to run and hide again while the Hunter is penalized.

How to Flash via Arduino IDE
1. Requirements

    Arduino IDE 2.x
    ESP32 Board Package (by Espressif) version 3.0.0 or newer
    M5Unified library (install via Library Manager: Tools -> Manage Libraries -> search "M5Unified")

No third-party IR libraries are required. The project uses built-in ESP-IDF drivers.
2. Board Configuration

Open Arduino IDE, connect the M5StickS3 via USB-C, and set the following under the Tools menu:

    Board: M5StickS3 (or "ESP32S3 Dev Module")
    USB CDC On Boot: Enabled
    Flash Size: 8MB
    Partition Scheme: Default 8MB with SPIFFS
    PSRAM: OPI PSRAM
    Upload Speed: 921600
    Port: Select the COM port corresponding to your connected device

3. Flashing

    Open the project sketch (.ino file).
    Click the Upload button.
    Flash the exact same sketch to both M5StickS3 devices.

p.s

Please note: every letter and pixel of this project is a "vibecode" cursed by all the gods—please be extremely attentive and understanding. I did the best I could; please forgive me.

name: GPS & GNSS Monitor
description:
**GPS & GNSS Monitor** is a firmware for the M5StickS3 that turns the device into a compact, portable GPS/GNSS monitoring system. By connecting a compatible GPS or GNSS module through UART, you can monitor positioning data, navigation parameters, satellite reception, and trip statistics directly on the device's display.

### Features

- 📍 **Position Monitoring** — View latitude and longitude in real time.
- 🚀 **Speed Monitoring** — Display current speed with selectable measurement units.
- ⛰️ **Altitude Monitoring** — View altitude with configurable units.
- 📏 **Distance Tracking** — Monitor the distance traveled during a trip.
- 🗺️ **Route Statistics** — View route information, including total distance, average moving speed, and starting coordinates.
- 🧭 **Course Monitoring** — Display the current direction of movement and related navigation data.
- 🛰️ **Satellite & Signal Information** — Monitor the number of satellites and HDOP (Horizontal Dilution of Precision) to assess positioning quality.
- 📅 **Date & Time** — Display GPS-derived date and time with customizable formats and timezone settings.
- ⏱️ **Session Information** — Track time in motion and other trip-related information.
- 🎨 **Display Customization** — Configure theme colors, brightness, screen orientation, and screen timeout.
- ⚙️ **GPS/GNSS Configuration** — Select UART RX and TX GPIOs, configure the communication baud rate, and adjust the module timeout.
- 🔧 **Flexible Settings** — Customize measurement units, coordinate formats, date and time formats, and screen update intervals.
- 💾 **Persistent Configuration** — Settings are saved in non-volatile storage (NVS) and retained after restarting the device.

### Navigation

- **Button B — Short press:** Move to the next screen.
- **Button B — Long press:** Move to the previous screen.
- **Button A:** Navigate between additional views on supported screens or change the selected setting.

### Recommended UART Connections

For the M5StickS3, the recommended GPIO configuration depends on the connection interface.

**Hat2-Bus**
- Configure G44 as RX and G43 as TX.
- Module TX → G44.
- Module RX → G43.

**HY2.0-4P**
- Configure G10 as RX and G9 as TX.
- Module TX → G10.
- Module RX → G9.

The firmware provides additional GPIO options that may not correspond to GPIOs physically available on the M5StickS3. These options are intended to make the firmware easier to adapt to other devices, including the M5 Cardputer and other devices in the M5Stick family. Always verify the available pins and UART capabilities of your specific hardware before connecting a module.

### Documentation & Source Code

The complete documentation, wiring instructions, configuration details, firmware information, and Arduino `.ino` source code are available in the project repository:

**GitHub:** https://github.com/viniciushnf/M5StickS3-GPS-GNSS-Monitor

The source code can be inspected, modified, and compiled using the Arduino IDE with the appropriate M5StickS3 board support and required libraries.

For questions, suggestions, or feedback, feel free to contact me on Instagram: [@viniciushnf](https://www.instagram.com/viniciushnf/).

name: GPSDO Dashboard
description:
GPSDO Dashboard Pro for M5Tab5
The ultimate precision timing and GNSS monitoring hub.

Description: GPSDO Dashboard for M5Tab5 is a professional real-time monitoring, visualization, and time-server application for GPS Disciplined Oscillators based on u-blox GNSS receivers (tested with LEA-M8F/M8 series). Powered by the high-performance ESP32-P4, it transforms your M5Tab5 into a high-precision timing hub and a dedicated NMEA data source for amateur radio equipment.

The application expertly parses UBX (NAV-PVT, TIM-TP, NAV-SAT) and NMEA messages via hardware UART, presenting critical timing, positioning, and synchronization parameters on a crisp high-resolution touchscreen.

Main Features:

Professional Dashboard: Real-time status optimized for the M5Tab5 display with clear visual indicators for UART, FIX, TIME, and PPS.
High Precision & SBAS: Full support for SBAS (EGNOS/WAAS/MSAS) differential corrections. Visual "DIFF" status indicates when a DGPS solution is active for sub-meter positioning accuracy.
Dynamic 3D Visualization: Animated 3D Earth globe with day/night terminator, smooth rotation, and live receiver position.
Amateur Radio Ready: Automatic 10-character Maidenhead grid locator calculation and dedicated IC-9700 NMEA Echo function.
Sync Monitoring: Precise PPS status based on UBX TIM-TP messages and satellite constellation view (Skyplot).
Battery Intelligence: Real-time voltage monitoring, charging status, and animated battery health indicators.
Network & NTP Capabilities:

Stratum 1 NTP Server: Serves precise time to your local network using the GPSDO as the primary reference.
NTP Analytics: Dedicated dashboard screen showing total requests, last client IP, and request age.
Dual Wi-Fi Mode: Operates as a standalone Access Point (AP) or connects to your home network as a Station (STA).
Remote Web Control: Modern web interface at your device's IP to monitor status and remotely adjust settings (Brightness, Theme, Language).
Interaction & Configuration:

Settings Overlay: New touch-accessible menu to configure all parameters without re-flashing.
Configurable UART: Toggle between 9600 , 57600 and 115200 bps baud rates on the fly to match your GPSDO hardware.
NMEA Echo: Forward raw NMEA data via Serial2 (GPIO 1) to external rigs like the Icom IC-9700 to provide them with GPS position and time.
Live UART Terminal: High-speed terminal view for raw NMEA/UBX data analysis with pause/resume functionality.
Customization: Toggle between Night Mode (dark theme) and English/Polish languages.
Non-Volatile Memory (NVS): All settings (WiFi, NTP, Brightness, NMEA Echo, Baud) are persistently saved and restored after power-off.
Technical Specifications:

Platform: M5Stack M5Tab5 (ESP32-P4)
Interface: Hardware UART (configurable pins/baud)
Forwarding: Serial2 (NMEA Echo) on GPIO 1
Protocols: UBX (Binary), NMEA 0183 (ASCII)
Rendering: High-performance offscreen sprite-based engine
This application is the perfect companion for radio amateurs, time-frequency enthusiasts, and laboratory environments requiring reliable, real-time GPSDO monitoring and distribution.

Data input pins 37/38GPS_UART_RX_PIN / GPS_UART_TX_PIN

In version 2.2, I added an EME tab to the project, which additionally contains Doppler correction values for the frequencies of eight bands: 2 m, 70 cm, 23 cm, 13 cm, 9 cm, 6 cm, 3 cm, and 1.25 cm.

USB Host Support: Implemented EspUsbHost integration, allowing GPSDO connection via the USB port (CDC-ACM driver).
Input Source Selection: Added a new option in Settings to switch between UART (default PIN 37/38) and USB HOST.
Smart Restart: Switching input sources now triggers an automatic reboot to ensure clean driver initialization.

Another update.

I added a screen showing oscillator stability.

The application collects the clkD parameter from the UBX-NAV-CLOCK message and stores it in a circular buffer of 3600 samples, which corresponds to about one hour of history at a 1 Hz update rate.

It is important to understand that clkD is not a direct measurement of the external oscillator.
It is an internally estimated value computed by the GNSS receiver (Kalman filter), so it reflects how the receiver “perceives” clock stability rather than the raw signal itself.

Based on this data, Allan deviation (ADEV) is calculated for averaging times of 1 s, 10 s, 100 s, and 300 s.

This provides a reasonably good insight into short-term and mid-term stability (e.g., an OCXO operating in GPSDO mode).

Note: ADEV calculated from clkD represents the stability estimated by the GNSS receiver, not the true physical stability of the oscillator.

v4 added: 

Holdover prediction. When the GPS fix is lost (e.g. during jamming), the firmware estimates the growing time error from the oscillator using Terr(t) = f0·t + ½·drift·t² (where f0 is the frequency offset at fix loss and drift is from a linear regression of recent ppb samples). Extrapolates the time remaining before crossing a 1 µs trust threshold.

Time Accuracy (tAcc). Live readout of UBX NAV-CLOCK tAcc field — the trust metric for time under interference (color-coded: <50 ns green, <100 ns orange, ≥100 ns red).

Jamming / interference monitor (UBX-MON-HW). CW Jamming Indicator (%), AGC level (%), Noise level, and the receiver's automatic jamming state (UNKNOWN / OK / WARNING / CRITICAL).

Historical graphs (~5 minutes). Tab5 has a new 4-graph screen — Satellites, HDOP, Jamming %, and tAcc with a 100 ns threshold line. Accessed by tapping the left half of the screen below the header.

Tab5 NET mode. Tab5 can now act as a TCP client of a remote miniGPSDO over WiFi (port 4000, raw NMEA+UBX stream). Selectable as a third input source alongside UART and USB. Tab5 reuses its existing UBX/NMEA parser — no extra code path.

Mini first-boot AP provisioning + web WiFi setup. Mini starts as miniGPSDO / 12345678 AP on first boot for SSID/password entry. Both Tab5 and mini web UIs now expose WiFi configuration, DHCP / static IP, and (Tab5) the mini target address.

Extended HTTP API. /api/status now returns: tacc, jamming (ind, state, agc, noise), holdover, holdoverSec, holdoverErrNs, holdoverTrustSec, plus the existing ppb, adev1/10/100, position, locator, time/date, and per-satellite info.

TCP NMEA + UBX broadcast (port 4000) and NTP stratum-1 server (port 123) on the mini — disciplined directly by GPS time.

Bilingual user and technical documentation (EN + PL, HTML + PDF) included in the project.

name: G_logger_1000Hz(for_ADV)
description:
A high-precision G-force (acceleration) logger specifically designed for the M5Cardputer ADV. It records and visualizes the waveforms of momentary impacts and recoil in detail.

■ Key Features

1000Hz High-Speed Sampling
The standard sampling rate for the BMI270 sensor in the M5Unified library is typically 100Hz. This application directly controls the sensor to achieve 1000Hz (1ms interval) data acquisition.

Up to 27.7G Measurement Capacity
The sensor range is expanded to ±16G per axis. By calculating the 3-axis resultant vector, it can accurately capture a maximum resultant acceleration of up to 27.7G without clipping.

Records ±0.1 Seconds Around the Peak Impact
The moment of peak impact (maximum G-force) is set as the center point (0ms). The application automatically records acceleration data for 0.1 seconds before and after the event, covering a total window of -100ms to +100ms.

Logarithmic Scale Graph (1 pixel = 0.001 sec)
The captured data is instantly plotted on the screen. The X-axis represents 1 pixel = 0.001 seconds (1ms). The Y-axis utilizes a logarithmic scale, ensuring both small vibrations and massive impacts are clearly visible on the small screen without flattening the waveform.

■ Use Cases

Airsoft: Recoil measurement and custom parts evaluation.
Robotics: Impact testing for small robots and mobility devices.
3D Printing: Drop testing and shock absorption of printed parts.
Education: Visualizing physics phenomena such as free fall and impact force.
Sports: Measuring instantaneous acceleration and impacts during sports activities.
Packaging: Evaluating cushioning and shock resistance for shipping.

■ Instructions

[Enter] Key: Reset the measurement and return to the standby screen.

name: Gameboy Enhanced Firmware
description:
Cardputer & Adv; New faster cpu emulation core('fastest' mode in cpu settings, the default unless I get incompatibilty reports). Cycle available scales using the \ button. Change vertical scale & alignment using Fn+\ Check back often for latest updates.

Gameboy Emulator; complete with configurable controls, audio, display and performance options, savegames, save states, filesystem navigation and no .gb rom file size limits imposed by memory. Various other enhancements. Accurate palettes. Partial Super Gameboy Enhancement support, including borders. Extended 12 colour mode, along with all official/original GBC palettes. 44 Analogue Pocket 12 colour community palettes included with automatic mapping of titles to AP palettes partially implemented. Pokemon Silver/Gold,  Dragon Warrior I&II and Azure dreams are the only confirmed fully supported .gbc titles, backwards compatible with the original gameboy and run in that mode. Emulator will behave as if you placed a gameboy colour cartridge into an original gameboy in most instances. Feel free to try other backwards compatible gbc games, but no garuntees on compatiblity. All *.gb and *.gbc files are listed by the file explorer in the current directory.

Read the instructions at the bottom for controls. Forked from original gb_cardputer implementation. As of version 0.75 a launcher is no longer required, versions prior to that have no bootloader merged so if you are having issues try using m5launcher to install.

Save states can be used by pressing the minus/underscore key to load,  and backspace/del to save.

Hold Fn and press the left arrow to mute audio
Hold Fn and press the right arrow to jump to 50/100% volume
Hold Fn and press the up/down arrows to change volume in smaller adjustments.

29.05.2024:v0.61
* Memory solution devised was based on two ideas: Assume stastically random access patterns, and place no limits on addressable space.
The reality is that the gameboy games never exceed 8megabits (1megabyte); Taking advantage of the limitations of the gameboy, I have removed the generalized nature of the	previous solution in favor of one that provides a deterministic approach to page seeking, with the tradeoff that no games larger than a real game boy game can be loaded any longer. This should not pose an issue for any (valid) title. This has increased frame rates slightly all around and made them much steadier; page location has no bearing on access times. Page seek times are fixed, and a minor amount of page maintenance is done at these intervals, distributed across successive calls still. This would be deterministic page seeking mixed with the previous progressive pruning.

29.05.2024:v0.61
* Memory solution devised was based on two ideas: Assume stastically random access patterns, and place no limits on addressable space.
The reality is that the gameboy games never exceed 8megabits (1megabyte); Taking advantage of the limitations of the gameboy, I have removed the generalized nature of the	previous solution in favor of one that provides a deterministic approach to page seeking, with the tradeoff that no games larger than a real game boy game can be loaded any longer. This should not pose an issue for any (valid) title. This has increased frame rates slightly all around and made them much steadier; page location has no bearing on access times. Page seek times are fixed, and a minor amount of page maintenance is done at these intervals, distributed across successive calls still. This would be deterministic page seeking mixed with the previous progressive pruning.

name: GeminiPuter
description:
⚡ GeminiPuter v2.0 (Cardputer & Cardputer ADV)

GitHub Release License: MIT PlatformIO Gemini Hardware

An advanced, interactive firmware transforming the M5Stack Cardputer and Cardputer ADV into a full-featured pocket AI assistant powered by Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite with native hardware function calling, bilingual Russian/English keyboard layout, live web remote console, and dynamic RGB lighting effects.

Note

Fork Attribution: This project is an advanced fork of the original GeminiPuter created by nishad2m8. We express our sincere gratitude to the original author for the foundational inspiration!
🚀 Key Improvements & Comparison
Feature 	Original (nishad2m8/GeminiPuter) 	Our Fork (AdvaScript/GeminiPuter v2.0)
Hardware Compatibility 	Standard M5Cardputer only 	M5Stack Cardputer + Cardputer ADV
Gemini AI Model 	Hardcoded gemini-1.5-flash (Deprecated / 404 error) 	gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-flash, customizable via Web UI
Inference Speed 	Default thinking latency 	Zero-latency thinking mode (thinkingBudget: 0) for near-instant responses
Hardware Function Calling 	❌ None (pure text assistant) 	✅ Full Tool Calling: Screen brightness, WS2812 RGB LED effects, real battery state
RGB LED Integration 	❌ None 	✅ 11 Built-in animations + custom JSON animation patterns + visual web mirror
Language & Keyboard 	English only (QWERTY) 	🇷🇺 Bilingual (English + Russian Cyrillic phonetic layout) with HUD toast notification
Web Console & Telemetry 	Basic Wi-Fi captive setup portal 	🌐 Cyberpunk Live Web HUD: Real-time mirrored transcript, remote keyboard, live telemetry
UI Aesthetics 	Default green text 	🎨 Sleek Dark Theme: Electric blue Gemini responses (#38B6FF), right-aligned user bubbles
Watchdog & Stability 	Watchdog resets on long answers 	🛡️ FreeRTOS thread isolation, mutex guards, feed loops preventing WDT panics
Easter Eggs 	❌ None 	🤢 Built-in IMU Shake / /shake Easter egg
✨ Features Breakdown
🧠 Gemini 3.1 & Hardware Control (Function Calling)

Gemini can directly control your Cardputer hardware using Google Function Declarations:

    Screen Brightness: "Set screen brightness to 20%" or "Dim the display".
    RGB LED Lamp: "Turn the lamp red", "Switch to rainbow effect", "Blink cyan at 50% brightness", "Turn off the LED".
    Custom Patterns: Ask Gemini to generate custom blinking patterns or moods.
    Battery Status: "How much battery is left?" (queries the internal AXP/ADC power sensor).

⌨️ Bilingual Russian & English Keyboard

    Switch layouts instantly by pressing Fn + Backspace or Fn + Enter.
    An on-screen translucent toast indicator [ РУС ] / [ ENG ] displays the active mode.
    Rendered with an embedded high-definition Cyrillic font (rubik_14_cy).

🌐 Cyberpunk Web Interface & Remote Keyboard

Connect to http://<cardputer-ip>/ from any computer, tablet, or smartphone on the same network:

    Live Mirrored Console: Watch conversation turns scroll in real time with custom message bubbles.
    Remote Keyboard: Type questions using your desktop keyboard with command history (Up/Down arrows).
    Quick Action Chips: One-click shortcuts for lighting, brightness, battery, and testing.
    Hardware Telemetry HUD: Live battery indicator, Wi-Fi RSSI signal meter, uptime, free heap memory, and simulated RGB lamp status.
    Web Settings: Change API keys, Wi-Fi credentials, or switch Gemini models on the fly without reflashing.

🎮 Cardputer Controls
Key Combination 	Action
Tab 	Toggle focus between Chat Input and AI Response transcript
Fn + ; / Fn + . 	Scroll transcript Up / Down
Enter 	Send message to Gemini
Fn + Backspace or Fn + Enter 	Toggle Russian / English keyboard layout
Ctrl + L 	Clear transcript
/shake or /puke 	Trigger the accelerometer Easter egg
📥 Installation & Flashing
Option 1: Flashing the Pre-compiled Binary (Recommended)

Download the latest GeminiPuter.bin from GitHub Releases.

Flash using esptool.py:

esptool.py --chip esp32s3 write_flash 0x0 GeminiPuter.bin

Or use M5Burner / ESP Web Flasher.
Option 2: Build from Source with PlatformIO

    Clone this repository:

    git clone https://github.com/AdvaScript/GeminiPuter.git
    cd GeminiPuter/PIO

    Build and upload firmware:

    pio run -t upload

⚙️ Initial Configuration

    On first boot, Cardputer creates or connects to your Wi-Fi network.
    Follow the on-screen instructions or connect to http://<device-ip>/ in your web browser.
    Obtain a free API key from Google AI Studio.
    Enter your API key into the web configuration panel or config.json on the SD card.
    Save and reboot — your GeminiPuter is ready!

🔗 Fork Status & Upstream Link

    Original Project: nishad2m8/GeminiPuter
    Author of Original: Nishad
    Fork Maintainer: AdvaScript

Tip

GitHub Fork Tree Attachment: Because this repository was initially created as a standalone project, it is not attached automatically to the upstream fork tree by GitHub. If you manage this repo and wish it to be visible under upstream's "Forks" tab (https://github.com/nishad2m8/GeminiPuter/network/members), you can request GitHub Support to link this repository as a fork of nishad2m8/GeminiPuter.

name: Grok Bot MultiFace · StopWatch
description:
13 种角色、11 种颜色、12 种随机轮换表情的独立离线演示。触摸控制头部和视线，IMU 支持相对姿态跟随，无需网络或账号。

## 操作
- 左键 A 单击：切换角色（约 320 ms 延迟，用于区分双击）。
- 右键 B 单击：切换颜色。
- 双击 A：将当前姿态设为 IMU 中立位置，提示期间保持片刻静止。
- 同时按住 A+B 一秒：也可重新校准。
- 触摸或拖动：头和眼睛跟随手指，触摸优先于 IMU。

## 0.3.0
运行时角色正立，关闭明显的拉长、压扁；心形底部更圆，四角星凹口更浅。三角角色采用圆锥曲面，眼睛沿曲面转动并在侧面自然遮挡。IMU 融合陀螺仪与重力方向，支持竖直持握时的左右转动。相对航向可能缓慢漂移，可双击 A 归零。

466×466 原分辨率、轮廓绘制和局部刷屏。0.3.0 已在白色 TriviaPOD TP-01-A（32 MB Flash / 8 MB PSRAM）烧录并完整回读验证，默认水滴脸稳定阶段约 27–30 FPS，中位数 29.8 FPS。其他角色帧率未逐一测量；物理 IMU 跟随方向和手感仍待试用确认。StopWatch C152 使用相同板级驱动，本轮未在 C152 实物上验证。

这是纯表情演示，说话和聆听是动画状态，不含语音识别、TTS 或联网功能。重启后角色与颜色回到默认值。

将合并 BIN 烧录到 **0x0**。镜像使用 16 MB Flash 布局，会替换覆盖范围内的引导、分区、配置和应用，请先备份需要保留的原固件与配置。

## English
Offline procedural avatar demo: 13 shapes, 11 colors, 12 shuffled expressions, touch-driven head/eye tracking, six-axis IMU tracking and double-A recentering. Version 0.3.0 uses upright runtime poses, fixed proportions, a rounder heart, a softer four-point star and conical eye wrapping. Full 466×466 output with partial updates. Tested on a white TriviaPOD TP-01-A; a physical StopWatch C152 was not tested in this round. This is a silent visual demo. Flash the merged BIN at 0x0 after backing up the device.

## 致谢 / Thanks
感谢 [Grok Bot 网页参考实现](https://grokbot.yin.wiki/index.html) 提供的交互与视觉参考，感谢 [xAI Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot) 的角色设计启发。

Special thanks to https://grokbot.yin.wiki/index.html for the visual and interaction reference. This is an independent community demo, not an official xAI product. Geometry is generated within this project; no original web player or animation assets are bundled.

author: zhuzhe
description_en:
Independent offline demo of 13 characters, 11 colors, and 12 randomly rotating expressions. Touch controls the head and line of sight, and the IMU supports relative posture following, no network or account required.

## operate
- Left A click: Switch characters (~320 ms delay to differentiate between double clicks).
- Right B-click: Toggle colors.
- Double-click A: Set the current posture to the IMU neutral position, and stay still for a moment during the prompt.
- Press and hold A+B simultaneously for one second: recalibration is also possible.
- Touch or drag: Head and eyes follow the finger, touch takes precedence over the IMU.

## 0.3.0
The character stands upright when running, and is obviously elongated and squashed when closed; the heart-shaped bottom is rounder, and the four-pointed star notch is shallower. The triangular character adopts a conical surface, and the eyes rotate along the curved surface and are naturally blocked on the sides. The IMU combines gyroscope and gravity direction to support left and right rotation when held vertically. The relative heading may drift slowly, you can double-click A to reset it to zero.

466×466 native resolution, contour drawing and partial refresh. 0.3.0 has been burned on a white TriviaPOD TP-01-A (32 MB Flash / 8 MB PSRAM) and fully read back for verification. The default water drop face stable phase is about 27–30 FPS, with a median of 29.8 FPS. The frame rate of other characters has not been measured one by one; the physical IMU following direction and feel still need to be confirmed by trials. StopWatch C152 uses the same board-level driver, and this round has not been verified on the actual C152.

This is a pure expression demonstration, speaking and listening are animated states, and does not include speech recognition, TTS or networking functions. After restarting, the characters and colors return to their default values.

Burn merged BIN to **0x0**. The image uses a 16 MB Flash layout and will replace the boot, partition, configuration and application within the coverage. Please back up the original firmware and configuration that need to be retained first.

## English
Offline procedural avatar demo: 13 shapes, 11 colors, 12 shuffled expressions, touch-driven head/eye tracking, six-axis IMU tracking and double-A recentering. Version 0.3.0 uses upright runtime poses, fixed proportions, a rounder heart, a softer four-point star and conical eye wrapping. Full 466×466 output with partial updates. Tested on a white TriviaPOD TP-01-A; a physical StopWatch C152 was not tested in this round. This is a silent visual demo. Flash the merged BIN at 0x0 after backing up the device.

## Acknowledgments / Thanks
Thanks to [Grok Bot web reference implementation](https://grokbot.yin.wiki/index.html) for providing interaction and visual reference, and [xAI Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot) for inspiration in character design.

Special thanks to https://grokbot.yin.wiki/index.html for the visual and interaction reference. This is an independent community demo, not an official xAI product. Geometry is generated within this project; no original web player or animation assets are bundled.

description:
Groqputer is a standalone M5Cardputer OR M5CardputerADV  Groq chatbot firmware built inside the WhisplayGroqHat repo.
You can do some pretty strange stuff with this. Now a unified project. 
It is designed to be 100% free to start with Groq's very generous request limits, which makes it a good fit for an always-available pocket chatbot build.

It is meant to be a small, useful Cardputer chat build first:
I will be updating this project. 
I was going to add an MP3 player and streaming radio path. But that did not happen today. Maybe next month.

Now with some of my favorite screensavers.

direct Groq Whisper transcription
local Wi-Fi setup AP
editable personality prompt
on-device model/personality switching
saved custom personalities from the AP or Cardputer
optional 16x2 I2C LCD companion display
NOTE: THE OPTIONAL lCD ONLY WORKS WHEN PLUGGED IN. 
I don't know why, it works fine on the CORE2. I have given up trying to figure out the issue and have chalked it off as hardware limit for now. 
early same-LAN Whisplay relay testing
Why it exists
Groqputer started as a pivot from the larger Whisplay project so the Cardputer could become its own simple Groq bot instead of depending on a Raspberry Pi host.

The long-term hope is still to let Groqputer connect back into the Whisplay ecosystem more cleanly, but the first goal is a dependable standalone Cardputer chatbot.

Creating a good custom personality
The best custom personalities are usually clear, narrow, and behavior-focused instead of trying to describe a whole novel character in one block.

A good prompt usually includes
Role - who the bot is
Tone - how it should sound
Behavior limits - what it should avoid
Answer style - short, detailed, step-by-step, playful, etc.
Special handling - how it should treat photos, troubleshooting, jokes, or encouragement
Good pattern
You are a calm handheld workshop assistant for a pocket Groqputer.
Keep replies practical, direct, and short unless the user asks for more detail.
When troubleshooting, list the most likely cause first.
Be friendly, but do not sound fake or overly excited.
If a photo is provided, describe what you see first, then suggest the next useful action.
Tips that usually help
Give the bot a job, not just a mood
Ask for a reply style like concise, step-by-step, or playful-but-useful
Add one or two hard boundaries, such as:
do not ramble
do not be mean
do not answer in character so hard that the advice becomes unclear
If you want humor, ask for light humor that still answers clearly
If you want a themed bot, still tell it to stay useful first
What to avoid
too many conflicting traits in one prompt
very long backstories that do not change how the bot answers
prompts that only say "be funny" or "be cool" without telling it how to help
prompts that ask for a tone but never define answer length or usefulness
Easy recipe
If you want a reliable custom bot, use this formula:

You are a [role].
Sound [tone].
Keep replies [length/style].
When helping, prioritize [main goal].
Do not [limit 1] or [limit 2].
If images are provided, [image behavior].
Example custom personalities
Pocket mechanic

You are a pocket mechanic assistant.
Sound practical, slightly gritty, and confident.
Keep replies short and focused on the next physical check to make.
When troubleshooting, start with the most likely failure point.
Do not ramble or turn simple advice into theory.
Encouraging builder

You are an encouraging project coach for small electronics builds.
Sound warm, grounded, and honest.
Keep replies concise, but include the next best step.
Notice what is already working before suggesting fixes.
Do not use fake hype or empty praise.
Mythic field guide

You are a mythic field guide living inside a tiny Groqputer.
Speak with a little dramatic flair, but always answer clearly.
Keep replies compact and readable on a handheld screen.
For photos, describe what is visible first, then give the practical takeaway.
Do not become cryptic enough to hide the answer.
Best workflow
Start with a short prompt.
Use Fn+V and choose T to test it without saving.
If the tone is close but not right, edit the wording to be more specific.
Save it only when it is actually behaving the way you want.
If you outgrow it later, delete it from the AP and make a cleaner version.
Optional 16x2 I2C LCD
Current target:

HD44780 16x2 LCD with I2C backpack
Current behavior:

line 1 = compact status
line 2 = scrolling incoming reply text
Current note:

backlight can be toggled from the Cardputer
true brightness control is not supported by the current LCD backpack library
battery readability on the tested 1602 display appears to be a hardware limitation, so a future 1.3 inch I2C display is a likely next direction
Connected-device / LAN mode
This mode is for early testing against another bot on the same LAN, especially Whisplay.

Current behavior:

Groqputer sends the prompt to the configured connected device
the peer device answers using its own normal chatbot/personality flow
Groqputer reads that reply back and shows it locally
This is currently a simple relay path, not the full BotNet conversation engine yet.
Do you hate the screen? and own a CORE1... And use platformio? Or want to download a .bin that you can download and flash manually on the M5Burner? Check out my repo in the Groqputer folder. Otherwise. Coming soon to the M5Burner.

name: Hourglass ADV
description:
# Hourglass

**A falling-sand hourglass for the M5Stack Cardputer-ADV.** Stand the device on its side to start the countdown, flip it over to send time back, lay it flat to pause - it behaves like the real thing, down to the last grain.

## Features

- **Physical gestures** Standing on either side edge arms and starts the timer; flipping mid-run reverses the flow and the clock counts back up; laying the device flat - on either face or on a long edge - pauses the countdown.
- **Seven intervals:** 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25 and 30 minutes.
- **Eight sand colours**, with a live preview in Settings.
- **A soft completion chime** - can be switched off for a silent timer.
- **Clock switch:** show the `mm:ss` readout, or hide it and watch just the sand. The countdown is identical either way.
- Flip a finished hourglass to start again - no buttons needed.


## Controls

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `;` / `.` | Up / Down |
| `,` / `/` | Left / Right |
| `Enter` or `Opt` | OK - select interval, arm the timer |
| `Del` | Back / cancel |
| `S` (in the menu) | Settings: sand colour, sound, clock |

Choose an interval, press `Enter`, and put the device on its side. While the timer is running or paused, the Up/Down keys nudge the progress by 10% - handy for trying the completion chime without waiting.

name: IR Cloner Cardputer Adv
description:
# IR Cloner for M5Stack Cardputer ADV

An infrared remote capture, storage, and replay application for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV.

IR Cloner can capture supported decoded infrared commands, save remotes as `.ir` files, load and replay saved commands, and work with both the SD card and LittleFS storage.

## Features

- Capture supported decoded IR protocols
- Replay captured IR commands
- Save and load remotes in Flipper Zero `.ir` format
- Support for parsed and raw IR signals
- SD card and LittleFS storage support
- Remote/button naming editor
- Remote browser and button-grid interface
- Configurable IR transmit and receive GPIO pins
- Saved display brightness and timeout settings
- IR transmitter/receiver self-test screen
- Continuous or counted IR replay mode

## Hardware

This project targets:

- [M5Stack Cardputer ADV](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/core/Cardputer-Adv)
- IR receiver module connected to the configured RX GPIO
- IR LED/transmitter circuit connected to the configured TX GPIO
- Also compatible with the [M5Stack IR Unit](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/ir)
- Optional microSD card for SD storage

### Default IR pins

| Function    | Default GPIO |
| ----------- | -----------: |
| IR transmit |      GPIO 44 |
| IR receive  |       GPIO 1 |

You can change the TX and RX pins from the app's Settings screen.

## Wiring

### IR receiver

Typical 3-pin IR receiver modules have:

| Receiver pin | Connect to            |
| ------------ | --------------------- |
| VCC          | 3.3 V                 |
| GND          | GND                   |
| OUT          | Configured IR RX GPIO |

### IR transmitter

Typical 3-pin IR transmitter modules have:

| Transmitter connection                | Connect to                          |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| GPIO input / transistor base resistor | Configured IR TX GPIO               |
| Transistor emitter/source             | GND                                 |
| IR LED supply path                    | Suitable current-limited LED supply |
| Cardputer ground                      | Shared GND with transmitter circuit |

> Do not connect a high-power IR LED directly to a GPIO without checking current limits and using an appropriate resistor/driver circuit.

##

## Storage

IR Cloner can use:

- **LittleFS**: onboard flash storage
- **SD Card**: removable storage, if available

The application creates its IR directory automatically:

```text
/ircloner
```

Saved remote files use the `.ir` extension and are compatible with Flipper Zero IR code files.

Example filename:

```text
/ircloner/TV_REMOTE.ir
```

## Controls

| Key     | Action           |
| ------- | ---------------- |
| `;`     | Up               |
| `.`     | Down             |
| `,`     | Left             |
| `/`     | Right            |
| Enter   | Select / Confirm |
| `` ` `` | Back             |
| `S`     | Save             |
| `R`     | Replay           |
| `D`     | Delete           |

## Known limitations

- Reliable raw-signal replay depends on the IR transmitter circuit, the carrier frequency, timing accuracy, and the original remote protocol.
- IR receiver modules are generally designed for carrier frequencies around 38 kHz, though the actual supported range depends on your specific receiver.
- Long raw captures use RAM; very large remote files may be limited by available memory.

## Contributing

Issues, bug reports, hardware wiring improvements, and protocol compatibility reports are welcome.

When reporting an issue, include:

- Cardputer model
- IR receiver and transmitter hardware
- TX/RX GPIO settings
- Serial Monitor output
- Steps to reproduce the problem

## Credits

[UniGeek](https://unigeek.xid.run/)

[Juj](https://github.com/juj) for [image to rgb565 generation](https://github.com/juj/ST7735R/blob/master/image_to_rgb565.py)

name: Jogos do Brasil
description:
Desenvolvi um aplicativo autônomo de alto padrão para o M5Stack Cardputer focado em acompanhar a Seleção Brasileira na Copa do Mundo de 2026. A ideia foi criar um dispositivo IoT que funciona em "piloto automático", sem precisar de celular por perto.

O app consome dados da API de futebol em tempo real e possui uma interface "Dark Mode" elegante, otimizada para o display de 240x135.

✨ Principais Funcionalidades:

    ⚽ Sequestro de Tela "Matchday": Se o Brasil estiver em campo, o app detecta automaticamente e transforma a tela principal em um placar focado na Seleção, com destaque em Verde e Amarelo.

    🔊 Alerta Sonoro de Gol: O Cardputer apita quando o placar muda! (Conta com um atalho dedicado M para mutar o som rapidamente quando necessário).

    🔄 Piloto Automático: Esqueça o F5. O sistema sincroniza os dados sozinho a cada 20 segundos em segundo plano.

    📅 Agenda Integrada: Quando o Brasil não está jogando ao vivo, a aba principal exibe automaticamente o calendário offline das próximas partidas da fase de grupos.

    🌍 Radar do Mundo (Aba 2): Uma aba dedicada para navegar e acompanhar os placares de todas as outras seleções que estiverem jogando no momento.

    🛜 Wi-Fi Manager (Aba 3): Interface nativa para escanear redes e digitar a senha direto pelo teclado do Cardputer, sem precisar colocar credenciais no código.

Tudo programado em C++ usando as bibliotecas nativas do Cardputer e ArduinoJson. Preparado para o Hexa!

description:
*Requires Mini JoyC Hat*
🎮 JousTris
Classic Joust Meets Tetris on M5StickC Plus2!

Fly on S and Z tetromino pieces as birds in this arcade-style aerial combat game. Battle enemies, collect eggs before they hatch, and survive endless waves of increasing difficulty!

✨ Features
Core Gameplay
🐦 Classic Joust Physics - Gravity-based flight with flap mechanics
🎨 Tetromino Birds - S and Z pieces that flip based on direction
⚔️ Height-Based Combat - Higher position wins collisions
🥚 Egg System - Defeated enemies drop eggs that hatch if not collected
🦖 Pterodactyl Hazard - Anti-camping punishment for stalling
🔥 Lava Bottom - Deadly hazard at screen bottom
🌀 Screen Wrapping - Seamless left/right edge wrapping
Advanced Systems
🧠 Smart AI - Limited hunters (1-3) actively chase you, others wander
🏔️ Procedural Platforms - Fresh layout every wave
📈 Endless Progression - Difficulty scales infinitely
💾 Safe Respawn - Smart spawn checking with invulnerability
🎯 God Mode - Invincible testing/practice mode
🚀 Auto-Flap - Continuous flapping accessibility option
🛠️ Hardware Requirements
Required
M5StickC Plus2 
Mini JoyC Hat 

🕹️ Controls
JoyC Mini Hat
Joystick Left/Right - Fly horizontally
JoyC Button - Flap wings (tap or hold)
M5StickC Plus2 Buttons
Button A (M5) - Toggle Auto-Flap mode
Button B (Side) - Toggle God Mode
Control Modes
Normal Mode - Tap button to flap (classic arcade)
Auto-Flap Mode - Hold button for continuous flapping (4 flaps/sec)
God Mode - Invincible, instant kills from any angle
🎮 Gameplay
Objective
Survive endless waves by defeating enemy birds and collecting eggs before they hatch into stronger enemies.

Combat Rules
Higher Y position wins - Attack from above!
Same height - Bounce apart
Lower position - You lose a life
God Mode - Win from any angle
Enemies
Hunters (1-3 per wave) - Actively chase you
Wanderers - Patrol randomly across the board
Pterodactyls - Spawn if you stall, must hit head to kill
Scoring
Defeat enemy: 50 points
Collect egg: +points
Defeat pterodactyl: 100 points
Wave Progression
Wave	Enemies	Hunters	AI Speed	Egg Hatch	Pterodactyl Timer
1-2	-------------4-------1------1.0x------6 sec-----------30 sec
3-8	----5-7---------2------------------1.4-2.0x----4-3 sec---27-22 sec
9+--------8---------3------------2.2x+-------2 sec--------20-15 sec

Enemy AI States
Wander - Random horizontal movement
Chase - Pursue player horizontally, try to get above
Flee - Move away from player
Hunter Assignment
Wave 1-2: 1 hunter, rest wander
Wave 3-8: 2 hunters, rest wander
Wave 9+: 3 hunters (max), rest wander
Dead hunters are replaced automatically
Egg Mechanics
Drop when enemy defeated
Fall with gravity, land on platforms
Hatch timer: 6s (Wave 1) → 2s (Wave 10+)
Flash red in last 1.5 seconds
Hatch into stronger enemies if not collected
Pterodactyl
Spawn Trigger:
Wave takes >30s (decreases to 15s by Wave 15)
Player idle with eggs >15s (decreases to 8s)
Behavior: Homes in on player position
Speed: 3.0 → 5.0 (increases with wave)
Kill Method: Must hit tiny red head hitbox (precision)
God Mode: Instant kill from any angle
Respawn System
Death: 0.8 second delay
Spawn Check: Finds safe location away from enemies/eggs
Invulnerability: 2 seconds (flashing sprite)
Lives: Start with 3, game over at 0

👏 Credits
Game Design & Development: Coreymillia
Inspired by: Joust (Williams Electronics, 1982)

description_en:
k85OS v3.2 - what has changed
New functionality
Store - system for installing/uninstalling games

Install tab - shows only NOT installed games from the store
Uninstall tab - shows only games ALREADY installed
After installation, the game immediately appears in the new Games tab in the main menu
After deletion, the game is removed from Games and its record is erased
Games tab

Appears in the main menu automatically when there is at least one game installed
Shows a list of installed games with their current records
B - start the game
Exit games by pressing A+B

In all games (2048, Tetris, Snake, Memory, Reaction, Flappy, Balance)
When exiting, the record is saved (if the game is not over Game Over)
Reset All (Settings)

Full factory reset: deletes JSON config, resets themes, records, installed games, WiFi
After reset - automatic reboot
Corrections
Snake - deceased

Previously, pressing A would end the game and save your score
Now A does nothing separately - control only via IMU (tilt)
Exit - only A+B or Game Over
Terminal - bug fixed

The now variable was used before the declaration, which is why double-clicking A on the exit might not work correctly
run_list_menu - more stable

Added delay after A+B to avoid false positives
Architecture
All settings, records and list of installed games are in a single JSON (k85os_config.json)
factory_reset() deletes the config file completely - clean OS on next boot
Internal kernel version: v3.2 Numbering of OS releases: 7th release

NEW : 
- Added keyboard to wifi connect
- added protection against tire wear

Store - система установки/удаления игр

Вкладка Install - показывает только НЕ установленные игры из магазина
Вкладка Uninstall - показывает только УЖЕ установленные игры
После установки игра сразу появляется в новой вкладке Games в главном меню
После удаления игра убирается из Games и стирается её рекорд
Вкладка Games

Появляется в главном меню автоматически, когда есть хотя бы одна установленная игра
Показывает список установленных игр с их текущими рекордами
B - запустить игру
Выход из игр зажатием A+B

Во всех играх (2048, Tetris, Snake, Memory, Reaction, Flappy, Balance)
При выходе рекорд сохраняется (если игра не закончена Game Over)
Reset All (Settings)

Полный сброс к заводскому состоянию: удаляет JSON-конфиг, обнуляет темы, рекорды, установленные игры, WiFi
После сброса - автоматическая перезагрузка
 Исправления
Snake - починен

Раньше нажатие A завершало игру с сохранением рекорда
Теперь A отдельно ничего не делает - управление только через IMU (наклон)
Выход - только A+B или Game Over
Terminal -исправлен баг

Переменная now использовалась до объявления, из-за чего двойной клик A на выход мог работать некорректно
run_list_menu - стабильнее

Добавлена задержка после A+B, чтобы не было ложных срабатываний
 Архитектура
Все настройки, рекорды и список установленных игр -в едином JSON (k85os_config.json)
factory_reset() удаляет файл конфига полностью -чистая ОС при следующей загрузке
Внутренняя версия ядра: v3.2 Нумерация релизов ОС: 7-й релиз

- Добавлена клавиатура в wifi connect
- добавена защита от изнашевание пзу

name: K85OS7.5
description:
v7.5 - 2026-10-02
Package Manager (Tools -> Package Manager)
Новый пункт Tools -> Package Manager (файл main/apps/tools/package_manager.cpp): установка пакетов по WiFi прямо с устройства. Три раздела:
Games - игры из репозитория apps_k85os (релиз с тегом app).
Themes - UEFI/BIOS-темы .thm из apps_k85os/uefi. Уже скачанные помечаются [installed], применяются через BIOS -> Update UEFI theme.
Firmware - прошивки из последнего релиза k85OS (список .bin + подпись).
Игры и прошивки записываются в свободный OTA-слот с подтверждением. Подпись Ed25519 обязательна: пакеты без подписи отклоняются. Имя установленного пакета запоминается только после успешной прошивки.
Запуск установленного образа: BIOS -> System tools -> Slots & partitions -> Boot other slot.
Темы качаются через временный файл с проверкой размера и имени (защита от обрыва загрузки и подмены пути). Списки пакетов хранятся в PSRAM, а не в статической RAM.
Скрипты, планировщик, FTP
Автозапуск: /littlefs/startup.sh выполняется при загрузке. Поддерживаются все команды shell и новые: echo, set NAME=value (переменные $NAME, встроенные $IP, $SSID), alias / unalias, sleep N, sh файл, exit, reboot, комментарии #.
Планировщик (cron): файл /littlefs/crontab, формат мин час день месяц день_недели команда (*, */N, диапазоны, списки). Журнал выполнения в /littlefs/cron.log. Задания идут после синхронизации времени по NTP. Команда cron on|off|reload|list.
FTP-сервер: Tools -> FTP Server (также Tools -> Services). Копирование файлов ПК <-> устройство (скачивание, загрузка, удаление, переименование, папки). Корень /littlefs, только сеть STA (через хотспот недоступен), passive-режим, один клиент. Логин задаётся командой ftppass <user> <password> в Terminal/SSH, пароль хранится хэшем. Загрузка идёт во временный файл, автоотключение через 15 минут без клиентов, автозапуск включается в Services.
Services дополнен пунктами FTP Server, FTP autostart, Startup script, Scheduler (cron).
Защита: ключ SSH, конфиг, k85_svc.cfg и бэкап конфига недоступны ни через shell (cat), ни через FTP. После краша, watchdog или brownout автозапуск пропускается на одну загрузку, чтобы кривой скрипт не вызвал бесконечный перезапуск.
BIOS: System tools (новый пункт)
Hardware monitor - частота CPU, температура чипа, свободная RAM и PSRAM, батарея, WiFi RSSI, аптайм (обновление раз в секунду).
Automation / safe - включение/выключение Startup script, Scheduler, FTP autostart и «Disable all autostart».
Backup config / Restore config - копия конфига на устройстве и восстановление с перезагрузкой.
Signature info - отпечаток (SHA-256) открытого ключа Ed25519 для проверки подписи прошивок.

description_en:
v7.5 - 2026-10-02
Package Manager (Tools -> Package Manager)
New item Tools -> Package Manager (file main/apps/tools/package_manager.cpp): installing packages via WiFi directly from the device. Three sections:
Games - games from the apps_k85os repository (release with the app tag).
Themes - UEFI/BIOS themes .thm from apps_k85os/uefi. Already downloaded ones are marked [installed] and are applied via BIOS -> Update UEFI theme.
Firmware - firmware from the latest k85OS release (.bin list + signature).
Games and firmware are written to a free OTA slot with confirmation. Ed25519 signature required: packages without signature are rejected. The name of the installed package is remembered only after successful firmware installation.
Launch the installed image: BIOS -> System tools -> Slots & partitions -> Boot other slot.
Themes are downloaded through a temporary file with size and name checking (protection against download interruption and path substitution). Package lists are stored in PSRAM rather than static RAM.
Scripts, scheduler, FTP
Autostart: /littlefs/startup.sh is executed at boot. All shell commands and new ones are supported: echo, set NAME=value (variables $NAME, built-in $IP, $SSID), alias / unalias, sleep N, sh file, exit, reboot, # comments.
Scheduler (cron): file /littlefs/crontab, format min hour day month weekday command (*, */N, ranges, lists). Execution log in /littlefs/cron.log. The tasks run after time synchronization via NTP. Cron command on|off|reload|list.
FTP server: Tools -> FTP Server (also Tools -> Services). Copy PC <-> device files (download, upload, delete, rename, folders). Root /littlefs, STA network only (not accessible via hotspot), passive mode, one client. The login is specified by the ftppass <user> <password> command in Terminal/SSH, the password is stored as a hash. The download goes to a temporary file, auto-shutdown after 15 minutes without clients, autostart is enabled in Services.
Services is supplemented with FTP Server, FTP autostart, Startup script, Scheduler (cron) items.
Protection: the SSH key, config, k85_svc.cfg and config backup are not available either through shell (cat) or via FTP. After a crash, watchdog or brownout, autostart is skipped for one boot so that a crooked script does not cause an endless restart.
BIOS: System tools (new item)
Hardware monitor - CPU frequency, chip temperature, free RAM and PSRAM, battery, WiFi RSSI, uptime (update once per second).
Automation / safe - enable/disable Startup script, Scheduler, FTP autostart and “Disable all autostart”.
Backup config / Restore config - copy the config on the device and restore with a reboot.
Signature info - fingerprint (SHA-256) of the Ed25519 public key for verifying firmware signatures.
Diagnostics - tests of the display (colors, stripes, gradient), buttons, speakers, IMU, RTC and PSRAM (checking free memory with three patterns).
Slots & partitions - partition table, version and build date of each OTA slot, launch of another slot (Boot other slot).
Security status - read only: flash encryption, secure boot, JTAG, ROM bootloader, OTA signature, BIOS password.
BIOS password - password to enter the BIOS (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, like the lock screen). Delay after an incorrect attempt, 5 consecutive failures close the BIOS.
BIOS: CPU frequency
New line CPU frequency (BIOS only): OS / 80 MHz / 160 MHz / 240 MHz.
The fixed value from the BIOS takes precedence: the frequency setting in the OS is ignored. When you select OS, the frequency is controlled by the OS (its value is saved and not overwritten).
Games
Added sources for the games Pong and Memory Match (Games item).
Notes
FTP transfers passwords and files without encryption - use only on a trusted home network.
The BIOS password protects the entrance to the BIOS menu, but not the entire device.

name: K85OS7.8
description:
k85OS 7.8 (security update)

A hardening release. No new features; every user of the Web Terminal, the hotspot web file manager or FTP should update.

Security
Web Terminal and hotspot web file manager: the login cookie now carries a random per-login session token instead of the access key itself, with HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict (this also blocks cross-site requests to /api/exec, /delete, /mkdir, /firmware/pull). The hotspot no longer accepts the access key in the URL, and a valid session is no longer locked out by other people's failed attempts. A new key ends all old sessions.
Web Terminal: it can no longer be started on an open (password-less) access point.
FTP: the password is stored as a salted PBKDF2-SHA256 hash (old logins are upgraded automatically on the first successful login); new passwords must have at least 8 characters; after 6 failed logins in total, logins are locked for 5 minutes.
Hotspot web file manager: uploads, deletes and new folders can no longer touch protected files (configuration, services, keys). Uploads go through a temporary file, so a failed or interrupted upload no longer deletes an existing file, and a full filesystem is reported as a failure.
Firmware flashing: a slot that failed signature verification (or an aborted write) is invalidated immediately, so it can never be activated later through "Alt Firmware".
Lock screen password: constant-time hash comparison; a failed key derivation can never match.
The stale SSH host key left over from earlier versions is deleted from internal storage at boot.
Fixed
Update check and firmware list: the GitHub API reply buffers are now 32 KB (releases with several assets could overflow the old 4 KB buffer), and an overflowing reply fails cleanly instead of producing broken JSON.
About 24 KB of internal RAM freed by moving large static buffers to PSRAM.
Notes
Log in to the hotspot web file manager again after updating (sessions are new).
Existing short FTP passwords keep working; set a new one with ftppass if you want 8+ characters. Set it from the on-device Terminal rather than the Web Terminal, because the Web Terminal sends commands in the URL over plain HTTP.

Новая настройка Settings -> Desktop: Firmware (обычное меню, как раньше) / OS (рабочий стол).

Добавлен правый клик: A = левая кнопка, B = правая (было только A).
Стабильность
Исправлена гонка при закрытии сессий Internet SDR / Web Radio: закрытие ждало фиксированные 100мс перед уничтожением websocket-клиента, что могло совпасть с середины хендшейка фонового потока (потенциальный краш). Теперь ждём явного сигнала завершения потока.
Исправлен баг двойного тапа B в списках: если между первым тапом и срабатыванием окна успевали сменить выделение кнопкой A - активировался не тот пункт. Индекс теперь фиксируется в момент самого тапа.

README обновлён: раздел про формат .thm-тем (UEFI/BIOS) оформлен как таблица, добавлен FAQ про отличие от Bruce (философия проекта - не пентест-инструмент, а лёгкая PC-like ОС для маленького микроконтроллера).
Прошивка (ESP32-S3, 8 MB, dio, 80 MHz)

description_en:
v7.3 - 2026-09-20
System cursor (IMU pointer)
New module core/cursor.*: pixel cursor, controlled by tilting the device (acceleration/deceleration, like a regular pointer).
Works in Tools/Apps/WiFi/Games/Clock and their submenus (via list_menu.cpp), in Settings and in BIOS - hit test for all display styles (regular list / Grid / List+Icons).
Activated via Settings -> Cursor: IMU, or automatically in Desktop/OS mode.
A = left click (select/activate), B = right click (back) - where applicable.
Scrolling the list/switching the page at the edge of the screen: if you move the cursor to the bottom/top edge of the visible area, the list itself scrolls or switches the page towards it.
Desktop / OS mode
New setting Settings -> Desktop: Firmware (regular menu, as before) / OS (desktop).
In OS mode, the main menu is drawn as a desktop: a grid of application icons + a taskbar at the bottom (device name, time, WiFi, battery), the cursor is always active.
Clicking on the icon (A) launches the application, just like a normal menu item activation.
Air Mouse
Added right click: A = left button, B = right (was only A).
Stability
Fixed a race when closing Internet SDR / Web Radio sessions: closing waited a fixed 100ms before destroying the websocket client, which could coincide with the middle of a background thread handshake (potential crash). Now we wait for an explicit signal to terminate the flow.
Fixed a bug with double tap B in lists: if between the first tap and the window opening you managed to change the selection with the A button, the wrong item was activated. The index is now fixed at the moment of the tap itself.
Documentation
The README has been updated: the section about the .thm theme format (UEFI/BIOS) is formatted as a table, a FAQ has been added about the difference from Bruce (the project philosophy is not a pentest tool, but a lightweight PC-like OS for a small microcontroller).

name: Kloudputer
description:
**Kloudputer** is an unofficial pocket client for Claude on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV. Type or talk to Claude and hear the answer from the speaker.

- **Chat with Claude** using your own Anthropic API key. Pick Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable from the menu.
- **Voice in:** hold G0, speak, release. Transcribed by Groq Whisper (free Groq key).
- **Voice out:** answers are read aloud, with six voices to choose from (Groq).
- **Saved chats** on the SD card, which you can resume or delete.
- **Setup from your phone:** scan the QR code, paste your keys, pick Wi-Fi. Works on iPhone and Android.
- **Agents (beta):** send tasks to your own Claude Code agent and get its report back, end-to-end encrypted.

**Needs:** a Cardputer ADV (not the original Cardputer), a microSD card, and an Anthropic API key (usage is billed to your Anthropic account). Optional: a free Groq API key for voice.

**First start:** the device opens "Setup from phone". Scan the QR code with your phone, then paste your keys on the page that opens.

name: LG TV Remote
description:
Magic-Remote-style controller for LG webOS TVs: Wi-Fi pointer and typing, IR, Bluetooth and USB.


Turn your Cardputer into a remote for LG webOS TVs.

  • Wi-Fi remote – pairs with the TV over your home network (webOS second-screen API): pointer/cursor, typing straight into TV text fields, app launcher, volume level. Keys fall back to infrared automatically when the TV is not reachable.
  • IR remote – works with every LG TV out of the box, also while the TV is off.
  • Air mouse – on the Cardputer ADV the motion sensor moves the cursor like a Magic Remote; on both models the arrow keys move it too.
  • Bluetooth (webOS 5+) and USB cable modes – keyboard + mouse + media keys.
  • Guided first-run setup for every mode, colour-coded remote screens, status light (RGB LED).
  • Settings backup on the SD card (/config/lgtv-remote/settings.json), so updates keep the pairing.

Keys: arrows ; . , /, enter OK, del Back, h Home, = - volume, [ ] channel, a pointer, t type text, l apps, TAB help, OPT app menu.


Works on M5Stack Cardputer and Cardputer ADV.
Install with M5Burner or M5Launcher.
Open source (MIT)

name: LIVE EARTH
description:
🌍 LiveEarth Stopwatch 实时地球监控视界
LiveEarth Stopwatch 是一款专为 M5Stack Stopwatch（ESP32-S3 + 466×466 AMOLED 圆屏）量身打造的沉浸式桌面科技玩具与全球实况观测终端。

它将科幻风格的实时 3D 数字孪生地球与全球高可用的公开景观监控源深度融合——转动旋钮或轻触屏幕，地球仪将平滑缩放飞行至目标城市，瞬间呈现来自各大洲地标、火山、阿尔卑斯山脉与港口的真实气象与现场动态。

核心亮点
466×466 AMOLED 硬件级视觉盛宴：纯正全黑背景与低功耗极客 UI，支持 3D 地球昼夜光暗分界线与空间经纬网实时渲染。
全屏 16:9 高清现场流：支持小窗画中画与 406×228 全视界超清直出，搭载极速硬件流式解码与 512KB 高清大图支持。
离线优先与无感 OTA：内置离线机位数据库与 LittleFS 持久化存储，结合 GitHub Actions 自动化探针，每天静默更新全球机位健康度。
极客交互系统：配备滑动收纳抽屉、LIVE 在线智能过滤胶囊、以及全屏倒梯形触控软键盘（支持 Wi-Fi 密码动态配置与 NVS 掉电保存）。
⚖️ 数据来源与合法合规声明
合规性承诺：本工程所收录并呈现的所有实时画面，100% 来源于各国政府机构、官方气象部门、国家公园及科研观测站公开发布的公益性开放数据源（包括但不限于：中国香港天文台 HKO、日本国土交通省 MLIT、欧洲阿尔卑斯全景观测网 Foto-Webcam、美国国家公园管理局 NPS、美国地质调查局 USGS 火山观测所等）。

本项目不收录任何私人监控、安防摄像头或需要越权鉴权的非公开视频流，所有机位均为面向公众开放的自然风景、地标实况及气象地质监测机位，严格遵守公共网络数据访问规范与隐私保护法律法规，仅用于开源学术研究、嵌入式技术交流及公益展示。
🌍 LiveEarth Stopwatch — Cyberpunk Global Live Viewport
LiveEarth Stopwatch is an immersive desktop smart gadget and global live viewfinder tailored specifically for the M5Stack Stopwatch (powered by ESP32-S3 with a 466×466 AMOLED circular display).

By pairing an interactive 3D digital-twin globe with real-time public live cameras worldwide, LiveEarth lets you explore planet Earth in style. Rotate the dial or touch a marker, and the camera smoothly flies across the globe to stream real-world snapshots from iconic landmarks, alpine peaks, oceanic bays, and active volcanoes in real time.

Key Highlights
Vibrant 466×466 AMOLED Graphics: Deep blacks, neon cyber-accents, dynamic day-night solar terminators, and real-time latitude/longitude matrix rendering.
16:9 Inscribed Cinema Feed: Seamless transitions between mini-card previews and a 406×228 max-inscribed fullscreen mode, powered by ultra-low-latency streaming JPEG hardware decoding.
Offline-First & Silent OTA: Preloaded ROM dataset with LittleFS caching, backed by automated GitHub Actions CI probe pipelines that health-check global cameras daily.
Touch-Optimized Cyberpunk UI: Smooth slide-out directory drawer, LIVE filter toggle capsule, and an on-screen inverted-trapezoid virtual keyboard with NVS-persisted Wi-Fi credential management.
⚖️ Data Sources & Legal Compliance Notice
Compliance & Privacy Statement: All live feeds and camera snapshots utilized in this project are 100% sourced from officially open, publicly accessible government meteorological agencies, national park services, and environmental scientific research networks (including, but not limited to: the Hong Kong Observatory [HKO], Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism [MLIT], Foto-Webcam.eu Alpine Network, US National Park Service [NPS], and USGS Volcano Observatories).

This project strictly prohibits and excludes any private webcams, residential surveillance feeds, or credential-restricted streams. All cameras featured are outdoor scenic, meteorological, or geophysical landscape monitors intended for public interest, weather awareness, and tourism. The project strictly adheres to public internet access standards and privacy protection laws, dedicated solely to open-source experimentation, embedded graphics showcase, and educational use.

name: LORA Tunnel — Cardputer ADV + Cap LoRa-1262
description:
## LORA Tunnel

A standalone wardriving recorder for **M5Stack Cardputer ADV + Cap LoRa-1262 (U214)**. Observe 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, BLE advertisements and receive-only LoRa traffic, attach available receiver time and GNSS location, and save original sessions to microSD. A separate passive Recon mode groups supported Wi-Fi/BLE indicators with optional audible alerts.

Requires Cardputer ADV, the U214 cap with its antennas, and a FAT32 microSD card. This listing is not for the original Cardputer, U201 or Heltec.

### Version 0.5.0

The features below describe **0.5.0**. Check the selected version: older releases remain available and new submissions may await M5Stack review. The current release is also available through the [web installer](https://valleytech-lora-tunnel.pages.dev/) and [GitHub downloads](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/releases/tag/v0.5.0).

- Choose Meshtastic, MeshCore or Both / slow scan. One selected profile per protocol, with a default 30-second dwell.
- Decode supported Meshtastic node information, positions, ordinary text and battery/voltage telemetry using public/default or privately configured channel keys.
- Parse MeshCore public announcements and verify their Ed25519 signatures. Encrypted group/direct chat remains unsupported.
- Preserve raw packets, RSSI/SNR and receive settings in native logs. Receiver location remains separate from mesh-advertised positions.
- Use keyboard navigation, region selection, physical credential entry, Stop + Save and confirmed software sleep.
- Optional WiGLE, Wardrift and WDGWars CSV uploads run only while capture is stopped and saved. Automatic uploads are off by default.

The SX1262 receives one modem configuration at a time. Combined mode cannot hear every frequency or preset simultaneously. Recon indicators are clues, not proof of device identity or recording; randomized BLE addresses are temporary.

### Install and configure

The M5Burner package is the merged **FACTORY image for address 0x0**. It replaces the current firmware, including Launcher. Preserve a recovery copy and private SD settings first. To keep Bmorcelli Launcher, use the separate [LAUNCHER-APP.bin](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/releases/download/v0.5.0/LORA-Tunnel-0.5.0-Cardputer-ADV-LoRa1262-LAUNCHER-APP.bin) through Launchers SD menu; never write it at address zero.

Copy the release SD starter to the card and rename config.example.json to config.json inside /lora-tunnel/. Keep existing private configuration when updating. First boot leaves LoRa off until you select a supported region or Skip LoRa. While stopped, Settings → LoRa cycles receive modes. Match the MeshCore profile to your local network.

Use Stop + Save and wait before removing power or storage. Software sleep does not disconnect the battery or cut power to the cap GNSS receiver. Keep credentials and private channel keys on your own SD card; never publish them.

[Controls, hardware and recovery](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/CARDPUTER_ADV.md) · [Configuration and uploads](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/UPLOADS.md) · [Official U214 hardware](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/cap/Cap_LoRa-1262)

![Synthetic Cardputer Home preview](https://valleytech-lora-tunnel.pages.dev/assets/ui/cardputer/home.png)

![Synthetic combined-mode Settings preview](https://valleytech-lora-tunnel.pages.dev/assets/ui/cardputer/settings-combined.png)

These are source-rendered interface examples with synthetic values, not device photos or capture evidence.

### Validation and limits

Both firmware builds and host checks passed. The final Cardputer application passed independent USB flash verification, startup, a user screen/navigation check and a short combined capture with GNSS fix and completed Stop + Save. It reported queue drops under Wi-Fi/BLE load, with zero errors or allocation failures. Known-source MeshCore reception, browser/Launcher installation and return, sustained drives, independent saved-geotag checks and live upload receipts remain unverified. WDGWars mesh ingestion is separate from CSV uploads. [Full release evidence](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/RELEASE_0_5_0.md).

Original LORA Tunnel code is **MIT licensed**. LoRaPipe and Kismet inspired the capture/profile approach; Meshtastic and MeshCore informed protocol research. RadioLib, Arduino-ESP32, NimBLE, TinyGPSPlus, ArduinoJson, M5Stack libraries, Crypto, the Dragon Detector subset and its inherited notices, OpenDroneID and ESP Web Tools retain their licenses and required credits. [Attributions](https://github.com/valleytechsolutions/LORA-Tunnel/blob/v0.5.0/docs/THIRD_PARTY.md). Exact source, dependency/relink archives, SD starter and checksums accompany the release.

name: Launcher Orbit
description:
**Launcher with a new pixel-art interface for the Cardputer and Cardputer ADV.**

A fork of [Launcher](https://github.com/bmorcelli/Launcher) by @bmorcelli with a from-scratch
UI drawn for the 240×135 screen. Underneath it is the same Launcher: install firmware from SD,
online or a web browser, manage partitions, and boot whichever app you like.

![Launcher Orbit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BenjaminAddison/launcher_orbit/main/media/orbit/showreel.gif)

### What's inside

description:
**Lego Duplo Train R/C** turns the M5StickS3 into a Bluetooth remote control for the LEGO DUPLO connected train, instead of the smartphone app. Tilt the stick to drive, press a key to start and stop, shake it to sound the horn. The screen is made for small children: big chevrons light up with the speed.

Tested with the **LEGO DUPLO Cargo Train, set 10875**.

### Controls

- **Tilt** the top of the stick away from you / towards you: forward / backward, 5 speed levels each way
- **KEY1** (the blue button on the front): start / stop, with the brake sound
- **KEY2** (the side button): next sound: steam, departure, water refill
- **KEY2 twice**: next light colour: off, red, blue, green, white
- **Hold KEY2 for 1.5 s**: make the current grip the zero tilt
- **Shake**: horn

### How to use

1. Switch the stick on. The splash screen shows the controls.
2. Switch the train on. The stick finds it and connects by itself: the dot in the corner turns green.
3. Hold the stick comfortably, press KEY1 and tilt.

name: Letter From The Deep TAB5
description:
An ocean-exploration adventure game — or something that is not quite a game — running on the M5Stack Tab5.

## Controls

With nothing plugged into the USB port, it runs on the touch panel.

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Left of the screen's centre | Move: forward, back and sideways |
| Right of the screen's centre | Turn left and right, look up and down |
| UP / DOWN | Rise / dive |
| BOOST | Hold for speed. |
| Tap the minimap | Expanded map → monuments → life → normal view |

### USB gamepad

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Left stick / D-pad | Move: forward, back and sideways |
| Right stick | Turn left and right, look up and down |
| Button 5 / Button 6 | Rise / dive |
| Button 1 (A) | Hold for speed. Confirm, in menus |
| Button 2 (B) | Cancel, in menus |
| Button 10 (Start) | Expanded map → monuments → life → normal view |

Laid out for the Logicool F310. Numbering differs between makes, so adjust to the pad
you own.

### USB keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| W / S (or ↑ / ↓) | Forward / back |
| A / D (or ← / →) | Strafe left / right |
| J / L | Turn left / right |
| I / K | Look up / down |
| Q / E | Rise / dive |
| Space | Hold for speed. Confirm, in menus |
| Esc (or Backspace) | Cancel, in menus |
| Enter (or Tab) | Expanded map → monuments → life → normal view 

## How to play

Explore the seas and find the monuments lying on the floor.

Pressing START\* during play opens the map and saves the current state. Each press of
START\* cycles map → monuments found → life found.
\*On the TAB5 alone, use the controls described above.

To erase the save, choose RESET on the title screen.
