name: Live NOAA GOES Satellite Viewer for your CORE1
description:
A live NOAA GOES satellite weather image viewer for the M5Stack Core 1 (Basic). Connects to your WiFi via a captive portal setup screen, fetches and displays the latest GOES GeoColor satellite image every 5 minutes directly from NOAA's public CDN — no API key required. UTC clock displayed in the bottom-right corner.

🌐 Captive portal setup — WiFi and camera selection via your phone or PC browser on first boot
📡 6 NOAA GOES satellite views selectable from the portal or with a button press
🔄 Auto-refreshes every 5 minutes (NOAA update frequency)
🕐 UTC clock in the bottom-right corner, synced via NTP
💾 Persistent settings — WiFi credentials and camera choice saved to flash, survive reboots
🔘 BtnC cycles cameras without going back to the portal
🔁 Hold BtnA on boot to reopen the setup portal and change settings!<-------- If you screw up typing in or need to change the wifi.

First Boot Setup
On first boot (or after holding BtnA on startup), the device creates an open WiFi access point:

On your phone or PC, connect to the WiFi network:

WeatherCore_Setup
THIS IS A CAPTIVE PORTAL, IT SHOULD OPEN AUTOMATICALLY WHEN YOU HIT CONNECT. IF IT DOES NOT WORK, TURN OFF MOBILE DATA AND FOLLOW DIRECTIONS BELOW.
Open your browser and go to:

192.168.4.1
On most phones a browser page opens automatically (captive portal)
Either way. You must connect to wifi for this to work.  The portal will close once you hit save. You must reboot and hold button A or the left button while it is booting up to get the portal to re open.  
Fill in the form:

WiFi Network Name — your 2.4 GHz network SSID
WiFi Password — leave blank for open networks
NOAA Satellite View — choose from the dropdown
Tap Save & Connect. The portal closes, the device connects to your WiFi, and the satellite image appears within a few seconds.

⚠️ ESP32 supports 2.4 GHz WiFi only. 5 GHz networks will not appear.

Changing Settings After First Boot
Action	How
Reopen setup portal	Hold BtnA (left button) within 3 seconds of powering on
Cycle camera view	Press BtnC (right button) while the image is displayed
Camera selections are saved to flash immediately — the new view persists across reboots.

Satellite Views
View	Satellite	Coverage
GOES-East CONUS (default)	GOES-16	Full continental US, eastern focus
GOES-West CONUS	GOES-18	Full continental US, western focus
Eastern US	GOES-19	Eastern seaboard + Appalachians
Gulf of Mexico	GOES-19	Gulf Coast, Mexico, Central America
Caribbean	GOES-19	Gulf of Mexico + Caribbean Sea
Alaska	GOES-18	Alaska region
All views use NOAA GeoColor imagery — free, public, updated every ~5 minutes, no authentication required.


Created by Coreymillia from the original project WeatherPanel by moononournation

A compact, single-button satellite surface built for Companion v4 using the M5 AtomS3. Supports external RGB rear LED, full-screen bitmap mode, and a new high-visibility text mode with extra-large fonts for simple labels. Includes WiFi config portal, OTA updates, and automatic MAC-based device ID. Perfect for on-stage triggers, tally, timers, and status displays.

Features

Uses the M5 AtomS3 (ESP32-S3 / 0.85″ 128×128 display)

Two selectable display modes:
• Bitmap mode – full-screen rendering of Companion’s 72×72 bitmaps (upscaled)
• Text mode – fast, low-latency text with COLOR/TEXTCOLOR support

Extra-big font for 1–2 characters

Ultra-large font for 3 characters

Large font for 4–6 characters

Multi-line auto-wrapped text for longer labels

External RGB LED on G8/G5/G6 with G7 as Ground (mirrors key colour)

WiFiManager config portal (hold button for 5 seconds)

OTA firmware updates (ArduinoOTA)

Auto deviceID: “AtomS3_XXXXXX” (from full MAC)

Companion v4 Satellite API: TEXT, KEY-STATE, COLOR/TEXTCOLOR, BRIGHTNESS, PING

v1.3 TEXT mode no longer requests bitmaps, reducing traffic and improving responsiveness

Hardware Connections
G8 – LED Red
G5 – LED Green
G6 – LED Blue
G7 – LED Ground
(Use a common-cathode RGB LED with G7 as ground.)

Installation & Usage

Flash firmware to the AtomS3.

On boot the device shows a startup screen, then “Waiting for Companion…”.

In Companion v4, go to Surfaces → Add Device → enter the displayed deviceID.

Hold the front button for 5 seconds to open the WiFi config portal.
(SSID = deviceID)

Configure Companion IP/port and choose display mode (bitmap or text).

Press the button to trigger the assigned action.
The external LED mirrors the Companion key’s colour.

In TEXT mode, set TEXT and COLOR/TEXTCOLOR in Companion — the device renders automatically.

Troubleshooting

LED colours wrong → Confirm wiring; must be common-cathode (G7 = Ground).

Not connecting → Check Companion IP/port and ensure both devices are on the same network.

Text shows only one letter → Update to v1.3, which fixes text rendering and removes bitmap fallback.

Version History
v1.3 – New text-only behaviour, no bitmap requests, faster rendering, improved font scaling.
v1.2 – General stability and UI tweaks.
v1.1 – Fixed LED PWM output.

name: M5 Cardputer Environmental Monitoring with BME 680 gas sensor
description:
See: https://www.blogger.com/blog/post/edit/4759435067747297899/3827130560033440934
This software is for the M5 Cardputer (original, but should work on the “advanced” model) and is an environmental monitoring system, saving data to an SD card and displaying it nicely on a webpage.

This software is for the M5 Cardputer (original, but should work on the “advanced” model) and is an environmental monitoring system, saving data to an SD card and displaying it nicely on a webpage.

It uses the BME 680 sensor, connected via the I2C for remote environmental monitoring. The cardputer is set up as a Webserver so that current readings can be seen on a webpage.

This software project is unfinished, but all the main features work well and survive a 24 hour soak test. I hope others can build on it! The code is weakly commented, but I hope it is readable.

Readings of pressure, temp and humidity are taken every minute (frequency not currently configurable) and saved in memory and to a CSV file, stored on the SD card, if one is present. The file is named based on the current date and a new CSV file is created at midnight.

On the home page, you can click the “Data and Charts” button which will allow you to view the last 24 hours of data and adjust the viewing start and end times for a nice graphical display.

Any CSV files saved on the SD card can be downloaded to your local machine.

Another page allows you to configure operational parameters for high and low alarms for temperature, pressure and humidity. An alarm sound is played from a WAV file through the cardputer’s speaker and an indication of the alarm is given on the home page.

The Cardputer’s display can show each of the environmental values in turn when you press any key, along with the device’s IP address on the network, once it is connected. The local time is determined by connecting to an NTP server.

The code is built from various examples given on the M5Stack website and forums as well as some other places.

The cardputer software uses 2 HTML files from the root folder of the SD card – “index.html” and “charts without data.html” These have placeholders for various bits of data such that the cardputer software fills them in with the relevant data. The chart data stored in memory is sent as a Javascript array so that the web page, when rendered, shows all the chart data. The chart display code was written by Chatgpt and modified a little to produce the relevant display, with start and end time zoom sliders!

I hope someone uses it to monitor their greenhouse or something!

Of course, you can set up port forwarding on your router and keep an eye on your greenhouse remotely!

Enjoy!

Andrew Johnson Dec 2025

name: M5 INTEL
description:
产品简介

M5 INTEL 是为 M5StickS3 开发的离线近距离情报通信固件。设备通过 ESP-NOW 直接通信，不依赖手机、电脑、Wi-Fi 路由器或互联网。它将临时语音、预设短报文、状态代码、数字情报、设备遥测、IMU 手势信号、定时信标和 SOS 警报整合进一套竖屏赛博终端界面。

当前版本号：v1.0.0  
目标硬件：M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
通信方式：ESP-NOW，同频道设备直接通信  
固件类型：完整合并镜像，从 0x00000000 烧录

### 主要功能

1. M5 TALK
   - 使用内置麦克风录制语音。
   - 最长录音时间为 8 秒。
   - 屏幕实时显示录音时长。
   - 录音完成后可靠发送给同频道设备。
   - 接收端通过全局弹窗显示发送者和语音时长。
   - BtnB 播放语音，BtnA 确认并从内存销毁。

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - 支持发送 00–99 的数字情报。
   - 可用于人数、目标、距离、房间或任务编号。

5. TELEMETRY
   - 发送本机电量百分比。
   - 发送设备开机运行时间。

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - 通过明显摇动设备发送手势信号。
   - 约 2.5g 触发阈值。
   - 15 秒冷却时间，避免重复触发。
   - 录音期间暂停检测。

7. BEACON
   - 每 30 秒发送在线状态和电量。
   - 仅在发现同频道设备且未录音时发送。
   - 后台运行，不弹出干扰窗口。

8. SOS
   - 发送高优先级紧急警报。
   - 接收端显示独立红色 SOS 页面。
   - 播放一次短提示音。
   - BtnB 确认并解除警报。

### UI 与消息体验

- Matrix 风格绿色数字雨启动动画。
- 像素赛博风 M5 INTEL Logo。
- 黑色背景、绿色信息、红色警报。
- 全部功能采用竖屏布局。
- 离屏双缓冲绘制，降低屏幕频闪。
- 显示当前频道和在线设备数量。
- 普通消息和语音可在任意功能页面接收。
- 消息以全局弹窗显示，长内容自动分行。
- 关闭弹窗后返回接收前所在页面。
- 定时信标不弹窗，不打断操作。

### 可靠传输

- 语音降采样后分片传输。
- 数据包包含消息 ID、分片序号、总分片数、时长和 CRC16。
- 接收端逐片返回 ACK。
- 发送端只补发缺失分片，最多执行 5 轮选择性重传。
- 预设报文、状态、数字、遥测、IMU 和 SOS 同样等待接收确认。
- DELIVERED 表示对端已经确认。
- NOT CONFIRMED 表示未获得完整确认，需要重试。
- 重复消息自动去重，不完整语音超时清理。

### 操作方式

主菜单：

- BtnA：向下选择。
- BtnB：进入功能。
- A+B 长按：切换频道。

子功能：

- A+B 长按：返回主菜单。

M5 TALK：

- BtnA：开始或停止录音。
- BtnB：发送本地录音。
- 收到语音弹窗后，BtnB 播放，BtnA 确认并销毁。

普通消息弹窗：

- BtnA：确认并关闭。

### M5Burner 安装

文件：`M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. 在 M5Burner 中选择适用于 M5StickS3 的自定义固件烧录功能。
2. 选择上述 `.bin` 文件。
3. 烧录地址设置为 `0x00000000`。
4. 建议首次安装前执行 Erase Flash。
5. 选择设备对应串口并开始烧录。
6. 两台设备必须安装相同版本并设置为相同频道。

注意：这是完整合并镜像，已经包含 Bootloader、分区表、boot_app0 和应用程序。不要把该文件烧录到 `0x10000`。

### 技术边界

- 当前只面向 M5StickS3 设备之间的通信。
- 不连接 Android、iPhone 或原版 Bitchat 手机客户端。
- M5 TALK 是“录制后发送”，不是实时连续语音流。
- 当前 ESP-NOW 广播未启用链路加密。
- “播放后销毁”表示从运行内存中删除，不等同于经过安全审计的物理数据擦除。
- 当前 ACK 逻辑主要针对两台同频道设备的可靠通信场景。

---

### Overview

M5 INTEL is an offline, short-range field intelligence firmware for the M5StickS3. Devices communicate directly over ESP-NOW without a phone, computer, Wi-Fi router, or Internet connection. It combines temporary voice messages, preset reports, status codes, numeric intelligence, telemetry, IMU gesture signals, periodic beacons, and SOS alerts in a portrait cyber-terminal interface.

Version: v1.0.0  
Target hardware: M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
Transport: direct ESP-NOW communication between devices on the same channel  
Image type: merged flash image for offset 0x00000000

### Main Features

1. M5 TALK
   - Records voice with the built-in microphone.
   - Maximum recording length: 8 seconds.
   - Displays the live recording duration.
   - Reliably transmits completed recordings to same-channel devices.
   - The receiver shows a global popup with sender identity and duration.
   - BtnB plays the voice message; BtnA confirms and removes it from memory.

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - Sends numeric intelligence from 00 to 99.
   - Numbers may represent personnel, targets, distance, rooms, or mission IDs.

5. TELEMETRY
   - Sends battery percentage.
   - Sends device uptime.

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - Sends a gesture signal when the device is shaken firmly.
   - Approximate trigger threshold: 2.5g.
   - A 15-second cooldown prevents repeated triggers.
   - Detection is suspended while recording.

7. BEACON
   - Broadcasts presence and battery level every 30 seconds.
   - Operates only when another same-channel device is detected and no recording is active.
   - Runs silently in the background without interrupting the UI.

8. SOS
   - Sends a high-priority emergency alert.
   - The receiver displays a dedicated red SOS screen.
   - A short notification tone is played once.
   - BtnB acknowledges and closes the alert.

### Interface and Message Experience

- Matrix-inspired green digital-rain boot animation.
- Pixel cyber-style M5 INTEL wordmark.
- Black background, green information, and red emergency alerts.
- Portrait interface throughout the firmware.
- Off-screen buffered rendering to reduce visible flicker.
- Current channel and online device count are displayed.
- Voice and intelligence messages can be received from any feature screen.
- Global popups display the complete sender and message, with automatic line wrapping.
- Closing a popup returns the user to the previous screen.
- Periodic beacons stay in the background and do not open popups.

### Reliable Delivery

- Voice is downsampled and split into ESP-NOW fragments.
- Packets include a message ID, fragment index, fragment count, duration, and CRC16.
- The receiver acknowledges every valid fragment.
- The sender selectively retransmits only missing fragments for up to five rounds.
- Quick reports, status codes, numbers, telemetry, IMU signals, and SOS messages also wait for receiver acknowledgement.
- DELIVERED means the receiver confirmed delivery.
- NOT CONFIRMED means complete confirmation was not received and the user should retry.
- Duplicate messages are filtered and incomplete voice assemblies expire automatically.

### Controls

Main menu:

- BtnA: move down.
- BtnB: enter the selected feature.
- Hold A+B: change the ESP-NOW channel.

Inside a feature:

- Hold A+B: return to the main menu.

M5 TALK:

- BtnA: start or stop recording.
- BtnB: send the local recording.
- In an incoming voice popup, BtnB plays and BtnA confirms and destroys the message.

Standard message popup:

- BtnA: acknowledge and close.

### Installing with M5Burner

File: `M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. Open the custom firmware flashing workflow for M5StickS3 in M5Burner.
2. Select the `.bin` file above.
3. Set the flash offset to `0x00000000`.
4. Erase Flash is recommended before the first installation.
5. Select the correct serial port and start flashing.
6. Both devices must run the same firmware version and use the same channel.

Important: this is a complete merged image containing the bootloader, partition table, boot_app0, and application. Do not flash this file at `0x10000`.

### Current Technical Scope

- This release targets direct communication between M5StickS3 devices.
- It does not connect to Android, iPhone, or the original Bitchat mobile client.
- M5 TALK uses record-then-send voice messages, not continuous live audio streaming.
- ESP-NOW broadcast link encryption is not enabled in this release.
- “Destroy after playback” means deletion from runtime memory; it is not a security-audited physical data-erasure mechanism.
- The current acknowledgement design is primarily intended for reliable two-device operation on one channel.

author: 塔尔塔罗斯
description_en:
Product introduction

M5 INTEL is an offline NFC firmware developed for the M5StickS3. Devices communicate directly via ESP-NOW, without relying on a phone, computer, Wi-Fi router or the internet. It integrates temporary voices, preset short messages, status codes, digital intelligence, device telemetry, IMU hand signals, timing beacons and SOS alarms into a vertical screen cyber terminal interface.

Current version number: v1.0.0
Target hardware: M5StickS3/ESP32-S3-PICO-1/8 MB Flash
Communication method: ESP-NOW, direct communication with devices on the same channel
Firmware type: Complete merged image, burned from 0x00000000

### Main functions

1. M5 TALK
- Record voice using built-in microphone.
- The maximum recording time is 8 seconds.
- The screen displays the recording duration in real time.
- After the recording is completed, it can be reliably sent to the device on the same channel.
- The receiving end displays the sender and voice duration through a global pop-up window.
- BtnB plays the voice, BtnA confirms and destroys it from memory.

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
- Supports sending digital intelligence from 00–99.
- Can be used for number of people, target, distance, room or task number.

5. TELEMETRY
- Send the battery percentage of the device.
- Send the device boot time.

6. IMU SIGNAL
- Send hand signals by visibly shaking the device.
- Approximately 2.5g trigger threshold.
- 15 seconds cooldown to avoid repeated triggering.
- Pause detection during recording.

7. BEACON
- Send online status and battery level every 30 seconds.
- Only sent when a device on the same channel is found and is not recording.
- Runs in the background without popping up interfering windows.

8. SOS
- Send high priority emergency alerts.
- The receiving end displays a separate red SOS page.
- Play a short beep once.
- BtnB acknowledges and disarms the alert.

### UI and message experience
- Matrix style green digital rain start animation.
- Pixel cyber style M5 INTEL Logo.
- Black background, green message, red alert.
- All functions adopt vertical screen layout.
- Off-screen double-buffered drawing to reduce screen flickering.
- Display current channel and number of online devices.
- Ordinary messages and voices can be received on any function page.
- Messages are displayed in a global pop-up window, and long content is automatically divided into lines.
- After closing the pop-up window, return to the page you were on before receiving.
- Timing beacons do not pop up and do not interrupt operations.

### Reliable transmission

- Voice is downsampled and then transmitted in fragments.
- The data packet contains message ID, fragment sequence number, total number of fragments, duration and CRC16.
- The receiving end returns ACK piece by piece.
- The sender only resends missing fragments and performs up to 5 rounds of selective retransmission.
- Default messages, status, digital, telemetry, IMU and SOS also await confirmation of receipt.
- DELIVERED means the peer has acknowledged it.
- NOT CONFIRMED means complete confirmation was not obtained and needs to be retried.
- Automatic deduplication of duplicate messages and clearing of incomplete voice messages after timeout.

### How to operate

Main menu:

- BtnA: Select down.
- BtnB: Enter function.
- A+B long press: switch channels.

Sub-function:

- A+B long press: return to the main menu.

M5 TALK：

- BtnA: Start or stop recording.
- BtnB: Send local recordings.
- After receiving the voice pop-up window, BtnB plays it and BtnA confirms and destroys it.

Ordinary message pop-up window:

- BtnA: Confirm and close.

### M5Burner installation

File: `M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. Select the custom firmware burning function for M5StickS3 in M5Burner.
2. Select the `.bin` file above.
3. Set the burning address to `0x00000000`.
4. It is recommended to execute Erase Flash before first installation.
5. Select the serial port corresponding to the device and start burning.
6. Both devices must have the same version installed and set to the same channel.

Note: This is a complete merged image that already contains the bootloader, partition table, boot_app0 and application. Do not burn this file to `0x10000`.

### Technical boundaries

- Currently only for communication between M5StickS3 devices.
- Does not connect to Android, iPhone or original Bitchat mobile client.
- M5 TALK is "record and send", not a real-time continuous voice stream.

### Overview

M5 INTEL is an offline, short-range field intelligence firmware for the M5StickS3. Devices communicate directly over ESP-NOW without a phone, computer, Wi-Fi router, or Internet connection. It combines temporary voice messages, preset reports, status codes, numeric intelligence, telemetry, IMU gesture signals, periodic beacons, and SOS alerts in a portrait cyber-terminal interface.

Version: v1.0.0  
Target hardware: M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
Transport: direct ESP-NOW communication between devices on the same channel  
Image type: merged flash image for offset 0x00000000

### Main Features

1. M5 TALK
   - Records voice with the built-in microphone.
   - Maximum recording length: 8 seconds.
   - Displays the live recording duration.
   - Reliably transmits completed recordings to same-channel devices.
   - The receiver shows a global popup with sender identity and duration.
   - BtnB plays the voice message; BtnA confirms and removes it from memory.

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - Sends numeric intelligence from 00 to 99.
   - Numbers may represent personnel, targets, distance, rooms, or mission IDs.

5. TELEMETRY
   - Sends battery percentage.
   - Sends device uptime.

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - Sends a gesture signal when the device is shaken firmly.
   - Approximate trigger threshold: 2.5g.
   - A 15-second cooldown prevents repeated triggers.
   - Detection is suspended while recording.

7. BEACON
   - Broadcasts presence and battery level every 30 seconds.
   - Operates only when another same-channel device is detected and no recording is active.
   - Runs silently in the background without interrupting the UI.

8. SOS
   - Sends a high-priority emergency alert.
   - The receiver displays a dedicated red SOS screen.
   - A short notification tone is played once.
   - BtnB acknowledges and closes the alert.

- Matrix-inspired green digital-rain boot animation.
- Pixel cyber-style M5 INTEL wordmark.
- Black background, green information, and red emergency alerts.
- Portrait interface throughout the firmware.
- Off-screen buffered rendering to reduce visible flicker.
- Current channel and online device count are displayed.
- Voice and intelligence messages can be received from any feature screen.
- Global popups display the complete sender and message, with automatic line wrapping.
- Closing a popup returns the user to the previous screen.
- Periodic beacons stay in the background and do not open popups.

### Reliable Delivery

- Voice is downsampled and split into ESP-NOW fragments.
- Packets include a message ID, fragment index, fragment count, duration, and CRC16.
- The receiver acknowledges every valid fragment.
- The sender selectively retransmits only missing fragments for up to five rounds.
- Quick reports, status codes, numbers, telemetry, IMU signals, and SOS messages also wait for receiver acknowledgement.
- DELIVERED means the receiver confirmed delivery.
- NOT CONFIRMED means complete confirmation was not received and the user should retry.
- Duplicate messages are filtered and incomplete voice assemblies expire automatically.

Main menu:

- BtnA: move down.
- BtnB: enter the selected feature.
- Hold A+B: change the ESP-NOW channel.

Inside a feature:

- Hold A+B: return to the main menu.

M5 TALK:

- BtnA: start or stop recording.
- BtnB: send the local recording.
- In an incoming voice popup, BtnB plays and BtnA confirms and destroys the message.

Standard message popup:

- BtnA: acknowledge and close.

File: `M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. Open the custom firmware flashing workflow for M5StickS3 in M5Burner.
2. Select the `.bin` file above.
3. Set the flash offset to `0x00000000`.
4. Erase Flash is recommended before the first installation.
5. Select the correct serial port and start flashing.
6. Both devices must run the same firmware version and use the same channel.

Important: this is a complete merged image containing the bootloader, partition table, boot_app0, and application. Do not flash this file at `0x10000`.

- This release targets direct communication between M5StickS3 devices.
- It does not connect to Android, iPhone, or the original Bitchat mobile client.
- M5 TALK uses record-then-send voice messages, not continuous live audio streaming.
- ESP-NOW broadcast link encryption is not enabled in this release.
- “Destroy after playback” means deletion from runtime memory; it is not a security-audited physical data-erasure mechanism.

产品简介

M5 INTEL 是为 M5StickS3 开发的离线近距离情报通信固件。设备通过 ESP-NOW 直接通信，不依赖手机、电脑、Wi-Fi 路由器或互联网。它将临时语音、预设短报文、状态代码、数字情报、设备遥测、IMU 手势信号、定时信标和 SOS 警报整合进一套竖屏赛博终端界面。

当前版本号：v1.0.0  
目标硬件：M5StickS3 / ESP32-S3-PICO-1 / 8 MB Flash  
通信方式：ESP-NOW，同频道设备直接通信  
固件类型：完整合并镜像，从 0x00000000 烧录

### 主要功能

1. M5 TALK
   - 使用内置麦克风录制语音。
   - 最长录音时间为 8 秒。
   - 屏幕实时显示录音时长。
   - 录音完成后可靠发送给同频道设备。
   - 接收端通过全局弹窗显示发送者和语音时长。
   - BtnB 播放语音，BtnA 确认并从内存销毁。

2. QUICK INTEL
   - SAFE
   - NEED SUPPORT
   - TARGET FOUND
   - RETREAT
   - RENDEZVOUS
   - MISSION COMPLETE

3. STATUS CODE
   - GREEN
   - AMBER
   - RED
   - HOLD
   - MOVING
   - OFFLINE

4. NUMERIC INTEL
   - 支持发送 00–99 的数字情报。
   - 可用于人数、目标、距离、房间或任务编号。

5. TELEMETRY
   - 发送本机电量百分比。
   - 发送设备开机运行时间。

6. IMU SIGNAL
   - 通过明显摇动设备发送手势信号。
   - 约 2.5g 触发阈值。
   - 15 秒冷却时间，避免重复触发。
   - 录音期间暂停检测。

7. BEACON
   - 每 30 秒发送在线状态和电量。
   - 仅在发现同频道设备且未录音时发送。
   - 后台运行，不弹出干扰窗口。

8. SOS
   - 发送高优先级紧急警报。
   - 接收端显示独立红色 SOS 页面。
   - 播放一次短提示音。
   - BtnB 确认并解除警报。

### UI 与消息体验

- Matrix 风格绿色数字雨启动动画。
- 像素赛博风 M5 INTEL Logo。
- 黑色背景、绿色信息、红色警报。
- 全部功能采用竖屏布局。
- 离屏双缓冲绘制，降低屏幕频闪。
- 显示当前频道和在线设备数量。
- 普通消息和语音可在任意功能页面接收。
- 消息以全局弹窗显示，长内容自动分行。
- 关闭弹窗后返回接收前所在页面。
- 定时信标不弹窗，不打断操作。

### 可靠传输

- 语音降采样后分片传输。
- 数据包包含消息 ID、分片序号、总分片数、时长和 CRC16。
- 接收端逐片返回 ACK。
- 发送端只补发缺失分片，最多执行 5 轮选择性重传。
- 预设报文、状态、数字、遥测、IMU 和 SOS 同样等待接收确认。
- DELIVERED 表示对端已经确认。
- NOT CONFIRMED 表示未获得完整确认，需要重试。
- 重复消息自动去重，不完整语音超时清理。

### 操作方式

主菜单：

- BtnA：向下选择。
- BtnB：进入功能。
- A+B 长按：切换频道。

子功能：

- A+B 长按：返回主菜单。

M5 TALK：

- BtnA：开始或停止录音。
- BtnB：发送本地录音。
- 收到语音弹窗后，BtnB 播放，BtnA 确认并销毁。

普通消息弹窗：

- BtnA：确认并关闭。

### M5Burner 安装

文件：`M5_INTEL_v1.0.0_M5Burner_0x0000.bin`

1. 在 M5Burner 中选择适用于 M5StickS3 的自定义固件烧录功能。
2. 选择上述 `.bin` 文件。
3. 烧录地址设置为 `0x00000000`。
4. 建议首次安装前执行 Erase Flash。
5. 选择设备对应串口并开始烧录。
6. 两台设备必须安装相同版本并设置为相同频道。

注意：这是完整合并镜像，已经包含 Bootloader、分区表、boot_app0 和应用程序。不要把该文件烧录到 `0x10000`。

### 技术边界

- 当前只面向 M5StickS3 设备之间的通信。
- 不连接 Android、iPhone 或原版 Bitchat 手机客户端。
- M5 TALK 是“录制后发送”，不是实时连续语音流。
- 当前 ESP-NOW 广播未启用链路加密。
- “播放后销毁”表示从运行内存中删除，不等同于经过安全审计的物理数据擦除。
- 当前 ACK 逻辑主要针对两台同频道设备的可靠通信场景。

name: M5 Mod Wheel
description:
An application for the M5StickS3 that acts as a USB or Bluetooth MIDI mod wheel or pitch wheel.

## USB MIDI

Connect the M5StickS3 with a data-capable cable. The display shows `USB` when connected.

## Bluetooth MIDI

Press the side button to start Bluetooth pairing. The display shows `PAIR`.
Pair with the device named `M5 Mod Wheel`. The display then shows `CONN`.

On macOS, BLE MIDI do not appear in System Settings > Bluetooth like headphones.
See [Set up Bluetooth MIDI devices in Audio MIDI Setup on Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-euro/guide/audio-midi-setup/ams33f013765/mac).

## Controls

- Press the front button to switch between mod-wheel and pitch-bend modes.
  Each press also captures the current orientation as the zero pose.
- Tilt up and down to change the MIDI value.

## MIDI output

- Mod-wheel mode sends Control Change 1 on MIDI channel 1. The zero pose maps to 64; tilting in either direction moves the value toward 0 or 127.
- Pitch-bend mode sends standard 14-bit pitch-bend values on MIDI channel 1, centered at 8192 in the 0–16383 range. The zero pose is the center; tilting reaches the bend limits.

description:
M5Cardputer Album Cover MP3 Player
（请下载最新的V1.1，原先的V1.0因为我上传错固件了，会导致黑屏）
Features & User Guide
1. Overview
An embedded MP3 player for M5Cardputer (ESP32-S3). Built with arduino-audio-tools, ES8311 codec and NS4150 amplifier. Supports ID3 album art, multi-folder management, precise playback progress and smooth volume control. Works with standard CBR/VBR MP3 files, no popping noise during track switching.
2. Hardware & Dependencies
Mainboard: M5Cardputer (ESP32-S3)
Audio Codec: ES8311 (I2C: 0x18 | SDA=GPIO38, SCL=GPIO39; I2S: BCLK=GPIO41, WS=GPIO43, DOUT=GPIO42)
Amplifier: NS4150 (Auto mute when headphones plugged in)
Storage: Micro SD Card (SPI)
Libraries: M5Cardputer.h, SD.h, JPEGDEC.h, arduino-audio-tools
3. Core Functions
Playback
Supports 16-bit stereo MP3 (44.1kHz/48kHz). Reads XING/VBRI headers for accurate duration. Features play/pause, previous/next track and folder loop. Buffer flush prevents audio truncation.
Album Cover
Loads ID3v2 APIC art (JPG/PNG). Caches covers locally on first boot. Displays No Cover if no artwork exists.
File Management
Scans /mp3 subfolders. Max: 64 folders, 64 tracks per folder. Supports page browsing.
Audio Optimization
25-level volume with human-perception curve. ES8311 soft mute eliminates pops. Auto-adapts to different sample rates.
On-screen Display
Album cover, auto-wrap song name, progress bar, play status, track number, volume, sample rate, remaining time & battery level.
Extra
Key debounce, automatic memory management, progress resume after pause.
4. SD Card Rules
Format SD card to FAT32. Create a root folder named mp3, then put music into its subfolders:
plaintext
SD Root
└── mp3
    ├── Folder1
    │   ├── Track1.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── Folder2
Only 1st-level subfolders are supported.
Use English/Chinese names, avoid special characters.
Embedded ID3 cover will be cached as cover.jpg/cover.png.
5. Key Operations
Folder List Page
Q / W / , / ; : Switch up
A / S / . / / : Switch down
Enter: Open folder & play
Player Page
Space: Play / Pause
. : Previous track
; : Next track
/ = : Volume up
: Volume down
B / Backspace: Stop & return to folder list
Notes: Tracks loop at folder end. All keys with anti-repeat protection.
6. Usage Steps
Organize SD files and connect hardware.
Power on: Scanning SD... → Caching covers...
Select folder and press Enter to play.
Press B/Backspace to exit playback.
7. Troubleshooting
SD Card Failed: Reinsert SD or reformat to FAT32.
No MP3 Folders: Check /mp3 directory structure.
No cover: Embed ID3 art via MP3Tag/Foobar; delete cache files and reboot.
Noise: Check wiring or lower volume.
Progress offset: Minor deviation on old VBR files is normal.
Speaker no sound: Unplug headphones and check amplifier.
8. Additional Notes
Recommended format: 44.1kHz 16-bit stereo MP3.
Cover file ≤ 1MB for fast loading.
Stable for long-time continuous playback.

M5Cardputer 专辑封面 MP3 播放器
功能说明 & 使用指南
一、概述
基于 M5Cardputer（ESP32-S3）开发的嵌入式 MP3 播放器，搭配arduino-audio-tools音频库、ES8311 音频解码芯片与 NS4150 功放。支持 ID3 专辑封面、多文件夹管理、精准播放进度与人性化音量调节，兼容标准 CBR/VBR 格式 MP3，切歌无爆音。
二、硬件与依赖
主控：M5Cardputer（ESP32-S3）
音频解码：ES8311（I2C 地址 0x18，SDA=GPIO38、SCL=GPIO39；I2S：BCLK=GPIO41、WS=GPIO43、DOUT=GPIO42）
功放：NS4150（插入耳机自动关闭外放）
存储：Micro SD 卡（SPI 通信）
依赖库：M5Cardputer.h、SD.h、JPEGDEC.h、arduino-audio-tools
三、核心功能
播放功能
支持 44.1kHz/48kHz 16 位立体声 MP3，解析音频头精准计算时长。具备播放 / 暂停、上一曲 / 下一曲、文件夹内循环功能，缓冲区优化，杜绝音频截断。
专辑封面
读取 ID3v2 内嵌 JPG/PNG 封面，首次使用自动缓存图片；无封面时显示默认占位图。
文件管理
自动扫描 SD 卡mp3目录下子文件夹，最多支持 64 个文件夹、单文件夹 64 首歌曲，支持分页浏览。
音频优化
25 级音量调节，采用人耳感知曲线；ES8311 软静音设计，启停 / 切歌无杂音；自动适配不同音频采样率。
屏幕显示
实时展示专辑封面、自动换行歌曲名、播放进度条、播放状态、曲目序号、音量、采样率、剩余时长、电池电量。
附加功能
按键防误触、内存自动管理、暂停后记忆播放进度。
四、SD 卡目录规则
SD 卡格式化为 FAT32，在根目录新建mp3文件夹，音乐存放至其子目录：
plaintext
SD卡根目录
└── mp3
    ├── 文件夹1
    │   ├── 歌曲.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── 文件夹2
仅识别mp3下一级子文件夹，不支持多层目录
文件夹 / 名称支持中英文，请勿使用特殊符号
内嵌封面会自动缓存为cover.jpg/cover.png
五、按键操作
文件夹列表页
Q / W / , / ; ：向上切换文件夹
A / S /.// ：向下切换文件夹
回车键 ：进入文件夹并开始播放
播放界面
空格键 ：播放 / 暂停
. 键 ：上一曲
; 键 ：下一曲
/ = 键 ：音量增大
键 ：音量减小
B / 退格键 ：停止播放，返回文件夹列表
补充：播放至最后一首会自动循环；所有按键均做防重复处理。
六、使用步骤
按规则整理 SD 卡文件，接好硬件；
开机，设备依次执行 SD 卡扫描、封面缓存；
选择文件夹，按回车进入播放；
按下 B / 退格键可退出播放。
七、常见问题排查
SD 卡加载失败：重新插拔 SD 卡，或格式化为 FAT32 格式
未找到歌曲文件夹：检查 SD 卡mp3目录结构
无专辑封面：使用 MP3Tag、Foobar 等工具内嵌封面，或删除缓存图片后重启
播放有杂音：检查硬件接线，或调低音量
进度有偏差：老旧 VBR 格式 MP3 出现小幅误差属于正常现象
外放无声：拔掉耳机，检查功放硬件
八、补充说明
推荐使用：44.1kHz 16 位立体声 MP3 格式
封面文件大小建议不超过 1MB，保证加载速度
程序运行稳定，支持长时间连续播放

读取 ID3v2 内嵌 JPG/PNG 封面，首次使用自动缓存图片；无封面时显示默认占位图。
文件管理
自动扫描 SD 卡mp3目录下子文件夹，最多支持 64 个文件夹、单文件夹 64 首歌曲，支持分页浏览。
音频优化
25 级音量调节，采用人耳感知曲线；ES8311 软静音设计，启停 / 切歌无杂音；自动适配不同音频采样率。
屏幕显示
实时展示专辑封面、自动换行歌曲名、播放进度条、播放状态、曲目序号、音量、采样率、剩余时长、电池电量。
附加功能
按键防误触、内存自动管理、暂停后记忆播放进度。
四、SD 卡目录规则
SD 卡格式化为 FAT32，在根目录新建mp3文件夹，音乐存放至其子目录：
plaintext
SD卡根目录
└── mp3
    ├── 文件夹1
    │   ├── 歌曲.mp3
    │   └── ...
    └── 文件夹2
仅识别mp3下一级子文件夹，不支持多层目录
文件夹 / 名称支持中英文，请勿使用特殊符号
内嵌封面会自动缓存为cover.jpg/cover.png
五、按键操作
文件夹列表页
Q / W / , / ; ：向上切换文件夹
A / S /.// ：向下切换文件夹
回车键 ：进入文件夹并开始播放
播放界面
空格键 ：播放 / 暂停
. 键 ：上一曲
; 键 ：下一曲
/ = 键 ：音量增大
键 ：音量减小
B / 退格键 ：停止播放，返回文件夹列表
补充：播放至最后一首会自动循环；所有按键均做防重复处理。
六、使用步骤
按规则整理 SD 卡文件，接好硬件；
开机，设备依次执行 SD 卡扫描、封面缓存；
选择文件夹，按回车进入播放；
按下 B / 退格键可退出播放。
七、常见问题排查
SD 卡加载失败：重新插拔 SD 卡，或格式化为 FAT32 格式
未找到歌曲文件夹：检查 SD 卡mp3目录结构
无专辑封面：使用 MP3Tag、Foobar 等工具内嵌封面，或删除缓存图片后重启
播放有杂音：检查硬件接线，或调低音量
进度有偏差：老旧 VBR 格式 MP3 出现小幅误差属于正常现象
外放无声：拔掉耳机，检查功放硬件
八、补充说明
推荐使用：44.1kHz 16 位立体声 MP3 格式
封面文件大小建议不超过 1MB，保证加载速度
程序运行稳定，支持长时间连续播放

name: M5Cardputer WebRadio FR
description:
M5Cardputer WebRadio FR version
WiFi Settings will be stored in EEPROM
PlatformIO IDE used. (VS code)

Difficult to use an SD card for URL storage: The classic dilemma on ESP32:

Wi-Fi after SPI/SD_card = Wi-Fi fails
SPI/SD after Wi-Fi = SD fails
Why? On some boards like the M5Cardputer, SD access is done via HSPI, while Wi-Fi uses DMA/interrupts from the main bus. → When SD is initialized after Wi-Fi, the SPI bus or GPIO pins may conflict.

Implemented solution: Use an HTTP GET request to retrieve the list of channels: web-streams come from http://philae.synology.me/~admin/arduino/radio_dico.php

name: M5Dice
description:
**M5Dice** turns the M5StickS3 into real dice, in real 3D.

Press the blue button or just shake the stick: the dice fly up, tumble, bounce off the green felt and come to rest face up, every time at a different spot and angle. One fixed light shades them pixel by pixel, so their faces brighten and darken as they turn, with soft shadows, rounded edges and dimpled pips. Every bounce clacks through the speaker.

- Real-time 3D: a software renderer running on both cores of the ESP32-S3, 30 to 45 frames per second
- One die or two; the result is shown under the dice, like "1 + 6 = 7"
- Fair throws from the ESP32's hardware random number generator
- Shake to roll: the dice rattle while you shake and fly when you stop
- The screen sleeps after a minute without use and wakes up, showing the last throw, when you pick the stick up

### Controls

Hold the stick upright, screen towards you. It starts with one die.

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| KEY1 (the blue button on the front) | Throw |
| Shake the stick | Rattle, then throw when you stop |
| KEY2 (the button on the edge) | One die / two dice |

Double-press the power button to switch the stick off.

Source code: https://github.com/mbogatyr/M5Dice

Therefore, classical Bluetooth serial connexion won't work on the M5Stack Core S3. So, you will need to use ICUSBProxy(https://github.com/armel/ICUSBProxy). So, if you plan to use the Bluetooth connection, get an M5Stack Core or Core2 instead !

name: M5Paper NTP Master Clock
description:
# M5Paper Clock - Settings Configuration File
# Place this file on your SD card root as: /settings.txt
# Format: KEY=VALUE (one per line)
# Lines starting with # are comments and will be ignored

# Timezone offset from UTC (in hours)
# Examples: -7 = Mountain Time (MST/MDT), -5 = Eastern Time (EST/EDT)
#           0 = UK (GMT/BST), 9 = Japan/Korea (JST/KST)
TIMEZONE=-7

# WiFi Network Credentials
# Replace with your actual WiFi network name and password
WIFI_SSID=YOUR_WIFI_SSID
WIFI_PASSWORD=YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD

# NTP Time Server
# Recommended servers:
#   time.cloudflare.com (Cloudflare - very reliable, global)
#   pool.ntp.org (Global pool of time servers)
#   time.google.com (Google - very reliable)
#   time.nist.gov (NIST - US government)
NTP_SERVER=time.cloudflare.com

A basic TXT ebook reader designed for the M5Paper v1.1 development kit.

个人学习项目，目前只有基本功能，界面较为粗糙，未来会继续改进。

You can experience the feeling of punching holes in the paper of a hand-cranked music box and playing it.
While a real music box requires multiple sheets of paper, this app lets you correct mistakes and start over as many times as you like.
You can also write your own song on the music box's circuit board and give it as a gift, or download it to your smartphone using a QR code.


Key Features
- Transfer song data to the board and play it on the board
- Input from quarter notes to 64th notes
- 256 steps for quarter notes, 4096 steps for 64th notes
- Adjustable playback tempo
- 2-octave keyboard input
- Up to 3 notes per step
- Input up to 250 notes
- Data saving (automatically loaded when the app is restarted)
- Transfer composition data to your smartphone via QR code
- Save and load data to SD card
- Delete previously entered notes by reselecting them
- Automatic scrolling when typing (when scrolling is on)
- Up and down scroll keys (hold to fast forward)
- Set the end of the song with the END button
- Insert and delete one line
- Transfer song data created to a Frisk-sized music box workshop (オルゴール工房) board and play it on the board


How to Use
● Home Screen
Pressing a key will play the corresponding sound and add a mark.
Scrolling advances one note at a time according to the set note value (quarter note to 64th note).
The note value can be changed using the "(+)" and "(-)" buttons on the right.
The editing position can be moved using the "UP" and "DOWN" buttons on the left, and the sound at the moved position will be played.
Pressing and holding the "UP" or "DOWN" buttons will fast-forward. No sound will be played in this case.
Pressing the "SAVE" button will save the edited song to the internal memory and automatically load it the next time the unit is started.
To listen to the song you entered from the beginning, press the "TOP" button to move to the beginning of the song, then press the "PLAY" button.
Playback will automatically stop when it reaches the end of the song.
To stop playback midway, press the "PLAY" button.
Pressing the "INS" button will insert one line (the length of the current note) at the current editing position.
Pressing the "DEL" button will delete one line from the current editing position.
Press the "MENU" button to display the settings menu screen.


●Settings Menu Screen
Pressing the "CLEAR" button twice will clear all composition data.
Pressing the "ONLY PLAY" button to turn it on allows you to freely play without recording.
The "SD SAVE" button saves data to the SD card.
You can add an 8-digit number to the file name.
The "SD LOAD" button loads song data saved on the SD card.
Song data is limited to 100 songs.
Turning on the "AUTO SCROLL" button automatically scrolls one note at a time as you play.
The "VOL" button adjusts the volume.
The "TEMPO" button changes the tempo (30-240).
Pressing the "QR VIEW" button converts the current song data into a QR code and displays it.
Click the "TRANS" button to transfer the composition data to the Music Box Workshop board (オルゴール工房).
It can be loaded using the "オルゴール工房" smartphone app.


●Transferring Song Data to the Board
You can transfer the song data you created to the Music Box Workshop board and play it on the board.
Press the "Transfer" button in the menu to display the song data transfer screen.
Press and hold the button on the board until the LED slowly flashes (write mode).
Place the board's light sensor directly above the light-emitting element and press the "TRANS" button.
While writing, the board's LED will stop flashing and remain lit, and the progress bar will advance.
If the data is successfully written, the board's LED will turn off.
If the data transfer fails, the board's LED will flash rapidly; press the button on the board (to exit write mode) and try again.


To see videos on how to use it, search for "Music Box Workshop (オルゴール工房)" on YouTube.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKYO2o_FNh4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFtbN6PRWyo
The circuit board is available for purchase on Mercari and Switch Science. Search for "Music Box Workshop (オルゴール工房)".

name: M5StackTab5MusicBoxJP
description:
「オルゴール工房」
手作り手回しオルゴールを楽しめるアプリです。
手回しオルゴールの紙にパンチで穴を空けて演奏してみる感覚を味わえます。
実物では紙が何枚も必要になりますが、このアプリであれば失敗しても何度でも修正してやり直せます。
オルゴール基板に書き込んで自作の曲をプレゼントしたり、QRコードでスマホに取り込むこともできます。

主な特徴
・曲データを基板へ転送して、基板で演奏可能
・4分音符から64分音符まで入力可能
・4分音符で256ステップ、64分音符で4096ステップ
・再生時のテンポ設定可能
・2オクターブ鍵盤入力
・1ステップに3音まで同時発音
・250音まで入力可能
・データ保存（アプリ再開時に自動読み込み）
・QRコードを介してスマホと作曲データのやり取りが可能
・SDカードの保存と読出が可能
・入力済み音を再選択すると消去できます
・入力すると自動スクロールします（スクロールオン時）
・画面上下スクロールキー（長押しで早送り）
・曲の終了位置をENDボタンで設定できます
・1行挿入と1行削除機能
・フリスクサイズのオルゴール工房基板に作成した曲データを転送して基板で演奏できます

使い方
●トップ画面
鍵盤を押すとその音が鳴り、マークが付きます。
スクロールは、設定した音符（4分音符〜64分音符）にしたがって1音分送られます。
音符は、右側の「↑」と「↓」ボタンで変更出来ます。
編集位置は、左側の「↑」と「↓」ボタンで移動でき、移動した位置の音が再生されます。
「↑」と「↓」ボタンは、長押しすると早送りされます。この時は、音は再生しません。
「保存」ボタンを押すと、本体に保存され、次回起動時に自動的に読み込まれます。
打ち込んだ曲を最初から聴くには、「先頭」ボタンを押して曲の先頭に移動し、「演奏」ボタンを押します。
演奏が曲の最後まで来ると自動的に停止します。
途中で止めたいときは、「演奏」ボタンを押します。
「挿入」ボタンを押すと現在の編集位置に1行分（現在の音符の長さ分）挿入します。
「消去」ボタンを押すと現在の編集位置の1行分を削除します。
「設定」ボタンを押すと設定メニュー画面が表示されます。

●設定メニュー画面
「全消去」ボタンは、2回押すと作曲データを全てクリアします。
「フリー演奏」ボタンを押してオンにすると、記録せず自由に演奏を楽しめます。
「SD保存」ボタンでSDカードにデータを保存できます。
保存するファイル名は、8桁の数字を付ける事ができます。
「SD読込」ボタンでSDカードに保存した曲データを読み込めます。
曲データは100曲までの制限があります。
「自動スクロール」ボタンをオンにすると打鍵時に1音分自動でスクロールさせられます。
「音量」ボタンでボリュームを調整できます。
「テンポ」ボタンでテンポを変更できます。（30～240）
「QR表示」ボタンを押すと、現在の曲データをQRコード変換して表示します。
「転送」ボタンでオルゴール工房基板に作曲データを転送できます。
スマホアプリ「オルゴール工房」で読み込むことができます。

●基板への作成曲データ転送
オルゴール工房基板に作成した曲データを転送して基板で演奏することができます。
メニューの「転送」ボタンを押して、曲データの転送画面にします。
基板のボタンを長押しして、LEDがゆっくり点滅（書込モード）にします。
基板の光センサが発光部の真上に来るように置き「転送」ボタンを押します。
書込中は基板のLEDが点滅から点灯に切り替わり、プログレスバーが進行します。
データの書込が成功すると基板のLEDは消灯します。
データの転送に失敗すると基板のLEDが速く点滅するので、基板のボタンを押して（書込モード解除）やり直して下さい。

使い方の動画は、YouTubeで「オルゴール工房」「スマホアプリで電子オルゴール基板への曲データ書き込み」で検索して下さい。
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKYO2o_FNh4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFtbN6PRWyo
基板は、メルカリとスイッチサイエンスで販売中。「オルゴール工房」で検索して下さい。

"Music box workshop"
This is an app where you can enjoy handmade hand-cranked music boxes.
You can enjoy the feeling of punching holes in the paper of a hand-cranked music box and playing it.
In real life, you would need many sheets of paper, but with this app, even if you make a mistake, you can correct it and try again as many times as you like.
You can write your own songs on the music box board and give them as gifts, or you can import them to your smartphone using a QR code.

Main features
- Song data can be transferred to the board and played on the board
- Can input from quarter note to 64th note
・256 steps for quarter notes, 4096 steps for 64th notes
- Possible to set tempo during playback
・2 octave keyboard input
・Simultaneous pronunciation of up to 3 notes per step
・Up to 250 sounds can be input
・Save data (automatically load when restarting the app)
・You can exchange composition data with your smartphone via QR code.
・Can save and read from SD card
・You can delete the input sound by reselecting it.
- Automatically scrolls as you type (when scrolling is on)
・Screen up/down scroll key (long press to fast forward)
-You can set the end position of the song using the END button.
・One line insertion and one line deletion function
・You can transfer the song data you created to the Frisk-sized music box workshop board and play it on the board.

How to use
●Top screen
When you press a key, that note will sound and a mark will be added.
The scroll will advance one note according to the set note (quarter note to 64th note).
Notes can be changed using the "↑" and "↓" buttons on the right.
You can move the editing position using the "↑" and "↓" buttons on the left, and the sound at the moved position will be played.
Press and hold the "↑" and "↓" buttons to fast forward. At this time, no sound will be played.
When you press the "Save" button, it will be saved to the device and automatically loaded the next time it is started.
To listen to the song you typed from the beginning, press the "Start" button to move to the beginning of the song, then press the "Play" button.
The performance will stop automatically when it reaches the end of the song.
If you want to stop midway through, press the "Play" button.
When you press the "Insert" button, one line (the length of the current note) is inserted at the current editing position.
Press the "Delete" button to delete one line at the current editing position.
Press the "Settings" button to display the settings menu screen.

●Settings menu screen
Pressing the "Delete All" button twice will clear all composition data.
If you press the "Free Performance" button to turn it on, you can enjoy playing freely without recording.
You can save data to the SD card using the "SD Save" button.
The file name to be saved can be an 8-digit number.
You can read song data saved on the SD card using the "SD Read" button.
Song data is limited to 100 songs.
If you turn on the "Auto Scroll" button, it will automatically scroll by one note when you press a key.
You can adjust the volume with the "Volume" button.
You can change the tempo with the "Tempo" button. (30-240)
When you press the "QR display" button, the current song data will be converted into a QR code and displayed.
You can transfer the composition data to the Music Box Studio board using the "Transfer" button.
It can be loaded using the smartphone app "Music Box Workshop".

●Transfer created song data to the board
You can transfer song data created to the music box workshop board and play it on the board.
Press the "Transfer" button on the menu to display the song data transfer screen.
Press and hold the button on the board to make the LED blink slowly (write mode).
Place the board so that the light sensor is directly above the light emitting part and press the "Transfer" button.
During writing, the LED on the board changes from flashing to lit, and the progress bar advances.
When data writing is successful, the LED on the board turns off.
If data transfer fails, the LED on the board will flash rapidly, so press the button on the board (to cancel write mode) and try again.

For videos on how to use it, please search for "Music Box Workshop" and "Writing song data to electronic music box board using smartphone app" on YouTube.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKYO2o_FNh4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFtbN6PRWyo
The board is on sale at Mercari and Switch Science. Please search for "Music box workshop".

name: M5Stopwatch DIY Badge DIY胸牌
description:
## 这是什么
把 M5Stack StopWatch 变成一块挂在胸前的电子名片。展会、活动、技术交流时戴上：别人看一眼就知道你是谁，想加你直接扫码。

## 屏幕上能看到什么
- **名片页**：头像、姓名、职位和公司、几个标签；顶部显示时间、电量和大约还能用多久。
- **扫码页**：大号二维码，亮度自动调到最高，方便别人扫。
- **待机页**：一段时间不操作会自动变暗，只显示时间和名字，更省电。

## 按键怎么用
| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 黄键 短按 | 打开二维码（亮度拉满），到时间自动回到名片，或再按一次返回 |
| 蓝键 短按 | 有多个二维码时切换到下一个；只有一个时返回名片 |
| 蓝键 长按 2 秒 | 进入 / 退出「用手机修改」模式 |
| 待机时按任意键 | 回到名片；按黄键直接打开二维码 |
| 电源键 按一下 / 连按两下 | 开机 / 关机 |

## 用手机改成你自己的名片
1. 第一次开机（或长按蓝键 2 秒），屏幕会显示一个 Wi‑Fi 二维码和密码。
2. 用手机自带的相机扫码，连上胸牌的热点（微信扫一扫不行）。手机会自动打开编辑页面；没弹出来的话，用浏览器打开 192.168.4.1。
3. 填写名字、职位、公司、标签，换头像，最多添加 3 个二维码（可以直接选微信二维码截图，自动识别），再选主题和亮度。
4. 点「发布到胸牌」，看到「已保存」就完成了。热点会自动关闭。整个过程不需要联网，资料只保存在胸牌里。

## 电量小贴士
- 电池图标旁边的「x.xh」是估计还能用几个小时，充电时不显示。
- 满电时停在名片页大约能用 8–9 小时；经常亮二维码、开着热点会更耗电。
- 第一次用建议先充满，再一直用到快没电，胸牌会记住这块电池的实际情况，之后剩余时间会更准。
- 连按两下电源键关机，关机后时间还会继续走。

author: Dylan Luo
description_en:
## What's this
Turn M5Stack StopWatch into an electronic business card that hangs on your chest. Wear it at exhibitions, events, and technical exchanges: others will know who you are at a glance, and if they want to add you, they can just scan the QR code.

## What can be seen on the screen?
- **Business Card Page**: avatar, name, position and company, several tags; the top shows the time, battery and approximate remaining life.
- **Scan code page**: Large QR code, the brightness is automatically adjusted to the highest level, making it easier for others to scan.
- **Standby page**: It will automatically dim after a period of inactivity and only display the time and name, saving more power.

## How to use the buttons
| Operation | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Short press the yellow key | Open the QR code (full brightness), and automatically return to the business card when the time is up, or press it again to return |
| Short press the blue key | Switch to the next one when there are multiple QR codes; return to the business card when there is only one |
| Press and hold blue key for 2 seconds | Enter/exit "Modify with mobile phone" mode |
| Press any key in standby | Return to business card; press the yellow key to directly open the QR code |
| Power button once / double press | Power on / off |

## Use your mobile phone to change it to your own business card
1. When you turn on the phone for the first time (or press and hold the blue button for 2 seconds), a Wi‑Fi QR code and password will be displayed on the screen.
2. Use the camera that comes with your phone to scan the QR code and connect it to the hotspot on the badge (scanning via WeChat will not work). The phone will automatically open the editing page; if it does not pop up, use a browser to open 192.168.4.1.
3. Fill in the name, position, company, tags, change the avatar, add up to 3 QR codes (you can directly select WeChat QR code screenshots for automatic recognition), and then select the theme and brightness.
4. Click "Publish to Badge" and you're done when you see "Saved". The hotspot will turn off automatically. The entire process does not require an Internet connection, and the information is only saved in the badge.

## Battery Tips
- The "x.xh" next to the battery icon indicates how many hours it can be used and is not displayed when charging.
- When fully charged, it can be used for about 8-9 hours when parked on the business card page; frequently flashing QR codes and turning on hotspots will consume more power.
- It is recommended to fully charge the battery for the first time and then use it until it is almost empty. The badge will remember the actual condition of the battery and the remaining time will be more accurate.
- Press the power button twice to turn off the phone. Time will continue to run after the phone is turned off.

description_src:
## 这是什么
把 M5Stack StopWatch 变成一块挂在胸前的电子名片。展会、活动、技术交流时戴上：别人看一眼就知道你是谁，想加你直接扫码。

## 屏幕上能看到什么
- **名片页**：头像、姓名、职位和公司、几个标签；顶部显示时间、电量和大约还能用多久。
- **扫码页**：大号二维码，亮度自动调到最高，方便别人扫。
- **待机页**：一段时间不操作会自动变暗，只显示时间和名字，更省电。

## 按键怎么用
| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 黄键 短按 | 打开二维码（亮度拉满），到时间自动回到名片，或再按一次返回 |
| 蓝键 短按 | 有多个二维码时切换到下一个；只有一个时返回名片 |
| 蓝键 长按 2 秒 | 进入 / 退出「用手机修改」模式 |
| 待机时按任意键 | 回到名片；按黄键直接打开二维码 |
| 电源键 按一下 / 连按两下 | 开机 / 关机 |

## 用手机改成你自己的名片
1. 第一次开机（或长按蓝键 2 秒），屏幕会显示一个 Wi‑Fi 二维码和密码。
2. 用手机自带的相机扫码，连上胸牌的热点（微信扫一扫不行）。手机会自动打开编辑页面；没弹出来的话，用浏览器打开 192.168.4.1。
3. 填写名字、职位、公司、标签，换头像，最多添加 3 个二维码（可以直接选微信二维码截图，自动识别），再选主题和亮度。
4. 点「发布到胸牌」，看到「已保存」就完成了。热点会自动关闭。整个过程不需要联网，资料只保存在胸牌里。

## 电量小贴士
- 电池图标旁边的「x.xh」是估计还能用几个小时，充电时不显示。
- 满电时停在名片页大约能用 8–9 小时；经常亮二维码、开着热点会更耗电。
- 第一次用建议先充满，再一直用到快没电，胸牌会记住这块电池的实际情况，之后剩余时间会更准。
- 连按两下电源键关机，关机后时间还会继续走。

Weather dashboard for the M5Stack PaperColor (ESP32-S3, 4" Spectra 6 color e-ink, 600x400) with a browser-based config page on your local network. No API keys or accounts: weather from Open-Meteo, US zip-code geocoding from Zippopotam.us.

# FEATURES - Current conditions: temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, condition icon - Indoor temperature and humidity from the onboard SHT40 - 5-day forecast with highs (red), lows (blue), and precipitation chance - Six built-in themes: Classic, Night, Forest, Comic, Time Circuit (Back to the Future), DECK//OS (cyberdeck HUD in four accents) - Alternate view: pick a second theme and flip between them with any top-edge button - Web config page at http://m5weather.local (zip, units F/C, refresh 15 min to 3 h, theme, Wi-Fi) - First-boot captive portal over a WPA2 hotspot - Settings persist in flash; hardware RTC corrected from NTP - Hardened LAN web server: Host/Origin checks, validated input, size-capped API responses

# FLASHING Flash at address 0x0. If the port does not respond, hold the side power button for about 6 seconds with USB-C connected to enter download mode, flash, then press it once to reboot.

# FIRST BOOT 1. On your phone or laptop join the Wi-Fi network "M5Weather-Setup" (password: m5weather). 2. A setup page opens (or browse to http://192.168.4.1). Enter your home 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi credentials. The device reboots and joins. 3. Browse to http://m5weather.local, enter your US zip code, and click "Save & Update Display".

# NOTES - The device stays awake so the config page is always reachable; plan on USB power. - A full e-ink refresh takes several seconds with visible flashing, which is normal for Spectra 6 panels. - Trusted-LAN model, no login: anyone on your network can change settings. - US zip codes only for now.

name: M5stampclaw
description:
M5stampclaw turns the `M5Stamp S3` into a small AI assistant for embedded tasks.

It can:
- Chat with AI over Telegram or USB serial
- Turn safe GPIO pins on/off and read them
- Remember information across reboots
- Schedule reminders and timed actions
- Report current time, network status, RSSI, and IP
- Scan nearby Wi-Fi networks
- Change reply style/persona

## Example commands

You can talk to it in natural language. Example commands:

```text
Hello
Remember that my name is Jay
Turn on GPIO 5
Show me the current network information
Set a reminder in 10 minutes
```

You can also chain multiple actions in one prompt, for example:

```text
Remember that the pump relay is on GPIO 5. If GPIO 5 is off, turn it on, wait 2 seconds, read it again, then show me the current network info.
```

## First-time setup

There are 2 setup methods:
- Wi-Fi AP + web portal
- USB serial terminal

### 1. Setup over Wi-Fi + web portal

If the board does not have Wi-Fi credentials in NVS, it will automatically start a setup access point on boot:

- SSID: `ESPClaw-Setup-XXXXXX`
- Password: `espclaw1`

After connecting to the AP:
- Open `http://192.168.4.1`
- Fill in the required settings:
  - Wi-Fi SSID
  - Wi-Fi Password
  - LLM Backend
  - API Key
  - Model
  - Base URL (if using a custom endpoint)
  - Telegram Bot Token
  - Telegram Chat ID(s)
- Click `Save And Reboot`

The board will reboot automatically. If Telegram is configured, it will send an initial hello message after reconnecting to Wi-Fi, including a summary of its main capabilities.

### 2. Setup over USB serial

Connect the board to your computer, open a serial monitor, then use commands like:

```text
/config show
/config wifi "My WiFi" "My Password"
/config backend openai
/config apikey sk-...
/config model gpt-4o-mini
/config baseurl https://api.openai.com/v1
/config telegram 123456:ABCDEF -1001234567890
/config reboot
```

Notes:
- If the SSID or password contains spaces, wrap it in quotes.
- `chat_ids` can be a single ID or multiple IDs separated by commas.
- If you do not want Telegram, skip `/config telegram`.

name: MARS
description:
**MARS** is a port of the legendary demo by **Tim Clarke** (1993) to the M5StickS3.

Preserved in the Hornet demoscene archive, the original MARS.EXE was a tiny DOS
program of just 5.6 KB. It generated a fractal landscape with the Diamond-Square
algorithm and flew you over it in real time with voxel rendering: a
three-dimensional "red planet" on an IBM PC 386 with VGA (320×200, 256 colours).
Every run made a new planet.

This port does the same on the stick's 240×135 screen at about 35 frames per second:

- a new 256×256 Diamond-Square planet at every start, wrapping seamlessly, so the flight never ends;
- voxel rendering front to back, column by column, as in the original, with its palette,
  its salmon-red cloudy sky, the glowing horizon and far mountains sinking into dark maroon;
- an autopilot that follows the terrain, and steering by tilting the stick.

### Controls

Hold the stick in landscape, screen towards you.

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Lower the left or right end | Turn |
| Tip the top edge away / towards you | Dive / climb |
| KEY1 (the blue button on the front) | New planet; the current grip becomes neutral |
| KEY2 (the button on the edge) | Speed: slow, cruise, fast |

Let go, and the autopilot flies on by itself. The screen goes dark after 3 minutes
without a key press or a tilt; tilt the stick or press a key to wake it.
Double-press the power button to switch the stick off.

Source code: https://github.com/mbogatyr/M5Mars
author: mbogatyr

name: MARS for Cardputer ADV
description:
**MARS** is a port of the legendary demo by **Tim Clarke** (1993) to the Cardputer ADV.

Preserved in the Hornet demoscene archive, the original MARS.EXE was a tiny DOS
program of just 5.6 KB. It generated a fractal landscape with the Diamond-Square
algorithm and flew you over it in real time with voxel rendering: a
three-dimensional "red planet" on an IBM PC 386 with VGA (320×200, 256 colours).
Every run made a new planet.

This port does the same on the Cardputer's 240×135 screen at about 33 frames per second:

- a new 256×256 Diamond-Square planet at every start, wrapping seamlessly, so the flight never ends;
- voxel rendering front to back, column by column, as in the original, with its palette,
  its salmon-red cloudy sky, the glowing horizon and far mountains sinking into dark maroon;
- an autopilot that follows the terrain; steer it by tilting the Cardputer or with the arrow keys.

### Controls

Hold the Cardputer in front of you, screen towards you. Lower the left or right end
to turn; tip the top edge away or towards you to dive or climb.

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Arrow keys `,` `/` or `A` `D` | Turn left / right |
| Arrow keys `;` `.` or `W` `S` | Climb / dive |
| Enter or the G0 button | New planet; the current grip becomes neutral |
| Space | Speed: slow, cruise, fast |

The keys and the tilt work together. Let go, and the autopilot flies on by itself.
The screen goes dark after 3 minutes without a key press or a tilt; tilt the
Cardputer or press a key to wake it.

The same firmware also runs on the M5StickS3 (a separate MARS listing).

Source code: https://github.com/mbogatyr/M5Mars

name: MCCC (MeshCore CardComm) - MeshCore client for Cardputer ADV with CAP LoRa-1262
description:
🇬🇧 ENGLISH

MCCC (MeshCore CardComm) is a dedicated MeshCore client built specifically for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV and CAP LoRa-1262 module.

After trying out various MeshCore firmwares on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV, I encountered compatibility issues with my local repeaters running newer MeshCore versions, alongside some usability drawbacks for everyday use. As a developer and active amateur radio operator (EA3IIU), I decided to develop my own client: MCCC — MeshCore CardComm.

My main goal was clear from the start: to make the Cardputer function as a fully independent MeshCore device without needing a phone nearby, while still retaining the ability to pair via Bluetooth as a companion whenever needed. Above all, MCCC is a personal learning project focused on experimentation, solving real-world compatibility hurdles, and sharing progress with the MeshCore community.

Features:

Dual Mode: Operates 100% standalone or as a Bluetooth companion for smartphones.
Rich Messaging: Displays usernames, timestamps, unread badges, and supports path hash size configuration for maximum repeater compatibility.
Alerts & Audio: Visual message notifications and customizable alert tones for DMs and channels.
UI & Tools: On-screen battery level indicator, UI color themes, display brightness control, and real-time user/channel search.
Clock & GPS: Automatic RTC time sync via Bluetooth or physical GPS module.

☕ Support the project: [https://buymeacoffee.com/jsaludes](https://buymeacoffee.com/jsaludes?utm_source=gemini)

Como desarrollador y radioaficionado (EA3IIU), decidí desarrollar mi propio cliente: MCCC — MeshCore CardComm.

Mi objetivo principal fue claro desde el principio: conseguir que el Cardputer funcionase como un dispositivo MeshCore totalmente independiente sin necesidad de tener un teléfono cerca, manteniendo la posibilidad de vincularlo por Bluetooth como compañero cuando sea necesario. Ante todo, MCCC es un proyecto personal de aprendizaje centrado en la experimentación, la resolución de problemas reales de compatibilidad y el compartir progresos con la comunidad MeshCore.

MCCC (MeshCore CardComm) is a dedicated MeshCore client built specifically for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV and CAP LoRa-1262 module.

After trying out various MeshCore firmwares on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV, I encountered compatibility issues with my local repeaters running newer MeshCore versions, alongside some usability drawbacks for everyday use. As a developer and active amateur radio operator (EA3IIU), I decided to develop my own client: MCCC — MeshCore CardComm.

My main goal was clear from the start: to make the Cardputer function as a fully independent MeshCore device without needing a phone nearby, while still retaining the ability to pair via Bluetooth as a companion whenever needed. Above all, MCCC is a personal learning project focused on experimentation, solving real-world compatibility hurdles, and sharing progress with the MeshCore community.

Features:

Dual Mode: Operates 100% standalone or as a Bluetooth companion for smartphones.
Rich Messaging: Displays usernames, timestamps, unread badges, and supports path hash size configuration for maximum repeater compatibility.
Alerts & Audio: Visual message notifications and customizable alert tones for DMs and channels.
UI & Tools: On-screen battery level indicator, UI color themes, display brightness control, and real-time user/channel search.
Clock & GPS: Automatic RTC time sync via Bluetooth or physical GPS module.

☕ Support the project: [https://buymeacoffee.com/jsaludes](https://buymeacoffee.com/jsaludes?utm_source=gemini)

Como desarrollador y radioaficionado (EA3IIU), decidí desarrollar mi propio cliente: MCCC — MeshCore CardComm.

Mi objetivo principal fue claro desde el principio: conseguir que el Cardputer funcionase como un dispositivo MeshCore totalmente independiente sin necesidad de tener un teléfono cerca, manteniendo la posibilidad de vincularlo por Bluetooth como compañero cuando sea necesario. Ante todo, MCCC es un proyecto personal de aprendizaje centrado en la experimentación, la resolución de problemas reales de compatibilidad y el compartir progresos con la comunidad MeshCore.

Características:

description:
## MIASMORA — Dark Ambient Drone Generator

**Fully synthesised horror ambience for the Cardputer ADV** (no samples, 25 layers)

Firmware that turns the Cardputer ADV into a **dark ambient drone generator**: an endless, uneasy horror-film drone, synthesised in real time. It keeps changing by itself and reacts to the room.

> Earphones are recommended: the built-in speaker barely reproduces the lowest notes.

### Key features

- **25 synthesised layers**: 11 drones, 13 events (knocks, footsteps, drips, insects…) and a reverb
- **24 moods** + random scenes, all from a **6-digit seed** you can share
- **DREAD**: one knob that makes everything more unsettling
- **Drift** and **Arc**: the sound keeps changing by itself, building to a climax
- **Listen**: a sudden sound in the room makes everything fall silent (levels only, nothing is recorded), and an engraved eye opens to look around
- **Cursed Mode** (opt-in): strange things happen now and then
- **PLANCHETTE**: tilt the unit to feel your way through a mood
- **Poltergeist**: hide it as a prank — it knocks and creeps about with the screen dark
- **WAV export**: seamless loops, stems, batches and one-shot sound effects; live recording

### What you need

- M5Stack Cardputer ADV (the original Cardputer is untested)
- A microSD card (for settings, scenes and recordings)
- Earphones (recommended)

name: MORPHASE
description:
# MORPHASE — 4-Operator FM Polyphonic Synthesizer

**Standard build** (Unit MIDI / DIN, 12 voices)

Firmware that turns the Cardputer ADV into a 12-note polyphonic FM synth that you play from a MIDI keyboard. The Cardputer is not the keyboard: it is the editor and controller for the sound.

> Want to play over Bluetooth MIDI from an iPhone / iPad, or don't have a Unit MIDI? Use **MORPHASE BLE** instead.

## Key features

- 4-operator FM with 14 algorithms
- Waveform morphing: each operator slides smoothly through 8 waveforms
- Patch morph: move between patches lined up in 8 slots, blending everything
- GLITCH: repeat, reverse, chop, or knock the tone off for a moment
- Theremin (Unit ToF4M): wave your hand to move the sound, or play notes by hand height
- Tilt the unit (IMU) to change the tone; MIDI Learn
- Arpeggiator with STEP patterns; FX (Crush / Chorus / Delay / Reverb / Drive)
- 32 factory patches, ready to play

## What you need

- M5Stack Cardputer ADV (the original Cardputer is not supported)
- A MIDI keyboard + **Unit MIDI** on the Grove port (DIP switch = **BYPASS**, Grove 5V switch = **5VOUT**)
- A microSD card (for patches and settings)
- Earphones (the built-in speaker barely reproduces low notes)

## Manuals (English / Japanese, with PDFs)

https://github.com/oldtokage-collab/MORPHASE

Made by @Tokagetchi / Code by Claude (Anthropic) / License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.
author: Tokagetchi

name: MORPHASE BLE Version
description:
# MORPHASE BLE — 4-Operator FM Polyphonic Synthesizer

**BLE build** (Bluetooth MIDI + Unit MIDI / DIN, 10 voices)

Firmware that turns the Cardputer ADV into a 10-note polyphonic FM synth that you play over **Bluetooth MIDI** from an iPhone / iPad, Mac or PC — or from a MIDI keyboard through a Unit MIDI, both at once. The Cardputer is not the keyboard: it is the editor and controller for the sound.

> Bluetooth uses memory and CPU time, so this build plays 10 notes instead of 12. If you only play through a Unit MIDI, **MORPHASE** (Standard) gives you 12.

## Key features

- 4-operator FM with 14 algorithms
- Waveform morphing: each operator slides smoothly through 8 waveforms
- Patch morph: move between patches lined up in 8 slots, blending everything
- GLITCH: repeat, reverse, chop, or knock the tone off for a moment
- Theremin (Unit ToF4M): wave your hand to move the sound, or play notes by hand height
- Tilt the unit (IMU) to change the tone; MIDI Learn
- Arpeggiator with STEP patterns; FX (Crush / Chorus / Delay / Reverb / Drive)
- 32 factory patches, ready to play

## Connecting over Bluetooth

The unit appears as a Bluetooth MIDI device named **MORPHASE**. Connect **from inside an app** (tested: KeyPad on iPhone / iPad), not from the phone's Bluetooth settings. On a Mac, use Audio MIDI Setup → MIDI Studio → Bluetooth.

## What you need

- M5Stack Cardputer ADV (the original Cardputer is not supported)
- An app or device that sends Bluetooth MIDI, and/or a MIDI keyboard + Unit MIDI (DIP = **BYPASS**, Grove 5V = **5VOUT**)
- A microSD card (for patches and settings)
- Earphones (the built-in speaker barely reproduces low notes)

## Manuals (English / Japanese, with PDFs)

https://github.com/oldtokage-collab/MORPHASE

MTPLX Mate 是 Apple Silicon 本地推理 MTPLX 的桌面伴侣，专看别处看不到的东西——投机解码到底赚了多少。

· MTP 加速页：今日接受率、每 verify 产出几个 token、各档 depth 的接受概率曲线
· 实时速度页：当前 tok/s、首字延迟、缓存命中、显存占用、最近采样波形
· 省钱页：同一批 token 走云端要多少钱，扣掉本地电费还剩多少
· 用量 / 趋势 / 模型：今日与 7 天 30 天的 token、请求数、缓存命中、逐模型排名
· 一条命令装好 Mac 端后台程序：设备自己显示地址，复制粘贴即可，不用 SSH
· Mac 合盖也照算：设备离线不丢数据，一上线就收到最新
· 按 A/B 翻页；充电只变暗，电池 2 分钟自动熄屏，按任意键唤醒

需要一台 Mac（Apple Silicon）与正在运行的 MTPLX；设备为 M5Stack StickS3。

English: A desk companion for MTPLX on Apple Silicon — acceptance rate, tokens per verify, depth curves, live tok/s, TTFT, cache hit, memory, and what your local tokens would have cost in the cloud. Needs MTPLX running on a Mac; device is M5Stack StickS3.
author: andjiang
description_en:
Put the acceleration and "money saved" of MTPLX on a small 240×135 desktop screen.

MTPLX Mate, the desktop companion to Apple Silicon's native inference MTPLX, looks at what you can't see anywhere else - just how much money is being made in speculative decoding.

· MTP acceleration page: today’s acceptance rate, how many tokens are generated per verify, and the acceptance probability curve of each depth level
· Real-time speed page: current tok/s, first word delay, cache hit, video memory usage, latest sampled waveform
· Savings page: How much does it cost to use the same batch of tokens in the cloud, and how much is left after deducting the local electricity bill?
· Usage/Trend/Model: Today and 7/30 tokens, number of requests, cache hits, model-by-model ranking
· Install the Mac background program with one command: the device displays the address itself, just copy and paste, no SSH required
· Mac works even when the lid is closed: the device will not lose data when it is offline, and will receive the latest updates as soon as it is online
· Press A/B to turn pages; the screen will only dim when charging, the screen will automatically turn off after 2 minutes of battery use, press any key to wake up

Requires a Mac (Apple Silicon) with MTPLX running; device is M5Stack StickS3.

name: MacOS
description:
This project runs a Motorola 68040 emulator that can boot real Macintosh ROMs and run genuine classic Mac OS software. Performance is comparable to a Mac IIci (25 MHz 68030), achieving 24 FPS video and 1.5-3 MIPS CPU speed. The emulation includes:

CPU: Motorola 68040 emulation with FPU (68881) — 1.5-3 MIPS
RAM: Configurable from 4MB to 16MB (allocated from ESP32-P4's 32MB PSRAM)
Display: 640×360 virtual display (2× scaled to 1280×720 physical display), supporting 1/2/4/8-bit color depths at 24 FPS
Storage: Hard disk and CD-ROM images loaded from SD card
Input: Capacitive touchscreen (as mouse) + USB keyboard/mouse support
Video: Optimized pipeline with write-time dirty tracking, double-buffered DMA, and tile-based rendering

# MAKER FIGHTER

**The hand you make becomes a fist. **

A 1v1 3D fighting game powered by M5Stack Tab5. The fighters, drawn with flat-shaded polygons reminiscent of 90s arcades, are not fighters but makers and engineers. Use the virtual stick on the screen and the three buttons G, P, and K to fight by hitting upper, middle, and lower strikes.

Official website: https://maker-fighter.com/

## Features

- Tab5's software 3D rendering runs at 30fps.
- 1P vs. CPU winner.
- 3 rounds (best 2), time limit 45 seconds, ring out.
- 8 special techniques that can be issued using commands.


## How to play

1. When you turn on the power, the title screen (demo battle between CPUs) will appear. Tap the screen to proceed to character selection.
2. Select a character by tapping the face lined up below, then tap the same face again to confirm (it will be determined automatically after 15 seconds). The first opponent is determined by a roulette wheel.
3. If you win, move on to the next opponent. Even if you lose, you can continue by tapping YES within 10 seconds (no limit to the number of times).

The volume can be changed using the ⚙ button (settings screen) at the top right of the title screen (0 to 10 levels. Saved on the main unit).

You can also play with a USB joystick. Plug directly into the Tab5's USB-A port (USB encoder for Akecom, Xbox 360 compatible pad, PS4 / PS5
pads, etc.). While connected, the pad on the screen will disappear. Button assignments can be changed on the ⚙ settings screen.

## operate

"Front" and "back" are based on the direction of the opponent (the character always faces the opponent).

| Input | Operation |
|---|---|
| Before / After | Walk. Dash before, before / after, after / back dash |
| Bottom | Crouch (does not hit the top row) |
| Top | Jump (short press for a small jump, long press for a large jump) |
| P/K in the air | Jump attack (techniques change while ascending and descending) |
| G | Standing guard (prevents upper and middle attacks) |
| Down + G | Crouching guard (prevents lower step) |
| P | Punch (upper row. 3 in a row with P, P, P) |
| Front + P | Elbow (midsection) |
| Down + P | Lower punch |
| K | High kick (upper stage) |
| Back + K | Middle kick |
| Down + K | Low kick (lower) |
| Front down + K | Knee (middle. If you hit it, the opponent will float) |
| Forward + K | Big kick (upper stage. Opponent will fall if hit) |
| P + G | Throw (at close range. Can also be used by opponents who are standing guard) |
| Down + P / Up + P | Stomp / Diving Elbow |
| While falling down, press G or up / behind / K | Get up on the spot / Roll backwards / Kick to get up |

- Crouch to dodge the upper stage. The middle stage cannot be blocked by crouching guard, and the bottom stage cannot be blocked by standing guard.
- Counter (1.5x damage) if you hit the opponent while they are using a technique.
- Special skill commands (→↘P, ↓→P, ←Charge→P, K+P+G, etc.) can be viewed along with the moves on the MOVE LIST of CHARACTER on the official website.

## What you need

- M5Stack Tab5
- (optional) USB joystick

name: Mandelbrot Explorer
description:
A pocket explorer of the Mandelbrot set for the M5StickS3. Tilt the stick to fly over the set, hold a key to dive in or pull back. The picture sharpens as soon as you stop, down to the finest filaments.

## Controls

Hold the stick in landscape: screen on the left, USB-C on the right.

- **Tilt**: the view rolls the way a marble would. Lower the right edge to move right, tip the top edge away to move up. The steeper the tilt, the faster.
- **Hold KEY1** (the blue key next to the screen): zoom in, 2x per second.
- **Hold KEY2** (the key on the top edge): zoom out.
- Releasing a zoom key makes the pose you hold the stick in level. Within 8 degrees of level nothing moves.
- An animated intro explains the controls at power-on; any key skips it.

## Features

- Smooth coloring with the classic blue, white and orange palette; the edges of the set are smoothed with four samples per pixel.
- Progressive rendering on both ESP32-S3 cores: a quick preview while the view moves, full resolution as soon as it stops.
- Zoom down to 16384x.
- The display turns off after 3 minutes without activity; any key wakes it.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/mbogatyr/M5Fractal

name: Manual Flash Calculator - ATOMS3
description:
v1.0.0:

If you use manual flash in your camera, this will calculate the settings to get the right exposure.

Inputs:

- Tilt left and right: Change the distance from the flash to the subject. Aperture is calculated based on GN, ISO, flash power and distance.
- Double click: Cycles through parameters for editing (GN, ISO, flash power and LCD brightness).
- Single click: Cycles through available values for the parameter that it's currently set for editing. GN from 1 to 64, ISO from 50 to 6400, flash power from 1/128 to full power, and 4 levels of brightness.
- Long click: Locks distance wheel, so you can adjust other settings and see the lens aperture value recalculated.

To save your current GN, ISO, flash power and brightness settings on the non-volatile memory, set the editing box on the brightness indicator and do a long click. This will save your config and reset the device.

v1.1.0:

- Added snap to distance wheel. Click when no other setting is selected and it will cycle through "no snap", 0.25m, 0.5m and 1m snap.

「红药丸还是蓝药丸？」

绿色代码雨从屏幕顶端落下，秒数在跳动 —— 不是手调的静态时间，是联网自动对时的真时间。每次开机都是一场小仪式：连上网络、和授时服务器握手、确认此刻是真实的，然后雨才开始下。

"Red pill or blue pill?"

Green code rain falls down the screen while the seconds tick — real network time, not something you set by hand. Every boot is a small ceremony: join the network, shake hands with the time server, confirm the moment is true, and then let the rain begin.

name: MeshWatch
description:
```
MeshWatch turns an M5Stack StickS3 into a passive counter-surveillance scanner
and an off-grid MeshCore messenger — no phone required.

It listens on WiFi and BLE (it never transmits at the devices it detects) and
flags, with a confidence score, sound and an on-screen banner:

• Flock Safety ALPR cameras, Penguin battery packs and Raven gunshot sensors
• Axon body cameras / Tasers and other law-enforcement gear
• Item trackers — AirTag / Find My, Tile, Samsung SmartTag, Chipolo, Google FMD
  (warns when one has been following you)
• Consumer & CCTV WiFi cameras — Ring, Wyze, Reolink, Hikvision, Dahua, Arlo…
• Drones broadcasting Remote ID (WiFi and BLE)
• Rogue access points (karma / Pineapple-style SSID floods)
• Attack tools — Flipper Zero (incl. BadKB), BLE advertisement spam, Pwnagotchi
• Card-skimmer Bluetooth modules, WiFi deauth floods, iBeacon / Eddystone
• MeshCore and Meshtastic radios

Messaging & field tools
• Pair a MeshCore companion radio over Bluetooth and read/send mesh messages
  right from the stick — channels and contacts, with preset quick-replies.
• Signal finder with a CLOSER/FARTHER direction cue to walk a device down.
• Baseline watch: learn a safe area, then alert on anything new.
• Evidence log saved to flash (survives reboot), optionally geotagged.
• Stealth mode, auto-report to the mesh, team alerts, and a device lock with a
  duress wipe code.

Controls: two buttons. A = select, B = next, hold B = next screen / back.

Detection is for passive, defensive use only. An empty screen is not proof that
an area is free of surveillance. Signatures adapted from the flock-you and
nyanBOX projects; camera OUIs from the public IEEE registry.

Source & docs: https://github.com/Korrie71/meshwatch
```
