name: Picoware
description:
Open-source custom firmware for PicoCalc, Cardputer ADV, Video Game Module, and other ESP32/Raspberry Pi Pico devices

If installation fails do this instead:
1. Type in `M5Launcher` in the search bar above, then click `Download` next to the M5Launcher firmware.
2. Turn off your Cardputer, then hold the `Go` button on your Cardputer while connecting it to your computer using a USB-C cable until your computer recognizes a new storage device.
3. In M5Burner, click `Burn`, then `Continue`, then change the `COM Port` to the one that corresponds to your Cardputer, and click `Start`.
4. Wait until the flashing process is complete, then disconnect your Cardputer from your computer and turn it on. M5Launcher should now be installed and ready to use!
5. Download the `Picoware-Cardputer.bin` file from the `builds/MicroPython` directory of this repository and copy it to the root of your SD card.
6. With your Cardputer off, insert the SD card into your Cardputer, then turn on your device.
7. Once the app is open, click `SD` then scroll down and select the `Picoware-Cardputer.bin` file, then click `Install`. 
8. Wait until the installation process is complete and your Cardputer will reboot into Picoware!

name: Pitaox PaperMono Mesh
description: # Pitaox PaperMono Mesh - [English](#english) - [中文](#中文) --- ## English ### 1. Before you begin Pitaox PaperMono Mesh is designed for the full PaperMono model with LoRa hardware. Charge the device, insert a microSD/TF card if you plan to read books, then power it on. The e-paper panel is intentionally different from a phone display. A brief flash or a slightly slower update can be normal, especially after several rapid UI changes. ### 2. Home screen and navigation The Launcher is the home screen. Its bottom navigation bar provides four main destinations: | Label | Function | | --- | --- | | `READ` | Open the current book in the Reader. | | `LIB` | Browse books and folders on the TF card. | | `MESH` | Open LoRa Mesh, messages, nodes, and radio settings. | | `SET` | Open device settings. | To return from Library, Reader, Settings, or Mesh, swipe upward from the bottom edge of the screen. This bottom-edge gesture is the normal Back action. ### 3. Reading books 1. Copy EPUB files to a FAT-compatible microSD/TF card. 2. Safely eject the card from the computer and insert it into PaperMono. 3. Tap `LIB` on the Launcher. 4. Tap a folder to enter it, or tap an EPUB file to open it. #### Reader gestures | Action | Result | | --- | --- | | Tap the left side of a page | Previous page. | | Tap the right side of a page | Next page. | | Tap the center | Open reading settings. | | Swipe downward from the top edge | Open the front-light panel. | | Tap the bookmark control | Add or remove a bookmark for the current page. | | Swipe upward from the bottom edge | Return to Library. | The reading settings panel provides text size, line spacing, chapters, and bookmarks. The first time a TF card is used, PaperMono may install its bundled Chinese fonts; leave the card inserted until startup finishes. ### 4. Device settings Open `SET` from the Launcher. #### Brightness Drag the brightness slider, or use `-` and `+` for 10% steps. The percentage shown on the right is the saved value. #### Sound Tap the `SOUND` row or its switch to turn the global sound preference on or off. This affects local audible notifications; Mesh notification behavior is separately selected in Mesh settings. #### Firmware version The `FIRMWARE` row shows the installed Build ID in `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` form. It is useful when reporting an issue or confirming that a newly built image was flashed. ### 5. Mesh basics Open `MESH` from the Launcher. The Mesh page has its own bottom navigation: | Label | Function | | --- | --- | | `OVR` | Overview of the local node, radio, and device statistics. | | `INBOX` | Conversation list and message composer. | | `NODES` | Known nodes and direct-message entry point. | | `SET` | Radio, alert, indicator, and stored-data settings. | #### Select a radio region Before using LoRa, open `OVR` and tap the status area to select the applicable regional configuration. Use only a radio region and transmit settings that are legal for your location. #### Connect the Meshtastic mobile app 1. Enable Bluetooth on the phone. 2. Open the Meshtastic app and select the PaperMono device. 3. Complete the pairing flow. If PaperMono shows a pairing code, enter or confirm that code in the app. 4. Keep the app open until the initial configuration and node data have synchronized. The device keeps the Mesh service active according to its Mesh background setting. Bluetooth, phone synchronization, and radio activity can take a moment after startup or reconnection. ### 6. Messages and conversations 1. Tap `INBOX`. 2. Tap a conversation to open it. 3. Tap `TAP TO WRITE A MESSAGE` to open the on-screen composer. 4. Enter text and send it. Use the `INBOX` button in the bottom Mesh navigation to return from an open conversation to the conversation list. An unread badge may appear below the `INBOX` label. Delivery state is shown for locally sent messages; `SENT` only means the local radio accepted the transmission, while delivery confirmation can later change the state to `DELIVERED` or `FAILED`. ### 7. Nodes and direct messages Tap `NODES` to view discovered nodes. The heading includes total, online, and offline counts. Tap a remote node row to open a direct-message composer for that node. Node discovery and message delivery depend on the radio region, modem preset, channel configuration, antenna, distance, and other Mesh nodes. A node listed on screen is not a guarantee of immediate end-to-end delivery. ### 8. Mesh settings Open `MESH` > `SET`. Tapping a row changes or opens its setting. | Setting | Use | | --- | --- | | `MESH BACKGROUND` | Keep Mesh runtime servicing while you use other PaperMono apps. | | `MODEM PRESET` | Cycle the LoRa modem preset. Use a preset compatible with the intended mesh. | | `HOP LIMIT` | Cycle the maximum routing hop limit. | | `TX POWER` | Cycle transmit-power settings. Follow local radio rules. | | `MESSAGE ALERTS` | Cycle message alerts through off, sound, light, and both. | | `LIGHT STYLE` | Choose the supported unread-message light reminder style. | | `DATA & HISTORY` | Review and clear stored messages and/or node cache. | `DATA & HISTORY` is destructive. Clearing the node cache also removes stored node names and direct-message public-key information, so direct-message key synchronization must happen again. ### 9. Power off Double-press the side power button to start the controlled shutdown sequence. Wait until the shutdown screen has completed before disconnecting power or storing the device. A short single press may only acknowledge through the power-management hardware and is not the normal software shutdown action. ### 10. E-paper care - Keep the panel away from direct sunlight, high temperatures, and strong UV. - Do not deliberately perform continuous rapid UI actions for long periods. - The firmware merges rapid updates in the same area and performs a cleanup refresh after a limited number of fast updates, but these are safeguards rather than a substitute for careful use. - If a persistent ghost image remains after normal use, allow the interface to perform its next full refresh; avoid repeatedly forcing rapid changes. ### 11. Troubleshooting | Symptom | What to try | | --- | --- | | A new book is not visible | Confirm the TF card is inserted, the file is EPUB, and reopen `LIB`. | | Mesh has no activity | Confirm the correct regional setting, matching channel/modem settings, antenna connection, and another reachable node. | | Phone does not connect | Toggle the phone's Bluetooth, reconnect from the Meshtastic app, and complete any displayed pairing-code flow. | | Direct messages fail after clearing data | Let node information synchronize again; node-cache clearing removes stored DM key material. | | Screen has visible ghosting | Stop rapid interaction and allow a full refresh; keep the panel away from heat and direct sun. | For a firmware issue report, include the Build ID from `SET` > `FIRMWARE`, the exact device model, and relevant serial logs. --- ## 中文 ### 1. 使用前准备 Pitaox PaperMono Mesh 面向带 LoRa 硬件的完整版 PaperMono。使用前请为设备充电；如需阅读书籍，请插入 microSD/TF 卡，然后开机。 墨水屏的工作方式与手机屏幕不同。短暂闪烁或在连续操作后更新稍慢属于正常现象。 ### 2. 主界面与导航 启动器（Launcher）是主界面，底部导航栏提供四个主要入口： | 标签 | 功能 | | --- | --- | | `READ` | 在阅读器中打开当前书籍。 | | `LIB` | 浏览 TF 卡上的书籍和文件夹。 | | `MESH` | 打开 LoRa Mesh、消息、节点和无线电设置。 | | `SET` | 打开设备设置。 | 在图书馆、阅读器、设置或 Mesh 页面中，如需返回，请从屏幕底部边缘向上滑动。这是标准的返回手势。 ### 3. 阅读书籍 1. 将 EPUB 文件复制到 FAT 兼容的 microSD/TF 卡中。 2. 在电脑上安全弹出 TF 卡，再将其插入 PaperMono。 3. 在启动器中点击 `LIB`。 4. 点击文件夹进入，或点击 EPUB 文件开始阅读。 #### 阅读器手势 | 操作 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | 点击页面左侧 | 上一页。 | | 点击页面右侧 | 下一页。 | | 点击页面中间 | 打开阅读设置。 | | 从屏幕顶部边缘向下滑动 | 打开前光面板。 | | 点击书签控件 | 添加或移除当前页书签。 | | 从屏幕底部边缘向上滑动 | 返回图书馆。 | 阅读设置面板可调整字号、行距，并打开目录和书签列表。首次使用 TF 卡时，PaperMono 可能会安装内置中文字体；请在启动完成前保持 TF 卡插入。 ### 4. 设备设置 在启动器中点击 `SET`。 #### 亮度 拖动亮度滑块，或点击 `-`、`+` 按钮以 10% 为单位调整。右侧显示的百分比为已保存的亮度值。 #### 声音 点击 `SOUND` 行或右侧开关，即可开启或关闭全局声音偏好。它影响本机的声音提醒；Mesh 消息提醒方式需在 Mesh 设置中单独选择。 #### 固件版本 `FIRMWARE` 行显示当前安装固件的 `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` Build ID。反馈问题或确认新固件是否已烧录时，请提供这一编号。 ### 5. Mesh 基本使用 在启动器中点击 `MESH`。Mesh 页面拥有独立的底部导航： | 标签 | 功能 | | --- | --- | | `OVR` | 本机节点、无线电和设备指标概览。 | | `INBOX` | 会话列表和消息编辑器。 | | `NODES` | 已知节点及私信入口。 | | `SET` | 无线电、提醒、指示灯和本地数据设置。 | #### 选择无线电区域 使用 LoRa 前，请进入 `OVR` 并点击状态区域，选择适用的区域配置。只能使用所在地允许的无线电区域和发射参数。 #### 连接 Meshtastic 手机 App 1. 打开手机蓝牙。 2. 在 Meshtastic App 中选择 PaperMono 设备。 3. 按 App 的步骤完成配对。如 PaperMono 显示配对码，请在 App 中输入或确认该代码。 4. 保持 App 打开，直到首次配置和节点数据同步完成。 设备会依据 Mesh 后台运行设置持续服务 Mesh。开机或重连后，蓝牙、手机同步和无线电活动可能需要短暂时间恢复。 ### 6. 消息与会话 1. 点击 `INBOX`。 2. 点击一个会话进入对话页。 3. 点击 `TAP TO WRITE A MESSAGE` 打开屏幕键盘。 4. 输入文本后发送。 在会话页面中，点击底部 Mesh 导航中的 `INBOX` 即可返回会话列表。`INBOX` 标签下方可能显示未读徽标。本机发送消息会显示投递状态：`SENT` 仅代表本机无线电已接受发送；后续确认可能将状态更新为 `DELIVERED` 或 `FAILED`。 ### 7. 节点与私信 点击 `NODES` 查看已发现节点。标题区域会显示总数、在线和离线统计。点击远程节点行可打开该节点的私信编辑器。 节点发现和消息投递取决于区域设置、调制解调器预设、信道配置、天线、距离及中间 Mesh 节点。屏幕上已显示某节点，并不代表一定可以立即完成端到端投递。 ### 8. Mesh 设置 进入 `MESH` > `SET`。点击对应项目可切换或打开设置。 | 设置 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `MESH BACKGROUND` | 使用其他 PaperMono 应用时，是否继续服务 Mesh 运行时。 | | `MODEM PRESET` | 切换 LoRa 调制解调器预设；需与目标 Mesh 兼容。 | | `HOP LIMIT` | 切换最大路由跳数。 | | `TX POWER` | 切换发射功率设置；请遵守当地无线电规定。 | | `MESSAGE ALERTS` | 在关闭、声音、灯光、声音+灯光之间切换消息提醒。 | | `LIGHT STYLE` | 选择设备支持的未读消息灯光提醒样式。 | | `DATA & HISTORY` | 查看并清理保存的消息和/或节点缓存。 | `DATA & HISTORY` 中的清理操作不可撤销。清除节点缓存会同时移除保存的节点名称和私信公钥信息，之后需要重新同步私信密钥。 ### 9. 关机 双击侧边电源键会启动受控关机流程。请等待关机画面完成后，再断开电源或收纳设备。短按一次可能只会被电源管理硬件响应，并不是正常的软件关机操作。 ### 10. 墨水屏使用注意事项 - 避免阳光直射、高温和强紫外线。 - 不要长时间持续进行高频界面操作。 - 固件会合并同一区域的快速刷新，并在达到一定次数后执行清理刷新；这些是保护措施，不能替代谨慎使用。 - 正常使用后若出现持续残影，请等待界面进行下一次全屏刷新；避免反复强制快速变化。 ### 11. 常见问题 | 现象 | 可尝试的处理方式 | | --- | --- | | 新书未显示 | 确认 TF 卡已插入、文件为 EPUB，然后重新打开 `LIB`。 | | Mesh 没有活动 | 确认区域设置正确、信道/调制设置匹配、天线连接正常，并且附近有可达节点。 | | 手机无法连接 | 关闭再打开手机蓝牙，在 Meshtastic App 中重新连接，并完成设备显示的配对码流程。 | | 清理数据后私信失败 | 等待节点信息重新同步；清理节点缓存会移除已保存的私信密钥材料。 | | 屏幕有明显残影 | 停止快速操作并等待全屏刷新，同时避免高温和阳光直射。 | 如需反馈固件问题，请提供 `SET` > `FIRMWARE` 中的 Build ID、具体设备型号以及相关串口日志。

description_en: # Pitaox PaperMono Mesh - [English](#english) - [中文](#中文) --- ## English ### 1. Before you begin Pitaox PaperMono Mesh is designed for the full PaperMono model with LoRa hardware. Charge the device, insert a microSD/TF card if you plan to read books, then power it on. The e-paper panel is intentionally different from a phone display. A brief flash or a slightly slower update can be normal, especially after several rapid UI changes. ### 2. Home screen and navigation The Launcher is the home screen. Its bottom navigation bar provides four main destinations: | Label | Function | | --- | --- | | `READ` | Open the current book in the Reader. | | `LIB` | Browse books and folders on the TF card. | | `MESH` | Open LoRa Mesh, messages, nodes, and radio settings. | | `SET` | Open device settings. | To return from Library, Reader, Settings, or Mesh, swipe upward from the bottom edge of the screen. This bottom-edge gesture is the normal Back action. ### 3. Reading books 1. Copy EPUB files to a FAT-compatible microSD/TF card. 2. Safely eject the card from the computer and insert it into PaperMono. 3. Tap `LIB` on the Launcher. 4. Tap a folder to enter it, or tap an EPUB file to open it. #### Reader gestures | Action | Result | | --- | --- | | Tap the left side of a page | Previous page. | | Tap the right side of a page | Next page. | | Tap the center | Open reading settings. | | Swipe downward from the top edge | Open the front-light panel. | | Tap the bookmark control | Add or remove a bookmark for the current page. | | Swipe upward from the bottom edge | Return to Library. | The reading settings panel provides text size, line spacing, chapters, and bookmarks. The first time a TF card is used, PaperMono may install its bundled Chinese fonts; leave the card inserted until startup finishes. ### 4. Device settings Open `SET` from the Launcher. #### Brightness Drag the brightness slider, or use `-` and `+` for 10% steps. The percentage shown on the right is the saved value. #### Sound Tap the `SOUND` row or its switch to turn the global sound preference on or off. This affects local audible notifications; Mesh notification behavior is separately selected in Mesh settings. #### Firmware version The `FIRMWARE` row shows the installed Build ID in `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` form. It is useful when reporting an issue or confirming that a newly built image was flashed. ### 5. Mesh basics Open `MESH` from the Launcher. The Mesh page has its own bottom navigation: | Label | Function | | --- | --- | | `OVR` | Overview of the local node, radio, and device statistics. | | `INBOX` | Conversation list and message composer. | | `NODES` | Known nodes and direct-message entry point. | | `SET` | Radio, alert, indicator, and stored-data settings. | #### Select a radio region Before using LoRa, open `OVR` and tap the status area to select the applicable regional configuration. Use only a radio region and transmit settings that are legal for your location. #### Connect the Meshtastic mobile app 1. Enable Bluetooth on the phone. 2. Open the Meshtastic app and select the PaperMono device. 3. Complete the pairing flow. If PaperMono shows a pairing code, enter or confirm that code in the app. 4. Keep the app open until the initial configuration and node data have synchronized. The device keeps the Mesh service active according to its Mesh background setting. Bluetooth, phone synchronization, and radio activity can take a moment after startup or reconnection. ### 6. Messages and conversations 1. Tap `INBOX`. 2. Tap a conversation to open it. 3. Tap `TAP TO WRITE A MESSAGE` to open the on-screen composer. 4. Enter text and send it. Use the `INBOX` button in the bottom Mesh navigation to return from an open conversation to the conversation list. An unread badge may appear below the `INBOX` label. Delivery state is shown for locally sent messages; `SENT` only means the local radio accepted the transmission, while delivery confirmation can later change the state to `DELIVERED` or `FAILED`. ### 7. Nodes and direct messages Tap `NODES` to view discovered nodes. The heading includes total, online, and offline counts. Tap a remote node row to open a direct-message composer for that node. Node discovery and message delivery depend on the radio region, modem preset, channel configuration, antenna, distance, and other Mesh nodes. A node listed on screen is not a guarantee of immediate end-to-end delivery. ### 8. Mesh settings Open `MESH` > `SET`. Tapping a row changes or opens its setting. | Setting | Use | | --- | --- | | `MESH BACKGROUND` | Keep Mesh runtime servicing while you use other PaperMono apps. | | `MODEM PRESET` | Cycle the LoRa modem preset. Use a preset compatible with the intended mesh. | | `HOP LIMIT` | Cycle the maximum routing hop limit. | | `TX POWER` | Cycle transmit-power settings. Follow local radio rules. | | `MESSAGE ALERTS` | Cycle message alerts through off, sound, light, and both. | | `LIGHT STYLE` | Choose the supported unread-message light reminder style. | | `DATA & HISTORY` | Review and clear stored messages and/or node cache. | `DATA & HISTORY` is destructive. Clearing the node cache also removes stored node names and direct-message public-key information, so direct-message key synchronization must happen again. ### 9. Power off Double-press the side power button to start the controlled shutdown sequence. Wait until the shutdown screen has completed before disconnecting power or storing the device. A short single press may only acknowledge through the power-management hardware and is not the normal software shutdown action. ### 10. E-paper care - Keep the panel away from direct sunlight, high temperatures, and strong UV. - Do not deliberately perform continuous rapid UI actions for long periods. - The firmware merges rapid updates in the same area and performs a cleanup refresh after a limited number of fast updates, but these are safeguards rather than a substitute for careful use. - If a persistent ghost image remains after normal use, allow the interface to perform its next full refresh; avoid repeatedly forcing rapid changes. ### 11. Troubleshooting | Symptom | What to try | | --- | --- | | A new book is not visible | Confirm the TF card is inserted, the file is EPUB, and reopen `LIB`. | | Mesh has no activity | Confirm the correct regional setting, matching channel/modem settings, antenna connection, and another reachable node. | | Phone does not connect | Toggle the phone's Bluetooth, reconnect from the Meshtastic app, and complete any displayed pairing-code flow. | | Direct messages fail after clearing data | Let node information synchronize again; node-cache clearing removes stored DM key material. | | Screen has visible ghosting | Stop rapid interaction and allow a full refresh; keep the panel away from heat and direct sun. | For a firmware issue report, include the Build ID from `SET` > `FIRMWARE`, the exact device model, and relevant serial logs. --- ## Chinese ### 1. Preparation before use Pitaox PaperMono Mesh targets the full version of PaperMono with LoRa hardware. Please charge the device before use; if you need to read books, please insert a microSD/TF card and turn it on. Ink screens work differently than phone screens. Brief flashing or slightly slower updates after continuous operation are normal. ### 2. Main interface and navigation The Launcher is the main interface, and the bottom navigation bar provides four main entrances: | Tags | Features | | --- | --- | | `READ` | Open the current book in the reader. | | `LIB` | Browse books and folders on TF card. | | `MESH` | Opens LoRa Mesh, messages, node and radio settings. | | `SET` | Open device settings. | To go back in the Library, Reader, Settings, or Mesh page, swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen. This is the standard return gesture. ### 3. Read books 1. Copy the EPUB file to a FAT compatible microSD/TF card. 2. Safely eject the TF card on the computer and insert it into PaperMono. 3. Click `LIB` in the launcher. 4. Click the folder to enter, or click the EPUB file to start reading. #### Reader Gestures | Operation | Result | | --- | --- | | Click on the left side of the page | Previous page. | | Click on the right side of the page | Next Page. | | Click in the middle of the page | to open reading settings. | | Swipe down from the top edge of the screen | Open the front light panel. | | Click the bookmark control | to add or remove bookmarks for the current page. | | Swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen | Return to the library. | The reading settings panel allows you to adjust font size, line spacing, and open the table of contents and bookmark list. When using the TF card for the first time, PaperMono may install built-in Chinese fonts; please keep the TF card inserted until the startup is completed. ### 4. Device settings Click `SET` in the launcher. #### Brightness Drag the brightness slider, or click the `-`, `+` buttons to adjust in 10% increments. The percentage shown on the right is the saved brightness value. #### sound Click the `SOUND` row or the switch on the right to turn global sound preferences on or off. It affects the local sound reminder; the Mesh message reminder method needs to be selected separately in the Mesh settings. #### Firmware version The `FIRMWARE` line displays the `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` Build ID of the currently installed firmware. Please provide this number when reporting a problem or confirming whether the new firmware has been burned. ### 5. Basic use of Mesh Click `MESH` in the launcher. Mesh pages have independent bottom navigation: | Tags | Features | | --- | --- | | `OVR` | Overview of native node, radio and device metrics. | | `INBOX` | Conversation list and message editor. | | `NODES` | Known nodes and private message entry. | | `SET` | Radio, alerts, lights and local data settings. | #### Select radio area Before using LoRa, please enter `OVR` and click on the status area to select the applicable area configuration. Only use radio zones and emission parameters that are permitted for your location. #### Connect to Meshtastic Mobile App 1. Turn on your phone’s Bluetooth. 2. Select the PaperMono device in the Meshtastic App. 3. Follow the steps in the App to complete pairing. If PaperMono displays a pairing code, please enter or confirm the code in the app. 4. Keep the app open until the first configuration and node data synchronization are completed. The device will continue to serve Mesh based on the Mesh background running settings. Bluetooth, phone sync, and radio activity may take a short time to resume after powering on or reconnecting. ### 6. Messages and Conversations 1. Click on `INBOX`. 2. Click a conversation to enter the conversation page. 3. Click `TAP TO WRITE A MESSAGE` to open the on-screen keyboard. 4. Enter the text and send. On the session page, click `INBOX` in the Mesh navigation at the bottom to return to the session list. An unread logo may appear below the `INBOX` label. A message sent by this machine will display the delivery status: `SENT` only means that the local radio has accepted the delivery; subsequent confirmation may update the status to `DELIVERED` or `FAILED`. ### 7. Nodes and private messages Click `NODES` to view discovered nodes. The title area displays total, online and offline statistics. Clicking on a remote node row opens the private message editor for that node. Node discovery and message delivery depend on locale, modem preset, channel configuration, antenna, distance, and intermediate mesh nodes. Just because a node is displayed on the screen does not mean that end-to-end delivery can be completed immediately. ### 8. Mesh settings Go to `MESH` > `SET`. Click the corresponding item to switch or open the settings. | Settings | Usage | | --- | --- | | `MESH BACKGROUND` | Whether to continue serving the Mesh runtime when using other PaperMono applications. | | `MODEM PRESET` | Switch LoRa modem preset; needs to be compatible with the target Mesh. | | `HOP LIMIT` | Switch the maximum number of routing hops. | | `TX POWER` | Toggle transmit power setting; please comply with local radio regulations. | | `MESSAGE ALERTS` | Switch message reminders between off, sound, light, sound + light. | | `LIGHT STYLE` | Select the unread message light reminder style supported by the device. | | `DATA & HISTORY` | View and clear saved messages and/or node caches. | Cleanup operations in `DATA & HISTORY` are irreversible. Clearing the node cache will also remove the saved node name and private message public key information, and you will need to resynchronize the private message key afterwards. ### 9. Shut down Double-clicking the side power button will initiate a controlled shutdown process. Please wait until the shutdown screen is completed before disconnecting the power or storing the device. A short press may only be responded to by the power management hardware and is not a normal software shutdown operation. ### 10. Precautions when using the ink screen -Avoid direct sunlight, high temperatures and strong UV rays. - Do not continue to perform high-frequency interface operations for a long time. - The firmware will merge rapid refreshes of the same area and perform clean refreshes after a certain number of times; these are protective measures and are not a substitute for careful use. - If persistent image persistence occurs after normal use, please wait for the next full-screen refresh of the interface; avoid repeated forced rapid changes. ### 11. FAQ | Phenomenon | Possible solutions | | --- | --- | | New books are not displayed | Confirm that the TF card is inserted and the file is EPUB, then reopen `LIB`. | | Mesh No Activity | Verify that the zone settings are correct, the channel/modulation settings match, the antenna connections are working, and there are reachable nodes nearby. | | The phone cannot connect | Turn off and on the phone's Bluetooth, reconnect in the Meshtastic App, and complete the pairing code process displayed on the device. | | Private message failed after clearing data | Waiting for node information to be resynchronized; clearing the node cache will remove the saved private message key material. | | There is an obvious afterimage on the screen | Stop quick operations and wait for full-screen refresh, and avoid high temperature and direct sunlight. | If you need to report firmware issues, please provide the Build ID, specific device model and related serial port logs in `SET` > `FIRMWARE`.

Troubleshooting | Symptom | What to try | | --- | --- | | A new book is not visible | Confirm the TF card is inserted, the file is EPUB, and reopen `LIB`. | | Mesh has no activity | Confirm the correct regional setting, matching channel/modem settings, antenna connection, and another reachable node. | | Phone does not connect | Toggle the phone's Bluetooth, reconnect from the Meshtastic app, and complete any displayed pairing-code flow. | | Direct messages fail after clearing data | Let node information synchronize again; node-cache clearing removes stored DM key material. | | Screen has visible ghosting | Stop rapid interaction and allow a full refresh; keep the panel away from heat and direct sun. | For a firmware issue report, include the Build ID from `SET` > `FIRMWARE`, the exact device model, and relevant serial logs. --- ## 中文 ### 1. 使用前准备 Pitaox PaperMono Mesh 面向带 LoRa 硬件的完整版 PaperMono。使用前请为设备充电；如需阅读书籍，请插入 microSD/TF 卡，然后开机。 墨水屏的工作方式与手机屏幕不同。短暂闪烁或在连续操作后更新稍慢属于正常现象。 ### 2. 主界面与导航 启动器（Launcher）是主界面，底部导航栏提供四个主要入口： | 标签 | 功能 | | --- | --- | | `READ` | 在阅读器中打开当前书籍。 | | `LIB` | 浏览 TF 卡上的书籍和文件夹。 | | `MESH` | 打开 LoRa Mesh、消息、节点和无线电设置。 | | `SET` | 打开设备设置。 | 在图书馆、阅读器、设置或 Mesh 页面中，如需返回，请从屏幕底部边缘向上滑动。这是标准的返回手势。 ### 3. 阅读书籍 1. 将 EPUB 文件复制到 FAT 兼容的 microSD/TF 卡中。 2. 在电脑上安全弹出 TF 卡，再将其插入 PaperMono。 3. 在启动器中点击 `LIB`。 4. 点击文件夹进入，或点击 EPUB 文件开始阅读。 #### 阅读器手势 | 操作 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | 点击页面左侧 | 上一页。 | | 点击页面右侧 | 下一页。 | | 点击页面中间 | 打开阅读设置。 | | 从屏幕顶部边缘向下滑动 | 打开前光面板。 | | 点击书签控件 | 添加或移除当前页书签。 | | 从屏幕底部边缘向上滑动 | 返回图书馆。 | 阅读设置面板可调整字号、行距，并打开目录和书签列表。首次使用 TF 卡时，PaperMono 可能会安装内置中文字体；请在启动完成前保持 TF 卡插入。 ### 4. 设备设置 在启动器中点击 `SET`。 #### 亮度 拖动亮度滑块，或点击 `-`、`+` 按钮以 10% 为单位调整。右侧显示的百分比为已保存的亮度值。 #### 声音 点击 `SOUND` 行或右侧开关，即可开启或关闭全局声音偏好。它影响本机的声音提醒；Mesh 消息提醒方式需在 Mesh 设置中单独选择。 #### 固件版本 `FIRMWARE` 行显示当前安装固件的 `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` Build ID。反馈问题或确认新固件是否已烧录时，请提供这一编号。 ### 5. Mesh 基本使用 在启动器中点击 `MESH`。Mesh 页面拥有独立的底部导航： | 标签 | 功能 | | --- | --- | | `OVR` | 本机节点、无线电和设备指标概览。 | | `INBOX` | 会话列表和消息编辑器。 | | `NODES` | 已知节点及私信入口。 | | `SET` | 无线电、提醒、指示灯和本地数据设置。 | #### 选择无线电区域 使用 LoRa 前，请进入 `OVR` 并点击状态区域，选择适用的区域配置。只能使用所在地允许的无线电区域和发射参数。 #### 连接 Meshtastic 手机 App 1. 打开手机蓝牙。 2. 在 Meshtastic App 中选择 PaperMono 设备。 3. 按 App 的步骤完成配对。如 PaperMono 显示配对码，请在 App 中输入或确认该代码。 4. 保持 App 打开，直到首次配置和节点数据同步完成。 设备会依据 Mesh 后台运行设置持续服务 Mesh。开机或重连后，蓝牙、手机同步和无线电活动可能需要短暂时间恢复。 ### 6. 消息与会话 1. 点击 `INBOX`。 2. 点击一个会话进入对话页。 3. 点击 `TAP TO WRITE A MESSAGE` 打开屏幕键盘。 4. 输入文本后发送。 在会话页面中，点击底部 Mesh 导航中的 `INBOX` 即可返回会话列表。`INBOX` 标签下方可能显示未读徽标。本机发送消息会显示投递状态：`SENT` 仅代表本机无线电已接受发送；后续确认可能将状态更新为 `DELIVERED` 或 `FAILED`。 ### 7. 节点与私信 点击 `NODES` 查看已发现节点。标题区域会显示总数、在线和离线统计。点击远程节点行可打开该节点的私信编辑器。 节点发现和消息投递取决于区域设置、调制解调器预设、信道配置、天线、距离及中间 Mesh 节点。屏幕上已显示某节点，并不代表一定可以立即完成端到端投递。 ### 8. Mesh 设置 进入 `MESH` > `SET`。点击对应项目可切换或打开设置。 | 设置 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `MESH BACKGROUND` | 使用其他 PaperMono 应用时，是否继续服务 Mesh 运行时。 | | `MODEM PRESET` | 切换 LoRa 调制解调器预设；需与目标 Mesh 兼容。 | | `HOP LIMIT` | 切换最大路由跳数。 | | `TX POWER` | 切换发射功率设置；请遵守当地无线电规定。 | | `MESSAGE ALERTS` | 在关闭、声音、灯光、声音+灯光之间切换消息提醒。 | | `LIGHT STYLE` | 选择设备支持的未读消息灯光提醒样式。 | | `DATA & HISTORY` | 查看并清理保存的消息和/或节点缓存。 | `DATA & HISTORY` 中的清理操作不可撤销。清除节点缓存会同时移除保存的节点名称和私信公钥信息，之后需要重新同步私信密钥。 ### 9. 关机 双击侧边电源键会启动受控关机流程。请等待关机画面完成后，再断开电源或收纳设备。短按一次可能只会被电源管理硬件响应，并不是正常的软件关机操作。 ### 10. 墨水屏使用注意事项 - 避免阳光直射、高温和强紫外线。 - 不要长时间持续进行高频界面操作。 - 固件会合并同一区域的快速刷新，并在达到一定次数后执行清理刷新；这些是保护措施，不能替代谨慎使用。 - 正常使用后若出现持续残影，请等待界面进行下一次全屏刷新；避免反复强制快速变化。 ### 11. 常见问题 | 现象 | 可尝试的处理方式 | | --- | --- | | 新书未显示 | 确认 TF 卡已插入、文件为 EPUB，然后重新打开 `LIB`。 | | Mesh 没有活动 | 确认区域设置正确、信道/调制设置匹配、天线连接正常，并且附近有可达节点。 | | 手机无法连接 | 关闭再打开手机蓝牙，在 Meshtastic App 中重新连接，并完成设备显示的配对码流程。 | | 清理数据后私信失败 | 等待节点信息重新同步；清理节点缓存会移除已保存的私信密钥材料。 | | 屏幕有明显残影 | 停止快速操作并等待全屏刷新，同时避免高温和阳光直射。 | 如需反馈固件问题，请提供 `SET` > `FIRMWARE` 中的 Build ID、具体设备型号以及相关串口日志。

name: Pocket Gambler
description:
🚀 Pocket Gambler OS – v1.0.0 (The Final Release)
We made it to 1.0! What started as a simple collection of minigames has evolved into a complete, standalone, handheld operating system for the M5Cardputer. Version 1.0.0 represents the ultimate, stable, and feature-complete vision of the Pocket Gambler OS.

It is a living, breathing digital underworld in your pocket—featuring real-time Wi-Fi crypto trading, RPG progression, dynamic random events, and bulletproof hardware optimization.

🔥 The Complete Feature Set
Live Crypto Terminal: Connect to local Wi-Fi and pull live Bitcoin market data directly from the Binance API. Speculate, buy, sell, and track your P/L (Profit/Loss) in real-time.

The Living OS (Dynamic Events): The system never sleeps. An active background timer generates random events while you navigate the OS. You might get mugged, face a police raid, find a wallet, or suffer a crypto market crash.

The Black Market: An exclusive underground shop (accessible only with $15,000+). Buy permanent perks like VIP Cards (XP multipliers), Bribe Cops, or Tax Evaders to bend the rules of the OS in your favor.

Hardcore Vault Heist: Take out a loan at the Mafia Bank, or risk it all by hacking their vault. Decipher a 6-letter Fallout-style terminal password in just 3 attempts. Win big, or lose half your net worth.

Classic Casino & Slots: Spin the brand-new 3-reel visual Slot Machine, or test your luck in the core games that started it all.

RPG Progression & Analytics: Every dollar won or lost generates XP. Level up your Player Card and watch your wealth grow (or crash) on a dynamic, real-time 50-point vector line graph.

Dynamic Visual Themes: Press t in your Player Card to seamlessly switch the entire OS aesthetic between Neon Cyberpunk, Matrix Hacker, and Blood Casino.

🛡️ v1.0.0 Ultimate Stability & Polish
Bulletproof Hardware Controls: Completely rewrote the input matrix. The OS now reads direct hardware states, mapping standard navigation to the Cardputer's D-pad (. and ;).

The G0 Override: To combat hardware quirks with the Enter key, the silver G0 button (BtnA) on the side of the Cardputer has been hardcoded as a universal, fail-safe ENTER key across the entire OS.

Real-Time OS Kernel: Shifted all internal game loops and random event triggers from frame-based counters to true hardware millis() timers. This completely eliminates UI freezes and soft-locks.

Zero-Crash Architecture: All applications have been packaged into a monolithic, header-only structure, completely bypassing PlatformIO linker errors (vtable crashes) and ensuring flawless compilation.

Atomic Memory Protection: The SD card save.txt structure now safely handles 15 Black Market perks, 50 history nodes, and debt structures, saving atomically after every single transaction to prevent data corruption.

💖 Thank You
Thank you to everyone who followed the development of this project. Grab your M5Cardputer, flash the firmware, and try not to go bankrupt!

⚠️ LEGAL DISCLAIMER
This software is entirely a fictional, educational game simulation. The "Crypto Terminal", "Black Market", and all betting modules connect to public APIs purely for entertainment and simulation purposes. No real money, real cryptocurrency, or real financial transactions are executed, stored, or processed by this software. The developer assumes zero responsibility or liability for any financial losses, hardware damage, network security issues, connectivity failures, or data corruption that may occur while using this software. Use at your own risk.

name: Pocket Market · ADV 股票看板
description:
让 Cardputer ADV 变成你的口袋股票看板。直接连接 Wi-Fi，独立查看美股、港股和沪深股票。
主要功能：

  • 自选列表：中文股票名、三位小数报价、红涨绿跌。
  • 体感卡牌：左右倾斜切换股票，左右键微调，长按快速滑动。
  • 多周期图表：5 日、日 K、周 K、月 K、年 K，支持线图切换和缩放。
  • 美股盘前：同时展示常规收盘价与盘前报价；盘中展示常规报价。
  • 股票搜索：支持代码、名称及常用股票拼音、首字母。
  • 手机管理：扫码打开同一 Wi-Fi 下的网页，批量添加、拖动排序并保存自选。
  • 后台预加载、手动刷新、本地时间、Wi-Fi 状态与电量显示。

快捷键

日常看盘

  • G：普通列表 / 体感卡牌切换。
  • U：刷新当前报价；详情页同时重试图表。首页 / 详情也可按侧键刷新。
  • F：搜索股票，支持代码、名称及常用股票拼音 / 首字母。
  • W：显示二维码，手机在同一 Wi-Fi 下扫码管理自选、拖动排序并保存。
  • B：关屏 / 亮屏；关屏后设备仍工作联网。
  • ESC：返回上一层；卡牌返回普通列表，删除确认页取消删除。

普通列表

  • 上 / 下：切换股票，长按加速；首尾循环并提示边界。
  • 1 / 2 / 3：打开当前屏对应股票详情。
  • Enter：手工编辑自选代码列表。
  • TAB：打开设置，可调整 Wi-Fi、刷新间隔、亮度、时区和体感开关。

体感卡牌

  • 左右倾斜设备：滑动选卡，中央卡牌放大。
  • 左 / 右：微调选卡，长按连续滑动并加速。
  • Enter：查看当前卡牌详情；卡牌不使用 1 / 2 / 3。
  • ESC：退出卡牌，返回普通列表。

股票详情

  • TAB：切换 5 日、日 K、周 K、月 K、年 K。
  • 空格：切换 K 线 / 收盘价折线；5 日保持线图。
  • Z / X：放大 / 缩小图表。
  • ; 或 , / . 或 /：上一只 / 下一只股票。
  • D：申请删除当前股票；再按 Enter 确认，ESC 取消。

搜索、输入与联网

  • TAB（搜索中）：切换 CN 拼音 / EN 英文模式。
  • 1 / 2 / 3（有拼音组合时）：选对应候选；空格选首个候选。
  • Enter（搜索中）：提交候选 / 查询 / 添加选中结果，按当前步骤执行。
  • DEL：删除输入字符，无需 Fn。
  • R（Wi-Fi 扫描页）：重新扫描；断网也能使用。
  • Enter（设置 / Wi-Fi）：选择项目、输入密码或保存连接。

字符方向键、候选翻页、完整输入规则与返回层级见 完整按键表。输入页面里的 B / F / G / U / W 是输入字符，不触发功能。

仅适用于 Cardputer ADV。本包为完整安装包，首次安装写入地址为 0x0，会覆盖原配置。保留配置升级请使用 GitHub 中的应用升级包。

报价依赖第三方数据，可能延迟或中断；不提供夜盘、盘后报价及下单功能。完整说明与全部按键见项目主页。

基于 ansonlianson/cardputer-adv-stock-monitor 开发，采用 MIT 许可。

name_src: Pocket Market · ADV 股票看板
description_en:
Let Cardputer ADV become your pocket stock board. Connect directly to Wi-Fi and view US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, and Shanghai and Shenzhen stocks independently.
Main functions:

  • Optional list: Chinese stock names, quotations to three decimal places, red rising and green falling.
  • Somatosensory Cards: Tilt left and right to switch stocks, use left and right keys to fine-tune, long press to slide quickly.
  • Multi-period chart: 5-day, daily K, weekly K, monthly K, year K, supports line chart switching and zooming.
  • U.S. stock pre-market: Displays regular closing prices and pre-market quotes at the same time; displays regular quotes during the session.
  • Stock search: supports code, name, pinyin and initials of commonly used stocks.
  • Mobile phone management: Scan the QR code to open web pages under the same Wi-Fi, add them in batches, drag and sort, and save your selections.
  • Background preloading, manual refresh, local time, Wi-Fi status and power display.

Shortcut keys

Daily viewing

  • G: Normal list / somatosensory card switching.
  • U: Refresh the current quotation; the details page will also refresh the chart. The homepage/details can also be refreshed by pressing the side button.
  • F: Search for stocks, supporting code, name and common stock pinyin/initial letters.
  • W: Display the QR code. Use your mobile phone to scan the code under the same Wi-Fi to manage your selections, drag to sort and save.
  • B: Turn off/on the screen; the device will still work and connect to the Internet after turning off the screen.
  • ESC: Return to the previous level; the card returns to the normal list, and the deletion confirmation page cancels the deletion.

Normal list

  • Up / Down: switch stocks, long press to accelerate; cycle from beginning to end and prompt boundary.
  • 1 / 2 / 3: Open the stock details corresponding to the current screen.
  • Enter: Manually edit the self-selected code list.
  • TAB: Open settings to adjust Wi-Fi, refresh interval, brightness, time zone and motion sensing switch.

Somatosensory Cards

  • Tilt the device left and right: Slide to select cards, and the central card will zoom in.
  • Left / Right: Fine-tune card selection, long press to continuously slide and accelerate.
  • Enter: View current card details; cards do not use 1 / 2 / 3.
  • ESC: Exit the card and return to the normal list.

Stock details

  • TAB: Switch 5 days, daily K, weekly K, monthly K, year K.
  • Space: Switch K line/closing price line; 5-day holding line chart.
  • Z / X: Zoom in/out the chart.
  • ; or , / . or /: previous / next Only stocks.
  • D: Apply to delete the current stock; press Enter again to confirm, ESC to cancel.

Search, input and networking

  • TAB (Searching): Switch CN Pinyin / EN English mode.
  • 1 / 2 / 3 (when there is a pinyin combination): Select the corresponding candidate; space select the first candidate.
  • Enter (Searching): Submit candidate/query/add selected results and execute according to the current step.
  • DEL: Delete input characters, no Fn required.
  • R (Wi-Fi scanning page): Rescan; can be used even when the network is disconnected.
  • Enter (Settings / Wi-Fi): Select an item, enter a password, or save the connection.

See Full key table for character direction keys, candidate page turning, complete input rules and return levels. B / F / G / U / W in the input page are input characters and do not trigger functions.

Available only with Cardputer ADV. This package is a complete installation package. The write address for the first installation is 0x0, which will overwrite the original configuration. To upgrade configuration-preserving configuration, please use the application upgrade package in GitHub.

Quotations rely on third-party data and may be delayed or interrupted; night trading, after-hours quotation and order functions are not provided. Full instructions and all keys can be found on the project homepage.

Based on ansonlianson/cardputer-adv-stock-monitor, licensed under MIT license.

  • ESC：退出卡牌，返回普通列表。

股票详情

  • TAB：切换 5 日、日 K、周 K、月 K、年 K。
  • 空格：切换 K 线 / 收盘价折线；5 日保持线图。
  • Z / X：放大 / 缩小图表。
  • ; 或 , / . 或 /：上一只 / 下一只股票。
  • D：申请删除当前股票；再按 Enter 确认，ESC 取消。

搜索、输入与联网

  • TAB（搜索中）：切换 CN 拼音 / EN 英文模式。
  • 1 / 2 / 3（有拼音组合时）：选对应候选；空格选首个候选。
  • Enter（搜索中）：提交候选 / 查询 / 添加选中结果，按当前步骤执行。
  • DEL：删除输入字符，无需 Fn。
  • R（Wi-Fi 扫描页）：重新扫描；断网也能使用。
  • Enter（设置 / Wi-Fi）：选择项目、输入密码或保存连接。

字符方向键、候选翻页、完整输入规则与返回层级见 完整按键表。输入页面里的 B / F / G / U / W 是输入字符，不触发功能。

仅适用于 Cardputer ADV。本包为完整安装包，首次安装写入地址为 0x0，会覆盖原配置。保留配置升级请使用 GitHub 中的应用升级包。

报价依赖第三方数据，可能延迟或中断；不提供夜盘、盘后报价及下单功能。完整说明与全部按键见项目主页。

基于 ansonlianson/cardputer-adv-stock-monitor 开发，采用 MIT 许可。

description:
# PocketPal S3
Your tiny offline companion for the M5Stack StickS3.

Meet Pip, a little chibi dragon you can feed, play with, clean, tuck into bed, and gently pet.

## Features
- Animated dragon with sound and motion reactions.
- Five care stats: fullness, happiness, energy, cleanliness, and health.
- Floating care items, including a soccer ball, strawberries, bubbles, and three gentle pats.
- Forest-themed mobile WebUI with six color themes.
- Saved pet name, age, care stats, and sleep state.
- Nova-and-Pip startup splash.

## Getting started
Follow the StickS3's Wi-Fi connection instructions, then open http://pocketpal in your browser.

Use the M5 button to select an action and the blue Face button to perform it. Double-press Face to go back.

## Private and offline
No cloud account or internet connection required. Sound reactions process loudness locally; no audio is recorded or transmitted.

Early-development release for StickS3 only.

name: Pocket Radio
description:
A little internet radio for your M5Stack StickS3. Tune into live stations, choose your favorites from ten curated options, and shake the radio to change its monochrome color.

Six stations are selected to start: Tiki Time, Illinois Street Lounge, KEXP, NTS 1, KCRW Eclectic 24 and Radio Paradise. Add Bossa Beyond, Secret Agent, Suburbs of Goa or Heavyweight Reggae from the setup page.

## First-time setup
1. Join the PocketRadio Wi-Fi network shown on the radio using its displayed password.
2. Open http://192.168.4.1/ on your phone if the setup page does not appear automatically.
3. Choose your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, enter its password, and tap Connect & play.

The radio remembers your network. No phone app, account or code editing is required.

## Controls
- A tap: next station. A hold: stop/resume.
- B tap: volume up. B hold: volume down.
- Shake: change color.
- Hold A+B for 1.5 seconds: Wi-Fi and station setup.
- Double-click the separate side power/reset button: power off. Single-click: power on/reset. Long press: upload mode.

To change your dial, select stations and tap Save stations, then Return to radio. Keep at least one selected.

## Notes
StickS3 only. Built-in speaker; Bluetooth speaker audio is not supported. Requires ordinary 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with internet access. Hotel sign-in pages and enterprise Wi-Fi are unsupported. Battery percentage is approximate; volume is limited for battery stability. Station availability depends on broadcasters. Network stalls can briefly delay controls. Custom stream URLs and track titles are not supported.

The audio adapter is based on M5Stack's web-radio example. Streams connect directly to broadcasters; support the stations you enjoy.

name: PocketBoy S3
description:
PocketBoy S3 turns the M5Stack StickS3 into a private, offline GB/GBC homebrew gaming system.

The StickS3 creates its own Wi-Fi network and hosts the complete WebUI, game library, and save backup. Games run locally in Google Chrome on a connected phone or tablet—no native app, internet connection, cloud account, or telemetry required.

### Features

- Plays legally obtained homebrew `.gb` and `.gbc` games
- On-device game library with 2 MiB of dedicated storage
- DualSense, Xbox One, and touchscreen controls
- Controller-only landscape fullscreen with L2 toggle
- Browser audio with volume and mute controls
- Save states and battery-backed game saves
- Dedicated 1 MiB save-backup partition
- Save synchronization between Chrome and the StickS3
- Portable save export/import for moving between devices
- Battery level, charging status, Wi-Fi credentials, and join QR display
- Offline and private operation

PocketBoy S3 uses the open-source binjgb WebAssembly emulator. No commercial ROMs, copyrighted game data, or console firmware are included. Please use only games you created or have permission to use.

name: PocketQuest Mini S3
description:
# PocketQuestMini — A little world. A big quest.

A cozy fantasy adventure for the M5Stack StickS3, designed for short sessions you can put down anytime.

## Two ways to play

- **On the StickS3:** Battle Slimes, Wolves and Goblins using the Face button or gentle motion controls. Earn XP, level up and save your progress.
- **In your browser:** Explore an illustrated woodland road, fight turn-based battles, discover loot chests, challenge bosses and return to Oakwood for a peaceful rest.

## Browser features

- Female and male Nova appearances.
- Touch, keyboard and compatible PS5 controller support.
- Increasing road difficulty and randomized encounters.
- Animated Oakwood resting scene.

## Getting started

Join the device-specific Wi-Fi shown on the StickS3, then open:

http://PocketQuest

Browser controller, fullscreen and audio support vary by device. Touch controls remain available.

name: PocketStudio
description:
# Pocket Studio

为 **M5Stack Cardputer ADV** 开发的口袋音乐工作站，集实时演奏、多轨编曲、采样与音色制作、音乐播放于一体。

## 多轨编曲

- 三条旋律轨，每轨支持四复音，可手动演奏七和弦。
- 独立鼓组轨，提供八种鼓声。
- 支持实时演奏、循环录音和 STEP 步进输入。
- 支持 1、2、4 小节循环，以及全局 BPM、总音量和轨道静音。

## 和弦与琶音

- 支持项目移调及大调、自然小调。
- 自动调内三和弦：按一个根音即可生成对应和弦。
- 琶音器支持上行、下行和往返模式。
- 可调整速度、发声比例、八度范围，并用 HOLD 保持演奏。

## 鼓机

- 八种鼓声：底鼓、军鼓、拍手、闭镲、开镲、低音通鼓、高音通鼓和打击音。
- 支持鼓垫实时演奏及分行步进编辑。
- 可调整单鼓音量、音高、静音、独奏和 Swing。

## 采样与音色制作

- 支持麦克风录音、录音倒计时和 WAV 导入。
- 提供波形显示、选区试听、精细裁剪和裁剪保存。
- 支持单次播放、按键门控及持续循环。
- 可设置独立循环区和接缝交叉淡化。
- 音色保存到 SD 卡后，可交给旋律轨演奏。

## 声音设计

- 提供正弦波、三角波、方波、锯齿波和白噪声。
- 双振荡器支持波形混合与音程调整。
- ADSR 音量包络、音高包络和滤波包络。
- LFO 可调制音高、滤波截止频率或音量。
- 提供低通滤波、共振、软失真和位深降质。

## 音乐播放器

- 支持浏览 SD 卡目录。
- 支持 16bit PCM WAV 和常见 MP3 文件。
- 提供播放、暂停、换曲、进度跳转和独立音量调节。

## 存储与使用条件

- 编曲项目可保存到内部存储或 SD 卡。
- 采样素材、音色设置和录音保存在 SD 卡。
- 基础编曲可不插 SD 卡使用；采样器、采样音色和播放器需要 SD 卡。
- 适配 **Cardputer ADV**。
author: drw41823
description_en:
# Pocket Studio

A pocket music workstation developed for **M5Stack Cardputer ADV**, integrating real-time performance, multi-track arrangement, sampling and tone production, and music playback.

## Multi-track arrangement

- Three melody tracks, each track supports four-note polyphony, and seventh chords can be played manually.
- Independent drum track providing eight drum sounds.
- Supports real-time performance, loop recording and STEP step input.
- Supports 1, 2, and 4-bar loops, as well as global BPM, master volume, and track mute.

## Chords and Arpeggios

- Supports project transposition and major and natural minor keys.
- Automatically tune internal triads: Press a root note to generate the corresponding chord.
- Arpeggiator supports uplink, downlink and round trip modes.
- Adjust tempo, voicing ratio, octave range and keep playing with HOLD.

## Drum Machine

- Eight drum sounds: kick, snare, clap, closed hi-hat, open hi-hat, bass tom, treble tom and percussion.
- Supports real-time performance of drum pads and line-by-line step editing.
- Adjustable drum volume, pitch, mute, solo and swing.

## Sampling and sound production

- Supports microphone recording, recording countdown and WAV import.
- Provides waveform display, selection audition, fine cropping and cropping saving.
-Supports single playback, key gate control and continuous looping.
- Independent loop areas and seam crossfade can be set.
- After the sound is saved to the SD card, it can be played on the melody track.

## Sound Design

- Provides sine wave, triangle wave, square wave, sawtooth wave and white noise.
- Dual oscillators support waveform mixing and pitch adjustment.
- ADSR volume envelope, pitch envelope and filter envelope.
- LFO can modulate pitch, filter cutoff frequency or volume.
- Provides low-pass filtering, resonance, soft distortion and bit depth degradation.

## Music player

- Support browsing SD card directory.
- Supports 16bit PCM WAV and common MP3 files.
- Provides play, pause, song change, progress jump and independent volume adjustment.

## Storage and usage conditions

- Arrangement projects can be saved to internal storage or SD card.
- Sample material, sound settings and recordings are saved on the SD card.
- The basic arrangement can be used without an SD card; the sampler, sampled sounds and player require an SD card.
- Adapted to **Cardputer ADV**.

name: Punch Drunk
description:
Punch Drunk

Telemetry 9 — PUNCH LABS #001

Punch Drunk turns the M5StickS3 into a two-part motion arcade game.

Round 1 — Punch

Hold Punch securely in your palm and punch into open air after the countdown.
The game reads the onboard IMU and reports:

  • Estimated punch speed
  • Peak G
  • Punch power
  • Drunk level

The punch detector ignores weak setup motion and rejects attempts that are too weak or unclear instead of reporting a fake 0 MPH result.

Round 2 — Stay Up

The harder the valid punch, the more difficult the balance round becomes. Tilt the StickS3 left and right to keep the Punch Drunk mascot on his feet.

Drunk levels: SOBER → TIPSY → BUZZED → DRUNK → WASTED → BLACKOUT

BLACKOUT requires both a high estimated punch speed and high Peak G.

Features

  • Built for M5StickS3
  • Portrait arcade UI
  • IMU punch detection
  • Tilt balance gameplay
  • One-time How To Play tutorial
  • Persistent stats
  • Adjustable master volume
  • Real battery monitoring and low-power protection
  • Check-safe screen layout to reduce clipped/off-screen UI
  • No extra hardware required

Controls

  • A: play / confirm / retry
  • B: menu / back
  • Tilt left/right: balance during Round 2

Safety

Hold the StickS3 securely in your palm and punch into open air only.
Do not strike people, animals, objects, walls, bags, pads, or other surfaces while holding the device.

Measurement note

EST. MPH is an IMU-derived gameplay estimate, not a radar-gun or laboratory measurement. Peak G is derived from the onboard motion sensor.

Telemetry 9 — Still Transmitting.

Read R2-D2’s response (scroll with Fn+; / Fn+. if long).
Ask follow-up questions — it remembers the whole conversation!

name: RC Throw Meter
description:
RC airplane control-surface deflection measurement tool

 Splash screen: app title + "by Planet-Soaring.com" for 5 seconds.

 Orientation page (shown after the splash, before the setup page):
   VERTICAL   -> pitch: elevation of the long axis X (toward the USB end)
   HORIZONTAL -> roll : elevation of the short axis Y
   B: toggle selection, A: confirm and continue to the setup page

 Boot setup screen:
   MODE  angle / chord (mm)
   CHORD 20..999 mm, 1 mm steps (chord mode only)
   B (side): change mode / chord (tap = +1, hold = continuous)
   A (front): next / start; hold A: back to MODE

 Measurement screen (always relative to a captured zero, no absolute mode):
   angle mode: live angle in degrees, with MAX/MIN peaks
   chord mode: live deflection in mm = chord * sin(angle), same MAX/MIN
   on entry the zero is captured automatically from a full 1 s window
   BtnA: re-zero here and reset peaks
   BtnB: back to the mode selection page

 The measured axis follows the orientation page:
   VERTICAL   (pitch): elevation of X, the long axis, positive when the                        USB end is raised.
   HORIZONTAL (roll) : elevation of Y, the short axis. Held in landscape the
                       long axis X lies across the screen, so tipping the
                       display rotates around it and the short axis is the
                       one that swings.

The angle is computed from a 1-second moving average of the
acceleration vector, which removes most hand shake and sensor noise.

Official StickS3 IMU axes: +X toward the USB-C end, +Y toward the
viewer's left when the USB end is up and the screen faces the viewer,
 +Z out of the screen.

name: RHesus RAdio  (webradio)
description:
Streams ICEcast MP3 and AAC internet radio over Wi-Fi with real-time audio visualizations.  
Stations load from a `station_list.txt` file on the SD card, with built-in defaults if none is found.

---

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `BTN A` × 1 | Next station |
| `BTN A` × 2 | Previous station |
| `BTN A` hold | Volume up |
| `/` | Next station |
| `,` | Previous station |
| `;` | Volume up |
| `.` | Volume down |
| `M` | Mute / unmute |
| `S` | Screen on / off (press to sleep, any key to wake) |
| `F` | Fullscreen toggle (hides header) |
| `V` | Cycle visual modes |
| `0–9` | Jump directly to stations 1–10 |

---

## Visual Modes

Cycle through with `V`:

- **Bars** — FFT frequency bars with peak hold
- **Spectrum** — scrolling waveform
- **Both** — bars + waveform combined
- **Liss-Trail** — Lissajous with phosphor trail fade
- **Liss-Line** — Lissajous continuous line
- **Liss-3D** — rotating 3D Lissajous with depth shading
- **VectorScope** — M/S stereo vector scope with phosphor persistence

All modes include a stereo VU meter and volume bar in the header.

---

## Station List

Create a plain text file at the **root of your SD card** named `station_list.txt`.  
One station per line, format: `Name, URL`  
Lines starting with `#` are treated as comments and ignored.

```
# My stations
Radio Tango, http://ais-edge148-pit01.cdnstream.com/2202_128.mp3
Radio Soyuz, http://65.109.84.248:8100/soyuzfm-192.mp3
My AAC Station, http://example.com/stream.aacp
```

- Supports up to **100 stations**
- MP3 and AAC / AAC+ streams supported
- If no SD card or file is found, 4 built-in default stations are used
- Last played station and volume are saved and restored on boot

---

## Notes

- Streams over HTTP only (HTTPS is not supported by the ICY stream library)
- 1 MB stream buffer (~40 s at 192 kbps) for smooth playback
- Audio decode task runs on PRO_CPU at priority 2 for stable performance
- Wi-Fi credentials configured via `CardWifiSetup`

name: Rain Chamber
description:
掌上的一方雨景：两千滴雨，在你手边下着。

举起来，雨幕跟着手腕转——倾斜就是视角，不用按键。风一吹雨就斜着落，落地那一下在屏幕上溅开；远处天光一闪，几秒之后才是雷声滚过来。

最好的部分是声音。雨声和雷声不是录音，是设备现场算出来的：雨下大时声音跟着变亮、变密，雨小了只剩一层细细的沙沙——就像窗外真的在下。

· 两千滴雨的 3D 环绕雨场，倾斜机身自由看
· 雨声与雷声全程现场合成，不占一点存储
· 闪电之后 0.15~0.45 秒雷才炸响，远处的闷雷要等 1.5~3 秒——延迟就是距离
· 雨势、风、闪电每次开机都是新的一段，阵雨说来就来
· B 键双击静音；也可以就让它这么下着，当白噪音

M5Cardputer ADV · 240×135

---

Hold a rainstorm in your hand — two thousand raindrops falling in 3D.

Tilt it and the rain follows your wrist: no buttons for looking around. Wind slants the drops, each one splashes where it lands, and a far-off flash lights the sky seconds before the thunder arrives.

The best part is the sound. The rain and the thunder are synthesized live on the device — nothing is recorded. When the rain comes down harder the hiss brightens and the drops thicken; when it eases off, only a fine patter is left. It sounds like weather outside your window.

· A 3D volume of 2,000 raindrops, steered by tilting the device
· Rain and thunder synthesized live — no audio files at all
· Thunder lands 0.15–0.45 s after a nearby flash, or 1.5–3 s later when it is far away (that delay is the distance)
· Rain intensity, wind and lightning run a different sequence every boot; squalls arrive out of nowhere
· Double-press B to mute — or just leave it raining as white noise

M5Cardputer ADV · 240×135

name: Raspyjack (v1/v1.1/ADV)
description:
Turn your Cardputer into a remote companion for RaspyJack running on a Raspberry Pi.
This is not RaspyJack itself, it connects to your existing RaspyJack setup and lets you control it using the Cardputer screen and keyboard.

Setup & General Controls
-Press any key during boot to open Settings or hold BtnA on top right to get back to settings
-Configure Wi-Fi first, then add your RaspyJack host
-Hold BtnA during a session to return to Settings
-Press BtnA in menus to go back
-Press D to edit Wi-Fi or host profiles
-Press DEL to delete a saved Wi-Fi or host
-Use Factory Reset to erase all saved data

Streaming Controls (RaspyJack)
1 = Key 1
2 = Key 2
3 = Key 3
Arrow keys = Navigate menus
W / A / S / D = Alternative navigation (same as arrows)
Enter = Open menus or launch a payload

Important Note
-Some Wi-Fi payloads may interrupt the stream
-After exiting such payloads, press the reset button on the Cardputer to restart the session
-Not all payloads fully support keyboard input yet
-A dedicated keyboard helper is required and is not yet implemented in all payloads (In Process)
-However, all payloads can still be navigated and controlled using the available controls

Make sure you flash your rpi with the latet Raspyjack version
Raspyjack main project by 7h30th3r0n3:
https://github.com/7h30th3r0n3/Raspyjack

- **双语支持**：启动时按 `1` 选中文 / `2` 选英文
- **动态引导**：切换场景后自动显示概念解说（7 秒淡出）

- **3D 视角**：IMU 倾斜控制 + WASD 键盘控制（`I` 切换）

| 按键 | 功能 |
|------|------|
| Enter / Space | 切换场景 |
| 1-5 | 直接跳转场景 |
| +/- | 调节参数 |
| W/A/S/D | 视角控制（键盘模式） |
| I | 切换 IMU / 键盘视角 |
| C | 开关对比模式（场景2） |
| E | 切换模式（场景4/5） |
| R | 重置视角 |
| H | 开关 HUD |
| ? | 帮助面板 |

name: S1-ADV - AI Companion for Cardputer ADV
description:
# S1-ADV: AI companion for M5Stack Cardputer ADV

Turn your Cardputer ADV into a keyboard and voice interface for your own OpenClaw AI agent, with local tools and optional reviewed firmware updates over Wi-Fi.

## Features

- Text chat and push-to-talk voice with a separately configured host-side AI agent.
- Clock, focus timer, notes, calculator, games and Internet Radio.
- Animated companion eyes and configurable Realtime voice with a compatible speech provider.
- Optional firmware development workflow: request a feature, build on your host, review the result, offer an OTA update, then install it on the device.

## Hardware and setup

For M5Stack Cardputer ADV only: ESP32-S3, 8 MB flash. Original Cardputer compatibility is not claimed.

This is development preview 0.2.201-dev. Fresh-device installation of this public image has not yet been independently hardware-validated. Existing project footage is not acceptance of this exact generic image.

This full image starts at flash address 0x0 and includes its bootloader and partition table. Installing it can replace existing settings. It contains no preconfigured Wi-Fi password, private bridge address or device token. Configure your own Wi-Fi and, for AI functions, your own HTTPS bridge address and device token.

The AI model runs on a separately configured host, not on the ESP32. AI chat needs a running OpenClaw bridge and a configured model provider. Ordinary voice also needs STT/TTS; Realtime voice requires separate compatible provider setup. No hosted AI service, subscription or provider credit is included. A microSD card is used by features that store audio or files.

Start here: https://github.com/s1z0v/s1-adv/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md
Flashing: https://github.com/s1z0v/s1-adv/blob/main/docs/FLASHING.md
OpenClaw setup: https://github.com/s1z0v/s1-adv/blob/main/docs/OPENCLAW.md
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_0f9UTwefmo
Source and issues: https://github.com/s1z0v/s1-adv

## Source, license and credits

Firmware source for this exact binary: https://github.com/s1z0v/s1-adv/tree/89f07e45ab8cb6d51379afe43dc4b4513703a15a

Combined Mesh-enabled firmware: GPL-3.0-only. Bridge/plugin: MIT. Source archives, build inputs and dependency notices are available with the matching GitHub release: https://github.com/s1z0v/s1-adv/releases/tag/v0.2.201-dev

name: SH. speedometer stick-c plus 2
description:
speedometer for a bicycle, motorcycle, etc. based on a Hall sensor

1. Required components:
M5StickC Plus 2: The device itself.
Hall sensor: For example, KY-024 (linear) or KY-003 (digital). For a speedometer, a digital sensor is better, which produces a clear HIGH/LOW signal when a magnet is detected.
Magnet: A neodymium magnet that will be attached to the wheel.
Connecting wires.
Grove cable (optional): If you are using the Grove port of the M5StickC Plus 2.
2. Connecting the Hall sensor:
The M5StickC Plus 2 has several available GPIO. We will use one of them.

VCC (power) of the Hall sensor -> 5V or 3.3V on the M5StickC Plus 2 (check the specification of your sensor).
GND (ground) of the Hall sensor -> GND on the M5StickC Plus 2.
OUT (signal pin) of the Hall sensor -> GPIO 32 on the M5StickC Plus 2. (GPIO 32 is available on the Grove port as SDA, but it can be used as a regular GPIO).

**Important:** Make sure that your Hall sensor produces a signal level compatible with the 3.3V logic of the ESP32. Most digital Hall sensors have a built-in comparator and work with 3.3V. If you have a 5V sensor, you may need a voltage divider on the signal line, but this is usually not necessary as the ESP32 is tolerant of 5V inputs up to a certain threshold.

description:
# SP2ALERT for M5StopWatch

POTA / SOTA スポット通知ファームウェア(M5Stack「M5StopWatch」向け)。
`SP2ALERT_Android_1.3` の機能を、ESP32-S3ベースの円形AMOLEDウェアラブル
「M5StopWatch」(1.75インチ 466x466 タッチ, ボタン2+電源ボタン, WiFi)に
移植したものです。

起動フロー: スプラッシュ → Wi-Fi接続画面 → スポット監視(カード表示)。
Wi-Fi接続画面は `M5CoreHamCAT_ForCore3SE_2.33` の実装パターンを移植しています。

## ビルド・書き込み

```bash
# ビルド
pio run

# ファームウェア書き込み(実機をUSB接続した状態で)
pio run -t upload

# 音声クリップ(data/voice/*.pcm)をLittleFSへ書き込み(初回・クリップ変更時に実行)
pio run -t uploadfs

# シリアルモニタ
pio device monitor
```

初回ビルド時に `M5.getBoard()` がシリアルログで `board_M5StopWatch` を
返すことを確認してください(異なる場合はPSRAM未検出などのハード起因の
可能性があります)。

## 音声読み上げクリップについて

`data/voice/*.pcm` は16bit / 16kHz / モノラルの録音済み音声クリップで、
`alert_engine.cpp` がコールサイン等をアルファベット/数字ごとに1クリップずつ
連結再生する方式です(自由文の公園名・山名は読み上げ対象外)。

現在同梱しているクリップは、macOS標準の `say` コマンド(英語音声

description_en:
# SP2ALERT for M5StopWatch

POTA / SOTA spot notification firmware (for M5Stack "M5StopWatch").
The functionality of `SP2ALERT_Android_1.3` has been added to a circular AMOLED wearable based on ESP32-S3.
"M5StopWatch" (1.75 inch 466x466 touch, button 2 + power button, WiFi)
It's a transplant.

Startup flow: Splash → Wi-Fi connection screen → Spot monitoring (card display).
The Wi-Fi connection screen is ported from the implementation pattern of `M5CoreHamCAT_ForCore3SE_2.33`.

## Build/Write

```bash
# build
pio run

# Write firmware (with the actual device connected via USB)
pio run -t upload

# Write the audio clip (data/voice/*.pcm) to LittleFS (execute for the first time/when changing the clip)
pio run -t uploadfs

# serial monitor
pio device monitor
```

During the first build, `M5.getBoard()` reports `board_M5StopWatch` in the serial log.
Please make sure to return it (if it is different, it may be due to hardware such as PSRAM not detected).
possible).

## About audio reading clips

`data/voice/*.pcm` is a 16bit / 16kHz / monaural pre-recorded audio clip,
`alert_engine.cpp` displays call signs, etc., one clip per alphabet/number
This is a connected playback method (free text park names and mountain names are not read out).

The clips currently included are the macOS standard `say` command (English audio).
Samantha). The quality is not a problem in practical use, but it is more natural.
If you want to make audio, use the same file name (26 types of NATO phonetics + numbers 0-9 +
pota/sota/qrt) and replace it with 16bit/16kHz/monaural PCM (no header) audio.
Please rerun `pio run -t uploadfs`.

## Current scope (initial release)
- Alert: CW tone / voice reading (recorded clip). CW vibe (vibration) is not supported.
- Filter only has a single global setting (multiple named presets on Android version are not supported).
There is no list editing UI for bands/modes etc. on the main body, but ON/OFF and numerical parameters.
You can adjust the settings on the main unit settings screen.
- Exclusion by Hunted/Chased (CSV import) is not supported.
- Notified/acknowledged state is RAM-retained only and is lost on reboot
(Immediately after restarting, the alert may sound again for the currently matched spot).
- Bluetooth related functions are not supported (the main unit is WiFi only).

- WiFi manager — scan, connect, save credentials; auto-connect on boot

description:
Scorched Earth M5 - Artillery Game
A turn-based artillery game for the M5StickC Plus2, featuring destructible terrain and tetrimino-styled graphics.

Overview
ScorchedM5 is a Scorched Earth-style artillery game where you face off against an AI opponent. Both players control upside-down T-shaped tetrimino tanks positioned on randomly generated destructible terrain. Take turns adjusting your angle and power to fire projectiles across the map and destroy your opponent.

Features
Destructible Terrain: Randomly generated landscapes with smooth terrain profiles
Turn-based Combat: Adjust angle and power, then fire at your opponent
Physics-based Projectiles: Realistic arc trajectory with gravity
AI Opponent: Computer-controlled enemy with randomized but strategic firing
Animated Sky: Scrolling clouds and tetrimino birds add atmosphere
Win/Loss Tracking: Keep track of your victories and defeats
Tetris-themed Graphics
Controls
M5StickC Plus2 Buttons:
Left Button (PWR): Decrease angle (move aim left)
Right Button (BtnB): Increase angle (move aim right)
M5 (BtnA): Cycle power (1-100%, hold to reverse direction)
Right Button: Fire projectile

Gameplay:
IN THIS ORDER!
1.Adjust your firing angle using Left/Right buttons (in 2.5% increments)
2.Set your power level using M5 button (in 2.5% increments) 
Hold M5 to go in lower increments, press M5 to raise it. 
3.Then press Right button to fire

Watch the projectile arc across the screen
AI takes its turn automatically
First to destroy opponent's tank wins!

Game Mechanics
Terrain Generation
Randomly generated smooth terrain using sine wave patterns
Different heights and profiles each game
Fully destructible - blocks removed by explosions
Tank Placement
Tanks spawn on opposite sides of the terrain
Always on solid ground
Random horizontal positions each game
Projectile Physics
Gravity affects trajectory
Angle range: adjustable via buttons
Power range: 1-100%
Explosion radius removes terrain blocks
AI Behavior
Calculates approximate trajectory to player
Adds randomization to power and angle
Becomes more accurate as game progresses
Avoids shooting directly off-screen
Win Conditions
Destroy opponent's tank with direct hit
Track wins and losses across multiple rounds
Terrain collapses are visual only (tanks don't fall)
Credits

Part of the Tetrimino game series for M5StickC Plus2:

Tetriminos - Space Invaders variant
TetriSnake - Snake with tetrimino obstacles
ScorchedM5 - Artillery combat (this project)
TetroidsM5 - Asteroids meets Tetris

I remembered playing this as a kid. Could not remember the name so it was built from memory. But there are a lot of similar ones like Scorched Earth. 

Colors are MUCH better than my gif here.

description:
# 识字 · 拼音 — M5Paper 儿童墨水屏学习卡

> **Made by Tim** · v0.1.5
> 电子墨水屏护眼学习伴侣：无背光、深睡省电、进度记忆

![cover](screenshots/cover.png)

## 功能

| 模块 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **识字** | 一年级上册 **100 汉字**（部编版写字表全册）· 认 → 写 → 用 认知闭环 |
| | 认：完整字 + 拼音 + 组词（2 二字词 + 1 四字词）+ 造句（目标字反白） |
| | 写：**米字格逐笔演示**（当前笔实心 / 已写衬灰 / 未写轮廓）+ 笔画名 + 笔顺序列 |
| **拼音** | **63 项**：声母 23 · 韵母 24 · 整体认读 16 |
| | 四线三格（字母基线锚定）· 发音口诀 · 例字 · 韵母/整体认读**四声逐调演示** |
| **首页** | 大时钟 + 日期 + 双入口卡片 |
| **对时** | 轻点时钟区 → Wi-Fi 连接 + SNTP 网络对时（未配置时直达配网） |
| **设置** | 右上角齿轮 → Wi-Fi 扫描配网（触摸密码键盘）/ 立即对时 / 关于 |
| **省电** | 空闲 5 分钟自动深睡（墨水屏保画，侧键唤醒续学） |

![home](screenshots/home.png)
![cards](screenshots/card_hanzi.png)
![pinyin](screenshots/card_pinyin.png)

## 安装

### 方式一：M5Burner（推荐）

1. 打开 M5Burner → 设备选择 **M5Paper**
2. 进入用户固件 / Publish Firmware，指向本仓库（含 `m5burner.json`）
3. 一键烧录（含全部数据分区，约 11MB）

### 方式二：esptool 手动烧录

```bash
# 替换 PORT 为你的串口 (macOS: /dev/cu.usbserial-*, Windows: COMx)
PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-XXXXX
esptool.py --chip esp32 -p $PORT -b 460800 write_flash \
  0x1000    firmware/bootloader_0x1000.bin \
  0x8000    firmware/partitions_0x8000.bin \
  0x10000   firmware/shizi_card_0x10000.bin \
  0x310000  firmware/shizi_0x310000.bin \
  0xb80000  firmware/pinyin_0xb80000.bin
```

> 文件名即烧录地址（`名字_地址.bin`），五个文件缺一不可。

## 使用

| 操作 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| 首页轻点左卡 / 右卡 | 进入识字 / 拼音 |
| 首页轻点时钟区 | 网络对时 |
| 首页右上角齿轮 | 设置（配网 / 对时 / 关于） |
| 识字中轻点屏幕 | 逐笔演示（左 1/3 = 上一笔回看） |
| 左 / 右侧键短按 | 上一项 / 下一项 |
| 中键短按 | 重播 |
| 长按左键 1.5s | 转屏方向（记忆） |
| 长按中键 2s | 深睡 |
| 识字中长按右键 1.5s | 返回首页 |

## 硬件 / 技术

- **M5Paper**（ESP32-D0WD · 960×540 电子墨水屏 IT8951 · GT911 触摸 · 16MB Flash）
- ESP-IDF v5.5.1 + M5GFX
- 内容管线：makemeahanzi 笔画数据 + 规范笔顺表 + 楷体字形 → 全量预烘焙位图
- 首发认知设计：认字音形 → 写笔顺动觉 → 用组词造句

## 版本

| 版本 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 0.1.5 | 首个公开发布：识字 100 字 + 拼音 63 项 + Wi-Fi 对时 + 设置 |

| **Power Saving** | Automatically sleep deeply after 5 minutes of idle time (ink screen saver, side button to wake up to continue learning) |

![home](screenshots/home.png)
![cards](screenshots/card_hanzi.png)
![pinyin](screenshots/card_pinyin.png)

## Install

### Method 1: M5Burner (recommended)

1. Open M5Burner → Device selection **M5Paper**
2. Enter User Firmware/Publish Firmware and point to this warehouse (including `m5burner.json`)
3. One-click burning (including all data partitions, about 11MB)

### Method 2: Manual burning with esptool

```bash
# Replace PORT with your serial port (macOS: /dev/cu.usbserial-*, Windows: COMx)
PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-XXXXX
esptool.py --chip esp32 -p $PORT -b 460800 write_flash \
0x1000    firmware/bootloader_0x1000.bin \
  0x8000    firmware/partitions_0x8000.bin \
  0x10000   firmware/shizi_card_0x10000.bin \
  0x310000  firmware/shizi_0x310000.bin \
  0xb80000  firmware/pinyin_0xb80000.bin
```

> The file name is the burning address (`name_address.bin`), and all five files are indispensable.

## use

| Operation | Action |
|---|---|
| Tap the left card / right card on the homepage | Enter literacy / pinyin |
| Tap the clock area on the home page | Network time synchronization |
| Gear in the upper right corner of the homepage | Settings (Network Distribution/Time Synchronization/About) |
| Tap the screen during literacy | Step by step demonstration (left 1/3 = review of the previous stroke) |
| Short press of left/right key | Previous item/Next item |
| Short press of the middle button | Replay |
| Long press the left button for 1.5s | Screen rotation direction (memory) |
| Long press the middle button for 2s | Deep sleep |
| Press and hold the right button for 1.5s during literacy | Return to home page |

## Hardware/Technology

- **M5Paper** (ESP32-D0WD · 960×540 e-ink screen IT8951 · GT911 touch · 16MB Flash)
- ESP-IDF v5.5.1 + M5GFX
- Content pipeline: makemeahanzi stroke data + standardized stroke order table + italic font → full pre-baked bitmap
- The first cognitive design: recognize the sound and shape of characters → follow the kinesthetic sense of writing → use group words to make sentences

## Version

| Version | Description |
|---|---|
| 0.1.5 | First public release: Literacy 100 words + Pinyin 63 items + Wi-Fi time synchronization + settings |

name: Silicon Bubbles - iMessage Client (needs BlueBubbles server)
description:
## ⚠️ You need a Mac first

**This is a client, not a server.** It talks to
[BlueBubbles](https://bluebubbles.app/install/), the free open-source
iMessage bridge, which must be running on a **Mac (or Hackintosh / macOS
VM) signed into iMessage** and reachable from the Cardputer over LAN or
HTTPS.

No Mac, no messages — there is no way around Apple on this one. Setup
takes about ten minutes and their documentation is good. Validated
against **BlueBubbles server v1.9.9**.

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| **Conversations** | One entry per person, not per thread — duplicate SMS/iMessage threads are merged |
| **Bubbles** | Left/right alignment, tails, author grouping, time labels |
| **Emoji** | 42 hand-drawn 12×12 glyphs covering 68 codepoints — unknown ones get a clean placeholder, never tofu |
| **Tapbacks** | Reactions shown as a pill on the bubble corner |
| **Sending** | From the 56-key keyboard, with an honest *sent-but-unconfirmed* state |
| **Sounds** | Five synthesized struck-bar timbres, not beeps — each one switchable |
| **Bilingual** | English and French, switchable on the device or in the web portal |

Text only by design: attachments show as `[attachment]`. Polling only —
no Socket.IO, no webhooks.

## Setup, from your phone

First boot raises a WiFi access point and shows a **QR code**: scan it
with your phone camera, join, and the configuration portal opens by
itself. Afterwards the same portal lives at `http://cardputer.local`.

Everything is also editable **on the device**: WiFi network scan, server
address and password, language, sounds, refresh rate. Plus local contact
names (BlueBubbles does not expose the Mac's contacts), and
**backup/restore of all settings to microSD** — so the next firmware
flash doesn't cost you your configuration.

## Keys

| Key | List | Conversation | Compose | Settings |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `;` `.` | move | scroll, bubble by bubble | — | change field |
| `,` `/` | — | — | — | change value |
| `Enter` | open | write | send | open WiFi scan / server / QR / SD backup |
| `` ` `` | info | back | cancel | save and exit |
| `r` | resync | — | — | — |
| `n` | name the contact | — | — | — |
| `p` / `s` | *(info screen)* test server / settings | | | |

## Device support

Built and tested on the **Cardputer ADV** only — hence the `-ADV` suffix
in the version. The original Cardputer uses a different keyboard
controller and audio path; it may work, it is untested, and a report
either way would genuinely help.

## 🚧 Status: work in progress

This runs daily against exactly **one** setup: an ADV, a BlueBubbles
v1.9.9 server behind Cloudflare, French phone numbers. That is one data
point. If you try it on anything else — other country codes,
group-heavy accounts, self-signed TLS, ngrok — please open an issue and
say what worked and what didn't. Right now, reports from setups unlike
mine are worth more than any feature.

Source, documentation and error-code table (E11–E50) on GitHub, MIT:
<https://github.com/chatelp/silicon-bubbles-cardputeradv>

> **Flashing this erases existing device settings.** Silicon Bubbles can
> back its own settings up to microSD (Settings → Backup to SD) and offers
> to restore them on first boot.

name: Silicon Casino - Slots Blackjack Poker Roulette
description:
Slots, blackjack, video poker and roulette on a Cardputer. **Virtual
chips only** — no real money, no purchases, no account, no network of any
kind. You cannot be ruined: the house refills an empty balance. The
randomness is the ESP32 hardware TRNG.

### The five games

| Game | Rules | Return |
|---|---|---|
| Slots 3×1 | 8 symbols, one payline, pair-left pays ×2 | **95.24 %** |
| Video slot 5×3 | five paylines, its own reel strip | **94.95 %** per line |
| Blackjack | 3:2, dealer stands on all 17, double, no split | **95.81 %** |
| Video poker | Jacks or Better **9/6**, max-bet royal 800:1 | 9/6 full pay |
| Roulette | European, single zero, ten bet kinds | **97.3 %** on every bet |

The odds are computed, not tuned. Video poker is checked against all
**2,598,960** possible five-card hands, every roulette bet settles at
exactly **972,973 ppm** across the 37 pockets, and the slots return comes
analytically from the reel strips. 136 native tests in the repository
lock all of it — if a strip or a paytable drifts, the build fails.

### Keys

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `space` / `enter` | spin, deal, draw, launch the ball |
| **shake the device** | pulls the lever — launches the roulette ball too |
| `,` `/` | change bet, or move the cursor in a hand |
| `;` `.` | navigate the lobby, pick a roulette number |
| `1`…`9` `0` | house credit, +10 to +100, anywhere |
| `h` | help — general in the lobby, game rules in a game |
| `s` | settings · `l` leaderboard · `a` about |
| `` ` `` | back — works any time, even mid-hand |

### What makes it this device's casino

Everything is electronics. The slot cabinet is a printed circuit board
with mounting holes and vias, the blackjack felt is routed like one with
silkscreen, and the roulette wheel rides a rotary encoder marked
**RE1 — 37 detents**, one per pocket. While the reels spin, the bottom of
the screen is an oscilloscope trace that loses sync and tears whenever a
reel locks. Reel symbols are floppy, CRT, chip, invader — with a `GLYPHS`
setting that restores cherries and bells. Same paytable either way.

One balance shared by all five games, bets remembered per player and per
game, up to 8 players on a persistent leaderboard. Left idle for twelve
seconds, any game slips into a grey, free attract demo until you touch a
key. An arcade boot sequence opens the firmware, and its fake self-test
shows **real** hardware numbers — checked against the board definition
and the drivers actually instantiated.

### Tested on

Built and tested on the **Cardputer ADV**, which is what this listing
targets. It also runs on the original Cardputer — a player uses it
there — but the shake-to-spin lever needs the ADV's IMU; without it,
use `space`. Owners of the original model can flash the very same build
from the GitHub release linked below.

Source, desktop SDL simulator and full documentation, MIT licensed with
the pixel art included:
<https://github.com/chatelp/geek-casino-cardputeradv>

Built with Claude Code, directed and tested by a human. Nothing AI runs
on the device — press `a` in the lobby and it says so itself.

name: Sinclair ZX Spectrum 48K - Cardputer ADV
description:
# Sinclair ZX Spectrum 48K for Cardputer ADV

C++ / Arduino emulator of the classic 48 KB Sinclair ZX Spectrum for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3, 8 MB flash, no PSRAM required).

## Features
- Z80 CPU, 48 KB RAM and ULA colour video with INK, PAPER, BRIGHT and FLASH.
- TAP tapes, common TZX blocks, SNA 48K and Z80 v1/v2/v3 48K snapshots from microSD.
- Original cassette loading with coloured borders and tape sound, plus fast silent loading.
- Filtered RGB565 video fits the complete Spectrum image on the 240 x 135 LCD.
- Beeper audio with an independent audio worker and buffered output.
- Folder browser, automatic folder creation and filtering of hidden macOS metadata.
- Kempston, Sinclair 1, Cursor and QAOP + Space control profiles.

## Prepare your microSD
Use FAT32 and provide your own ROM and games:
```text
/SPECTRUM/48.ROM       exactly 16384 bytes
/SPECTRUM/GAMES/TAP/   your TAP tapes
/SPECTRUM/GAMES/TZX/   your TZX tapes
/SPECTRUM/GAMES/SNA/   your 48K snapshots
/SPECTRUM/GAMES/Z80/   your 48K snapshots
```
ROMs and games are not included. Compatibility depends on each game and loader. This is a 48K emulator; 128K/AY, disks, ZIP, CSW and generalized TZX blocks are not supported.

## Controls
- Tab / G0: open the browser. Enter: load. Backspace: parent folder.
- Printed arrows without Fn: movement in game mode. Space: fire.
- Fn+J: switch between game controls and BASIC typing. Fn+K: cycle control profile.
- Shift: CAPS SHIFT. Ctrl / Alt: SYMBOL SHIFT.
- Fn+= / Fn+-: volume in 5% steps; initial volume 30%.
- O / R in the browser: original / fast loading. S: tape sound.
- Fn+F: fast mode. Fn+B: border. Fn+T: pause/resume tape. Fn+R: reset and eject.

## Installation
Compact merged BIN: 743,648 bytes, for the 8 MB Cardputer ADV. M5Launcher can extract the included 678,112-byte application and install it while keeping Launcher. The application-only app.bin is also available in the GitHub release.

Direct flashing from M5Burner uses offset 0x0 and installs the included bootloader and standard partition table, replacing the existing firmware layout. To retain M5Launcher, install through Launcher instead.

[Source code, firmware and complete Spanish guide](https://github.com/NeXoDevLab/Spectrum48KCardputerADV)

[Real device captures and full cassette-loading videos](https://nexodevlab.github.io/Spectrum48KCardputerADV/)

name: SkyCompass_Satellite
description:
SkyCompass Satellite 是 SkyCompass 项目的扩展演化版本，运行在 M5Stack Cardputer ADV上，与原项目关注自然天体（太阳、月亮等）不同，Satellite 版本专注于**人造飞行器（如国际空间站 ISS、天宫空间站、哈勃望远镜等）**的实时轨道追踪与可视性预测。
SkyCompass Satellite is an advanced evolutionary extension of the original SkyCompass project, running on the M5Stack Cardputer ADV (currently relying on the Cap LoRa1262 module for GPS coordinates retrieval).
Unlike the original project which focuses on natural celestial bodies (such as the Sun and Moon), the Satellite edition is dedicated to the real-time orbit tracking and visibility forecasting of artificial space objects (e.g., the International Space Station (ISS), Tiangong Space Station (CSS), Hubble Space Telescope, and more).
- **全景快捷交互与按键映射**：
- `Enter`：展开/收起近期最佳观测窗口推荐面板。
- `S` 键：调出卫星复选菜单，自由决定同屏显示的目标。
- `W` 键：呼出 WiFi 扫描与全键盘密码输入界面。
- `H` 键：随时在屏幕中央悬浮呼出**快捷键帮助菜单**。
