name: Smart Level
description:
智能水平仪固件，支持气泡水平仪、数字角度、目标角度、校准和蜂鸣提示。
Smart Level is a compact digital spirit level firmware for M5StickS3.

It uses the built-in IMU to measure pitch and roll angles, then shows the result on the screen with a bubble-style level, numeric angle display, and target-angle guidance mode.

Features:
- Bubble level view with color feedback
- Numeric pitch and roll angle display
- Current-pose calibration
- Target angle mode from -45° to +45°
- Direction guidance such as LEFT HIGH, RIGHT HIGH, FRONT HIGH, BACK HIGH
- Beep feedback when approaching level or target angle
- Mute / unmute by holding A + B

Controls:
- Press A: calibrate current position as zero
- Press B: switch display mode
- Hold A in Target mode: decrease target angle
- Hold B in Target mode: increase target angle
- Hold A + B: toggle beep on or off

This firmware is useful for adjusting desks, brackets, camera mounts, small machines, shelves, and other surfaces that need quick leveling or angle alignment.

name: Smart rattle
description:
# 🪇 Детская погремушка — M5StickC Plus2

Трясёшь — играет и светится. Три режима, безопасная громкость и яркость, умеет засыпать само, если про него забыли.

## Что это

Обычный M5StickC Plus2 превращён в музыкальную игрушку для малыша: движение рукой даёт ноту и цвет на экране. Никаких проводов и приложений — включил, и можно играть. Громкость и яркость программно ограничены специально для детских ушей и глаз, а если устройство оставили лежать без дела, оно само притухнет и уснёт, экономя батарею.

## Включение и выключение

На торце устройства — кнопка питания. Нажатие включает экран, долгое удержание полностью выключает устройство.

Пока устройство включено, оно умеет засыпать само (см. [«Сон»](#сон) ниже) — для этого отдельно ничего нажимать не нужно.

## Режимы

Режимов три, переключаются кнопкой **A** по кругу: Погремушка → Шкатулка → Пианино → Погремушка.

### 🪇 Погремушка

Самый простой режим. Трясёшь — звучит нота и экран вспыхивает цветом. Чем сильнее трясти, тем ярче «дышит» экран.

### 🎵 Шкатулка

Нужно несколько раз потрясти, чтобы «завести» — дальше мелодия играет сама, а цвет на экране медленно переливается. По мере того как завод кончается, музыка замедляется — потряси ещё, чтобы продолжить.

### 🎹 Пианино

Наклоняешь устройство — высота ноты меняется по ступеням, как клавиши. Звук идёт только пока двигаешь: остановился — тишина, хотя полоска на экране останется показывать последнюю ноту.

## Управление

| Кнопка | Действие |
|---|---|
| **A** (под экраном) | Переключить режим. Если устройство спало — первое нажатие будит его и не меняет режим, нужно нажать ещё раз. |
| **B** (сбоку) | Переключить громкость по кругу: Тихо → Обычно → Без звука → Тихо. |

## Экран

В верхней полоске — название текущего режима, значок громкости и индикатор заряда батареи. При зарядке от USB-C рядом с батарейкой появляется молния. Чем меньше заряда — тем тревожнее цвет индикатора (жёлтый, затем красный).

## Сон

Если устройство полежало без движения около 20 секунд — экран притухает. Ещё примерно через минуту он гаснет и устройство засыпает полностью, почти не тратя батарею. Разбудить можно тряской или нажатием **A** — режим и громкость при этом не теряются. Пока устройство подключено к USB, оно не засыпает само — удобно, если оно просто лежит на столе заряжается.

## Если что-то пошло не так

- **На полоске красным светится «IMU»** — не определяется датчик движения. Это не поломка в привычном смысле: нажатие **A** всё равно проиграет ноту и даст вспышку на экране, кнопка **B** по-прежнему меняет громкость, но переключение между тремя режимами недоступно, пока датчик не заработает.
- **Экран мигнул сообщением «Заряд» и устройство выключилось** — батарея разрядилась почти полностью, это штатное поведение для защиты аккумулятора. Просто зарядите через USB-C.


## Для тех, кто хочет заглянуть под капот

Прошивка собирается через [PlatformIO](https://platformio.org/) (`pio run -e m5stack-stickc-plus2`), построена на [M5Unified](https://github.com/m5stack/M5Unified).
author: rootofsystem
description_en:
# 🪇 Baby rattle – M5StickC Plus2

You shake it and it plays and lights up. Three modes, safe volume and brightness, can fall asleep on its own if you forget about it.

## What is this

The regular M5StickC Plus2 is turned into a musical toy for kids: hand movement gives a note and color on the screen. No wires or apps - turn it on and you can play. The volume and brightness are programmatically limited specifically for children's ears and eyes, and if the device is left lying idle, it will dim itself and fall asleep, saving the battery.

## Turn on and off

At the end of the device there is a power button. Pressing turns on the screen, long holding turns the device off completely.

While the device is turned on, it can fall asleep on its own (see [“Sleep”](#sleep) below) - you don’t need to press anything separately to do this.

## Modes

There are three modes, switched with the **A** button in a circle: Rattle → Box → Piano → Rattle.

### 🪇 Rattle
The easiest mode. When you shake it, a note sounds and the screen flashes color. The harder you shake, the brighter the screen “breathes.”

### 🎵 Box

You need to shake it several times to “start it up” - then the melody plays itself, and the color on the screen slowly shimmers. As the plant runs out, the music slows down - shake again to continue.

### 🎹 Piano

You tilt the device and the pitch of the note changes in steps, like keys. The sound comes only while you move: stopped - silence, although the bar on the screen will remain showing the last note.

## Management

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| **A** (under screen) | Switch mode. If the device is asleep, the first press wakes it up and does not change the mode; you need to press again. |
| **B** (side) | Switch the volume in a circle: Quiet → Normal → Silent → Quiet. |

## Screen
The top bar contains the name of the current mode, the volume icon and the battery charge indicator. When charging via USB-C, a lightning bolt appears next to the battery. The less charge, the more alarming the color of the indicator (yellow, then red).

## Dream

If the device lies motionless for about 20 seconds, the screen dims. After about another minute, it goes out and the device falls asleep completely, almost without wasting the battery. You can wake up by shaking or pressing **A** - the mode and volume are not lost. While the device is connected to USB, it does not fall asleep on its own—it’s convenient if it just lies on the table while charging.

## If something went wrong

- **“IMU” lights up red on the strip**—the motion sensor is not detected. This is not a malfunction in the usual sense: pressing **A** will still play a note and flash on the screen, the **B** button will still change the volume, but switching between the three modes is not available until the sensor is working.
- **The screen flashed the message “Charging” and the device turned off** - the battery was almost completely discharged, this is normal behavior to protect the battery. Just charge via USB-C.


## For those who want to look under the hood

The firmware is compiled via [PlatformIO](https://platformio.org/) (`pio run -e m5stack-stickc-plus2`), built on [M5Unified](https://github.com/m5stack/M5Unified).

description:
Snake Cardputer Game 🐍💻

An evolved version of game-snake-m5cardputer from ZrutrA

Game controls

left: "," or left arrow ⬅️

right: "/" or right arrow ➡️

up: ";" or up arrow ⬆️

down: "." or down arrow ⬇️

pause - "p" ⏸️

new game - "n" 🆕

Best score (record)

If an SD memory card is inserted in the device, the largest number of fruit eaten by the snake is stored on this memory. The record will still be visible after the power is restarted. If there is no SD card in the device - the record is reset after each power restart.

How to install a game from a .bin file?

- Via ESPHome

Open <https://web.esphome.io/> in a browser that supports WebSerial (Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge). Click "Connect", select the appropriate port, click "Connect". Then click "Install", point to the snake-M5Cardputer.bin file and click "Install". Ready.

- Via M5Burner

Just find this project in the list, hit "Download" Button and then "Burn" when ready (don't forget to connect to device and select the device COM port).

name: SomaFM Player for Cardputer
description:
SOMA-FM - The BEST radio for Programmers

An internet radio player for the M5Stack Cardputer.
Streams all SomaFM channels. 
Features a custom UI with station logos, genre-colored lists, and live audio visualizers. 
Made with Claude Opus 4.6

Key Features:
On-Device WiFi Setup: Scan and connect to networks directly on the device (no hardcoded credentials).
Audio Visualizers: Cycle through EQ bars, Waveform, and VU meters.
Smart Caching: Uses LittleFS to cache station logos and channel lists for near-instant startup.
Favorites & Persistence: Pin favorite stations to the top and remembers your last station/volume on reboot.
Dual-Core Performance: Gapless MP3 streaming on Core 0 while the UI stays responsive on Core 1.
Hardware Support: Fully compatible with both the original Cardputer and the new Cardputer ADV (ES8311 codec).

Controls
Enter: Play selected station
Space: Pause / Resume
Tab: Cycle Visualizers (Bars / Wave / VU / Off)
W/S or ;/. : Scroll stations (hold to repeat)
F: Toggle Favorite
N: Network/WiFi Setup
Volume: Keys , and /.

name: Sparks
description:
本固件为 Cardputer-ADV 定制个人固件，核心功能包含米家设备控制、Cursor 使用信息查看。

应用清单：
1. 米家（Mijia）｜快捷键：m｜设备状态查看、控制
2. 时钟（Time）｜快捷键：t｜开机时长、实时时间、秒表、倒计时
3. Cursor（Cursor Dashboard）｜快捷键：c｜Cursor 信息查看，TOKEN余量，24小时/7天/30天使用概况
4. 红外（Infrared）｜快捷键：x｜电视、空调红外遥控，适配主流品牌
5. 麦克风（Mic）｜快捷键：r｜麦克风测试、波形查看
6. IMU｜快捷键：g｜BMI270 六轴传感器参数查看
7. WiFi｜快捷键：w｜WiFi 设置，支持多组网络配置切换
8. AP/LAN（Config）｜快捷键：u｜Web配置服务，用于修改 config.json
9. 系统配置（Options）｜快捷键：o｜屏幕、音量等偏好设置
10. 图标查看（Icons）｜快捷键：a｜浏览固件内置图标
11. 字体（Font）｜快捷键：f｜预览系统内置字体
12. 休眠（Sleep）｜快捷键：s｜设备不关机，支持浅休眠、深休眠
13. 摩斯密码（Morse）｜快捷键：j｜按键触发摩斯密码音频输出
14. 键盘（HID Keyboard）｜快捷键：k｜蓝牙、USB HID键盘功能
15. LED（RGB LED）｜快捷键：l｜ESP32板载RGB LED测试
16. 蓝牙（BLE）｜快捷键：b｜扫描并查看周边蓝牙设备列表
17. 屏幕（Display）｜快捷键：d｜屏幕测试，支持多背景色、线条、方块测试

-----  English  ---------

This firmware is a custom personal build tailored for Cardputer-ADV, with core functionalities including local control of Mijia devices and statistics viewing for cursor usage.

Smart Home
m - Mijia: Local LAN-based Mijia device control
Additional entry - Get Device Token: Export token & ble.key via cloud tools and output in config.json format
x - Infrared: IR remote control for TV, air conditioner (GPIO44 pin)

Network & Config
u - Config: Edit firmware config.json via AP hotspot or LAN web page
w - WiFi: Scan, connect and switch up to 5 saved WiFi networks
b - BLE: Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices

Time & Power
t - Time: Clock toolkit — uptime, system clock, countdown, stopwatch
p - Battery: Real-time battery level + about 1-hour historical curve chart
s - Sleep: Enter light sleep or deep sleep mode

Productivity
c - Cursor: Cursor usage statistics with daily/weekly/monthly trend charts
k - HID Keyboard: Emulate HID keyboard over USB and BLE
j - Morse: Generate audible Morse code tones

System & Info
o - Options: Global system settings (brightness, sound, time, IR parameters etc.)
i - Info: Overview of memory, chip model, firmware, network and runtime status
v - Version: Firmware version and about page

Hardware Debug & Demos
g - IMU: Attitude visualization for BMI270 inertial measurement unit
l - RGB LED: Onboard RGB LED functional test
r - Mic: Real-time audio waveform, VU meter and gain adjustment
d - Display: Screen test patterns including color blocks, grids and lines
a - Icons: Browse all built-in firmware icons
f - Font: Preview embedded system fonts
n / e - I2C: Scan internal on-board I2C bus and external expanded I2C bus respectively

name: SpectroSleuth: MP3 Reader & Ultimate Audio and Vibration Swiss Army Knife
description: SpectroSleuth turns your Cardputer ADV into the ultimate Swiss army knife for sound and vibration. Audio mode: spectrogram, spectrum with harmonics, oscilloscope, real-time 3D landscape, tuner, sound level meter, waveform view and a music view with MP3 and WAV player (play a whole folder, in order or shuffled). Accelerometer mode: live traces, recorded curves, G-G radar, shock analyser, vibration spectrogram and machine health check (ISO 10816). The code is optimised to the extreme, down to counting CPU cycles: hot paths run from IRAM, there are no float divisions in the inner loops, fixed-point colour ramps are used, and SD reading runs on the second core. The result is fast analysis, a smooth 3D view and fluid MP3/WAV playback on a small ESP32-S3. Main keys: [Tab] switches between audio and accelerometer, [Alt] chooses the view, [M] jumps to the music view, [L] opens the files to play your MP3s, [H] shows the help for the screen you are on. Built with pure ESP-IDF. I am super proud of this one, enjoy!

name: Stamp Timer Power2 User Demo For ESP32
description:
A live Web demo firmware for Stamp Timer Power2 (S021). This version is intended for ESP32-based host devices, with automatic M5 device and display detection through M5Unified/M5GFX. On boot, the device starts a SoftAP and display-equipped boards show a Wi-Fi QR code. Open [http://192.168.4.1/](http://192.168.4.1/) to view device information, configure I2C pins, detect M5PM1 at address 0x6E, and enter the same interactive console experience as the online demo—backed by real register access, voltage telemetry, GPIO, PWM, ADC, NeoPixel, timer and power operations.

- AP: `M5STP2-XXXX`
- Default password: `m5stp2demo`

Flash this firmware onto an ESP32-based host device and make sure the STP2 is correctly wired and powered. External I2C pull-ups are required. This firmware is intended for demonstration only and must not be used in safety-critical applications.

Starship is a classic, fast-paced arcade game inspired by the legendary "Game & Watch: Eggs" handhelds, reimagined in a space setting.

Classic Gameplay: Simple, addictive retro mechanics with a fresh sci-fi twist.
High Score Tracking: The game automatically saves your personal best directly to the device's non-volatile memory—compete against yourself and set new records!
Optimized for M5Cardputer ADV: Specifically designed for the M5Cardputer, utilizing the keyboard and display for maximum responsiveness.
Retro Vibes: Classic pixel art and sound effects that capture the golden age of arcade gaming.
How to Play:
Use the [CTRL], [FN], [ENTER], and [SPACE] keys to activate shields in the corresponding directions. Don't let the enemies break through your defenses!

- **网络**：Wi-Fi 信道分析 / 信息牌(天气+AQI) / 网页遥控台 / 网络延迟 / 一键触发 / 二维码

- **其它**：随机密码 / 电池监控 / I2C 扫描
- **Grove 外设**：环境(温湿度) / 功率计 / 电子秤 / 光照 / 气压 / 空气质量 / 测距 / 输出(继电器·舵机) / 示波器

#StickS3 Toolbox

A "pocket toolbox" on an M5Stack StickS3 with 46 useful tools:

- **Time**: Network time adjustment / clock / alarm clock / stopwatch (counting) / countdown / world time / lunar calendar
- **Gesture**: level / protractor / step counter / anti-lost alarm / gesture (double click·flip) / dice
- **Audio**: Decibel Meter / Spectrum Analysis / Guitar Tuning / Metronome / Tone Generator / White Noise / Recording

- **Bluetooth**: Scan for devices / Broadcast intercom / **PPT page turning pen** / Shortcut key panel (volume·media)

# StickS3 校园天气机

给住校学生用的桌面天气预报机（M5Stack StickS3 / ESP32-S3）。

## 功能
- 🕐 **横屏时钟**：时间 + 农历 + 干支（丙午马年 戊戌月 丁巳日 九月初一）
- 📅 **7 个天气页**：今日 · 未来5天 · 防晒指数 · 生活提示 · 24小时趋势 · 空气质量 · 洗晒指数
- 🎨 **动态天气图标**：太阳旋转、雨点下落、雪花飘、雷电闪烁
- 🌏 **中英双语**（设备界面 + 配网页）
- 🎙 **离线语音播报**：气温/天气/体感/湿度/风速/紫外线/带伞提醒（普通话/English，男声/女声）
- ⚠️ **天气预警**：高温/严寒/降雨/雷电/大雾/大风/重污染/极强紫外线
- ⏰ **起床闹钟** · 🔋 **省电息屏** · 📶 **手机配网页** · ⬆️ **WiFi OTA**

1. 开机后设备开热点 **StickS3-Weather**

3. 选 WiFi、填密码和城市 → 保存并连接

- KEY1 单击翻页 / 长按播报
- KEY2 单击刷新 / 双击打开设置热点 / 长按3秒重新配网

name: Sticker Level
description:
**Sticker Level** turns your M5StickS3 into a precise digital spirit level. It reads the built-in BMI270 IMU and switches between two modes on its own, depending on how you hold the device. No menus, no button press.

## Two modes, chosen automatically

**FLAT: check horizontal surfaces**
Lay the StickS3 flat with the screen up. A bubble-circle shows **pitch** (front/back) and **roll** (left/right) together, with live angles in degrees. The bubble turns **green** when the surface is level and **red** when it's tilted.

**VERTICAL: check plumb, like a torpedo level**
Stand the StickS3 on its edge with the screen facing you, against a wall, post, door frame or picture frame. The display switches to a horizontal tube with a sliding bubble. It shows the **lean** angle and a **PLUMB / TILTED** status.

A small hysteresis band stops the screen flickering between modes while you move the device.

## Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| **Left**, short press | Change tolerance: ±0.5° → ±1° → ±2° → ±5° |
| **Left**, long press | **Tare**: set the current position as zero (until reboot) |
| **Right**, short press | Clear the tare |
| **Right**, long press | **Calibrate**: save a permanent zero to flash (~6 s) |

FLAT and VERTICAL each keep their own tare and calibration. Calibrating one never changes the other.

## First use: calibrate once

Every MEMS accelerometer has a small factory offset, so an uncalibrated unit can be off by up to about 1°.
1. Place the StickS3 on a surface you **know** is level (for FLAT) or plumb (for VERTICAL).
2. Hold the **Right** button until "Calibrating..." appears, then keep the device still for about 6 seconds.
3. The offset is saved and loaded again on every boot.

**VERTICAL mode must be calibrated once before you use it.** Until then it has no reliable reference for plumb.

## Accuracy
After calibration, expect accuracy within a few tenths of a degree. Each reading averages 8 samples, and calibration averages 600. If readings drift over time or with temperature, recalibrate.

## Hardware
M5StickS3 (ESP32-S3, BMI270 IMU, 135×240 display). Built with Arduino, M5Unified and M5PM1 on PlatformIO.

name: TETRIS! Single OR Multi-Player Battle!+ - M5StickC Plus2
description:
TETRIS! MULTI-PLAYER!

*There is still a single player mode!

This project represents a significant evolution from a single-player M5StickC Plus2 Tetris game to a full-featured 2-player battle system. While built upon AleksAlcDel's excellent foundation and inspired by Hexagon's advanced concepts, the battle system, enhanced features, and professional polish represent substantial original contribution to the M5Stack Tetris Community. 

*REQUIRES Mini JoyC Hat!
-Multi-Player *Requires 2nd M5StickC Plus2
TO CONNECT- After booting opening screen. First hold down on the JoyC Hat. Then WAIT! about 15-20 seconds and it will create a hotspot. Shortly afterward hold down on JoyC hat on 2nd M5Stick, it will connect quickly. They are supposed to ready up together. Sometimes they do. Sometimes one person opens a few seconds earlier. No matter what the game syncs up and the battle begins. I would however not delay a long time after connecting to each other to ready up.

-20 Levels
-Ghost Piece
-Next Piece  *only displays for a second. Not intentional. 
-Border- to fill the void on the original
-A battle meter! I don't actually know what this does. 
-You can each select your own levels! For multi skill level users. 
-GARBAGE! Clearing. 2 Lines sends ,  3 lines sends 2 and 4 lines sends 4! I was going to make T-spins send 4. But its really not fair, as they are so easy. 
-Press Left button for hold next piece!
-M5 pauses it game
*note: pausing one game does NOT pause the other

-Progressive lock delay! I think it works. not a huge fan of slow speeds, so I really only could tell on the higher level. But its set to go from 450 ms to 650ms at Max level. 
-There is also a left over WiFi monitor hold up... and Tetris beacon on the opening screen if you hold L+R. So. Don't do that unless you want the world to know someone is playing Tetris nearby. 

Only for M5StickC Plus2

name: TETROIDS! Asteroids Tetris Piece Game M5StickC Plus2
description:
**Mini Joy C Hat Required!!**
TetroidsM5 - Tetris meets Asteroids
A space shooter for M5StickC Plus2 where you pilot a T-piece ship through waves of Tetris asteroid attacks!

  🎮 Game Description
Control a T-piece spaceship that rotates 360° and fires bullets to destroy incoming Tetris-shaped asteroids. Survive waves of tetromino enemies, break them apart, and rack up your high score! Classic arcade action meets block-puzzle aesthetics in this retro-inspired shooter.

🌟 Key Features
360° Ship Rotation - 8-direction smooth rotation with momentum physics
Asteroid Destruction - Shoot Tetris pieces that break into smaller blocks
Progressive Waves - Increasing difficulty with more asteroids
Tetris Aesthetics - Classic piece colors (I=Cyan, O=Yellow, L=Orange, J=Blue, S=Green, Z=Red)
Screen Wrapping - True Asteroids-style edge teleportation
God Mode - Invincibility toggle for testing/practice
Smooth 60 FPS - Buttery gameplay on ESP32
🕹️ Controls
Input	Action
Joystick Left/Right	Rotate ship counter-clockwise/clockwise
Joystick Up	Thrust forward (momentum physics)
Joy Button	Fire bullet (max 4 on screen)
M5  Warp/hyperspace
Button B	Toggle God Mode (invincibility)

How to Play
Survive the Waves - Each wave spawns 3-8 Tetris-shaped asteroids
Shoot to Break - Hit large asteroids to break them into 4 smaller blocks
Destroy All - Clear all asteroids to advance to next wave
Avoid Collisions - Touching asteroids damages you (unless God Mode is on)
Score Points:
Small block destroyed: 10 pts
Large asteroid broken: 50 pts
Wave completed: 100 × wave number
Survival time: 1 pt/second

Design Philosophy
This game combines the best of two arcade classics:
Asteroids (1979): Rotation, thrust, screen wrap, shooting
Tetris (1984): Block aesthetics, piece types, colors
Atari's Asteroids & Alexey Pajitnov's Tetris

Created by Coreymillia

name: TICKER
description:
《行情机》TICKER —— 一台放在桌上的行情机。

拿起就玩几个交易日，一天 6 分钟，放下就走。冷色调像素屏，一屏六根蜡烛，所有画面由代码逐像素画出。

· 一个交易日 12 根蜡烛：日终强制平仓，第二天换一只标的
· 你的单子会推动价格：大单滑得狠，钱多了你自己就是那条鲸鱼
· 五类异象、每类三套剧本：鲸鱼、灰犀牛、黑天鹅、瀑布、升天，方向严格随机 —— 出事了不等于该抄底
· 财报是岔路口：36% 预告、9% 突袭，传闻只有一半是真的
· 每只标的都有隐藏性格：抗跌的、上蹿下跳的、财报爱造假的、鲸鱼常来的
· 战绩册：今日权益曲线、跨日与大盘对比、六类异象收集（集齐解锁一只妖股）
· 持仓中关机不丢，开机接着玩；2 分钟不按键自动熄屏，任意键唤醒

按键：B 买入 / S 卖出 / L 战绩册 / H 帮助 / M 静音 / C 红绿互换（默认红涨绿跌）

author: andjiang
description_en:
"Ticket Machine" TICKER - a ticker placed on the table.

Pick up and play for a few trading days, 6 minutes a day, put it down and go. A cold-toned pixel screen with six candles on one screen. All images are drawn pixel by pixel by code.

· 12 candles in one trading day: forced liquidation at the end of the day, and another underlying stock the next day
· Your orders will drive the price: big orders will slide hard, and if you have more money, you will be the whale.
· Five types of anomalies, three sets of scripts for each type: whale, gray rhinoceros, black swan, waterfall, ascension, the direction is strictly random - something goes wrong does not mean it is time to buy the bottom.
· Financial reports are a fork in the road: 36% previews, 9% surprises, only half of the rumors are true
· Each stock has a hidden personality: one that resists falling, one that jumps up and down, one that likes to falsify financial reports, one that whales often come to
· Record book: today’s equity curve, cross-day comparison with the market, collection of six types of anomalies (collect together to unlock a monster stock)
· Turn off the phone while holding a position and it won’t be lost. Turn it on and continue playing; the screen will automatically turn off if you don’t press a button for 2 minutes and wake up with any key.

Buttons: B buy / S sell / L record book / H help / M mute / C red and green swap (default is red up and green down)

name: Tab5 Fancy Clock
description:
An elegant analog + digital desk clock for the Tab5's 1280x720 screen.

- **Analog dial** with a sweeping second hand, day-progress ring, big digital time, date and a frosted-glass calendar
- **Five themes** (Aurora, Sunset, Ocean, Jade, Graphite): tap the background to switch
- **Hourly announcement**: a bell and the spoken hour, with adjustable volume
- **Hourly shows**: fireworks, a 3D dial flip, numerals in flight, a split-flap board, an aurora and a light sweep
- **Night mode** (23:00-07:00): the same clock as a faint red outline at low brightness, with the hourly sound and
  shows quiet; a tap shows the normal clock
- **Settings**: tap the gear in the calendar header
- **Network time** over WiFi with automatic daylight saving; the RTC keeps time offline
- **Time zone picker**: tap the greeting to choose from 59 major cities
- **Battery card** with charge state, time estimate and an optional 80-90% charge limit
- **Auto-rotate** (landscape or upside-down), low power (~20% CPU by day, ~2% at night)

**Touch:** drag left/right for brightness - double-tap for display off - tap the digits for 12/24 h - tap the WiFi
icon to connect - tap the battery icon for details.

For the Tab5's ESP32-P4 revision v1.x (shown when M5Burner/esptool connects).

The firmware also contains third-party software (some LGPL): its notices and source are on the GitHub release page,
https://github.com/yejun/tab5-fancy-clock/releases/tag/v1.1.0

Source and documentation (MIT): https://github.com/yejun/tab5-fancy-clock

name: Tab5 PC
description:
## Tab5 PC – a 386/486 DOS PC on your Tab5

Runs DOS on the Tab5 with **VGA graphics**, **Sound Blaster 16 / AdLib** sound, hard disks, CD-ROM images and floppies. Type on the **Tab5 Keyboard** or a USB keyboard and mouse; the touch screen works as a touchpad.

**Performance:** roughly an early-1990s 486, thanks to a fast interpreter and a translator to RISC-V code.

**First start:** insert an empty microSD card, choose your Wi-Fi network, tap **Install FreeDOS 1.4**, and answer the installer's questions (about 25 minutes).

**Copy files** from a web browser over Wi-Fi (use it only on a trusted network).

For ESP32-P4 chips of revision v1.x. Source, tools, licences and the v3.x image: https://github.com/yejun/tab5-pc

-

## Tab5 PC – 在 Tab5 上运行的 386/486 DOS 电脑

在 Tab5 上运行 DOS，支持 **VGA 图形**、**Sound Blaster 16 / AdLib** 声音、硬盘、光盘镜像和软盘。可使用 **Tab5 键盘**或 USB 键盘和鼠标，触摸屏可当作触控板。

**性能：** 大约相当于 1990 年代初的 486，得益于快速解释器和将代码翻译为 RISC-V 指令的翻译器。

**首次使用：** 插入空的 microSD 卡，选择 Wi-Fi 网络，点击 **Install FreeDOS 1.4**，按安装程序提示回答问题（约 25 分钟）。

**复制文件：** 通过 Wi-Fi 用网页浏览器复制（请只在可信任的网络中使用）。

适用于 ESP32-P4 v1.x 版本芯片。源代码、工具、许可证和 v3.x 版本固件：https://github.com/yejun/tab5-pc

**性能：** 大约相当于 1990 年代初的 486，得益于快速解释器和将代码翻译为 RISC-V 指令的翻译器。

**首次使用：** 插入空的 microSD 卡，选择 Wi-Fi 网络，点击 **Install FreeDOS 1.4**，按安装程序提示回答问题（约 25 分钟）。

**复制文件：** 通过 Wi-Fi 用网页浏览器复制（请只在可信任的网络中使用）。

适用于 ESP32-P4 v1.x 版本芯片。源代码、工具、许可证和 v3.x 版本固件：https://github.com/yejun/tab5-pc

name: Tab5 Web Display
description:
**Needs the free PC server from GitHub: https://github.com/yejun/tab5-web-display**

Show web pages on your Tab5 and use them by touch, like on a tablet: tap buttons and links, drag sliders, pinch to
zoom. A small Python program on your PC opens the page in Chrome or Chromium and streams it to the Tab5 over WiFi.

**What it can do**
- Show any website (`--url`), your own HTML file (`--file`), or a video (`--file clip.mp4`, with sound)
- Multi-touch: pinch zoom and scrolling; swipe between tabs, three fingers for back and forward
- M5Stack's Tab5 Keyboard: type into pages, control videos, type the WiFi password; its lights show the status
- Sound: what the page plays comes out of the Tab5's speaker (Linux PC)
- Built-in apps: dashboard (weather, forecast, air quality, headlines), clock with calendar, sticky notes,
  老黄历 (Chinese almanac), touch and motion demo. No API keys needed.
- Smooth and light: only changed areas are sent and drawn by the Tab5's hardware JPEG engine; animations
  run at up to ~58 fps, videos at up to 30
- Battery level in the settings

**How to run**
1. Flash this firmware. On first start, pick your WiFi network on the Tab5's screen.
2. On a PC on the same network (Python 3.9+), download the project from GitHub and run:
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   python server/server.py
3. With the Tab5 plugged in by USB, the server finds it by itself. Otherwise add `--device <IP>`; the Tab5
   shows its IP address.

Use a server version that matches this firmware (v1.3.x); the server warns if they differ.

Swipe down from the top edge for the settings (WiFi, brightness, volume, keyboard lights, flip).

name: Tab5-Launchpad
description:
# Tab5-Launchpad

![Tab5-Launchpad](docs/previews/hero.png)

A dedicated firmware for the [M5Stack Tab5](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/core/Tab5)
(ESP32-P4) that turns its touchscreen into a class-compliant USB-MIDI grid
controller — six playing modes, live value readouts, and a flat,
professional UI, with zero DAW-specific lock-in: it's generic MIDI, so it
works with whatever you already use (map it in your DAW's own MIDI-learn,
the same way you'd map any controller).

All images on this page are real renders of the actual firmware code — the
project ships a native Linux preview tool (`tools/build-launchpad-preview.sh`)
that links the real rendering source against a software framebuffer, so
these aren't mockups.

## Features

- **Six modes**, one grid: **Notes** (chromatic, 3 layout sizes), **Drums**
  (GM percussion map, auto-selects MIDI channel 10), **Faders** (CC20-27,
  relative touch drag, live value readout), **XY** (CC1 + CC74, a soft
  glowing touch point, absolute position), **Macros** (CC102-117, 16 relative
  rotary knobs), **Looper** (4-track, records/replays whatever you play in
  any mode, per-track overdub, visual BPM metronome, can also capture MIDI
  from a connected host — see below).
- **Every control shows its real value and CC/note assignment on screen** —
  no memorizing a mapping, no guessing what a fader is currently at.
- **Large, dedicated channel picker** (not a cramped always-on strip) — 16
  full-size buttons, one tap to switch.
- **Panic button** — Sustain Off, All Notes Off, All Sound Off, across every
  channel actually used this session, with send-failure feedback.
- **Honest connection state** — the firmware only ever claims what it
  actually knows (USB enumerated vs. not), never implies a DAW is listening
  just because the OS sees the device.
- **Real double-buffered, vsync-synced rendering** — no tearing, every
  frame fully repainted.
- **Class-compliant USB-MIDI device**, always on from boot. Plug in, your
  DAW/synth/whatever sees a standard MIDI input — no driver, no DAW-specific
  plugin.

## How to use

### Home

Boots to a small home screen: open the controller, or check Settings /
Diagnostics.

![Home screen](docs/previews/12_home_landscape.png)

### Notes

Tap pads to play. The footer's dimension button cycles grid size (8x4 /
8x2 / 4x4); the channel button opens the full-screen picker; Panic clears
stuck notes instantly.

![Notes mode](docs/previews/02_note_pressed.png)

### Drums

Fixed 4x4 GM percussion layout. Switching into this mode auto-selects MIDI
channel 10 — the convention essentially every GM/GS/XG-aware synth and DAW
expects for drums — still overridable from the channel picker afterward.

![Drums mode, pads held](docs/previews/04_drum_pressed.png)

### Faders

Four real touch faders (CC20-27 depending on variant). Press anywhere in a
column to grab it, drag to change the value — the fader won't jump just
because you touched it.

![Faders mode](docs/previews/05_mixer_cc.png)

### XY

The whole pad is one continuous surface: X → CC1 (mod wheel), Y → CC74
(filter cutoff/brightness) — both conventional, DAW/synth-recognized CC
assignments. A soft glow tracks your touch instead of a hard crosshair.

![XY mode](docs/previews/06_xy_center.png)

### Macros

Up to 16 rotary knobs (CC102-117). Press and drag **vertically** to turn —
relative drag, not absolute angle, since a flat touchscreen has no
detents to make angle-based turning reliable.

![Macros mode](docs/previews/10_knob_variant0.png)

### Looper

**4 independent tracks.** Tap a track button (T1-T4) to select which one
Record/Play/Clear target — the other three keep doing whatever they were
already doing (playing, recording, paused) regardless of which one is
selected, so you can layer tracks: record a part on track 1, let it loop,
select track 2, record over the top of it, and so on.

Tap **Record** to start capturing on the selected track, tap it again to
close the loop at whatever length you just played (it starts looping
immediately). Switch to another mode and keep playing — the loop keeps
going underneath. Tap Record again while it's playing to **overdub**
(layers new material into that track without erasing it); tap again to
stop adding. **Play/Stop** pauses and resumes from exactly where it left
off, not from the start. **Clear** wipes the selected track only.

Each track records whatever you play locally in *any* mode, **and** MIDI
received from a connected host/DAW while that track is armed — so you can
loop something your DAW sends back to the device, not just what you play
on the pads.

A BPM readout with +/- buttons and a pulsing beat indicator give a visual
tempo reference — purely a feel aid, it does not quantize or snap
recording/playback to a grid.

![Looper mode, 4 tracks, mixed states](docs/previews/17_looper_multitrack.png)

### Channel picker

A dedicated full-screen picker (not a cramped strip) — large, legible
touch targets for all 16 MIDI channels.

![Channel picker](docs/previews/11_channel_selector.png)

### Settings

![Settings screen](docs/previews/13_settings_landscape.png)

### Diagnostics

Live hardware/USB health — chip, memory, battery, SD, panel, and detected
peripherals.

![Diagnostics screen](docs/previews/14_diagnostics_landscape.png)

## MIDI mapping reference

Exact note/CC numbers, value formulas, and per-mode variant tables:
[`docs/midi-mapping.md`](docs/midi-mapping.md).

| Mode | Message | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Notes | Note On/Off | Fixed velocity 100 (no pressure sensing on this touch panel) |
| Drums | Note On/Off | GM percussion map, fixed velocity 110, channel 10 by default |
| Faders | CC 20-27 | Continuous, relative drag |
| XY | CC 1 + CC 74 | Absolute touch position, holds last value on release |
| Macros | CC 102-117 | Relative vertical drag |
| Looper | (replays recorded messages) | Not its own message type — re-sends whatever was captured, locally or from the host, into the selected track |

MIDI channel is set entirely by the device (via the channel picker) — the
host never negotiates or assigns it; it just listens on whichever channel
its MIDI input is pointed at. 16 channels is a hard MIDI 1.0 protocol
limit, not a firmware restriction.

## Building

Stock ESP-IDF project (tested against 5.5.4):

```sh
idf.py build
idf.py -p /dev/ttyACM0 flash monitor
```

Requires a real ESP-IDF 5.5.4 install (`. $IDF_PATH/export.sh` before the
commands above) — this is a stock IDF project, nothing project-specific
needed beyond that. Known gap worth knowing about: some sandboxed/offline
setups fetch an `esptool` that predates ESP32-P4 support; if
`elf2image`/flashing fails with `invalid choice: 'esp32p4'`, you need an
esptool ≥ 5.x ahead of it on `PATH`.

Iterate on the screen's visuals without hardware at all:

```sh
./tools/build-launchpad-preview.sh   # writes real rendered frames to launchpad-preview/
```

A `perf` command is also available over the serial console (any terminal
at 115200 baud) — calls the real draw+present path directly per mode,
unthrottled, and reports timing. Useful if you're chasing a performance
question on your own hardware.

## Architecture notes

- `main/launchpad_modes.c/.h` — pure pad/CC-index → MIDI-message mapping,
  no platform dependency at all.
- `main/launchpad_controller.c/.h` — portable touch-ownership, note
  lifecycle, per-mode channel/layout recall, panic, transport-error state,
  and the Looper's 4-track recording/playback engine. Also platform-free,
  unit-testable natively.
- `main/launchpad_grid.c/.h` + `main/studio_ui.c/.h` — rendering and
  hit-testing, built on antialiased proportional type instead of a bitmap
  font. Every screen does a full repaint every frame it presents — required
  by the real double-buffered display pipeline (`main/display.c`); a
  partial/dirty-region redraw would desync the two alternating hardware
  framebuffers. Text renders via a composed-glyph blit (`su_text()` →
  `sgfx_blit()` → `display.c`'s `set_window`/`write_pixels`), not one fill
  call per antialiasing run.
- `main/launchpad_app.c` — the one ESP-IDF-specific file: touch polling,
  frame pacing, host MIDI receive polling (feeds the Looper's host-capture
  path), wiring the portable controller to real hardware.
- `main/usb_midi_device.c/.h` — always-on class-compliant USB-MIDI device
  (TinyUSB), no host mode of any kind.
- `lib/SIC`, `lib/SGFX`, `lib/konsole` — vendored hardware-abstraction,
  graphics, and console libraries (board bring-up, MIPI-DSI panel driving,
  serial CLI).

name: Tab5OS
description:
# Tab5OS

**Tab5OS** transforms the **M5Stack Tab5** into a versatile portable workspace for writing, drawing, reading, media, maps, software development and communication.

Work directly on the touchscreen or connect a **USB keyboard, mouse or compatible gamepad**. Alongside its built-in tools, Tab5OS supports **11 ready-to-run ELF applications**, MicroPython programs and expandable software libraries, with access to microSD and USB storage.

## Writing and reading

A versatile **Markdown and code editor** for everyday writing, structured documents and software development. Work across multiple documents and organised project groups, with syntax highlighting, search, and navigation through document outlines, hyperlinks and references to other files or specific text sections. An integrated Python console and serial communication tools extend the editor beyond conventional text editing.

Read **EPUB ebooks** with bookmarks, or explore Wikipedia through its dedicated application, with support for online content and compatible **offline ZIM archives**, including hyperlinks, tables and optional images.

## Drawing and image editing

A complete drawing and image-editing workspace with **brushes, shapes, text, layers, selections and transformations**. Create illustrations, edit imported images and refine details using colour adjustments, gradients, patterns, feathering and local deformation tools.

Rectangular, elliptical and freehand selections, a magic wand, and undo/redo provide additional editing flexibility. Preserve editable compositions in the native **T5I layered format**, or export finished images as **BMP and JPEG**.

## Files, sharing and security

A graphical **SD/USB file explorer** provides hierarchical folder navigation, search, multiple selection and contextual **Open with** actions for working with different file types and applications.

Transfer, browse and manage files from a computer's web browser through a local network or direct Wi-Fi connection, without requiring dedicated desktop software.

Protect sensitive information with **file encryption** and a **PIN-controlled vault** for passwords, encryption keys and authentication tokens. Print documents through compatible **network IPP and IPP-over-USB printers**.

## Development and network tools

Tab5OS provides an integrated environment for **MicroPython development**, from editing and executing programs to managing projects, importing modules, maintaining libraries and downloading compatible packages.

Built-in **Git integration** supports practical version-control workflows, including repository cloning, change tracking, staging, commits, history, and synchronisation with remote repositories through fetch, pull and push.

The **interactive command-line terminal** goes beyond basic file management, allowing elaborate commands and multi-step workflows through **command pipelines, redirections, variables and scripts**. Its utilities cover text processing, file operations, searching, SHA-256 verification and network diagnostics.

Additional networking capabilities include DNS queries, ping, TCP connections, port checks and HTTP requests. Run **remote SSH commands**, transfer files through **SFTP**, and communicate with external devices over **USB-C serial or RS485** connections.

## Maps, media and everyday tools

Explore **online and offline maps**, search for places, save locations and download map data for use without an internet connection.

Enjoy local audio and supported video playback, internet radio and audio recording. Everyday utilities include a calculator with history and unit conversions, alarm clock, system diagnostics, and extensive personalisation with **customisable themes, fonts, shortcut controls and 14 interface languages**.

Compatible external hardware extends the system with **RTL-SDR radio reception** and **Meshtastic messaging**, including connected node positions displayed directly on maps.

## Included ELF applications

Tab5OS includes **11 ready-to-run ELF applications**, covering network diagnostics, utilities, games and retro emulation:

**Pentest** network diagnostics, **hash\_file** file-fingerprint example, **Doom**, **Maze3D**, and emulators for **Game Boy, Game Boy Color, NES, Sega 8-bit, Game Boy Advance, SNES and Mega Drive**.

These applications run as separate ELF programs, extending the system beyond its built-in firmware.

## Included Python applications

Ready-to-use **MicroPython applications** extend Tab5OS with IRC chat over TLS, Wikipedia browsing, library and project management, map and radio import tools, theme creation, SD repair and update utilities, and programming examples.

Additional compatible **ELF and MicroPython applications** can be installed on microSD or USB storage, allowing the software environment to grow independently of the main firmware.

## Installation and downloads

**For first installation:** Use the **M5Burner firmware image**, which replaces the device's internal Flash contents.

**For existing Tab5OS installations:** Use the **OTA firmware image through the Explorer** to update the system.

The complete **microSD package**, ELF and Python applications, additional resources, installation instructions and source code are available on GitHub.

**Project repository, downloads and documentation:**

**[GitHub — Belekos/Tab5OS](https://github.com/Belekos/Tab5OS)**

name: Talking Tom
description:
## Talking Tom for M5StickS3

Say something, and a cartoon character repeats it in a funny voice, moving its mouth and paws.

**Three characters.** The blue button (KEY1, under the screen) switches between them:

- **Cat**: a cartoon voice, like Talking Tom
- **Hippo**: a deep, gritty bass
- **Mouse**: a squeaky voice

**How to play**

1. Switch the StickS3 on with the side button: the Cat is listening.
2. Say a phrase. The character cups its ear while you speak and repeats the phrase as soon as you stop.
3. Press the blue button for the next character. The new one drops in from above.
4. After two minutes without a phrase the character gets sleepy, waves goodbye and the StickS3 powers off. Press the blue button while it waves to keep it on.

The pitch is shifted while the tempo stays about the same, so the voices sound like cartoons rather than a sped-up tape.

Source code: https://github.com/mbogatyr/M5TalkingTom

name: Tamagacha
description:
# Tamagacha

Discover and care for 200+ creatures on your
[M5 Stick S3](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/core/StickS3).

Press button A (on the front) to feed the creature.

Hold button B (on the right) and rotate the device to preview possible evolutions.
Release button B to make your choice.

## Make your own

Open the vault directory in [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md/). Edit the Lineages canvas.
This graph of images is the evolution tree. `base` is the starting state. You can replace
everything, or just make a few changes.

Once you're happy with the evolution tree, run all cells in `prep.ipynb`.
This generates `data/images.bin`.

Lastly, run "Upload Filesystem Image" and "Upload" in [PlatformIO](https://platformio.org/).
I've used the VS Code extension.

name: Tamagotcho
description:
**たまごっちょ (Tamagotcho)**: a 電子単語帳 (electronic flashcard book) for kanji. Multiple-choice reviews with spaced repetition, fully offline. One image for the **StickS3** and the **Cardputer ADV**: it finds the board at boot.

A new kanji is introduced first: its stroke order, meanings, readings and two example words. Then it is asked: pick its meaning or its reading from four options and answer. Spaced repetition (FSRS) decides when you see it again, and the wrong options are ones you could really confuse. Get one wrong and a card shows its meanings, readings and stroke order.

**Features**

- Kanji → meaning, kanji → reading, meaning → kanji
- Learning mode: each new kanji gets an intro card, then is asked again a few cards later
- Spaced repetition on the device, a daily cap of new cards
- Stroke order animated from KanjiVG on new kanji and after a mistake
- 12 free decks: JLPT N5 to N1 and the 2,136 Jōyō kanji, in English and Spanish, with example words, downloaded over Wi-Fi
- A web portal on your phone: decks, statistics, uploads
- The real date from your phone or NTP; dims and sleeps to save the battery
- Screens in English or Spanish

**First start**

1. Choose the language.
2. Scan the QR code on the screen with your phone to join `Tamagotcho-XXXX`, open the page, enter your home Wi-Fi and press **Switch to my Wi-Fi**.
3. Scan the new QR code and download a deck, e.g. JLPT N5.

**Controls**

- StickS3: tap the front button to move, **hold it to answer**; hold the side button for the settings, tap it to go back. On a new kanji's card, a side tap says you already know it.
- Cardputer ADV: `;` `.` `,` `/` (the arrows) move, **Enter answers**, Tab opens the settings, Esc goes back. On a new kanji's card, ← says you already know it.

Burning erases the settings (home Wi-Fi, preferences). Code MIT; decks CC BY-SA (KANJIDIC2, KanjiVG, JMdict). Source, manual and other boards: https://github.com/dcarnicer/tamagotcho

name: Tanooki Games Console for Cardputer ADV w external screen support
description:
Tanooki is a handheld games console originally for the S3, now ported to the Cardputer ADV. It currently features:
Maze Mouse! Rogue-lite mouse maze crawling action!
Bad Bug - Bloody arcade maze-muncher
Xenoflux - Plasma routing sim/evolution cycle manager
Bug Hunt - radar-based mutation containment simulator

For this port, buttonA is mapped to Enter/Ok, buttonB is mapped to backspace/delete.

Menu navigation operated with smooth tilt controls! ENJOY!
You'll also find switchable themes, a sound test, stats pages, and more. 
(the heartbeat lets you know it's working!)
***NEW***
Tanooki now supports an optional external ILI9341 2.4" SPI display connected through the Cardputer ADV's EXT 2.54-14P header. 
Pinout:
vcc = 5vin
gnd = gnd
cs = g5
reset = g13
dc = g15     
mosi = g14 
sck = g40
led = 5v out
When enabled, the game canvas is scaled from 240×135 to 320×180 using a fast nearest-neighbor integer scaler running over 40MHz SPI with DMA — filling the larger screen while maintaining crisp pixel art. The display mode is fully automatic: a persistent setting (default ON) controls whether the external screen is used, and a two-second audio-cued boot window lets you switch to the built-in display by pressing any key. The preference is saved to flash and survives reboots!
No hardware modifications are required beyond wiring a standard ILI9341 module to the EXT header with DuPont jumpers or a ribbon cable. The firmware handles SPI bus arbitration, display initialization ordering, and sprite memory management transparently — games don't need to know which display is active. The "Ext Display" toggle in Settings lets you switch modes at any time, with a reboot to apply.

(If you have no display, when loading for the first time you will hear some beeps, you have a few seconds to press any key and it will kill external screen init and pass on to built-in display. Built-in display will then be the default screen unless you enable the external screen again in settings.)

name: Tetrimino Space Invaders Game - M5StickC Plus2
description:
TETRIMINO SPACE INVADERS!
 v1.2
**Requires Mini JoyC Hat**
💥 Particle explosion system - Colorful particles on every hit
🎯 Individual block destruction - Shoot enemies one block at a time
🎨 Random enemy positioning - Organic, scattered formations
💀 Death animations - Player explodes into particles when hit
⏱️ Respawn delay - 2.5 second visual explosion before respawning
🎮 Bottom border - Clean visual floor at screen bottom
✨ Polish - Fixed pixel artifacts and visual glitches

-Game Features
Core Gameplay
Classic Space Invaders with Tetris theme
T-piece player ship at bottom
Enemy formation of small Tetrimino pieces (9×4 grid)
Vertical shooting mechanic
3 lives to start (max 5 with bonuses)
Progressive Difficulty
Wave 1: No enemy shooting, slow movement (800ms delay)
Wave 2: Light enemy shooting (30% chance), faster (750ms)
Wave 3-4: Moderate shooting (50% chance), faster (700-650ms)
Wave 5+: Heavy shooting (80% chance), very fast (600ms+)

-Scoring System
10 points per enemy destroyed
100 points per wave completed
Bonus life every 1000 points (max 5 lives)
Controls
Joystick Left/Right: Move ship horizontally
Joystick Button: Shoot projectile upward
Right Button -Toggle God Mode (invincibility)
M5 - Restart game (when game over)
Enemy Shooting System
Starts at Wave 2
Only frontmost enemies in each column can shoot
Red bullets travel downward
Frequency increases with wave number -射击间隔: 2 seconds minimum between shots
Visual Indicators
Lives: Red squares at top right
Wave: Top left (W#)
Score: Top center (S:#)
God Mode: Yellow bar below HUD
Enemy Alert: Red "!" when enemies can shoot (Wave 2+)
Bonus Life: Green "BONUS LIFE!" message appears (2 seconds)

Based on 1978 Space Invaders by Midway Manufacturing

name: The Tithe
description:
The Tithe is a go-outside roguelike for the Cardputer, inspired by Balatro. Every WiFi router around you is a well. You walk up to one, draw its energy and offer it at another, and the relics you collect change what each offering is worth. Each Night has a Tithe to pay, and seven Nights make a week.

It only listens, so it runs passive scans, never sends anything, and hashes network names on the device. You don't need an account or a WiFi password.

**Installing:** the easiest way is M5Launcher. Copy `Tithe-v0.6.1.bin` from the GitHub release to your SD card's `/downloads` folder and pick it in the launcher, so nothing else on your Cardputer is touched. Burning it from M5Burner writes the full image and replaces everything on the device, Launcher included.

Source, releases and the 62-page manual: https://github.com/the-tithe/the-tithe

Website: https://the-tithe-game.vercel.app

name: The USB of bable
description:
A flash drive that holds every possible file. Based on p2r3's babel-usb, with a new animated GUI.

Plug the Cardputer into a computer and it shows up as an MTP drive called **USB of Babel**. Its folders go on forever. Every folder holds one `file`, and that file's contents are spelled out by the path you took to reach it. Every photo, song and document is in there somewhere.

**The Air Shaft screen:** you look straight down a shaft in Borges' library, and each floor is a folder. As your computer browses, the folder names lock into place and the path builds up at the bottom of the screen. When the computer reads `file`, a book rises and opens: raw bytes on the left page, text on the right. Tilt the Cardputer and the view tilts too. With no computer connected, you fall through the library by lantern light.

**Find any file:** type its contents on the keyboard. The shaft dives to the right folder and shows the path to browse to on your computer.

**Keys**
- Type: look up a file by its contents
- `del`: back one folder, or delete a character
- `enter` / G0 button: open or close the book
- `tab`: back to the root
- `fn` + `;` / `fn` + `.`: brightness up / down
- `opt`: switch folder names between Babel-70 and hex (while unplugged)
- `alt`: show frame rate and free memory

**Hosts:** Windows and Linux (GNOME Files, Dolphin) open the drive directly. macOS needs OpenMTP or Android File Transfer.

Unlike the original, browsing back up gives the right file, and every file can be reached by some path.

Based on p2r3/babel-usb (PortalRunner, "This Flash Drive has Literally Every File"). MIT license.

name: Threads Extender
description:
Open-source firmware turning the ultra-compact **M5Stack M5NanoC6** (ESP32-C6FH4) development board into a high-performance **Thread Range Extender / Router (Full Thread Device - FTD)**.

Ideal for expanding IEEE 802.15.4 mesh coverage for **Matter over Thread** and native Thread networks across your smart home, eliminating dead zones and boosting connectivity for Thread Border Routers such as Home Assistant (OpenThread Border Router - OTBR), Apple Home (HomePod / Apple TV), and Google Home (Nest Hub).

### ✨ Features
- 🌐 **True Thread Router (FTD):** Full Thread Device routing mesh traffic at the IEEE 802.15.4 IPv6 layer, forwarding frames and supporting child end devices (Sleepy End Devices).
- 💾 **Persistent NVS Storage:** Thread active operational datasets are automatically saved to non-volatile storage (NVS), enabling instant, seamless reconnection after power cycles.
- 💡 **Dual LED State Machine:**
  - **Searching / Detached:** Flashing blue every 1s (500ms ON / 500ms OFF).
  - **Connected:** Solid blue for 2s, followed by solid green for 3s, then fully off.
  - **Discrete Normal Operation:** LEDs remain completely OFF during routing operation to eliminate ambient light in bedrooms or living spaces.
- 🔘 **Multi-Function Button (GPIO 9):**
  - **Quick Click (< 1s):** Triggers an immediate mesh diagnostic and telemetry report over Serial with a rapid green confirmation pulse (250ms).
  - **Long Press (5s):** Clears Thread dataset from NVS, performs an OpenThread factory reset, and reboots in pairing/unconfigured mode (solid red LED for 1s).
- 💻 **Interactive OpenThread CLI (USB CDC):** Built-in serial console on the native USB port at 115200 bps for easy configuration, inspection, and network management.
- 💓 **Periodic Mesh Heartbeat (60s):** Automatically logs network role, RLOC16, channel, and PAN ID every 60s to monitor mesh vitality.

name: Three-Body Problem
description:
A cosmos in your palm — stars dance, trails fade, the universe breathes. But listen. In the deep silence of the night, when the room is dark and your eyes have grown accustomed to the drifting constellations, a faint signal emerges from the tiny speaker. A warning, crossing light-years. You thought you were watching chaos. But chaos was watching you.

掌中宇宙，星移斗转，尾迹如烟。 但且静听。 夜深人静之时，灯熄室暗之后，当你的目光已随星云飘荡许久—— 那微弱的扬声器里，传来一个信号。 跨越光年的警告。 你以为你在欣赏混沌。 但混沌，也在注视着你。（有彩蛋哦）

A living universe on a 135×240 screen. Three stars dance under gravity — their trajectories traced in glowing, fading dots through 3D space. Watch them orbit, collide, and fling each other across the void.

Place it on your desk. After 15 seconds of stillness, it enters **Auto-Demo mode** — the camera drifts, tracking targets cycle randomly, presets shuffle, zoom breathes, and the simulation speeds up and slows down like a living organism. It runs forever, never repeating the same view twice.

Interactive when you want it. Self-playing when you don't.


在 135×240 的小屏幕上，运行着一个活的宇宙。三颗星体在引力中起舞——发光渐隐的尾迹在 3D 空间中划出轨迹。时而优雅盘旋，时而混沌弹射。

放桌上，15 秒静止后进入**自动演示模式**——相机漂移、跟踪随机切换、预设轮换、缩放呼吸、速度忽快忽慢……它自己演出一场永远不会重复的宇宙芭蕾。

| **Camera drift** — smooth random sway, like a floating observer | **相机漂移** — 平滑随机摇摆，如同漂浮的观察者 |
| **Bullet-time** — sim speed varies 0.7x–1.5x in demo mode | **子弹时间** — 演示模式速度 0.7x~1.5x 缓慢变化 |

| **Depth rendering** — bodies glow brighter when closer, trails fade with depth | **深度渲染** — 星体近亮远暗，尾迹随深度衰减 |
| **6 presets** — Lagrange, Asym, Pytha, Escape, Random, Binary | **6 种预设** — 拉格朗日、非对称、毕达哥拉斯、逃逸、随机、双星 |
| **4 tracking modes** — center of mass or any individual star | **4 种跟踪** — 质心或任一新星体 |
| **3 zoom levels** — 1.2x / 1.0x / 0.5x | **3 档缩放** — 1.2x / 1.0x / 0.5x |
| **IMU view control** — tilt the device to rotate the cosmos | **IMU 视角** — 倾斜板子旋转视角 |
| **Energy display** — real-time system energy on HUD | **能量指示** — HUD 实时显示系统总能量 |
| **800-point trails** — dot-based, fade gradually, never tangle | **800 点尾迹** — 点状渲染、渐变消失、永不缠绕 |

| | Long hold | Pause / Resume |
| **Key2 (BtnB)** | Short press | Cycle preset (6 total) |

放桌上，15 秒静止后进入**自动演示模式**——相机漂移、跟踪随机切换、预设轮换、缩放呼吸、速度忽快忽慢……它自己演出一场永远不会重复的宇宙芭蕾。

想玩就上手，不想动就看着它。

| **Auto-Demo** — idle 15s → cosmic screensaver mode, never repeats | **自动演示** — 15s 空闲 → 宇宙屏保模式，永不重复 |
| **Camera drift** — smooth random sway, like a floating observer | **相机漂移** — 平滑随机摇摆，如同漂浮的观察者 |
| **Bullet-time** — sim speed varies 0.7x–1.5x in demo mode | **子弹时间** — 演示模式速度 0.7x~1.5x 缓慢变化 |
| **Three star layers** — 250 bright stars + 100 distant dim stars + 6 nebula clouds | **三层星场** — 250 亮星 + 100 深空暗星 + 6 片星云 |
| **Depth rendering** — bodies glow brighter when closer, trails fade with depth | **深度渲染** — 星体近亮远暗，尾迹随深度衰减 |
| **6 presets** — Lagrange, Asym, Pytha, Escape, Random, Binary | **6 种预设** — 拉格朗日、非对称、毕达哥拉斯、逃逸、随机、双星 |
| **4 tracking modes** — center of mass or any individual star | **4 种跟踪** — 质心或任一新星体 |
| **3 zoom levels** — 1.2x / 1.0x / 0.5x | **3 档缩放** — 1.2x / 1.0x / 0.5x |
| **IMU view control** — tilt the device to rotate the cosmos | **IMU 视角** — 倾斜板子旋转视角 |
| **Energy display** — real-time system energy on HUD | **能量指示** — HUD 实时显示系统总能量 |
| **800-point trails** — dot-based, fade gradually, never tangle | **800 点尾迹** — 点状渲染、渐变消失、永不缠绕 |

| Button | Action | Function |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Key1 (BtnA)** | Short press | Cycle camera: COM → ① → ② → ③ |
| | Long hold | Pause / Resume |
| **Key2 (BtnB)** | Short press | Cycle preset (6 total) |
| | Long hold | Cycle zoom: 1.2x → 1.0x → 0.5x |

64³ block window over an infinite world  ·  5 hostile + 3 passive mob types 8 climate biomes (plains/forest/desert/taiga/swamp/mountains/jungle/savanna) with tinted foliage desert temples + ziggurats with baked redstone arrow traps and high-tier loot cave lava (light source + animated + lethal) · water+lava → obsidian · gravel → flint · lit portals redstone circuits, TNT, dispensers, observers, pistons, doors, ladders, trapdoors · giant boss spider furnaces + chests with rarity-tiered loot  ·  full chest + furnace persistence across saves 6 control schemes incl. d-pad-walk + double-tap-hold reverse  ·  4-slot save + screenshot picker Debussy Clair de Lune soundtrack — random key each loop, pitch sliding toward bright in caves drifting clouds · flash-backed worlds

A native ESP-IDF firmware port for the M5Stack Cardputer (ESP32-S3). 

The Cardputer has no d-pad, so the keyboard maps onto the console control scheme — the d-pad walks and turns, and holding B switches it to look:

```
S       move / turn — inverted T at the bottom-left
Alt Z X
Enter       jump
L or A      mine / attack
' or D      place / use
; , . /     look around (arrow-legend cluster)
[ / ]       strafe left / right
Left-Shift  look modifier (hold)
`           menu
1-8         select hotbar slot
\ / Tab     previous / next hotbar slot
```

name: TianJi 天机
description:
**天机 TianJi** —— M5Stack Cardputer ADV 掌上固件，开源（MIT）。
余生倒计时 · 小六壬 · 求签 · 掷筊 · 3D 骰子与硬币 · SD 卡长录音 · 番茄钟 · Kindle 翻页器

源码、截图与技术笔记：https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer

## 首次使用

1. 首页按 **T** 设置日期时间，按 **S** 进设置填写**生日**。
2. Cardputer 没有断电保持的时钟：不用时请**长按 G0 进入待机**，不要拨开关断电。待机时时钟继续走，按任意键或 G0 唤醒。
3. 真断电后首页会出现「时间待校准」提示，按 **T** 校准；填了 WiFi 的话，断电后开机会自动联网校时（待机唤醒不会联网）。
4. 录音和番茄钟统计需要一张 **FAT32** 格式的 SD 卡。

## 通用按键

- **方向键**：键盘上的 `;`（上）、`.`（下）、`,`（左）、`/`（右）。在输入文字的状态下，需要按住 **Fn** 再按。
- **Esc**：左上角的 `` ` `` 键。**Esc** 或 **退格键（Del）** 都能从任意页面回到首页。
- **Enter** 确认，**空格** 开始或执行。
- 屏幕熄灭时，按第一下只会点亮屏幕，不会触发操作（翻页器页面除外）。

## 全局快捷键（任意页面都有效）

- **短按 G0** 或 **Ctrl+R**：一键开始录音，再按一次停止
- **长按 G0 约 1.5 秒**：进入待机（屏幕中间出现一圈进度，满了即待机）；按任意键或 G0 唤醒；番茄钟计时中不能待机
- **Fn+1 / Fn+2 / Fn+3**：直接用对应预设开始录音（随手录 / 长时录音 / 高保真 44.1kHz）

## 首页 · 余生

- 方向键、Enter、Tab 或空格：打开底部应用栏；←→（或 Tab）切换，Enter 或空格打开，Esc 收起
- 字母键直达：**L** 小六壬　**Q** 求签　**J** 掷筊　**D** 骰子　**C** 硬币　**R** 录音　**F** 录音库　**P** 番茄钟　**K** 翻页器　**S** 设置
- 数字 **1–9**：按应用栏顺序直接打开
- **U**：进入 U 盘模式
- **T**：校准时间（←→ 选择年 / 月 / 日 / 时 / 分，↑↓ 调整，按住 Shift 一次 10，也可以直接输入数字；Enter 确认，**W** 联网校时，Esc 取消）

## 小六壬

- **空格**：时辰起课（自动取当前农历月、日、时辰）
- **Tab**：切换「时辰起课 / 报数起课」
- 报数起课：输入数字后按空格确认，共输入三个数；**退格键** 删除一位，没有可删的位时退回上一个数
- 出结果后按 **Enter** 看竖排诗诀，再按 Enter 或 Esc 返回
- 同一个时辰内，时辰起课的结果不变（传统算法）

## 求签 / 掷筊 / 骰子 / 硬币

- **按住空格（或 Enter）蓄力，松手投出**，蓄得越满投得越猛；轻点一下是轻抛
- 也可以直接**甩动设备**来摇签或投掷
- 求签：签落地后按 **Enter** 看详解（事业、财运、感情、健康、出行），再按 Enter 回到签文；**J** 接着掷筊请示；**空格** 重新求签
- 掷筊：圣杯（一平一凸）、笑杯（两平）、阴杯（两凸）；连得三次圣杯有特效
- 骰子：**1–6** 选择骰子个数，或用 **- / =** 增减
- 硬币：**C** 或 **0** 清零正反面计数

## 录音

- **↑↓** 或 **1–3** 选择预设，**Enter** 或空格开始录音
- 录音中：**空格** 暂停或继续，**M** 打标记，**Enter** 停止并保存
- 录音中按 Esc 回首页不会中断录音：首页会显示录音时长，其它页面右上角有红点提示
- 录音时屏幕自动调暗、熄屏省电（可在设置里调整）；按任意键点亮
- **F**：打开录音库
- 文件保存在 SD 卡 `/REC/`，按录制时间命名；长时间录音会自动分段续写

## 录音库

- **↑↓** 选择，**Enter** 或空格播放
- **D**：删除（连按两次确认，第一次按会出现红色提示）
- **R**：开始新录音，**U**：进入 U 盘模式
- 播放中：**空格 / Enter** 暂停或继续；**←→** 快退或快进 5 秒，按住 **Shift** 一次 30 秒；**- / =** 音量；**N / P** 跳到下一个或上一个标记；**Esc** 回到列表

## 番茄钟

- 列表：**↑↓** 选择，**Enter** 或空格开始
- **E** 编辑当前预设，**N** 新建（也可以选最后一行「+ 新建」），**D** 删除（连按两次确认）
- **Tab**：查看统计（今日分钟数、番茄个数、连续天数、近 7 天），再按 Tab 或 Esc 返回
- 编辑：**↑↓** 选择字段，**←→** 调整数值（按住 Shift 一次 ±5），在「名称」上按 **Enter** 输入名称（支持英文），Enter 或 Esc 保存
- 计时中：**空格 / Enter** 暂停或继续，**S** 跳过当前阶段，**X**（或退格键）连按两次结束
- 计时中按 Esc 回首页，计时继续在后台进行，首页会显示进度
- 专注结束会自动开始休息；休息结束后按空格开始下一轮，在设置里打开「番茄钟自动开始」则会自动开始
- 专注记录保存在 SD 卡 `/POMO/focus.csv`

## Kindle 翻页器（实验性）

- 首次配对：在 Kindle 上打开「设置 › 蓝牙设备」，选择 **TianJi Click**
- **→ ↓ 空格 Enter N**：下一页　**← ↑ B**：上一页
- **- / =**：Kindle 亮度
- **Z**：让 Kindle 休眠
- **F**：清除配对（连按两次确认，Kindle 上也要「忘记设备」）
- 看书时屏幕 20 秒后自动熄灭，熄屏状态下按键照样能翻页
- 蓝牙只在这个页面里开启，离开后自动关闭；录音时不可用
- 尚未在真机 Kindle 上验证，欢迎反馈

## U 盘模式

- 插上电脑会弹出 3 秒倒计时，按任意键取消；倒计时结束后，SD 卡会作为 U 盘出现在电脑上
- 在电脑上推出 U 盘或拔掉数据线，设备会自动回到正常模式
- 想手动退出：连按两次 **Esc**
- 也可以在首页按 **U** 或在设置里手动进入；「插电自动U盘」可以在设置里关闭

## 设置

- **↑↓** 选择，**←→** 调整数值或开关，**Enter** 编辑文字项
- 编辑文字时：直接输入，**退格键** 删除，**Enter** 确认，**Fn+`** 取消
- 「日期时间」按 Enter 打开时间校准界面（操作同首页 T）
- 可设置：生日、预期寿命、日期时间、WiFi、自动校时（关闭 / 断电后 / 每天）、校时后关 WiFi、时区、亮度、音量、音效、录音采样率、录音增益、录音调暗与熄屏、专注熄屏、番茄钟自动开始、蓝牙翻页器开关、插电自动 U 盘、进入待机
- 关闭「蓝牙翻页器」后会重启一次，把蓝牙预留的内存释放给其它功能，也更省电

---

TianJi: life countdown, Chinese divination toys, 3D dice & coin, SD voice recorder, pomodoro timer and a Kindle page turner for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV. Full key reference, source and notes: https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer (MIT).
author: Wenston

warnings: Data partition 'spiffs' (spiffs) has no content; copy_size set to 0.

description_en:
**TianJi**——M5Stack Cardputer ADV handheld firmware, open source (MIT).
Countdown to the rest of life · Xiao Liuren · Asking for lots · Throwing dice · 3D dice and coins · SD card long recording · Pomodoro · Kindle page turner

Source code, screenshots and technical notes: https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer

## First time use

1. Press **T** on the homepage to set the date and time, press **S** to enter the settings and fill in the **birthday**.
2. Cardputer does not have a clock that is maintained when powered off: When not in use, please **press and hold G0 to enter standby** and do not turn the switch to power off. The clock continues to run during standby, press any key or G0 to wake up.
3. After a real power outage, a "Time to be calibrated" prompt will appear on the homepage, press **T** to calibrate; if WiFi is filled in, it will automatically connect to the Internet to calibrate the time after a power outage (it will not connect to the Internet when waking up from standby).
4. Recording and Pomodoro statistics require an SD card in **FAT32** format.

## General keys

- **Direction keys**: `;` (up), `.` (down), `,` (left), `/` (right) on the keyboard. While entering text, you need to hold down **Fn** and then press it.
- **Esc**: `` `` `` key in the upper left corner. **Esc** or **Backspace (Del)** can return to the homepage from any page.
- **Enter** to confirm, **Space** to start or execute.
- When the screen is off, pressing it for the first time will only light up the screen and will not trigger operations (except page turner pages).

## Global shortcut keys (valid on any page)

- **Short press G0** or **Ctrl+R**: Start recording with one click, press again to stop
- **Press and hold G0 for about 1.5 seconds**: enter standby (a circle of progress appears in the middle of the screen, and when it is full, it is standby); press any key or G0 to wake up; cannot standby during Pomodoro timer
- **Fn+1 / Fn+2 / Fn+3**: Start recording directly with the corresponding preset (random recording / long-term recording / high-fidelity 44.1kHz)

## Home · The rest of your life

- Arrow keys, Enter, Tab or Space: open the bottom app bar; ←→ (or Tab) switches, Enter or Space opens, Esc closes
- Direct access to the letter keys: **L** Xiao Liuren **Q** Asking for lots **J** Throwing dice **D** Dice **C** Coin **R** Recording **F** Recording library **P** Pomodoro **K** Page turner **S** Settings
- Numbers **1–9**: Open directly in the order of the app bar
- **U**: Enter U disk mode
- **T**: Calibration time (←→ select year/month/day/hour/minute, ↑↓ to adjust, hold down Shift once 10, you can also enter numbers directly; Enter to confirm, **W** to online time calibration, Esc to cancel)

## Xiao Liuren

- **Space**: Time to start class (automatically takes the current lunar month, day, and time)
- **Tab**: Switch between "Time to start class/Time to start class"
- Start the lesson by reporting numbers: After entering the number, press space to confirm. Enter three numbers in total; **Backspace key** deletes one digit, and returns to the previous number if there is no digit to be deleted.
- After the results are displayed, press **Enter** to see the vertical poem, and then press Enter or Esc to return.
- Within the same hour, the result of starting class at that hour remains unchanged (traditional algorithm)

## Asking for lots / throwing dice / dice / coins

- **Hold the space (or Enter) to charge, then release to throw**. The fuller the charge, the harder the throw; tap once to throw lightly.
- You can also directly **swing the device** to draw or throw
- Requesting a signature: After signing, press **Enter** to see detailed explanations (career, wealth, relationship, health, travel), and then press Enter to return to the signature; **J** then throw the fork to ask for instructions; **Space** to request a signature again
- Toss: Holy Grail (one flat and one convex), Laughing Cup (two flat), Yin Cup (two convex); winning the Holy Cup three times in a row has special effects
- Dice: **1–6** Select the number of dice, or use **- / =** to increase or decrease
- Coin: **C** or **0** clear heads and tails count

## Recording

- **↑↓** or **1–3** Select preset, **Enter** or space to start recording
- Recording: **Space** to pause or continue, **M** to mark, **Enter** to stop and save
- Pressing Esc to return to the homepage during recording will not interrupt the recording: the recording duration will be displayed on the homepage, and there will be a red dot in the upper right corner of other pages.
- The screen automatically dims and turns off during recording to save power (can be adjusted in settings); press any key to light up
- **F**: Open the recording library
- The file is saved in SD card `/REC/` and named according to the recording time; long-term recording will be automatically continued in segments

## Recording library

- **↑↓** Select, **Enter** or space to play
- **D**: Delete (click twice to confirm, a red prompt will appear when you press the first time)
- **R**: Start a new recording, **U**: Enter U disk mode
- Playing: **Space / Enter** to pause or continue; **←→** to rewind or forward 5 seconds, hold **Shift** once for 30 seconds; **- / =** volume; **N / P** to jump to the next or previous mark; **Esc** to return to the list

## Pomodoro

- List: **↑↓** selection, **Enter** or space start
- **E** edit the current preset, **N** create new (you can also select the last line "+ New"), **D** delete (click twice to confirm)
- **Tab**: View statistics (today’s minutes, number of tomatoes, consecutive days, last 7 days), and then press Tab or Esc to return
- Edit: **↑↓** select the field, **←→** adjust the value (hold Shift once ±5), press **Enter** on "Name" to enter the name (English supported), Enter or Esc to save
- Timing: **Space/Enter** to pause or continue, **S** to skip the current stage, **X** (or backspace key) to press twice to end
- Press Esc to return to the home page during timing. The timing will continue in the background and the progress will be displayed on the home page.
- Rest will automatically start when concentration is over; after the rest, press space to start the next round, and turn on "Pomodoro Automatic Start" in the settings to start automatically
- Focus records are saved in SD card `/POMO/focus.csv`

## Kindle page turner (experimental)

- First time pairing: Open "Settings › Bluetooth Devices" on Kindle and select **TianJi Click**
- **→ ↓ Space Enter N**: Next page **← ↑ B**: Previous page
- **- / =**: Kindle brightness
- **Z**: Put Kindle to sleep
- **F**: Clear pairing (click twice to confirm, also "forget device" on Kindle)
- When reading a book, the screen will automatically turn off after 20 seconds. You can still turn pages by pressing the buttons when the screen is off.
- Bluetooth is only turned on in this page and will be turned off automatically after leaving; it is not available during recording
- Not yet verified on a real Kindle, feedback is welcome

## USB disk mode

- When plugged into the computer, a 3-second countdown will pop up. Press any key to cancel; after the countdown is over, the SD card will appear on the computer as a USB flash drive.
- Eject the USB flash drive or unplug the data cable from the computer, and the device will automatically return to normal mode
- To exit manually: Double-click **Esc**
- You can also press **U** on the homepage or enter manually in the settings; "Automatic U disk plug-in" can be turned off in the settings

## set up
- **↑↓** select, **←→** adjust values ​​or switches, **Enter** edit text items
- When editing text: Direct input, **Backspace** to delete, **Enter** to confirm, **Fn+`** to cancel
- Press Enter in "Date Time" to open the time calibration interface (the operation is the same as T on the home page)
- Configurable: birthday, life expectancy, date and time, WiFi, automatic time adjustment (off/after power off/every day), WiFi off after time adjustment, time zone, brightness, volume, sound effects, recording sampling rate, recording gain, recording dimming and screen off, focus screen off, Pomodoro automatic start, Bluetooth page turner switch, plug in automatic USB flash drive, enter standby
- After closing the "Bluetooth Page Turner", it will restart once, releasing the memory reserved by Bluetooth for other functions, and saving more power.

TianJi: life countdown, Chinese divination toys, 3D dice & coin, SD voice recorder, pomodoro timer and a Kindle page turner for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV. Full key reference, source and notes: https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer (MIT).
description_src:
**天机 TianJi** —— M5Stack Cardputer ADV 掌上固件，开源（MIT）。
余生倒计时 · 小六壬 · 求签 · 掷筊 · 3D 骰子与硬币 · SD 卡长录音 · 番茄钟 · Kindle 翻页器

源码、截图与技术笔记：https://github.com/Wenston-dev/tianji-cardputer

## 首次使用

1. 首页按 **T** 设置日期时间，按 **S** 进设置填写**生日**。
2. Cardputer 没有断电保持的时钟：不用时请**长按 G0 进入待机**，不要拨开关断电。待机时时钟继续走，按任意键或 G0 唤醒。
3. 真断电后首页会出现「时间待校准」提示，按 **T** 校准；填了 WiFi 的话，断电后开机会自动联网校时（待机唤醒不会联网）。
4. 录音和番茄钟统计需要一张 **FAT32** 格式的 SD 卡。

## 通用按键

- **方向键**：键盘上的 `;`（上）、`.`（下）、`,`（左）、`/`（右）。在输入文字的状态下，需要按住 **Fn** 再按。
- **Esc**：左上角的 `` ` `` 键。**Esc** 或 **退格键（Del）** 都能从任意页面回到首页。
- **Enter** 确认，**空格** 开始或执行。
- 屏幕熄灭时，按第一下只会点亮屏幕，不会触发操作（翻页器页面除外）。

## 全局快捷键（任意页面都有效）

- **短按 G0** 或 **Ctrl+R**：一键开始录音，再按一次停止
- **长按 G0 约 1.5 秒**：进入待机（屏幕中间出现一圈进度，满了即待机）；按任意键或 G0 唤醒；番茄钟计时中不能待机
- **Fn+1 / Fn+2 / Fn+3**：直接用对应预设开始录音（随手录 / 长时录音 / 高保真 44.1kHz）

## 首页 · 余生

- 方向键、Enter、Tab 或空格：打开底部应用栏；←→（或 Tab）切换，Enter 或空格打开，Esc 收起
- 字母键直达：**L** 小六壬　**Q** 求签　**J** 掷筊　**D** 骰子　**C** 硬币　**R** 录音　**F** 录音库　**P** 番茄钟　**K** 翻页器　**S** 设置
- 数字 **1–9**：按应用栏顺序直接打开
- **U**：进入 U 盘模式
- **T**：校准时间（←→ 选择年 / 月 / 日 / 时 / 分，↑↓ 调整，按住 Shift 一次 10，也可以直接输入数字；Enter 确认，**W** 联网校时，Esc 取消）

## 小六壬

- **空格**：时辰起课（自动取当前农历月、日、时辰）
- **Tab**：切换「时辰起课 / 报数起课」
- 报数起课：输入数字后按空格确认，共输入三个数；**退格键** 删除一位，没有可删的位时退回上一个数
- 出结果后按 **Enter** 看竖排诗诀，再按 Enter 或 Esc 返回
- 同一个时辰内，时辰起课的结果不变（传统算法）

## 求签 / 掷筊 / 骰子 / 硬币

- **按住空格（或 Enter）蓄力，松手投出**，蓄得越满投得越猛；轻点一下是轻抛
- 也可以直接**甩动设备**来摇签或投掷
- 求签：签落地后按 **Enter** 看详解（事业、财运、感情、健康、出行），再按 Enter 回到签文；**J** 接着掷筊请示；**空格** 重新求签
- 掷筊：圣杯（一平一凸）、笑杯（两平）、阴杯（两凸）；连得三次圣杯有特效
- 骰子：**1–6** 选择骰子个数，或用 **- / =** 增减
- 硬币：**C** 或 **0** 清零正反面计数

## 录音

- **↑↓** 或 **1–3** 选择预设，**Enter** 或空格开始录音
- 录音中：**空格** 暂停或继续，**M** 打标记，**Enter** 停止并保存
- 录音中按 Esc 回首页不会中断录音：首页会显示录音时长，其它页面右上角有红点提示
- 录音时屏幕自动调暗、熄屏省电（可在设置里调整）；按任意键点亮
- **F**：打开录音库
- 文件保存在 SD 卡 `/REC/`，按录制时间命名；长时间录音会自动分段续写

## 录音库

- **↑↓** 选择，**Enter** 或空格播放
- **D**：删除（连按两次确认，第一次按会出现红色提示）
- **R**：开始新录音，**U**：进入 U 盘模式
- 播放中：**空格 / Enter** 暂停或继续；**←→** 快退或快进 5 秒，按住 **Shift** 一次 30 秒；**- / =** 音量；**N / P** 跳到下一个或上一个标记；**Esc** 回到列表

## 番茄钟

- 列表：**↑↓** 选择，**Enter** 或空格开始
- **E** 编辑当前预设，**N** 新建（也可以选最后一行「+ 新建」），**D** 删除（连按两次确认）
- **Tab**：查看统计（今日分钟数、番茄个数、连续天数、近 7 天），再按 Tab 或 Esc 返回
- 编辑：**↑↓** 选择字段，**←→** 调整数值（按住 Shift 一次 ±5），在「名称」上按 **Enter** 输入名称（支持英文），Enter 或 Esc 保存
- 计时中：**空格 / Enter** 暂停或继续，**S** 跳过当前阶段，**X**（或退格键）连按两次结束
- 计时中按 Esc 回首页，计时继续在后台进行，首页会显示进度
- 专注结束会自动开始休息；休息结束后按空格开始下一轮，在设置里打开「番茄钟自动开始」则会自动开始
- 专注记录保存在 SD 卡 `/POMO/focus.csv`

## Kindle 翻页器（实验性）

- 首次配对：在 Kindle 上打开「设置 › 蓝牙设备」，选择 **TianJi Click**
- **→ ↓ 空格 Enter N**：下一页　**← ↑ B**：上一页
- **- / =**：Kindle 亮度
- **Z**：让 Kindle 休眠
- **F**：清除配对（连按两次确认，Kindle 上也要「忘记设备」）
- 看书时屏幕 20 秒后自动熄灭，熄屏状态下按键照样能翻页
- 蓝牙只在这个页面里开启，离开后自动关闭；录音时不可用
- 尚未在真机 Kindle 上验证，欢迎反馈

## U 盘模式

- 插上电脑会弹出 3 秒倒计时，按任意键取消；倒计时结束后，SD 卡会作为 U 盘出现在电脑上
- 在电脑上推出 U 盘或拔掉数据线，设备会自动回到正常模式
- 想手动退出：连按两次 **Esc**
- 也可以在首页按 **U** 或在设置里手动进入；「插电自动U盘」可以在设置里关闭

## 设置

- **↑↓** 选择，**←→** 调整数值或开关，**Enter** 编辑文字项
- 编辑文字时：直接输入，**退格键** 删除，**Enter** 确认，**Fn+`** 取消
- 「日期时间」按 Enter 打开时间校准界面（操作同首页 T）
- 可设置：生日、预期寿命、日期时间、WiFi、自动校时（关闭 / 断电后 / 每天）、校时后关 WiFi、时区、亮度、音量、音效、录音采样率、录音增益、录音调暗与熄屏、专注熄屏、番茄钟自动开始、蓝牙翻页器开关、插电自动 U 盘、进入待机
- 关闭「蓝牙翻页器」后会重启一次，把蓝牙预留的内存释放给其它功能，也更省电

---

name: Torta na Cara ADV
description:
Transforme seu M5Cardputer em um verdadeiro sistema de "Passa ou Repassa" / "Show do Milhão"! Este aplicativo é um jogo de trivia dinâmico que testa os reflexos e os conhecimentos dos jogadores. Ele já vem embarcado com um banco de dados de 100 perguntas divertidas (cultura pop, ciências, matemática básica e conhecimentos gerais) prontas para jogar, ideal para crianças e adolescentes.

O grande diferencial deste projeto é a sua flexibilidade de hardware: além de usar o próprio teclado do aparelho, você pode expandir o jogo conectando botões físicos de fliperama (estilo Arcade) diretamente nos pinos superiores da placa, criando uma experiência de competição real de palco.

Como Funciona a Dinâmica
O sistema é ultrarrápido e à prova de empates, desenhado para ser mediado por um "Apresentador" e disputado por dois Jogadores.

    A Tensão (Contagem Regressiva): Cada rodada começa com uma tela laranja e um cronômetro de 5 segundos, acompanhado de bipes sonoros, para que os jogadores posicionem as mãos nos botões.

    O Duelo (A Pergunta): Um apito longo soa e a pergunta sorteada surge na tela para leitura.

    O Buzzer (Trava de Reflexo): O primeiro jogador que apertar o seu botão aciona o alarme. O sistema trava instantaneamente o botão do adversário, ilumina a metade da tela do vencedor (Vermelho para o J1, Azul para o J2) e emite a sirene de parada.

    O Veredito (Revelação): O jogador dá a sua resposta em voz alta. O Apresentador aperta um botão secreto para exibir a resposta correta na tela e julga se o jogador pontua ou leva a "torta na cara".

    Reinicio: Com um simples comando, uma nova pergunta aleatória é puxada do banco de dados e o ciclo recomeça.

Mapeamento de Controles e Pinos Físicos

Controles do Apresentador:

    Tecla R: Revela a resposta correta após alguém bater no buzzer.

    Tecla ENTER: Inicia a próxima rodada com uma nova pergunta.

Controles do Jogador 1 (Lado Esquerdo - Cor Vermelha):

    Teclado: Tecla CTRL.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico entre o pino G5 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

Controles do Jogador 2 (Lado Direito - Cor Azul):

    Teclado: Tecla ESPAÇO.

    Hardware Externo (Opcional): Conecte um botão físico entre o pino G3 (Header superior) e qualquer pino GND.

name: TouchFish News
description:
# TouchFish News · PaperDIY

TouchFish News 是一个面向 M5Stack PaperDIY 的桌面新闻看板。它把新闻、极简的宠物互动、
农历和节假日信息集中显示在 4.7 英寸电子纸上，适合放在书桌、玄关或办公室，
作为低功耗的信息屏。


## 硬件

- M5Stack PaperDIY Complete Kit
- ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8
- 16 MB Flash，8 MB Octal PSRAM
- 4.7 英寸 960×540 灰度电子纸
- Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz
- 机身电源键
- KEY1：GPIO4
- KEY2：GPIO3

## 功能

- 新闻主题：财经、综合、科技、AI、体育、航天、国际和娱乐
- 新闻来源：
  - 华尔街见闻
  - 新浪财经
  - 东方财富
  - IT之家
  - 新浪娱乐
  - Wall Street Journal
  - Hacker News
  - ESPN
  - arXiv AI
  - NASA
- 新闻来源在独立页面中选择
- 来源切换前会实际联网抓取，网络失败时不会切换
- 新闻默认 10 分钟更新一次，可手动即时同步
- 宠物表情随日期、节假日、夜间和按键互动变化
- 公历、农历、节假日名称和倒计时
- 工作日上下班打卡提醒，可设置具体时间
- 手机扫码网页配网
- 支持 4 个屏幕方向，每次逆时针旋转 90°
- 横屏与竖屏独立布局
- 电子纸局部刷新，减少整屏闪烁和残影
- 固定使用 UTC+8

设备开机后先显示启动日志，依次检查 Wi-Fi、同步时间和网络数据，随后进入
宠物新闻看板。

看板按键：

- KEY1 短按：与宠物互动
- KEY1 长按：立即同步新闻和节假日
- KEY2 短按：打开设置

设置按键：

- KEY1 短按：光标上移
- KEY2 短按：光标下移
- KEY1 长按：确认当前选项
- KEY2 长按：返回上一级

## 首次配网

1. 在看板短按 KEY2 打开设置。
2. 移动到“Wi-Fi 网络”，长按 KEY1 确认。
3. 手机扫描屏幕二维码，加入 `InkPet-Paper-XXXX` 临时热点。
4. 在打开的网页中选择家庭 Wi-Fi 并输入密码。

```text

```
